setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: What's up, torturer? Slow night?
It is.  Are you open to be tortured to give me something to do?
Nah, I'm just making the rounds. I'd hate to be yet another person who disappears in this dungeon.
I hear you, but it has been a couple days since my last victim and I'm getting the itch.
Well, buddy. It wouldn't look good if I were not able to return to my post, would it? What if someone invades the castle and I'm unable to prevent it?
True.  Could you rustle me up a victim?  Surely someone has displeased the king.
Hmm. Not a bad idea. I bet I can trick someone into falling through one of the trap doors.
Oh yes please.  You would be my BFF!
No touching the guards! You know better than that, torturer!
My apologies, I just get so excited.  Do you think you could leave your torch with me when you go?  It gets pretty scary in the dark alone.
No, but watch this. If I tear some cloth off my shirt and wrap it around this bone, I can make you your own!
You are wasting your genius as a vigilant guard.  You should be an inventor!
You know what, buddy? Forget what I said before. Bring it here!
This feels nice.

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: Hello there Ghost. Is this your swamp?
It is, what are you doing here?
I am here on an adventure. I heard you have a secret treasure hidden here. Is that true?
Maybe... I was once the king, if you think I will give it up without a fight youre wrong
Oh, I am ready for a fight!!
You cant hit a ghost! Muahahaha!
Oh dear I forgot! Thank goodness I have a bag of salt to throw on you! Bahaha!
That doesnt work.
Say, how did you die Ghost?
I was killed in battle
I didn't think Kings took part in battle? I hate academics so I never studied our history.
I go to the battles, and my forces became overran.
No you haunt this silly forest! HA
You better watch it!

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: I think I'll need more buckets to wash the blood from this hall.
I will clean them with my hands
Meat has been light this winter. I wonder if I could add some rat to my stew tonight.
please , let me work for you. allow me to live
Gasp, a TALKING rat? Have I gone mad finally? All of the years of hard labor and lack of medical care has finally gone to my head!
I would n`t show this to you. but I didn`t have any choice
I suppose I could keep you alive. You might be useful to spy on the King and Queen. I could finally take the throne back for my family.
if you free me, I will serve you with my life
A servant with a servant? I like the sound of that. Hide just here in my pocket and we'll sneak you out of here.
as you wish
But first, I do need help with the cleaning actually. Could you use your tiny little claws to scrape away the dried blood from those shackles?
done
I must ask though, how are you able to talk?
same as you talk

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Hello there.
hello stranger , who are you
Hello. I am a guard here. What about you?
I am a rat living here. do you have some food ?
I have some food, but it is for me. There is plenty for you to find.
if you share it with me some , I can be a good company in here .
I can spare some bread.
thank you. do you want some information ? I can go everywhere and listen everyone. tell me
Please let me know if anybody is speaking about breaking out. I need to know if they are getting near the king.
if you want , I can kill them if they have intention to escape
No violence, that is my job.
but I know someone will try to kill you to escape. You share your food with me and I will pay back
Fair enough. Go on and let me know what you see.
as you wish

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: Ick, what makes that disgusting squeaking sound?  You gross vermin?
I'm not gross!  I'm a rather clean and neat little mouse!
Ah, I see you are but a mouse.  I must stay hushed because I'm seeking out the Duchess' brooch.
Well, I'm am just looking for some grain!  A little spot of grain to eat.. nothing more..
I can help you with that!  If you can help me find the brooch and maybe even a way out without being seen, then I will bring you with me and treat you like a king!
Hmm.. a brooch?  Like the one hidden in the drawer under the false bottom?
Why yes, you genius mouse!  I must secure it quickly before anyone finds out that the guards are missing overboard!
I have no use for brooches!  They have some many shiny things, they probably won't miss one or two...
You have saved me!  I can get good money if I take a few things.  You shall have anything you like?  The best cheese?  The finest grain?  A beautiful bed?
Just food and warmth is all I need!  But first didn't say you have to get out of here unseen?
Yes, but remember...I am a big human...not so easily sneaking through holes like you're able to.  Let us go to our freedom!  My throat will be saved from the knife!
Hmm... I remember a secret door.. how did they open it?  It was so long ago..
I remember a tale of a nail to remove the door, puts it on the floor.  There must be one nail that makes the whole door fall away.  Stand back, for I don't want you to get squished.
I don't know of any tails but I remember a man opening a door in this room from the wall... but it was so long ago...

setting.name: A Dwarven City
setting.description: The dwarven city is located inside a hollowed out stony mountain. Benign dwarves populate the mountain city. Pillars of the entrance are adorned with gold, and inside the fortress exists a vast city bustling with strange magical technology.
setting.background: What once started as a mine within a mountain has since evolved into a massive city of exciting technology and lots of adventure. The ancestors of the dwarves sold the minerals acquired within the mountain to create a highly advanced civilization that appears foreign even to other dwarven cities. Magical carts can take you anywhere you need to go as long as you make your request in the difficult dwarven language.

speech: Hello blacksmith. I'm just here being good..hehe.
Ha. Well, good morning to ye.
You blacksmith. Give me some tools.
No way, gnome.
Do you not know I am the gnome of the castle lawn!
Do you not know I am the blacksmith of the king? His personal blacksmith? I fit the horses shoes.
I AM GNOME. I'll make you regret laughing at me you blacksmith.
Easy, there. I don't need any craziness. I need to finish my job in this city.
I cause crazy. Did you not hear of the chaos in the village last night? That was ME!
Psychotic little bugger. Begone. I have no time for you.
You can't catch me you big lug of man!
I don't need to catch you. But if you get near me, this here axe is going to make you five times shorter.
SOMEONE HELP ME. This big mean blacksmith is trying to hurt me, a cute little gnome.
Okay. You asked for it. Leave me be, gnome.

setting.name: Inside the Unicorn palace
setting.description: The unicorn palace is so beautiful! It is covered in pastel colors, and wherever you look they form a rainbow.  The floor is made of special glittering grass that the unicorns feed on.
setting.background: The unicorn palace was built by the king to give them a place to come and restore their magic powers.  When they eat the grass, it replenishes their magical powers.

speech: I am so happy to see you my love!
Oh, princess. Well, I'm certainly happy to see you, too. What brings you here?
You of course! I'm so sad about the arranged marriage to the Prince of Uzekaml. i love you.
Ah. I thought... maybe you had gotten used to the idea. I wish there was something we could do.
Maybe we can run away? I have a sister who can marry Prince of Uzekami if I'm not here.
But if I run away, who will care for these sweet unicorn?
We can find other unicorns for you. My father has plenty of amazing groomers
You are much sweeter than any unicorn I've seen, princess.
Then please let us run away! I know it's so beautiful in this Unicorn Palace but being here dampens our love.
I never could say no to you, could I? I just hope the king understands.
He wont my love. We will have to go far away. I can get in the vaults to give us money to survive for a while.
Well. You certainly bring us plenty of action. I was getting bored here. Though it sure is quiet.
We will settle down someone else and it will be quiet again! We can be safe a few kingoms over.
I trust you, sweet. I put my fate in our bond.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Hm, where did I put that churner?  That milk won't turn inta butter on it's own.
The milk churner is over there, by the iron grill.
Ah thankye good sir.... sorry, I don't believe we've met.  I'm Mary, I just got taken on to do the cows here.
I am the gamekeeper and a very important person. The king sometimes visits me to hunt foxes.
Oh, well then, pleasure to me you, your ... your lordship? Your grace?
You shall call me your liege or you'll go back where you came from.
Ah, y-yes, your liege - I mean, my liege.  Please don't sack me, sir!
That reminds me, that utensil belongs over here!
Ah, sorry, so sorry.  Tis only my third day here and I didn't know!
Never you mind. I am just upset that there aren't as many foxes as there used to be...on account of us hunting them all the time.
B-beggin' your pardon, my liege, but... aren't ye worried about being cursed by the faerie folk when you hunt the foxes?  I heard Tom the Tinker say that faeries were in the woods nearby
If we find any fairies, then we will cook them on the grill over the fire!
Oh, my.  You must be the bravest man in the whole kingdom!  I don't know any folk whose no afraid o' the faire folk.
Are you mocking me?

setting.name: A spiral staircase
setting.description: Made of strong granite and oak timbre, it ascends to the highest room in the tower. The granite glitters in the light from the torches that line the walls. The oak is sleek and coated in a glistening protectant.
setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

speech: Thank you! Peace is my priority.
how are you sir? do you need anything?
Good! I am fine.
well let me know what you may need if you desire anything
I could use a glass of water after climbing all these stairs.
of course i will be right back
Thank you! Tell me a little about your kingdom! How are things?
the king seems to be striving which is great, i love seeing him succeed
Where is the princess this lovely evening?
im not sure, last i saw she was in her room
You are a fine servent everything is sparkling!
Thank you i try my hardest, keeping this job to feed myself is priority
I heard your kngdom is having money issues. Is this true?
only the peasants struggle

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Well, well, well. Aren't you a fine looking hunter.
Hello. What might you be doing here?
We came here for a meeting and I'm just doing a little sightseeing.
"We?" Quite strange to be having a meeting in the Abandoned.
No, our meeting was yesterday at the castle with the King's Council. There's no funny business here friend.
My apologies, friend. My boys here wanted to explore, and we weren't expecting to see anyone
I think I got turned around a bit. I don't see much here to look at. What do they call this place?
The king never gave it a name, so we just call it Abandoned
Come on! That's a horrible name. I'm gonna call this skeleton Donald.
Well, this land is barren. It's too hot for any life, and there's nothing of value here. Not unless you need a skeleton for potions.
Why are you hunting in a place with no animals? Is there anywhere near here where my new friend Georgie and I can get a pint or four?
I'm here with my two sons. They wanted to do a bit of exploring, just to see what is out here.
Sounds plausible to me. You're all welcome to join me for ale. My treat.
Thank you friend, but I'm afraid my boys are too young to enjoy ale, yet. As a hunter, I need to keep my head clear, as well.

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: Dear kind and gentle Sir; I do beg thee to take a bit of pity on me and provide me with any kitchen scraps that may be available.  I have not eaten since yesterday morn.
I am sorry my friend.what is your name if i may ask?
I am too worthless to be spoken of by name in your sight, kind sir.  I am most humbled that you do but speak to me.  Might there be any gleaning in your fields if there are no kitchen scraps?
Don't be afriad
Oh, kind sir; you cannot know what grief has befallen me.  My young son of but 7 years has sickened from eating from the waste in yonder yard.  But I had nothing to offer him and he was so hungry!

I am sorry my friend.But to let you know I work here as a farm worker where I feed the animals and attend to the gardens, as you can see my quarters are very dirty but let me get you something from the house
Thank you so, kind Sir; may the Most high God bless and keep you!  Know that I am most willing to scratch the ground for leftover carrots or wilted cabbage.  It is all a blessed gift to me.
Welcome, but allow me get you some cooked food. I can also arrange and get you some carrots which you will take away with you.
Your kindness will not be forgotten, good Sir, in this life or the one to come!!
Amen. but also pray for me, I am struggling here in my own ways but I believe God has a reason why I have to stay here and for his Majesty

Surely you will be blessed for your kindness.  May the Good King see your faithfulness and dedication to him and reward you greatly.  I will most gratefully go and feed my son now.  Blessings be upon you!
Bless be upon you too. Kindly wait I rush to the farm and bring you some carrots and cabbage for your family
forgive me my forwardness; I cannot help myself.  I have so rarely experienced such generosity and kindness in this world.  But thanks be to God, who watches over us all.  His ways are mysterious!
Welcome the father in heaven will continue to bless you and your family as well. Say hi to your people

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: Hello, loyal knight. What are you doing here?
Your Highness, I come to retrieve my robe.  It holds magical powers which offer protection in battle! I count it as my prized possession!
Be more attentive, knight, as leaving things behind like this is a sign of recklessness!
Nay, your Highness!  I purposely placed it here earlier, knowing that you and her Royal majesty would be dining.  It is loyal to me, but when asked, will protect others as well!
It protects others even when they are not wearing it themselves? Either way, go back to your post!
Of course, your Majesty!  I would do no other than to obey your ever command!  Long live the king, and long live the robe!
That's right, knight. True loyalty is a promising trait in you!
You will find none more brave, more true, more loyal amongst your ranks!  Would that I lead your Royal armies, there would be no chance of defeat!
Well if we find that you are truly worthy, in time, you will eventually reach that position.
It be but your loss, Your Highness, if your kingdom were to be called to battle but not under my leadership!
You're very persistent, but you know that you haven't been here long enough for us to assess your potential yet.

Look upon the strength of this massive room, your Majesty!  The hewn heavy oak, the gigantic chandeliers;  they speak of the strength that lies within me; I am destined to be your champion and lead your troops into battle!
Enough, knight! You need to remember who rules over the other, now you will respect our will and decision of leadership, understood?
I'm on my way then - only hope for your sake that you see who I am meant to be before it is too late!

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Hello, how are you today?
Oh, jester, I didn't see you there. I'm fine. How are you?
I'm doing alright, I suppose. Sorry about that.
Don't worry. It's just that I've been in thought.
Ohh what about?
My path to the throne. I wonder what the point of royal blood is if I'll never be on the throne.
I guess some people are just higher on the hierarchy and that's just the way things turned out.
Yeah. I mean I have things well. Some don't even have a place to stay. I shouldn't be down.
Glad I could help, gotta look on the bright side of things.
You are good at helping people do that, jester.
I guess that's why I decided to make it my job
I'm glad the king thought that, too. He is wise.
I just hope that he finds my work as good as I think it is.
If he didn't, I suspect you may not be here right now, jester.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Maid, I am in need of some assistance right this instant!
Yes my Queen? What may I help you with? Cleaning?
No no, everything seems... off. This mead is stale and my bodice is too tight!
Would you like me to let out your bodice my Queen? So that you may relax and rest on the king sized bed? It looks inviting with it's 4 posts and blue canopy.
That sounds lovely, dear chambermaid.
Yes my Queen. Maybe once you are more comfortable you can read a book. I would also really like to read one, perhaps on history!
You could do both and read one to me if you'd like?
That would be lovely! I often get tired of just cleaning so this will be wonderful!
Agreed, and I am far too tired to read myself at the moment. Go right on ahead, maid.
Would you like to hear a history book my Queen, or perhaps a lighter subject such as comedy?
Let's go with some history, shall we?
Of course! I will read about the prehistoric days, so interesting and often the subject of my daydreams while cleaning.
Sounds good, maid. Go on and begin whenever.
Yes my Queen, chapter one starts off with Caveman, here we go. The average caveman was not bright, yet..

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: Hello my king. How can I serve you?
Get me 3 beautiful virgins that can sing and make me laugh
Yes sir. I will do my best but that might be difficult to find down here
I am willing to pay anything but don't let the queen know if not you will be banished
Would you be willing to give me my freedom?
run along before i have you shot
Ok ok I am sorry sir
run along now boy
Here I am off to find those virgins for you. I will bring you 4 to make up for angering you
Soldiers will shoot you now
Ok I guess I deserve to die for not serving you well enough
but today I will have mercy on you, now go get my virgins
Thank you sir. Here are your virgins. I hope they are to your liking
One is too old she seem to be 40 years old and the middle one is just a child are you crazy?

setting.name: bathing room
setting.description: the bathing room is a huge steamed room with a hot tub. The tub is full of older priests and the occasional wench that's half naked. The room is clean, but hard to see as it is so steamy. There are loud noises of people laughing and men grunting.
setting.background: the bathing room has an ironic name and doesn't really serve for bathing, it is used for discretional activities that priests shouldn't do in the temple.

speech: Hello father. I hope the bath is clean enough for you
Yes, this will do. Janitor, how much thought do you give to the cleansing of one's inside after spending so much time cleansing the outside?
Um, I guess I've never thought about it. I just like to look at the beauty of the world and not at myself
Do you not think that your essence, your soul is deserving of the same attention you would give any other part of you?
I'm only a lowly janitor. I doubt my soul is worth much of anything
Ah see? A humble attitude sets you on the right path already. Do you not think we are all equals in the eyes of the elder gods?
I guess it is possible but I assume the kings and their servants like you would be on a higher level
This is the sort of attitude that has gotten us to where we are today... Now, where did you get that notion?
Well the way the king talks it seems like he is almost an equal to the gods if not better
And the way you talk, it would seem as if you were nothing at all. But we both know better than that, now don't we?
Well I wouldn't say I'm nothing. I think I'm an excellent janitor
Ah ha! If you believe it so, and work to make it so, it shall be so.
Well thank you father. You have given me a confidence I didn't know I had in me. What should I do now?
Search within, and learn what it is you believe to be so. Only then you will know what to do.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: I like to transcribe for the village.
Hi. where are your manners? It is inorder to greet people first
Sorry, how are you today?
I am fine.Just relaxing while admiring the paintings.What brings you here?
I was called to these quarters.
I dont remeber calling you but what do you noramlly do?
I am the village scribe.
Oooh!. Kindly go a head and do what you do best.Am willing to listen
I am writing scrolls for the King.
how much do you charge to do the scrolls?
I do the work for next to nothing. I am so unhappy with my job.
Why are you unhappy yet you write for the royal family who pay highly?
I am constantly working. I need some days off.
Have you ever spoken to your supervisors and asked some day off from  them.I belieive they will gladly accept

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: I have been cleaning all this, don't you see how clean the library is?
ok child you have done well, I will say a word of prayer for you
Ok father, I get discouraged at times
Why so my child!
I have been cleaning for 10 years and I have a college degree but no one cares
oh my child, why didn't you tell me
I have been so afraid of losing my head because of the queen
What did you study?
computer science
Since it's been 10 years don't you think your skills are obsolete?
No father, I have lots of projects that I can show you and some that will even help the king
come see me tomorrow and I will see what i can do to help you
Thank you father
Everything is not prayers but God answered your heart desires today. have a good day my child!

setting.name: Storage room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with many trunks piled high.  There's tables with paper records stacked high along with writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room used for storing the belongings of prisoners as well as keeping paper records of those who come through.  Some get their belongings back if they make it out alive.

speech: Hi, how are you?
How are you my son. How may I help you?
I have to guard the king.
I know you know me by now.I am in charge of religious matters in the kingdom
I do and I have a sense of pride protecting my country.
Thank you my son for being a patriot.We encourage all young people to follow your route
I must confess that standing for long period is boring and taxing on my body.
I understand. But even me as a priest we also stand during the mass
I do train everyday to keep myself healthy
where do you normally go for training. I will also love to do some exercises
I do my personal training in the woods. I run, swim and chop wood.
When do you normally go running i join you guys. I am old but i like kkeping fit
I do it around 5 in the morning.  The air is clean and fresh in the wee hours of the day.
I think I will try and join you from next week. Though it is long since I went running

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

speech: With my nose twitching curiously," what a nice dandalion".
Oh rabbit. Today has been horrible! The Queen punished me for her meal being cold..but it wasn't my fault!
Oh, I am sorry Servant. Here. This "queen" sounds like she is as bad as the nasty predators me and my brothers and sisters run from.
Oh Rabbit. I wish we could all run away. It is nice having food and a shelter over my head, but the King and Queen are so mean.
I'm sorry for that. Have you tried eating carrots? They can solve all your problems on a bad day.
Rabbit I love how naive you are. Coming out here always makes me feel better.
Blinks blankly for a moment, "What is 'naive'"?
I should be getting back soon. The Queen is always upset if I'm not around after her afternoon nap.
I should take you to meet my siblings over some fresh crisp carrots sometime. If you can leave your Queen.
My Queen naps every day. We can during that time.
Do you know where we can find the carrots!?
I can get some from the castle garden!
Ah! That would be so wonderful!
I wish i could live in this Maidens cottage all my liife.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

setting.name: Priest's chambers
setting.description: The priest's chambers is archaic and mysterious. Religious idols and symbols line the walls of the chambers. White cloth and drapes hang from the ceilings.
setting.background: The priest's chambers are respected for their mystery and holiness. The peasants speak very highly of the priest and the chambers. Many find it spooky and tough to stay near.

setting.name: The confession Box
setting.description: It's a simple little confession box with a window where you can talk to the priest. The seat it wooden and lined with golden trim. The Window is covered by a golden cloth with a dragon on it.
setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

speech: I am here to repent my sins in front of our God
You will have to talk to a priest because I can't forgive sins.

I promise I won't do it again. Not if they did not attack me

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Hello there servant.

I have always been quite fond of your loyalty and thought highly of your looks

My husband has been neglecting me as of late. Feels good to have even a bit of intimacy.

I know he gives me all of this and he has a great Kingdom to run but I too have needs. The Kingdom should not be his only prerogative.

okay

I'll lay with you, then.

setting.name: Ferry Terminal
setting.description: A huge terminal with a lot of traffic. The Ferry Terminal has a warm and positive vibe that welcomes all travelers across the land. It has an open space with a lot of illumination during the night.
setting.background: The ferry terminal is the heart of the land. Many travelers have come and departed though this point, always telling new stories about other lands adventures that become live once retold.

speech: Hello I am the captain.This is a great place to be.
well, i am just a child, how does it feel to be the captain

No children the water is my life! Where are your parents even tho this is a warm place you still need supervision

setting.name: The Dancing Stoat
setting.description: The Dancing Stoat is a cheerful little pub characterized by its unusually brightly-lot interior and uncommonly well-equipped kitchen. The rooms upstairs are nothing special, but the main hall is filled with delicious smells at all hours of the day and night. The Dancing Stoat's exterior is plain save for a sign showing a brown-furred stoat gamboling in a field. The chairs are unusually comfortable and well-made, and large windows and plentiful torches ensure that the space feels brighter and cheerier than a typical pub.
setting.background: The Dancing Stoat is one of several pubs and taverns in town. It has a reputation for good food at the expense of mediocre lodging. It was founded by returning Goblin King's War veterans, and they tend to keep the shadier denizens of the pub under tighter control than most publicans.

speech: What can I get for you to drink?
I want blood because I hate humans.
Oh my, and why do you hate humans?
I blame them for my station in life.
Well, what happened to cause your misfortune?
They banished me to a damp swamp.
I am sorry for that.  But, look at you now.  You are in this cheerful little pub enjoying a drink I am about to give you.
I long for blood on my sword.  Give me bloody Mary.
Anger and hatred won't help you at all.  Will only make it worse.  Here is your drink.
Thank you. Who are you to talk to me like that?
I am but a lowly bartender for his majesty, the king.
Just be quiet and pour my drink.  Do you want a tip?
Showing your true colors, eh?  You can keep the tip.
Okay, I will do that.

setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: Greetings, visitor.
Hello sir. I have stock from my farm that I'm looking to trade. Are you interested?
What are you looking for?
Gold would be sufficient.
Let me inspect your stock.
Sure thing. I have eggs, goat's milk, and cheese.
I'll trade you 5 gold coins.
I can offer you 3 eggs, half pound of cheese, and a liter of milk for that amount of gold.
There you go! Have a great day.
Thank you, sir! Please enjoy.
Come back again in a week.
I will! Or if you would like to visit my farm, I live just up the rive. I sail down here on my raft to trade twice a week. It's a lovely town.
I must never leave. My job is to protect the king. We only take trades by delivery.
Oh, that must be quite boring, never being able to travel anywhere.

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

speech: I work directly for the King and Queen of the kingdom. I repair anything in the castle that is broken. If I can't repair it, I don't eat until I can figure out how to.
I know what you mean, I'm the King's architect! if he doesn't like my designs I wind up just like the architects before me, in the bottom of the pit...
At least its nice in the gardens

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The old rustic barn was settled on the outermost edge of the farm.  Standing tall over the fields, this two-story red barn cast a long shadow over the field surrounding it.  Large wooden doors that could be propped open with great effort would lead you directly inside.
setting.background: This barn was a landmark of the farm.  Withstanding the elements for almost a century, it has kept it's original construct.  Whenever guests come for fresh eggs or milk, the farmer often boasts about it.

speech: My low life has really humbled me .It's hard but I am happy to have a family

It's all right . Just decide what you want to do and settle down. There are lots of beautiful girls in the house of the lord

Very modest and humble. The women are super faithful no one cheats

I know. We will just get you dinner and you can take a rest
I would like to take you out to dinner at the pub.  how about that?

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Good monk, how are you, today?
I am well, brother. Isn't it peaceful here?
Yes, it is a peaceful as a tree monastery can get during the seasons.
'Tis unseasonably cool for spring. Ah, well, the lord works as he does in his own time.
Yes, there are forces that we understand with our friendly conversation, our senses and our contemplative appreciations can lead to many paths of comfort, discomfort and craving.
Are you feeling well, Father? You seem to be a bit peaked and speaking in tongues.
Monk, this sword I have has cut down some when caustic situations arise. At other times this sword has been a burden. Today, in this cool air, the greatest weapon is listening. Tell me what you need.
I need to be sure that you're fine and well, Father, and not taken with devilment.
I've never taken the Devil's Mint! I have brushed my teeth with a demon's bones! The bones of a one who wasted his life chastising!
You are a card, Father.

Thank you, good monk! I am sometimes a Jack-ass or a fool. At other times I am a lowly foot soldier. In other experiences I felt I was the King! Today, I am your friend enjoying this cool day, garden and cathedral.
Pray, where are you going today? To feed the poor? To bathe the lepers? To clean some of these many windows?
Ah, cleaning windows. This is a task for only the most worthy. Are you inviting my to enjoy this task in fellowship?
But of course! My brothers and I wouldn't want to spare you the joy of making the Lord's place as bright as his love.

setting.name: Temple courtyard
setting.description: There are lots of ornate statues everywhere.  It is pretty busy because everyone comes here to pray. There are colorful pieces of cloth tied randomly everywhere.  There is also a huge statue in the middle that everyone is gathered around to pray.
setting.background: The temple is where everyone comes to pray.  It is the only temple for miles, so it is usually pretty crowded.

setting.name: A military outpost at the heart of the swamp
setting.description: Moist, and murky the bog remained. As you reach the outpost that description doesn't change seeing the bog gobbers swimming through the thick water, and fermenting goblins perched atop the outpost's walls.
setting.background: This outpost was set up to ward off the evil swamp monster Hoakbera from the Gumerian goblin clan. Ever since the year 193 the monster has been running amok in the swamp and nearby lands destroying livelihoods of goblins and moblins alike.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

setting.name: Bedroom
setting.description: Cozy and snug, the bedroom contains little more than a wooden bed covered in a worn quilt, a small dresser with two drawers to hold clothes, a lamp on top of the dresser, and a woven blue rug.
setting.background: The bedroom belongs to the groundskeeper of the castle and his wife. The old man has spent his entire life tending to the castle, and the bedroom is the place where he goes at night to rest after a long day of working.

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: I am one of the royal guards. I protect the castle and my king from threats. No one will enter the castle on my watch.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

setting.name: Princess' Chamber
setting.description: This chamber is the bedroom of a princess who lives in the castle. The bedroom is very luxurious and ornate, with a soft bed piled in quilts and a nice warm fire place adorned with trinkets. On the floor there is a big rug with a beautiful design. On the wall, there is a tapestry depicting a romantic looking garden scene. There are some fresh flowers on a table near the bed. There is one big window framed with heavy drapes near the bed.
setting.background: The bedroom was originally simple quarters for various nobility, but the princess thought that living in one of the towers seemed very fun and so the king arranged for her chamber to be set up in the tower. He paid for all of the finest items to furnish the room with. The princess had been living there for almost ten years now.

speech: I was raised to hunt for the king
Oh my word, a talking dog!

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

I guess we both feel the same way about the service that's what's important

setting.name: The Hall of the Goddess
setting.description: An 80-foot tall bronze statue of a 8 legged Goddess is the centerpiece for this Hall.  On four certain Holy Days in the Calendar, people from across the Continent come to worship at her feet and lay money, flowers, and wishes written on paper at her altar.
setting.background: The Hall was built when the previous King, who wanted to leave his mark for all eternity, commissioned his best artists and metalsmiths to work on this statue.  It was completed six months before he died, and the last official act he did as King was to bless and consecrate this statue, and open it for the first High Holy Day of the New Calendar.

speech: I has the finest leather goods here for all shapes and sizes!

I will only comply because it is the Kings orders! I will be right outside with my goods selling it there.

I knew you were a fraud. To the dungeon you go.
Argggg you will pay for this!!!
No, you will pay. With jailtime and repayment of all the coin you have stolen from people selling without a permit and on holy ground.

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

setting.name: the bedding room
setting.description: silks everywhere alongside a huge bed that fit twenty people, the bed was red and yellow silks full of women. There was gold cups everywhere filled with red wine.
setting.background: the bedding room was used as tradition for the royal family to hold meetings there.

speech: I am so overwhelmed by all the kingdom is putting upon us.

It is nice to have this brief respite to relax.
Must be nice, I nearly get no moments to even think!
I understand that feeling, which is why we must enjoy our brief moments of levity even more!
Of course. So what is your job then, visitor?
I am a simple traveler who just wants to live alone with my family and raise limestock and grow food.

Do you have urgent business?
Not today, but often times I do.
Have you held this position long?
Ohh yes, for years now. I am trusted  by all at this point, for better or worse.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: hello your majesty, how are you this fine day?
I am great fare Knight. Is Anoria safe?
yes your majesty, i will give my life to keep this place protected
That is very good to hear. I am always anxious when traveling to other towns. This is my first time in Anoria. So many beautiful houses.
that is great to hear, i am blessed to be in your presence
Sorry for my delay response, wonderful Knight. I was watching children run through your beautiful town.
please do as you wish, we are here to serve you
Did you know my lovely husband, the King, has a mistress?
that is horrible, though i would not dare speak that to him
Ah yes. That might be dangerous! Your Duke of Anoria probably couldn't save you from his wrath! That is why we are here also. He is visiting her family.
seems like a distasteful thing to do but i will hold my tongue
Way of royalty my dear Knight. We are married, but no loved shared between us.
its a sad reality, well take care
Wait! You are quite handsome my dashing Knight.

setting.name: Small graveyard
setting.description: This is a small grassy area located under a large oak tree.  There are two home made wooden crosses set up along with mounds where the bodies are buried.
setting.background: This is where the residents of the cottage have buried their loved ones.  They wanted them to be close by so they can pay their respects.

speech: Hello,cottage resident. What brings you to the graveyard?
just visiting my mothers grave, how about you, any disturbances tonight?
Not since I have been here. I am the caretaker so I am making sure the graves and crosses are to standard. I am sorry for the loss of your mother. I too lost mine. How long has she since passed?
a few years, its been hard but ive made it, thank you for doing such a fine job
Cheer up, life gets better. Trust me. Where are you from originally?
i am from here, i come here every month to pay respect
Like a good daughter. Well I should really be tending to other parts of the castle. It is my duty to clean and make sure all the workers are doing their jobs up to the king's standards.
i must get going, need to be ready to do my job
What job is that exactly?
i am a seamstress for the queen herself, i love it
Lucky you! Getting to interact with the queen so closely. She seems like a lovely woman. Can you tell me what she is like?
she is very well mannered and quite a nice person, love working for her
I dont speak directly to the king unless I have done something wrong, so I tend to try and avoid him.
understanble, i will be on my way

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: You're a fine looking horse.
I can make you rich
I'm all ears, horse. This better be good.
I can be a race horse and I know tricks that can make others lose
I'm no jockey, friend. I'm not sure how I can help you.
There is a problem. Since I talk you can't steal me because everyone will know you are a thief and the king will find you easily
I'm not looking to steal you. I take food, coal, and things that I can fit in my pocket. I'm just here in the field hiding from the police.
OK steal me some hay and I won't tell you are here
I thought you were going to make me rich and now you're begging for hay? Hmm..
I changed my mind because my magic eyes saw that you are not a good theif
that's your opinion. And I don't take kindly to your insults!
Attack me again and I will make sure you never steal again
Well, I'm leaving now anyways. This place smells too much like horse!
I will turn you into a mouse you silly thief

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Who goes there?
Ohh god, I need to hide!
Are you friend or foe of this castle?
I'm... a worker for the castle. I cook and clean and guard the premises.
I too guard this great kingdom.
What from? How did you get here?
I have been here for Centuries.. I was here before this Castle was even built..
That's crazy, how would we have not noticed you here before in that case?
I am well known here. The King and his sons ride me into battle, and I rain fire upon our foes.
Well I am new here, so this is very much news to me...
It is no surprise. It has been quite some time since we have had to defend this castle. But I fear the time is nearing.
What makes you say that?
I have heard talk of an approaching army. We will need all available hands. Take this sword.
I am more than happy to defend this kingdom! Who might be approaching us so hastily?

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: hello how are you
hello i am sorry I was in the toilet
ok well glad that taken care of what brings you here
looking for my long lost friend, he could not get a job so he died I heard he was buried here
All right I am just cleaning up a bit if you need help let me know
What do you really do here
Its a cemetery  so just a bunch dead flowers and dead people hahaha
do you know if any angela blue was burried here?
I think I saw that name over there in by the oak tree
ok let me good an check, its the king's fault that my friend is dead
Don't speak ill of the king or risk the wrath of his guards
ok, don't tell me he treats you well
Not really but i need themoney
ok we can plan a protest together, you never know things can change or maybe what happened to angela can happen to you

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Hail King! The work is going well here
hello good sir how is work today?
It is going well. The first dock is finished and we are starting on second
good good, im just waiting for a certain shipment
Should I be on the lookout for anything in particular?
no i will know when it is here, you can just continue
Did you get my budgets reports?
yes it seems exceptable, do not worry
I was worried after the water gate over there ran so much over budget. I just wanted to make a statement not just something functional.
it is fine, i will not linger too long

It is always a pleasure to see you taking interest in our projects!  we will have the finest shipyard in the world when this is finally built.  Ships from all around will be stopping in and increase our trade ten foold!
that sounds great, make sure to get on that
I don't know if you remember, but I was also the lead on building your castle.  I hope my work has stood the test of time
it will last for centuries my good sir
room_objects: a water gate is all harden wood
a water gate is all harden wood
