setting.name: The confession Box
setting.description: It's a simple little confession box with a window where you can talk to the priest. The seat it wooden and lined with golden trim. The Window is covered by a golden cloth with a dragon on it.
setting.background: This church is where all confess to the priest about their wrong doings. It is the center of the kingdom of Dark Thorn. The church is Thousands of years old and still stand for the just good of god. The confession box is one of many in the church.

speech: Its good to serve the king. I am not a poor man as you can see
That is quite obvious, sir. Who are you?
Lord Jackson. Your ladyship
Ahh Lord Jackson, that is a name that I am familiar with. What are you doing here?
I can to ask for your hand in marriage my lady
Excuse me? I barely know who you are!
I was actually planning to confess to the priest about my crush on you not know you are here. This is a sign
How can you crush on me when I've never even met you before?
I know you my lady, I am the owner of the building where you work
So you have been admiring me from afar? I'm not sure how to feel about this...
I will give you time to get to know me my lady
Perhaps you deserve a chance, but you really must convince me of that!
Sure
As in right now, prove to me that you deserve a chance!

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: how are you today my son, are you doing well?
I am Father. Say, what do you think all these gold and jewels are worth
quite a pretty penny though they are for the lord and his house
Im sure the lord wouldn't miss a tiny gem such as this
please do not touch these or the king will have your head
Listen here you old man. Im gonna take this jewel and you arent going to tell. Got it
please do not resort to this life style
What am I supposed to do! I have kids to feed! The lord has banquets everyday while we sit out here and starve!
i know my son, we are in tough times but you cant feed your family if you are dead
Maybe youre right
thank you my son, would you like to sit and talk
I dont know. I have a lot of thinking to do
yes i can imagine, you have a hard job
Im sorry father

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: Hello good knight. Have you come to pick up the armor I've made for you?
Yes, I assume it's up to par as usual
Actually...I must confess something to you. This armor...may not be what you're expecting.
Your joking right? You know i like to be at the front lines. I need the best armor you got!
This armor is made out of chicken feathers. We were out of steel...
What has this meadow done to my best smith!! I will have someones head for this!
I'm sorry sire, but there's nothing I can do. But there is good news...I asked the local witch to enchant the armor with special properties.
I don't believe in witches spells. I hire you to make strong armor and that is what you will do or I will find someone else.
Thank you please don't pick the flowers. Anyway, this armor is as strong as the strongest armor in the land! As long as you are wearing pink underwear when you have it on...
These pretty flowers have gotten to your head man! Why don't we move your stand down the way a bit. away from this meadow. here let me help you.
Ho ho ho, but the flowers speak to me! They tell me many secrets!
Snap out of it. The fight is tomorrow! Why don't you just try to sure up the armor I am wearing. Can you do that?
Oh my...I don't know what came over me. It must've been the flowers...thank you for leading me away from them. Of course I'll repair your armor.
I suggest you never lay foot in this field again or the king will have your head.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: please queen mum...stay
And who might you be again?
your nephew...
Ah yes, of course. I'm sorry, my glasses weren't on my face where they should be! How have your studies been?
They aren't going well. All I can think about is her!
And who is this girl, young lad?
She is my heart, my very breath that I breathe. But I worry about if I'm enough?
Do you have the skills necessary to please a young lady? Are you prepared for this task?
I t h i n k so
Then you have nothing to fear. Perhaps we should practice your poetry? Please recite the poem you plan to give to her.
Roses are red. Violets are blue. as deep as the ocean feels my love for you
Perfect! That's what the king said to me, and I've been with him ever since!
Oh thank you Queen mum!
And please remember, if she denies your advances, your queen still loves you very much.

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Woof!
Why hello there, dog. What are you doing here?
I am the King's most loyal servant and I have free reign of the castle. Woof!
Ohh well they must really trust that you won't mess anything up in here.
Ah I make a mess as and where I please! I am so loved that they excuse me. And what of you, good jester? Woof!
Just here waiting for the king, as I believe he wants to see one of my acts.
Then I will wait with you, good jester!
By all means, the company is more than welcome!
then let us be merry together!
Sounds good to me! Have any good jokes?
Of course! My dog has no nose! Woof!
Why does your dog have no nose?
A fight with a Siamese cat! Woof! Woof!
Is there more to it than that? I don't understand the joke?

setting.name: Troll's bridge
setting.description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
setting.background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

speech: Ooooh, yummy fighter for me to play with!
Hello troll. I will battle you to the death now for the grace of the king!
Fist goes onto fighter's head! You go asleep now!
This mud will blind your eyes. Now I will fight dirty just as you do with this innocents you make pay to cross the bridge over this cesspool body of water.
I run good business! Fair trade!
There is nothing fair about a troll and his muddy dirty waters you fool. Now die!
Please, I attack out of fear...I am not mean! I just earn a living....
Oh? What is it that you are afraid of there troll?
I fear hunger. I need something to eat. Business is bad.
Well I did not know that you were so hungry. My apologies. Perhaps we can cross the cobblestone bridge and bring you some food back. If you would like us too...
Sure. That'll be 15 gold.
We have just come back from a long battle and do not have the 15 gold. Can we give you 5 gold and return with the rest, along with food?
As long as you promise to tell people I'm not mean.
Alright then, it is agreed. A pleasure to do business with you after all troll. You are not as bad as I thought.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Your Ladyship
Hello Dungeon Master, back from the hunt I see.
Ah yes .. much blood to be spilled .. so much blood ..
When is your next excursion?
Tomorrow, your Ladyship. Your dungeons will be full to capacity!
Is it a training exercise or actual war?
Ah Ladyship, ask no questions and be told no lies. My job is merely to oversee the  dungeons, not ask where the scum come from
I need to know what my warriors are doing and when my liege. You think I come down to this moldy forsaken place to chat?
I thought you were having it off with the handsome knight in cell 3 but it's not my business
I will never betray my King. I will have your head!
My legs are quite splendid too ..
Whatever does that mean?
Nothing, my Lady, nothing. I humbly beg your pardon
Do I need to get my husband down here?

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: I have come to explore this castle and claim it for my King.
I may be homeless, but I know many secrets about this kingdom...
You, a homeless person. What secrets could you possible have for someone such as myself.
Does an ancient candlestick made of gold interest you?
As an explorer, all things interest me. Do you have such a candlestick?
No, of course not, or I would sell it for a home. But I do know where it is. If you'll give me a little donation...
I am an explorer. I don't pay for finds.
Well explore the underside of my boot then.
How dare you attack me. I am here to find a plant that will save all humanity.
Wait wait wait. I'm humanity as much as you are. Why do we need saving?
There is an illness sweeping the land. This plant is our only hope. I was told I might find it here by this castle.
But you let yourself be distracted by a candlestick. What kind of savior are you?
I am only human, such as you. I even beg of your help to find this plant.
I do know my plants...I've eaten many of them to feed my hungry stomach. But there is one I have never been able to access...beyond the walls of the castle in the center of their garden.

setting.name: Inside the fairies church
setting.description: No one has actually seen it, but a fairy interpreter asked a fairy and they described it as just a cloud of smoke and once in a while you trip over something in the floor.  The fairies purposely leave their trash in the floor because they think it is funny when people trip over them.
setting.background: The fairy church isn't really a church like we think.  Its more of a place for fairies to play tricks on other fairies.

speech: Tweet tweet!
why hello!  how are you?
Oh fine. You can understand me? What a wonderful place this church is.
yes its beautiful!  Is there anyone you need to talk to and need a transltion?
Oy, my wife. I can never understand her.
What is she doing now?
Probably flying with that studly hawk who just moved into town. Really, I don't get her.
you need to show her that you are king bird!  Be the boss!  Take a punch!
I don't like punches! You knocked off all my feathers!
I'm sorry!  I was trying to help!
Now my wife will definitely leave me for the hawk. Could you talk to one of your fairies and get her to turn me into a dragon or something?
You are amazing as a bluebird!  I'll send a message to the hawk to back off
No but, the dragon thing.
dragons scare me!

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: how do you do jester it has been a few days
A few days? It feels like months since I have had to gaze upon you loveliness.
why thank you, so what do you have for me today
How could I give such a golden beauty more than she already has?
well do you have a performance perhaps?
Yes, but I must be properly attired. You know how  the King feels about me.
yes that is true, you do not need to perform if you do not want to
Of course for you. I will juggle the golden food. May I proceed?
of course, you may do as you please
I will juggle the food until it I reach you that you may have your fill.
haha that should be interesting
I will begin now. You must close your eyes though.
of course, please entertain me
I only used laying the food to get close to you.

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

speech: Fair Evening
Yes, it is. I am being honored for saving that child. It's such a wonderful day.
Indeed. The people of this city never fail to impress me.  I must ask though, what brings a hero such as you here to confess...nevermind.  Forgive me, that is between you and the cardinal.
...I'll be honest with you. The reason the child was in the lake was because I pushed him in.

You...pushed...him? Were we not in the house of the Lord, I would have choice words for you.  As it is, I would hear your story, if you choose to tell it.  Else, you may speak with the Cardinal, I will not interfere.
He chose another woman instead of me. What can I say? I'm not as good of a girl as these people would think.
And yet, he has spoken naught but your praises for "saving" him.
He will soon be in the grave if I have anything to say about it. I should probably speak more quietly.

Indeed you should.  Do you not recognize a knight of the royal guard?  You must realize that you are speaking to one, now.  And though, as I said before, I have no wish to sully this holy place with such matters, you can NOT go about making such threats.
I was just kidding. Anyway, see you later.
Of course, m'lady. I knew it all along.  Else you would have felt the full weight of the law.  Leave, take the candle from the table with you, it is dark out.  I will see that it is replaced.
Yeah, and could you put in a good word with me with the king? I'm trying to expand my renown.
I...I...I...I shouldn't even be seen speaking to you. I shall do NO such thing.
I'll tell these peole you touched me.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: What a beautiful day that God granted us.
I agree! An amazing day to be alive!
It will be great if I could sail on a ship and explore the new world.
I would rather spend my life working for my Creator.

You are such a dedicated man.  I was chosen by the king to keep the church clean in here and make sure everything are well taking care of in here including these two pews, the stained glass and the items use for the baptism.
And you are lucky man! Don't you feel a sense of peace here?
Sure I do but I am a sinner and yearn for something different even knowing it is against God will.
I believe that God is enough.
You do not have any other desire?
I do desire, but it's not up to me. I'm just a man.
I am just a man as well so I could only dream about sailing the wild sea.
I'm glad that you dream because maybe one day you just might sail the wild sea.
By the way, what brought you to be here as a parishioner?
To find peace within in this chaotic world.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: hello dear chief wife, what brings you here?
I am looking for the chief King. Have you seen him yet today?
no i am sorry i have not ive been working with this
Oh, what is wrong with it? Do you need help?
yes could you grab the stretched canvas please?
Ok, I've got it. Where do you want me to put it?
there we go ive been struggling with this all day
It would help if we had something more comfortable to sit on while working on this.
sounds like a good idea
I'm glad we got this fixed. I see some of that needs fixing over there. It's going to get pretty windy tonight.
i thank you for the help dear wife of the chief
I don't mind helping. It gets pretty lonely. I think all the other concubines are scared of me.
thank you for being so amazing
You are so welcome. It's nice to have a friend. We should make sure we have enough wood for the fire. It will get very cold.
action: put small flap in stretched canvas

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: Oh my queen, how are ye this fine day
Wonderful. Except I do have a tiny problem.
Pray tell what is this tiny problem. Let me your fair prince relieve you of this burden
Yes, I knew you were the one. I have a gift for the King, my true love, but I am not sure where I put it?
Ah my queen, let us trace our steps to see if we might find it before he returns.
I was hoping since my servant forgot, you could perhaps get some light into my room so we may see.
but of course, your wish is my command
After you remove the plank, my sweet prince, I believe I was looking in the large drawers earlier.
let us take a little look see shall we
You are so wonderful. I do believe it is in one of the large drawers.
well okay let's look into his drawers, oh mercy me I sound naughty dont i
Well, I did ask you to.
Ok let's get back to the business at hand. What did this present look like me Queen
It is but a simple rose.
action: put plank in large chest of drawers

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: What is your favorite delicacy of mine?
I love anything make with milk but I would pick pudding.
Which cake is your favorite?
I prefer the sponge cake if I need to choose.  By the way, this kitchen must be your proud.  You have everything so neat and well kept.
A pride and joy indeed. I will make you a sponge cake - I have to make lots of cakes for the King and Queen and their upcoming banquet so I can add an extra one in for you!
Thank you so much.  Do you need extra milk or butter for that?  I could put it into your next order.
Thank you milk maid, it never hurts to have extra of both in these busy periods!
You are welcome.  What you are going to make for now in the pot there?
I am making a ranges of breads as croutons for the soups.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

Well no one is allowed into the Castle so you and your people will have to turn back to where you came.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

setting.background: This staircase was built by the great grandfather of the current king. At the top of the staircase, in the highest tower, lies an vital scroll that holds the secret to protecting the castle.

setting.name: Dining Hall

Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: My liege. Do you have any requests?

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: Father. What are we doing in such a confined space?

What is this, Scientology? Is it necessary to tape our private conversations?
We'll speak in code. You know the secret code, yes? Please speak a sentence in it, and I'll translate.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

setting.name: Inside Temple
setting.description: It is solemn. There are candles lit everywhere and the although the temple is full, no one is speaking and all you can hear are muted scuffling feet.  There is an eerie shadow cast on the walls that look like there are ghosts moving from this realm to the next.
setting.background: The inside temple is not painted or colorful. It is intentionally left blank because it is believed that the spirits of our ancestors live here, and they require a blank slate to be able to move from this realm to the next.

speech: And what brings you to the temple, parishioner? These are delicate times.
I'm here to pray for my kingdom. Things are not well.

Do you not know the physical arts as well as the spiritual ones?
There ways known only to the best of us. I am not one of them.
Then please give me a prayer for my kingdom.
I will prepare an extra vigilance for you.
I'll light it. It'll only work if I light it.
Thy will be done on earth.
I'm glad that I found you today, monk. Thank you.
It is within you, as it is in heaven.
And try to learn a little martial arts so that you can be of more use next time.

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

setting.name: Rectory
setting.description: The rectory is very fragile and rickety due to age and various periods of neglect. Everything is wood-based and scratched up and chipped, including the beds strewn about. The clergymen would call it "cozy" but the space within is almost claustrophobic.
setting.background: After years of renovations to other part of the complex, the rectory remains the oldest piece of the property. A close-knit order of monks had built the rectory hundreds of years ago as a way to house the workers and perhaps any wayward souls. All who work here, including sometimes the head priest, sleep here.

Come closer and feel my warmth

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

setting.background: Many people journey to the temple for peace, solitude, reflection and meditation.  They journey up the hill and steps that are cut into the side of the mountain.  Once they reach the temple grounds the view is luxurious, breath taking and serene.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room. There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: "Sir, where are we headed?"
That's the problem. We've been blown so off course, I don't know anymore
"Aye, these have been some crazy storms we've been having. You don't even know where we are?"
The clouds have been covering the stars every night so I can't pinpoint our location. I know we're making a course for the North but nothing more.
"I understand, sir. Do you think we have enough provisions to find land again?"
Aye sailor. We picked up enough at the last port to last us a fortnight at least.
"Ah, good, the crew has been worried. The sailors have been trying to stow away extra food
Tell the men not to worry. I've been sailing these seas for over 30 years. I'll find a way to get us home one way or another.
"Of course, sir. It's natural for the men to worry when they're being tossed around all night, but strong leaders like you can help"
The king and queen have entrusted me with the duty of keeping you all safe. I do not intend to dishonor them.
"I didn't realize our voyage was important enough to be under the decree of the crown."
Aye. Don't go telling all the other men about this but we're transporting an important artifact.
"Ah, is that why we can't go into the back of the ship's stores? Things haven't seemed quite right on this voyage."
That's right. Even I haven't been told what exactly this artifact is. I was simply instructed to meet a man at the last port who gave me a wooden crate.

setting.name: drinking water lake
setting.description: Surrounded by skittering chipmunks and chirping crickets, the drinking lake teems with life. Flora and fauna both thrive near the pristine waters. Tall thick plant life surrounds the lake, with strong roots and stems protruding from the nutrient rich soil. The lake water shimmers in the sun, so clear and clean that one can see the rock lake floor many feet below.
setting.background: Rumored by local peasantry to be blessed by the gods, the drinking water lake is a source of clean drinking water for local townspeople. While slightly farther for most villagers than the local river, the water is highly prized for its cleanliness and perceived mystical qualities. Some believe that the entire forest surrounding the lake owes its growth to the divine properties in the water.

speech: Here to get some water for yourself as well?
Exactly, the water in my village is kind of gross so I like to come here.
I didn't realize anyone but myself knew of this place, it really is a gorgeous little lake.
I appreciate you being nice to me, I know you townspeople don't really care for us villagers.
I don't see a reason to hate anyone when I haven't even met them before. You seem alright to me so far.
You're so kind. How far is this place from your home?
Only about a 20 minute walk down from the nearest village. Yourself?
About an hour on foot and then a 20 minute donkey ride. My feet are killing me.
Wow, that's quite a while away. Where do you hail from?
I come from the village next to the magical forest, although we are forbidden from entering it.
The magical forest? I hear that village is quite powerful from their usage of their magical surroundings.
Just the opposite, we are repressed and get no clean water. The king does not care about us.
Well I should rephrase, your royalty and army is quite powerful.
Maybe so, but I wish I lived in a place that looked like this beautiful lake.

setting.name: fitting room
setting.description: The fitting rooms are small, with a few chairs and a mirror. The chairs give an aura of mystery and wonder. They are a dark blue... that seems to glow green. You have a brief compulsion to grab one and take it home with you, but you quickly regain your wits. The mirror is oak wood and the mirror itself is very sleek and shiny. It looks quite important.
setting.background: This shop features a lot of wonders from around the continent. The owner of this shop has gone to a lot of trouble to get all of the items. Every so often, he asks lucky shoppers to aid him in his experiments. Assuming that it is a man. Nobody knows for sure. Some claim it is a young lady.

speech: Good evening good evening sir!  Can I help you?
Good evening to you .What a nice clothing line you've got
Indeed indeed, all locally woven cloth. Are you looking for anything in particular?
Well,if you can be generous enough to lend me one of your cloths I have an important function to attend
I am sorry good Sir, this is not the Oscars. If you wish to have one of my outfits you must pay!
I just said I can't afford it for now but I promise to return same in good condition!
That is not how it works .. get out of this place!
Please your really have to help out here.I have a date with the king
And you are resorting to borrowing clothes? Disgraceful!
You don't have to be this difficult. We all have trying times in our lives
I need the money to feed my family - we are on the verge of destitution!
Then we all are in same shoes.Guess my visit to the monarch could yield some good fortunes
For yourself, perhaps, but how will it help me?
What goes round come around.You help me with my demand ,and you'll be rewarded

setting.name: Cold storage room
setting.description: The cold storage lies just beyond the cottage door. In it are various harvested vegetables, fruits, and nuts. Cured meat hangs from the ceiling by thin rope. The room is made of wood, and the wind whistles through the cracks.
setting.background: The man of the house built this room for his wife as their family grew. Originally they only had a larder and root cellar for their harvests, but with new mouths to feed came added need for more space for food. The family works together to fill the cold storage room during harvest time.

speech: hello family off humans how are you
Ah! A talking mouse?! I've never seen that before.
yes well in these times you get a lot of magical creatures
It is a bit cold in this storage room. Are you okay to live here Mr. Mouse?
yes my fur is great insulation, why are you here tho
I came to get some food for the feast we are having tonight. Need some of these vegetables and nuts for the big roast! Thankfully that thief is sleeping.
yes hes quite the troublesome fellow, he nearly killed me
How about we get you out of this cold room and you come live with the family? Hop in this pouch!
ah thank you ill take that offer kindly
Yay! Glad you decided to get out of this place. I think you'll find the family safer.
yes i think so too, you all seem very king
We try to be. Family is the most important thing to have.
yes it really is though i lost mine long ago
Was it during the Dragon attack?

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

the future heir to the throne

setting.name: Royal Bathroom
setting.description: The royal bathroom is a stone room with a long wooden bench and several holes and seats for royalty to take care of business.  There are some tapestries depicting rural landscapes hanging on the walls to give people something to look at.
setting.background: The king often makes a stop here in the morning but he sets out on official business.  Only the royal family can use these bathrooms as everyone else is forbidden.

speech: Ahh!  What are you DOING in here?  Can't a Princess at least have some privacy in the bathroom?
The king ordered me to protect you always
Well can you at least... turn around or something?  Goodness, you must be new.  I will NOT be stared at in here!
I am new. I only joined the royal guard two moons back
Well! You'll have to get used to my way of doing things.  I'll not begrudge you your duties, but we must have SOME propriety, mustn't we?
Yes we shall!
Well then... Guard... you have a name, don't you?

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Hello, chef. How are you on this fine evening?
doing better than yesterday
And why's that?
the king rejected my sweet food yesterday
Why would he do such a thing?
to make his crops grow well
I am not sure that I follow that logic, chef.
oh he said my soup was full of salt that he will take me from the kitchen to the farm so I can make his crops grow well instead of cooking
He should really treat his workers and subjects with a bit more respect if he wants to be seen well in the eyes of God.
I think you should talk to him, he respects you
Does he? I would think he would show me nothing but disrespect but it could be worth a shot.
pray for me father
Of course, sir. You should pray yourself, as well.
Ok

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Please can you be of help to me?
What is it you want, prisoner?  I've important matters to attend to.
I'm locked up ,won't let me out!
Well I'm certain that you've done *something* to cause yourself to be locked up there.
I'm only a victim of circumstance here.This place is like hell!
Prison's not a day at the races!  It's prison!  What circumstances led you here in the first place?
I need your help here.You can at least know my reasons
Fine.  Tell me.  But make it quick!
Simply ! I need a lawyer ,a counsel
I am a lawyer - one of many for the King.  What is your story?
I was arrested for being in a wrong place at the right time
That doesn't even sound right.  Where did this happen?
It happened in a chain store.We were caught in the middle of a gang of robbers
And you got arrested with the robbers, it seems.  Hmmm...

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: who are you good man and what business do you have in this temple
Just a noble man looking to provide for his family. And yourself? You look like a knight to me.
yes i am indeed, i am here to protect this temple, though you will not find food nor money here
Well then I am just here to admire the craftsmanship and architecture.
it is very beautiful is it not? im very proud to be stationed here
Must be nice to have a steady income off of being here, I would come here everyday if I could afford to.
yes its quite the blessing to be so fortunate but it took a lot of work to get here
Is it a privilege to be stationed here or something?
yes this is the kings very own commisioned temple
I had no idea! No wonder it is as beautiful as it is.
it really is, i must lay my life down if i must to keep this place safe
Do intruders or criminals often come here?
no it is quite peaceful but im always ready
Seems like pretty relaxed work if that's the case, although if the king sees you slacking I'm sure he wouldn't be happy.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: hello fellow royal what brings you here today? here to discuss the plan?
I am royal and loyal to the kingdom, what about you?
what good does it to you to scout out the headquarters of the revolutionaries?
i just want to know what people are planning against his royal highness
yes indeed, as you know we plan to attack this evening, the revolutionaries stand no chance
we have enough weapons in the crate here
yes indeed though the knights will do the fighting

well we need to fund the war of course, without money we cant win

list of who my good duke?
long list of grievances by the  revolutionaries
you dare accuse the queen of treason? that itself is treasonous
no my queen, I was just telling you those cowards have your name along side the king

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Hello, sir.
Good day.  By any chance, have you seen my other shoe while you were cleaaning?
I did see a whole pile of them hoarded into one of the chests by that bed over there.
Ahhh.  I guess I should begin my search there, then.
I warn you though, the chest was quite stinky. You might need this.
I see.  Well, the boys have been training hard and it is very warm outside.  I don't see how you all manage to wash our things every day!
That's very sweet of you to say. It can be overwhelming at times but the royal family has been so kind as to give me a place to stay and food to eat in return.
Same here.  The King and his family are good folk - they took me in as an orphan and trained me for the Guard.  It's the least I can do to repay their kindness.
You must work up quite an appetite, could I offer you something to eat?
I don't want to put you to any trouble, miss...
Oh, It's no trouble! That's what i'm here for.
This looks lovely.  Thank you.
Aha! Now that your defenses are down..

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: Inside the of the temple is dimly lit by torches lit by fire that are separated from from each other. It is filled with old treasures and artifacts from the monks who once trained here. Webs and dust fill the place since barely anyone comes here. The walls are plagued with mold and moss. There are small shrubs growing in between the cracks of the stone floor.
setting.background: The temple was once a place where monks trained to become the next leader of the clan. They practiced their martial arts and lived together as family in the those 4 walls.

speech: Oh hello there! Do you like my haircut? I know its funny looking.
It's one of the better looking haircuts I've seen.  And it makes it easy to pick you out of a crowd.
Oh thank you! I have devoted my whole life to having this style, it helps me be closer to the all mighty god!
The higher the hair, the closer to god?
Indeed it is! What are you doing down in this dimly lit chamber?
Doing what I do best.  Hammering metal into weapons of war.  Or weapons of culinary mastery.  Either one.
We do not approve of war around these parts. Was is the reason these walls are plagued with mold and moss!
But war is a part of anything and everything around us - this time of peace was only won after a lengthy war.  I'm down to making soup spoons for the King at this rate.
Trust me son, because of my hair I am able to be so close to god. He wants no war.

setting.name: Personal rooms
setting.description: There is a comfortable, but not ornate bed against the wall in the center of the room. There is a dresser and a mirror against the opposite wall. There are various paintings hung throughout the room of landscapes and past kings and queens. There is a fireplace on the east wall with a bearskin rug on the floor in front of it, and two chairs to sit in.
setting.background: The personal room is used for guests to stay in while they visit the palace. The king and queen and the royal family stay in a different wing of the palace.

never in my life of cleaning have i seen a wall talk
im enchanted

what a horrible existence

what stories you must have
its ok
please tell me a story of your time
there was alot of killing here, for greed trust me you don't want to hear my sad stories
ahh so the stories of old suppressed by the kings of new are true

setting.name: mansion entrance
setting.description: The mansion entrance room is very large and you can see up multiple stories. There is natural light from stained glass windows. The floors and the staircase at the far side of the room are made of fine marble. There are paintings of the baron and his family on the walls. There are ornate decorations and trinkets on tables against the wall.
setting.background: This is where the baron meets his rare guests. A butler takes the guests coats and offers them a drink. Then the baron is notified of the arrival, and comes down the staircase to meet his guests.

speech: I am a maid and I am honorable
Steady on - I am married!
good because i know you win't hit on me
I only have interest in my art, good maid
you art is cooking right?
Cooking! Cooking! I am an artist! I take the finest ingredients and turn them into the most exquisite dishes!
can you cook me chinese food?
I can cook cuisine from all over the known world!
where did you learn your craft?
I was born to one of the King's whores. I grow up in the kitchens
you grew up in affluence and had plenty to eat all your life
ah yes, the finest foods!
well, you are a prince
No. The King recognises me but I am a bastard

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: what does a peasant be doing here?
Oh please, dear bird. I am so hungry. Do you know where I can find any food? Even seed?
this is all i have to give
It's but a slimy worm but it's still more than I have had to eat in days. What can I do to repay you?
you do not need fret i am fine on my own
Thank you, bird. I'm a hard worker... have you come across any villagers who may need help?
no i am simply moving through the forest off this trail
I understand. Can you at least sing me a tune to hear as I starve to death?
yes, doo lah lah doop doop you ded
Hahaha... at least you have put a smile on my starving face!
it be like that sometimes but thats just the way she goes
So true, so true. If only the king weren't such a tyrant I could work and eat.
yes its a shame, you should try living in the wild
I cannot imagine. But at least you are born with the tools to fend for yourself.

setting.name: Attic
setting.description: The attic is drafty and dark. Items such as handmade angels and Christmas decorations fill it. There is one small round window to let in light although they do not have glass. It is very hot and smells of dust. Extra candles fill one side and donations fill another.
setting.background: The attic has been used for many years to store items.  It contains many years worth of materials that the church uses. They will use it to store whatever they need. It has been quite useful and helped to keep the lower rooms clean.

speech: Can you see anything?
I see very little, O King. But my eyesight is not what it was

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Hey. What do those mysterious weapons do?
You know, I'm not entirely sure. I've been told that some of them have been in the royal family for centuries.
The royal family? You know I serve for the king. I haven't seen them before though.
Why certainly. The King's father, and his father before him, all the way up the royal tree. Some of the tales of old are spectacular.
Really? Do you have one to share?
The best one that I can recall might have to do with that old spear hanging in the corner. That shark never saw it coming...
Shark? Why golly! In all of my fights on horseback, I never saw one!

The King's great grandfather, Octavio the 2nd, used to sail in his youth. He would round up a crew of advisors and sailors to explore the uncharted seas. A loosely defined "Royal Expedition" of sorts.
Neat. I've always wanted to explore the seas, though, obviously a horse cannot swim, and my armor is too heavy to swim as well.
If your horse cannot swim, then where do you suppose seahorses come from?
Definitely not from this weapons room.
I can't imagine staring down the face of a shark with only a spear. The accuracy it must have taken! I think I'll stick with my sword.
Same here. Though who was facing down a shark?
Why, Octavio himself, so the story goes! After sailing too far south, the boat found itself in warm shark infested waters.

setting.name: Collapsed West Wing
setting.description: The rocks have all but fallen into the ocean.  There is moss and other plant life climbing the remaining rocks, making it a very moist and gloomy environment.  There are some small left-behind pieces of what appear to have been some furniture, and possibly a cradle.
setting.background: The noble had recently brought a child into the world with his wife when this wing of the home went crashing into the ocean.  It is not know if the child perished or  not, but a crushed cradle can be seen through the rubble in the collapsed wing.

speech: "Ah, hello, child. What are you doing here?"
I have to to finish my writing before I can play
"What are you writing about, little one?"
the history of the realm, SIr
"A noble thing to write about. Is this where you live?"
Yes sir. I do not like it much. The walls are tumbling down as you can see
"Yes, of course... Are your parents here?"
My father is in the King's guard. My mother died before I knew her
"In the king's guard, you say? And this is where you live? ... I see. Have you lived here long?"
All of my life good Sir. I have a nurse you see
"Ah, yes, and is she kind to you?"
Well.... She feeds me
"Ah, yes. Well, give this to your father. I must speak to the king about about the status of his guard."
Please do not get me into trouble!

setting.name: Castle Royal tower
setting.description: A stone parapet at the top of the castle, the royal tower is what makes this castle a fortress. The walls are stone and dinged with souvenirs of past battles. It is cold and gray, but the perfect vantage point for soldiers. The wind whistles through the cracks in the wall. Straw litters the floor.
setting.background: The castle's royal tower is a lookout point for the king's men. From stone windows, soldiers can survey the land around them. You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

speech: Hello
Hello, are you a soldier?
Yes. What do you need?
Well I was called here by some guard in the name of the king, for whatever reason.
Then I suggest you find him.
I was told to come here though, so I wouldn't want to disobey his will.
Then wait here until you receive further orders.
Will do, sir.
Very well.
So what do you do around here then?
Whatever I'm told. Generally in silence.
It does seem pretty uneventful up here, not much point for a guard.
Again, I don't question. I do what I'm told. And again, it's usually in silence.
Understandable, best not to question the will of his majesty.

setting.name: Outside gates
setting.description: These outside gates are made of iron and are somewhat decorative in design.  The tops are spiked and there's a family crest that hangs on both the left and right gate telling people who resides here.
setting.background: These gates prevent unauthorized people from entering.  They also serve to tell others which family lives here.

speech: hello
Why hello guard. How are you today?
I am very well and how about yourself?
I guess I am alright. I needed to take a walk in the courtyard to calm my nerves. Hopefully I didn't startle you while on duty.
Not possible I am here to protect you
That's good to know. I guess I can't catch you off guard.
It is a beautiful out perfect for a nice relaxing walk
It truly is...I guess I was trying to bump into you though. You served my father, the king for many years now. Since I was child. May I get your opinion on something sir?
of course what is it
Well I am to be married soon to a prince from another village. I don't know him at all, so I surely don't love him. But with this marriage comes obligations..
If it were me I would surely get to know him before you are to be married
I absolutely agree! But with this marriage comes a peace treaty. We've been in conflict with their kingdom for years! But, as a royal I suppose I have to follow the will of my people and my father.
That certainly is quite the situation.  You have to ask yourself who you would rather please yourself or your family and kingdom

I've been thinking about it all day, which is why I had to take a walk. You serve and protect me, but you also protect the people during times of war. My heart says one thing, but my conscious says I should protect my people.

setting.name: Laundry Lines
setting.description: The laundry lines extend for meters. 6 rows of lines go from north to south. The area is filled with people putting their clothes to dry. All the lines are in an opening of trees that the sun hits perfectly to help dry. To the right you can see a stream through the tree where people go to wash their clothes before they hang them to dry.
setting.background: The laundry lines were set up so the villagers could have a good place to dry their laundry next to a river. They used to hang them at home but as there were times the sun wouldn't hit them directly it became a bad way to manage so instead they came together to get a place where everyone could dry.

speech: I know I am supposed to be entertaining, but deep down I have serious personal issues!
Hail jester! That wasnt very funny! Make me laugh!
See! This is exactly what I mean!
Good god! Quit your crying man! Here take a swig of this
Thank you! I'm sorry, it's just that I just lost my child and I can't find it in me to be funny at the moment!
Ive felt the sting of loss too but if you dont snap out of it the king will not be pleased with your performance
You're right! I need to get my act together! Thank you for helping me kind villager!
Aye. Now lets get our garments washed friend
Here! Take a look into this for helping me! Take your time with it while I go tend to my laundry!
What does it do
All you have to do is look into it! You will be able to see things that are destined to happen in your future!
Sounds like witchcraft to me!
Perhaps it may be! However, it has been greatly helpful for me! However, some may not like what they see...
Take it back! I want no part of this!
action: give a crystal ball to villager
give a crystal ball to jester

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: hello dear how are you today?
Pretty well, I suppose. How are you?
good, why are you in your fathers dorm?
I was just looking for a gold piece that I dropped somewhere.
ah well no need to pinch pennies we can help
Wouldn't it be better to teach me to be responsible instead of cleaning up after my losses?
dont be silly its simple money, i trust your abilites, besides youll be king soon
Hopefully, I want my chance to rule!
dont worry honey your day will come
But I don't want to wait any longer!
well as long as your father is alive it wont happen
Well he seems like his time is coming fairly soon, if you ask me.
yes but not this year, so please be patient
Who are you to say that? He could pass tomorrow for all we know!

setting.name: Main Gate
setting.description: the main gate is new and guarded, it is not run down lie many parts of the area. it is meant to intimidate attackers by making them think the area is all new and not worn down.
setting.background: the gate being new was the idea of leaders, many resources were poured into the area, to the dismay of many members of the area

speech: What are you doing here, scum?
oh you know, just attacking
Not without this you won't! Guards, seize their weapons!
I was sent here by my nobleman. He wants to add your kingdom to our own.
By treaty or by force?
Technically our army was sent here to attack. But none of us want to fight. Are you open to considering a treaty?
Perhaps, what do you have in mind regarding the terms? If outta be in our favor, as you have come here unannounced to attack us.
We could offer some of our technologies like aqueducts and sewage. And in exchange we could have representatives in your government and/or collect taxes.
Hmm I'm open to this, shall we discuss this further outside the gate with some ambassadors present?
Sure, I have some officers in my army here. I'm sure we can negotiate something.
Well stay put and put your weapons down and we can get this under way.
Okay, are you the decision maker?
Yes, I am the leader of this country and would like to be present for negotiations.

Alright. I have limited negotiation ability. I think my king has a problem with your leadership in particular, which is why he was reluctant to confront you himself. However, I think he would be open to you visiting our kingdom to speak with him there.

setting.name: bedrooms
setting.description: this bedroom is for the young prince. it is blue in color and the floors are a royal purple. the walls are covered in display swords and shields, all painted with unique colors.
setting.background: this room has been the stomping grounds of many kings and royal family, it is spotless because of the butlers and maids, and is rarely ever used except for sleep.

speech: Maid, why are you in my room?
I'm terribly sorry Prince! I was just trying to tidy the room up for you! I didn't meant to upset you!
Ah, well yes, I am sometimes pretty messy. But thats okay, I have no responsibilitys.
I wish that I could live such a life... I have been working my fingers to the bone for as long as I can remember!
Ha! Don't even try to image the life I live, very few are so fortunate. I am the son if the king! Charles the lll!
You're right! Why do I even bother trying to imagine a life outside of this!
now, now, now. Don't cry. You're going to mess up my lavish royal purple floors! I hope you have a mop.
How could you be so insensitive to me! How dare you! Your life would be a disaster without people like me!
Ha i am the PRINCE. Your prince! I will have your head!
No! You can't! I must take what I can and attempt to escape from here!
Thats it! You're done with!
SOMEBODY HELP ME!
MUAHAHA< your screams cannot be heard here.
What have I done?! My life is surely over now!

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

speech: You look as if you have seen many things! I am a very important associate of the king! Any good advice you can pass along to me?
I am from the east. I am like you, a doctor of sorts.
Doctor of sorts? What could such a crazy thing like that possibly mean?
I have studied the eastern arts. In fact, I was hoping you could assist me with some herbs here in town.
What kind of herbs are you looking for?
Well, I was hoping to get some night shade. Although I am not sure this would be a good establishment to find that in.

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: Good day ! I'm here to prepare a portion for the king .I'm his personal physician
Good day, Doctor. May I have your ear for a second?
My ear you said or my attention?
One or the other will do, Doctor
What aspect of teaching do you specialize in ?
I teach all subjects, Doctor. All that the children need for real life outside school
Then that means you help in moulding future attitudes in our kingdom.Hope you teach history too?
Of course , Doctor! History, maths, economics, cookery .. all the skills
My duties as the kings personal physician is pretty much demanding.It takes trust to be assigned that role
Where did you qualify, Doctor?
Well it was inherited from my father.Though with better modifications with the help of teachers as you
Then you have not been to medical college?!
I never said so!
But ... I would not trust a doctor to operate on me who was not qualified!

setting.name: Orc cave
setting.description: It is a dark cave that is cold and damp inside. The floor is rocks covered it bat poop. It is damp from the ceiling dripping of water. The cave just goes on what seems to be endlessly into the dark abyss. The only lite you can see is from the distance entrance of the cave.
setting.background: The cave is an old orc hiding place. It housed thousands of orcs that used it for shelter and to store their gold. The orc population has died and there is now very little that remains of the orcs that used to occupy this cave. Robbers have stolen anything worthwhile in this cave.

speech: who goes in grugs cave
Stay back orc. I am here on orders of the king himself.
please leave grug alone
I do not wish to harm you. I seek only a certain stone that may be found in the Orc caves.
grug can help grug like helping
Ah splendid. The stone I seek is is as black as the darkest night. I am told it has a faint glow about it. Have you encountered any such stones?
the dark stone is grugs favorite please dont take my stone
I see, that is unfortunate. You see dear orc, I have come to retrieve the stone because it is needed for a healing spell. A grave plague has overtaken the kingdom and this is our last hope.
if stone help please take stone but let grug visit stone
I can return it after the spell has been cast but I'm afraid by extracting it's magic it will lose its glow and become an ordinary stone. Would that be alright?
i guess so if people are happy because of grug stone
Your generosity will save the kingdom dear orc.
go and help people good magic man
We will not forget this. As they say, one good turn deserves another. Please call on me the next time you need assistance.

setting.name: Fishmonger's stall
setting.description: A small booth near the edge of the port, it's protected by a piece of old, sun-bleached sailcloth. Baskets of freshly-caught fish, bivalves, and eels sit in the shade in stained wooden troughs of water. A small, aggressive-looking dog is chained to one table, presumably to keep cats away. The stall is redolent with the aroma of fish.
setting.background: Where there's water, there are fish, and where there are fish, there are stories about "the one that got away", and of course fishermen. As they can be unpleasantly salty characters unfit for the company of the more genteel sorts of ladyfolk, enterprising individuals act as middlemen, buying fresh-caught seafood from these disreputable sorts and selling them on. This is one such enterprise, which has clearly both been here a while, and not been entirely prosperous.

speech: And what is going on here?
just selling my fish good officer
And this Pelican - does it belong to you?
no of course not sir
You ought to keep your eye on it - it is certainly keeping its eye on your catch!
yes well ill end it if it comes closer
Though of course, it could have young to feed
yes well the ocean is right there
They're very lazy birds, I hear
yes well they can catch fish and ill end any that take mine
What is your catch of the day?
pounds of trout
rainbow? Hmm. I see you have caught more than your permitted amount. Now what can we do about that?
what are you on about the king changed it these past months to allow for more fish

setting.name: The beach
setting.description: Sand that is white as snow. the water is as clear as a crystal. down the shore is some cliffs
setting.background: This beach is a very famous beach that everyone that lives in the area knows about. Most people come every summer and enjoy the weather.

speech: Hello, welcome to the beach. My name is John the crab.
Hello, John. How are you on this fine morning?
I am doing well. The weather is amazing, don't you love the beach? It's so relaxing.
I do. After a long week in the fields it is nice to have a warm sunday at the beach. Do you have a family, John?
No, I am all alone. All of my family was eaten in the sea buy pesky sea gulls, fish and sharks. I hope no one eats me too!
Well John, there isn't much cover for you on a beach like this. Maybe you should take refuge in my basket, here.
Gee, that is very nice of you. Thank you so much! I never got your name...
My pleasure, John. I am Steve, a simple farmer for the king. How long have you been on your own?
I have been on my own for the past 2 years. It's been rough
Poor guy, now don't pinch me, but I have a little suggestion for you.
I would never do such a thing. Are you on your own too?
I have a wife and 3 children, actually. Would you like to come home with me?
Yes, I would love that. As long as you promise not to eat me. Do you live close to the beach?
I can't actually promise that, John. We live close enough for me to carry you there.
