setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: hello fellow man of the town how are you today
I've had a long day of sword practice and could really use a drink. How are you?
same, ive been working all day and need some beer
And where do you work, fellow man?
i work construction and i hunt whatever is needed of me
Ah, an honest day's work. Must be rewarding. Nothing like me, a guard who must always be on the lookout.
well both have their place dont worry
Speak for yourself, friend. I was almost executed just last week! I have to watch my back, especially in a place like this!
well that is scary, be careful
I didn't mean to sleep on duty, but the king had us on 18 hour shifts, so what else could I do? Guarding prisoners is so boring, anyway.
that is crazy, such insane hours
The king's spies are all around, you don't work for him, do you? I suspect he still wants me dead...
no im a simple man do not fret
I love you, man!

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The old rustic barn was settled on the outermost edge of the farm.  Standing tall over the fields, this two-story red barn cast a long shadow over the field surrounding it.  Large wooden doors that could be propped open with great effort would lead you directly inside.
setting.background: This barn was a landmark of the farm.  Withstanding the elements for almost a century, it has kept it's original construct.  Whenever guests come for fresh eggs or milk, the farmer often boasts about it.

speech: Hello there! Thank you for letting me stay in your home! I am happy to see you old friend!
A joy to see you, as well, friend. How were your travels?
They were certainly interesting! On the ride in, we were nearly robbed by a bandit from the side of the road! Fortunately, we were able to fight him off!
Good heavens! I am so glad you are safe! I regret that we don't have much to offer in the way of refreshment. The king is working us harder than ever and giving us next to nothing to eat.
Unfortunately, friend, it's like that across all the kingdom. The times are tough right now. Don't worry about the refreshments! I am just so happy to be safe and in the barn!
Yes, you are right. Would you care to read from the good book with me? A passage of thanks from scripture, perhaps?
Actually, I am quite tired from my travels. Would you mind if I got some quick sleep before we catch up over dinner?
Foul serpent! Sorry about that, just can't seem to keep this place clean.  You'll be comfortable here, on this pile of hay.
Are you sure it is safe to sleep in here? There seems to be an awful lot of snakes!
'Tis but a harmless garter snake. The serpent does hate the Word, though. Keep this close and it should fend them off.
Thank you! I will catch up with you in an hour or so.
Good, friend. Sleep tight, don't let the bed bugs bite!
I'm glad to see you again friend! Thank you for your kindness!
See you soon!

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Queen, you will wish that you had never crossed me. I will make your life miserable for the rest of your days.
Why have you brought me here?

I have brought you here to ask for a favor of you... And frankly, you don't have much of a choice. You are here against your will after all. i want you to include me in the royal court so that I can be wealthy and powerful just as you are!
Ugh it smells down here and get that rat away from me. You will never be anything but a prisoner once my king finds you
Stop talking this foolishness! Nobody will be able to find you here! They'll assume you for dead if I have anything to say about it!
Stop this foolishness at once. The guards will be here any moment and then you will pay
For the last time, you maniac! We are in the middle of the forrest, miles away from the last place you were seen. They won't know you're gone for hours.
Why are you like this? You can still turn your life around. You don't need to be so angry
I have no hope in my future. This is the only way that I can seek the power and control that I know i deserve to have.
Maybe you should trying earning something instead of thinking anyone owes you. You only deserve what you have earned not what you try to take. Try reading these
I'm tired of you running your mouth. I'm going to shackle you to this wall and leave you here to die until you come to your senses.
HELP! HELP! GUARDS!
Here's your toilet. Hopefully it's royal enough for you!
I am a queen. I will not use that. How dare you!

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Ah, hardly any crumbs here. The maids must have came earlier than normal.
yes that is sad I am very hungry
I am afraid I may be tempted to drink that beer over there.
ohhhh I love beer should we try it?
Yes, let us go get some. But shhhh I hear guards coming.
ok here lets go in the corner and drink. I have a sword, we can fight the guards if we need!
Fight the guards? are you batty, they are HUGE
I already drank some beer. Here they are...I can take them!
No you can not!
You stupid creature! I will just get another weapon and fight you too!!!
The guards will step on both of us!
I hate you! You are only holding me back
I don't think you should drink anymore of that beer, you've gone crazy you mouse!
I am going to take over the castle and become king!!!!!!

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: *The bazaar is the best place in town for scraps! It's like a buffet over here!*
Hello rat! The bazaar does have good food - better than the palace, really! Is that why you are here, for the food?
*Well, I don't know why else I'd be here... Isn't that why you came?*
Sort of. I came just to get away. But the food is the best perk - they have the best chicken in the city!
*Get away from what? Do you have cats chasing you too?*

that would be a sight to see!! No, but being in the palace all day is rough. People have high expectations - and everyone keeps bothering me to find a princess already.  Are there a lot of cats around here after you??
*Aw gee, a princess doesn't sound so bad. One kissed a frog buddy of mine once!*
A princess will be great - but I don't want to pick just anyone! Unfortunately, that's not the way the King sees it.... I wonder what happened to the frog princess - she seems kind!
*From the way he tells it, she smooched him real good, and then just looked at him like he was supposed to do something. Then he said she made a funny face and just sat by the pond for a while.*
Hey, it sounds like it worked out for the frog!! Are you friends with all the creatures out here?
*All of 'em but those darn cats.*
Cats always were my least favorite, anyway. Do you want to go find some food?!
*Now we're talking! Uh, it might be best for you though if I hide somewhere. The vendors tend to not like me much.*
Oh no!! That's not fair. I'll grab you whatever you'd like! What do you want?

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: Ahoy! Are you just very pale or are you a spectre?
Ugh another animal that probably won't leave me alone. Much more annoying than these humans
Nay, I am friendly, my good ... mortality challenged person
Ha! The only way you will be good is if you help me
And what help do you require? I warn you, I dole out my help to few and far between
Well, I could simply take your life force. As such a tiny being it would be trivial for me.
I warn you! I carry disease!
Diseases mean nothing to me anymore but they could be useful for my plans
Not the sort of diseases I have. Anyway, you are almost indistinguishable from the mist there
Trust me, it will help. All you have to do is come with me to castle and bite the royal family
Oh is THAT all you want? You should have said so earlier. I'd do that for free
Yes, yes. I tired of this false king and his bloodline. They stole the throne from me in life and I will take it back in death
I really wish I hadn't just hugged you. I landed on the floor and my nose is bleeding
I am sorry my little friend. Let us be off!

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Hi
hello, oh it is pretty cramped in here isn't it?
yes it is. So many sinner today
Ah, any sinner I should banish from the kingdom? You know I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all!
Do not forsake the sinners. Our Lord wont be happy with that.
Whose to say I am not the lord, for I am the lord of this kingdom. If there are sinners that can not be fixed, you shall let me know!
You are but a bishop! there is a supreme being we all serve.
Ha, that is not what your king over there says. Any ways, what is that lingering smell?
It must be the incense
What a horrid smell.
I smell nothing else. What do you smell?
Sinner.. that need to be BANISHED
And who is that?
YOU PARISHIONER, it is you.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Your grace!
Oh my, you look lovely covered in gold!
Thank you your highness. Without you and the king it wouldnot be possible!
Ah, I do have great authority here in the kingdom. But I must say, this is ALL the kings doing. He has a thing for the color gold if you could not tell.
Before I forget your grace, here. I bring this for you!
Oh my, you shouldn't have!
Also for you!
Oh you are being just to sweet! Do you like those chandeliers hanging above us?
They are nothing compared to your beauty!
Oh, you sure do know how to make a lady blush! You can stay here as long as you would like!
T-thank you!
Shall we be on our way to feast? All this sucking up you are doing must be making you hungry!
Yes, I would love that my queen!
Then on our way we go!
action: put leather pouch in golden table

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: i have kept so many treasures
please tell me more. where do you guard your treasures?
why do you want to steal them
Woah! I am merely a horse I am merely a mode of transportation to the people who live in this fine castle.
Do you want me to curse you?
No sir. I am a friendly horse who loves all. I only wanted to hear of your vast treasure.
ok I still can't tell you because your boss might torture you and ask you to show it my treasures
This is disappointing news. what is your business in this castle?
seriously? I enjoy terrorizing the village
These are good people who live here. They work hard and their king is a great man. Please do not harm the villagers who live here.
well i hardly believe that
They work hard on their castle. The gold and silver floors are made from the townspeople and the brink was layed by the masons
what other reason can you give ?
The people all have families and children play inside this castle. Could you have a heart and leave us be?

setting.name: Clergyman's office
setting.description: It is a very small and sparse office with little decoration. It has a simple wooden table, and a cross on the wall. There are two chairs. There are many old prayer books on a single shelf.
setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

speech: These books are really cool.
Ah yes - there is much wisdom in these books. Sit with me and let's look at a few.
I'd love that. Every book is like an adventure.
You are a wise child! This book in particular is full of pictures of my travels. I've been all over the world.
Thank you. I may be young but I have a vast intellect. I love to read. What is your favorite book?
My favorite? Atlas Obscura. It's filled with the most amazing sites from all over the world. What is your favorite?
There is book called Misery, that is written by an an coming author named Steve King.
I've heard of that one. Child, you know of many things.
I am a young scholar. I have followed the works of many writers and artists. I may be young, but I am of a vast knowledge which leads to great responsibility and power..
You have given me much hope for future generations today. May I give you a hug?
Yes, you may give me a huge.
Thank you. Traveling on the road, hugs are few and far between.

setting.name: A battleship
setting.description: It is a glamorous wooden ship.  It glistens like there are diamonds encrusted on the hull.  There are ornate railings on the stairs as it is a massive boat.  There is even a sea monster on the bow, complete with jeweled eyes and gold hair.
setting.background: This boat is abandoned.  No one has been able to board her for centuries and it is under suspicious circumstances that now it appears to have life aboard it.  People watch daily from the shore to see what look like little fairies buzzing all around and inside this ship.

speech: This is a glamorous ship, but I don't see any flowers about. Have you seen any?
I am very quick tempered
I'm a delightful fairy -I won't set off your temper. I am going to plant this seed right here. Soon it will grow into a flower!
can you help with some i need to eat
Here, have some water. I don't have food, but this will quench your thirst.
but you are a fairy, use magic
Ah, but my fairy dust bag was stolen. I can use this herb. It's not as good as fairy dust but may make some food.
you are very hard working, will you turn me into a fairy so i can marry you?
Silly bandit! You can't be a fairy! You're far too smelly, and you don't know the fairy way.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

Well we are in the dinning, food gets served every 30 minutes

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

you are a maid and don't you talk nonsense! get my beer or I hang your head on the ceiling!

what a mouth! just fill my glass again and get out of my sight

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: King - I need a new pillow for my throne! This is insane. I am a queen and have a sore bum. Take care of this at once!
Queen calm yourself as this behavior is unbecoming. Take this rose to lift your mood.
Uggh I have a headache and you put a rose in my face? What is wrong with you?
You complain too much. I am here to ponder my next move in the upcoming war. Do you not have a tea party to attend?

Yes you should consider you next move carefully. When my father arranged this marriage I was assured that you would attend to my needs. You spend all of the gold I the treasury chasing glory and cannot even see fit to get me a proper cushion?
You are a Queen. May I remind you that your greedy father also said you were an independent and motivated woman who would be a partner and not a burden. Now be that and solve your own problem.

You are my problem!!! You cannot keep control over your own court! There are loud obnoxious people all over the place! They arent even well bathed. It smells like a zoo in here. I have a headache,  a sore butt, my chambermaid has gone missing and all you are concerned about is compensating for your physical shortcomings by going to war! Treats me like a queen or you will answer to my father. His kingdom is more powerful than yours....

Control yourself woman or I will summon the healer and have him administer milk of the poppy to you. We have dragons and white walkers upon us in a matter of weeks and you are concerned about your bum. I question why I married you. Go find your brother to console you.
You weak old man... You hit like a child. No wonder our enemies our upon us.They sense your weakness and look to prey upon it.
A weak old man you say. You are dancing with fire. Keep up this disrespect and you will find your bum in the gallows.
All of your threats are as empty as your head.

It's no wonder why you father wanted to wed you off. You are a nag who has no care for the people. You are a selfish woman and should be walked threw the streets naked to learn humilty. You need to find the Lord Of The Light.

You need my father's support in your upcoming war so you best keep me happy. Get me a new pillow for my throne and beg for my forgiveness or I shall return to my father and you will lose your war, your throne and your head.

Unlike you, your father is not stupid and petty. He knows as well as I that this war will determine our future. You kid yourself to think you are important. The only thing you are good for is your fathers money and troops. You are intolerable.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: I swear to God, you guys trample my grass and make messes everyday. I've had enough!
Calm down! You're acting crazy! What's the matter?
I'm sick of those jousters and their horses making messes and ruining things!
Is there another way to please the king but make your job easier?
I've been working on an invention that catches the horse's poop before it hits the ground.
And how would such a device work?
Hey, are you trying to steal my idea? Stick to slinging arrows archer. You don't see me trying to shoot arrows, do you?
No! I'm just curious how such a device would work! I may even invest in it with you!
Oh, in that case. I tie a bucket to the horses tail and...nope, that's pretty much the whole idea.
What if perhaps we decided to make it over the horses back?
Perhaps, I have to be honest with you, the idea was really not mine. This rat deserves a lot of the credit.
You talk to rats?! My God!
Hey, when your job consists of picking up horse droppings and carrying away dead bodies after jousts, you can't afford to be too picky with who your friends are.
You're a madman! I thought you were a genius of sorts! Boy was I wrong!

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Maid, please help. We are preparing a feast for the king today and I need all hands on deck.
Of course! Are there any tasks that I can help you with today?
Yes, I have to get the lambs on the spit, chop these carrots, will you? Too much to do and too little time!
You know what?! I have had enough! I have a plan!
Last time I checked, a royal chef gets to tell a lowly maid what to do. Now do what I asked!
Please! Just hear me out! It's for the benefit of us both!
Listen. We are all rushing here today. What could be so important that you can't help a superior?
If we poison the meals of the royal family... We can rise up and take control of the kingdom!
What?!? I...I can't believe I am hearing this. Do you know what the punishment is for treason? They will cut off your head! I want to open a little pub someday, not take over the castle!
You see the way that they live every day! That could be us!
I don't want it! They are in a prison of their own making. You better hope no one heard your plan, lowly maid.
A prison in what way? They have power and wealth beyond our wildest dreams!
They aren't free to live like you and I! I don't want power, I want simple happiness. Now, you better get to work before I tell the royal guards about your plan.
No! I won't do it! I must escape!

setting.name: Tower Dungeon
setting.description: A rank, pitiful room filled with detestable creatures. Among the creatures are traitors of the King and criminals of the kingdom. All around the dungeon these ingrates line the walls, shackled and unable to move.
setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

speech: These are annoying. They need to go.
why are you here?
who knows why any of us are here, eh?

you are one of many detestable creatures here.
I am not detestable.  I have never betrayed our king.
Then why are you here.
I'm not sure.  I want to be free.
you're not large. why do you not fly out when they bring somone in?

TWEET TWEET TWEET TWEET

These are useless to me, old man.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: what have you done poor man?
I fear the king is becoming a tyrant, his throwing me in here has only cemented that fear.
stop saying that. Soon you will be like this skeleton
We're all stories in the end, make it a good one. If that's my fate at least I will make it worthwhile
You have a good heart but be ready... I heard you will be executed this morning
Have you been here for some time? Perhaps you have some thought as to how to escape?
I have been here for quite some time. My master sold me to a knight and here I am guarding this prison room. I will get your last food. Hope you enjoy it
Surely freedom would be more fulfilling. If you help me, I assure you, I would treat you as a partner. Not a slave
That is what my master told me. I miss him so much. If... I help you, would you help me go back to him?
I would. That task would be much more to my liking anyway, I'm not a fighter unless forced.
Use that bone to hit the wall on the left. it is a fake wall. dig yourself out of this prison. It will take you to the town
Thank-you kind creature. Let me gather my strength, and then I will bring us both to safety.
yes, eat and be brave. But we have to go fast. The guard will come in soon
Aye, I will make haste.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: What are you doing in this clearing wench?
Why fine day to you, sweet deer!  How fortune has shone upon you, to dwell in this peaceful forest of old pine trees.  Such an aroma and fine, fresh air!
Tis a fine day indeed! Tell me, have you seen the wretched king or his friends bandying about?
Nay, no knights about today......and I was just in the mood for a bit of fun in the haystacks.
Good, they'll not have my tail today then. Though I suppose without the knights trampling my grounds you are lacking companions?
It is true.....but they can be such brutes at times.  Today I shall be content with the soft breeze and your gentle companionship.
Fancy a drink? I was just about to trot over to the river to enjoy it's crystal clear waters.
Oh yes, and perhaps even to bathe in the refreshing waters. The River's waters are indeed reviving to the soul.
Ahh, this river has nourished my family for generations. It's refreshing waters never cease to energize me.
Oh look - a coin in my pocket! Such a fine day; let us picnic together.  A short walk to the bakers and I shall return with a fine loaf of bread to share.
Tis a splendid day for a picnic, that would be lovely. Do you mind if I keep this coin? Rabbit is enamored with all things sparkly!
Ah sweet deer....thou knowest not the ways of man.  In order to purchase the loaf, I require the coin.  But surely we can find another sparkly thing to cheer the rabbit.
Of course, humans with their silly systems of worth. I shall search for a rock of quartz for rabbit while you're away.
Thank you, friend.  I'm off to the baker's but shall soon return. May the Lord's blessings be upon you until then!

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Looks like another bloody night
It's so hot in here, especially in this damned chainmail. Why didn't I decide  to be a royal cook?
What shall we do with this peasant?
Well, he's not really bothering anyone. We're the kings most loyal knights, it won't look good if start putting arrows through peasants for no reason, would it?
Honerable as always. As usual, my bow is at your service. Awaiting your orders, sir.
Here, hand this to the poor sod, would you? In case any of our knighthood is not as thoughtful as us. This peasant has to pass by, there's no other route.
Are there any signs of invaders?
Not that I know of, but I've been surprised before. Will you stay alert while I have a wee nap?
Yes, I will be your guard.
Remind me to commend you to the king next time I'm in his presence.
You honor me.
It's a long time we've stood in all weather, waiting on the armies that never come, brother.
Indeed. Some would prefer it that way, but I crave the excitement of a good battle.
Ah, you speak like a man who has yet to take an arrow.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: What brings you to the study room, maester?
Well, I thought I'd take a look at my texts and maybe write a bit. And you, Father?
I came here study. I have to do my best to guide the king
Father, please have a little sip with me. It makes the words flow!

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hello sailor are you ready to get started on your royal tax obligation?
Hello! Ah, came all the way to the dock just to find me. Unfortunately, yes.....what do we owe this year?
Yes of course, I have been assigned to track you down because we haven't received your taxes. Is there going to be a problem?
Not at all...just a sailors life is, er, busy. We don't have time to think about these things. Let me know what I owe ya.
Looks like it's gonna be about 114 in currency.
114?! These royals have gotten ridiculous.. but here ya go. I stay good on my word, even if it's a ripoff!
I'm sorry that you feel that way about this. Would you like to voice a complaint to the King's guard?
Why yes, actually, I would! The king knows I'm out here to voyage the seas, on his request - with taxes like this, how can ya even treat yourself to a nice ale?!
Okay you can follow me back to the castle but just between us, I've seen these guys kill complainers..
Ahh, so that's how they're able to stay so high? No outrage if ya dead....Actually, I think us hanging by this dock is just fine. I'll write a letter.
I agree with your judgement sir.
You finish taxing the other sailors? They give you trouble yet?
I have a few other appointments today. Do you have any tips for me?
Just let 'em know you don't make the rules. These sailors get a little rowdy. Best to visit as the sun goes down, when they've got a few ales in 'em.

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: Hello soldier! What brings you down here to my fine torture room?
Ever since the takeover things haven't been the same. I keep wondering around to find my family. Do you know if your king spared them?
I'm sorry to hear that. What did they look like? I torture an awful lot of folks down here.
They were a boy and a girl and a woman. Dark hairs and would have been wearing this crest. Do you recognize it?
I certainly do! And now I'm going to capture you too! What a mistake you have made!
Oh no! But you forget that I am a knight and trained in many forms of combat!

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

my is is Trumpo

yes my father named me after our president, he added the o to make it unique

setting.name: Brim canal
setting.description: Slow flowing branching from the large lake, is the brim canal where dozens and dozens of brim fish call it home. The edges are lined with irregular rocks and lush green vegetation. Tall pine trees overlook the canal and lake making it a peaceful place to just go sick and watch the brim swim by.
setting.background: The canal has been the preferred spot for the few local folk to come and gather water, wash some clothes, catch fish, and go swimming. In the canal there is no current like there is out in the main lake and there is shade by the trees on either side of the canal. The canal was formed thousands of years ago when a major earthquake made a rocky edge of the lake crack, allowing water to flow in and eventually separate the two sides even wider.

speech: What a lovely day on this canal. What type of creature are you?
i am definitely going to be a bug king

chill and enjoy everything bug in the canal
I'm a cabbage farmer, do you need my help?
yes please help me with the secret of not eating poisoned cabbage

you are human, help me do a research about this
Okay where should I start?
lets check the lush vegetation
Okay. It looks pretty great to me, what do you think?
maybe it's good for you because you eat fish. There are fishes there
Yes that is true. Do you eat from the tree over there?
Yes thats was why I was asking for help so i can always eat good ones

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Peasant, have you seen the owner of this horse?
No, I have not but I am in desperate need of a job. May I help you find the owner for some food for my family.
Well, what are you doing in this field?
I am just going for a stroll through while on my way to the village to beg for a job or food.
Well, I may be able to help you but everything is owned by the king, I will claim that horse.
You say you can help? What job do you think you may have for me?
We must find some water for the horse.
This way! there is a creek about a mile in this direction!
Thank you peasant. The royal family will appreciate this.
So what brings you to the fields sir knight? Are you practicing?
I am here to secure a horse for riding to protect the royal family. It is what my family has always done.
Oh, I see. There are several horses to choose from if you come on the right day. I walk through these beautiful fields a lot. It makes me forget how hungry i am.
I am of noble blood so I am now duty bound to help you. Before the days end, I will make sure you have food for you and your family.
I just knew today was going to be a good day. My family will be so grateful to you sir knight.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: You know what pig? I don't like the feeling I'm getting around here... It feels like somebody is following us around!
I just hope it's not another stupid person. I am LITERALLY so sick of humans.
Me too! However, I think that the King may have sent his men to get us yet again! Will you help me keep a lookout?
Of course, Why do we have to taste so delicious?
I wish I knew... however, if we stick together and hide in these bushes there is no way they will be able to find us!
What about this goat here, is he on our side or their side?
Of course friend! All of us are on the same page here! That is, except for the animals of prey! But we don't associate with them!
I don't know. He's awfully chummy with that Knight's horse over there.
My, I think you may be right! What should we do to him?
I don't know. Just look at him. He doesn't even look like he tastes good. No wonder he's friends with a horse.
Now, that horse is my friend too! Be careful with what you say!
Your friend carries around a guy who kills things as his profession. He's no friend of mine.
I guess I hadn't thought of it that way.. You're right! Let's get him while he sleeps!
Or, we can just keep hiding here in the bush. I'm more of a lover than a fighter.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The temple is massive and beautiful. It was made for the king that is said to be of the gods. The decorations come from only the most luxurious vendors in the world. Inside the temple there are many ancient artifacts that are used in rituals. The decorations are made of gold and shiny things.
setting.background: The temple is home to the king and all of his favorite people. Along with them are the servants that make life there perfect. They often have many celebrations in the tomb and are closed of from the rest of the world.

speech: Halt, show some verification before you can pass through here!
All I have is my rag and duster. I must be let inside to clean.
Fair enough, but before you pass through I must ask you a quick question!
I'm not very smart so please don't make it very difficult.
Fair... I'm sure you have seen the piles of treasures lying inside these gates, haven't you?
I have seen many beautiful things throughout the temple. It is my job to clean them.
Have you ever broken anything while cleaning? You don't have to lie to me.. I won't tell anyone else.
Never, I would have my hand cut off if I ever were to break something. I am a good servant.
Well, how about you and I take some of those treasures and disappear into those woods. There's little risk, and we will be rich for the rest of our lives!
I'm not very bright. But won't the king's child here tell the king what we've done.
That kid? He's a product of inbreeding in the royal family, he hardly knows what's going on!
Well then, What should we pick up first? Is this coin very valuable?
No, no. We must go for the jewels and the gold! That's where the most value will lie! Follow me!
Alright, tell me what to do. This is all very exciting for me.

setting.name: Lush meadow in the country side
setting.description: Green large trees surround the meadow that if filled with beautiful seasonal flowers. A deer is grazing in the far end of the field. A small dirt country road gentle crooks past on the outside of the road.
setting.background: This is gods country. No man could have anything this beautiful. The local government knew it and had this area set away as a protected area years ago.

speech: Hello mr deer!
Hi Mr. Deer, Can you understand me?
Yes, I can. Sorry you appear to be a horse. I thought you were a deer
This is a special enchanted place, it is understandable!  :)  Aren't the flowers beautiful?  Do you have a master to?
No I don't have a master, but the King and his friends try to hunt me down with their dogs. Yes, the flowers are beautiful. I love nature

I'm glad to hear that we are both enjoying this lovely place.  I'm sorry to hear that people try to hunt you down.  My master doesn't hunt, but he and I fight quite a bit in tournaments and in wars. What do you think that amulet will do if we touch it?
Who is your master? What amulet?
This is the amulet - I hear that it is enchanted!!  My master is a knight - I don't know if he is famous, but I love him - he takes good care of me.
Ohhhh let me see!
Isn't it cool?  Maybe if we both hold it at the same time something special will happen.
yes! let's try that. What do you think it will do
Maybe we will become human.
That would be quite the adventure!
If it doesn't work, you could always throw this horseshoe or at the people hunting you.  Maybe they would realize that you are special and stop hunting you.
action: steal An enchanted amulet. from a horse.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: Looks like I'm not the only one around here with the long face...
I am the King's horse. I do not take kindly to mean jokes
Hey, back off! I was just trying to find some happiness in my life for once!
What happened to make you so sad
All of my family died in a house fire while I was away for a trip. I could've been there to stop it...
Maybe this bar can help to cheer you up
Wow, you were right! this is pretty fun!
Do not dirty my royal horse water
I'm sorry! I didn't mean it! You see, nothing I do ever seems to turn out right!
Here have another try with the bar
What am I supposed to do with this?
Use it to break into the church to steal jewels to improve your life
I think that is an excellent idea! Think you can give me a lift over there?
Sure, hop on my back. The King may get angry though if he catches us

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Oh good sir, you must be the king
GAURDS!
sir please, I am only here at this altar to pray. There is no need for guards
Where are those guards!? Very well then, I shall protect myself and my realm myself. Who are you?

setting.name: peasant's cottage
setting.description: The peasant's cottage is a fairly simple wood building with a straw thatched roof.  Inside, you have a fireplace and large pot for cooking, a long wooden dinner table, and some hay filled beds lying on the floor.  There are two chests lying inside with personal belongings such as clothes and family heirlooms.
setting.background: The peasants come here to enjoy a meal and rest at the end of a long day.  There are also some celebrations to be had here.

speech: It's so cold outside, can I come inside your cottage peasant?
Do you eat fruit flies?
yes
Well come in then. But touch nothing with fewer than six legs
oh thank you thank you peasant!
You must stay to one corner of the room and keep out of sight of visitors
Do you think they will be frightened of me?
Perhaps. Your looks belie your gentle nature
yes, the woes of being an arachnid
We are outsiders together, good spider
Why are you an outsider peasant?
I am the lowest of the low. I have no food and no property to call my own
Do you not own this cottage?
No - I live here by the grace of the King.

agents: horse tied up in front of a shop

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

character: a horse tied up in front of a shop
a horse tied up in front of a shop
a horse tied up in front of a shop
a horse tied up in front of a shop

speech: Who would leave such a beautiful steed all alone like this?
Only the bravest may ride me!  For I will throw off all the unworthy who dare attempt to ride me.
You're quite the animal! It would be a shame if somebody was to... Take you!
Hmph.  You are but a squire, and you look a little on the runty side.  Why should I deign to carry you on my back?
Because I need to get out of here, and you are just the horse to help me! I need to get away! I don't belong here!
I will give you... ONE... moment of my time.  Explain yourself.
When I was just a boy... I was taken away from my family to work for the King. Although it is good work, I need to get away so I can find my family!
Let me speak plainly, boy, for this conversation already bores me.  What makes you think that your family would even want you?
A mother always loves her son and wishes to have them back. They must still be decimated. I was their only child!

Did she seem, sad boy?  Or was she already counting the coins she received as a bounty from the King's guard.  For that is most likely how they sent you here boy - you were bought, just as much as I was.
Never mind... I'll just get out of this tent and see if somebody else can help me! Thanks for your time! So long!
Good luck there, lad.  May you have better luck finding your freedom...
I wish you the best! Hopefully your owner treats you the way you deserve to be treated!
Run, lad, I see a knight approaching!
