setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: I work for the king and ensure that his estate is smooth and running well
Have you taken the Lord into your life, my friend?
well, what do you mean by that
Why, the holy word of course! Do they have church services for those of you that tend to the grounds?
Well there is a begger here, don't you think you should preach to him first?
Why just one of you? The Lord loves all his children!
what do you do when you are not preaching
I try to spend all of my free time dedicating my life to those in need. Providing food and shelter for those who need it.
well father, dont you see that I am carry the candle and the cross, I am changed already
I suppose I should have thought of that... It's just that... Some only appear to live this life while others truly believe in it
father i have repented and i am willing to give all my stolen wealth to the church so you can be richer ..hahaha, kidding father, I really want to give it all to the church
You're a kind soul. This really is a beautiful church isn't it? With all it's decorative art and architecture!
yes it is father
Do you two know each other?

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: Good evening, human friend
Good evening cat.  What are you doing in the Kings kitchen?
It is a kitchen. Why else would a cat be here? And I have bought a gift for you
A gift for me?  From a cat?  Whatever could it be?
A bird, chef. Though I want my share raw
Well, thank you.  How did you come across this fine delicacy?
I killed it, eviscerated it and thought you'd like it
Well, I guess I could cook this up, add some spices, and serve it to the king for supper.  He's always asking for something different.  I will be grad to remove a portion for you before I boil it.
And marinade it nicely
First I will need to pluck these feathers.  I don't want you to choke on them.
That is thoughtful of you

Here i your portion.  I'm going to just throw this into the stove with some potatoes and carrots and let it cook for a few hours. Say cat, I was wonder if you can do me a favor when you are done eating.  I have to paper that I need delivered to my friend in the royal court. Would you do me that favor?
I might ... but I do not do anything for nothing
What is it you want now.

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: Aha.. who have we here?
I am a traveller just passing through.  I saw this old ruined house and thought I would stay the night.  It is cold and I was going to start a fire with this old wood.
None pass through here without my consent!

We my friend, I do not mean to intrude on your space.  I have travelled the world and seen may things.  I try not to disturb the people and wild life around me.  I just need a place to stay the night and then I'll will be on my way.
In that case we can be friends. But you must respect myself and my pack
of course.  Maybe you can help me.  I found this old tattered map.  I wonder if you recognize this area marked with an X.
Ah ... yes, I know this area. But how do i know that I can trust you?
Well, I promise to share whatever I find with you and your pack.  On my honor and on the sword of my king.
Then I accept
Please join me at the fire and we can make a plan to follow this map come morning.  Tonight we shall feast.
Ah, I smell roasting meats!
That is why there is blood on the sword.  I recently killed a deer with it.  It is over there in the corner.  I will get this fire going and cook it for you and your pack.
We are happy to eat it raw
Whatever you fancy.
action: give a tattered map to wolf
put a tattered map in wolf costume

setting.name: tower spire
setting.description: A large spire at the tower top. It overlooks the city, maybe the tallest structure. You cans see it all from up here, all directions, all four of them.
setting.background: This is the peak of the tower. It was build last as the tower was started at the bottom, and only finished when the top was all the way on it. A pointy spike atop a tower. A bird makes a nest by it. It's a crow, but not a magic one.

speech: This is way too high up, I must get down soon.
Buzz, take me with you, back to those delicious horses, buzz.
You are annoying me, quit buzzing around me!
Hey! I am just being a fly! C'mon give me a little snack..
You're biting me for no reason! I must get down off this spire though before I panic.
Very well, hey, what's this!?
Hey give that back, that's mine!
I'm only curious, life's pretty dull around here when everyone's trying to kill you just because you want to eat. C'mon and read it to me.
Oh fine! The letter is from my family. I am in trouble and had to send them into hiding.
Whyever for? Sorry for getting it messy...
It's okay. The king is after us. He thinks I betrayed him.
Well did you?
Of course not! I would never betray my leader!
Where did you send your family?

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Do  you know why we are here today?
Not sure why I was summoned here today
I want you to help more with the kingdom.
I would be proud to help out and do more for the kingdom
here is a shield as well.
You stupid, stupid little man. I plan to take over this kingdom. You are done and I will make sure you don't live to see another day,.
I do not come down easily though.
You will fall and I will be king. I can't wait for you to die any longer
Not if I take you down first. This could be easy or it can be hard.
And that is the last word you wil say. I do not need you to run this kingdom. I will leave you die in this crypt. You are bleeding. I have struck you.
I can still attempt to fight, This isn't always the end. I have struck you as well, as I did steal the sword.
You will fall like the fallen in the painting on the wall. You have nothing left to fight for. Take that and that
you will only dishonor the kingdom. power is not what you think it is.
I have yet to finish you and you will be forgotten and never remembered by the people of this land
action: remove the royal coat of arms

setting.name: a room hidden in the dense canopy
setting.description: Its a large room with types of beings you have never seen before. There is a counter and a person who greets people suprise when you arrive because you are not one of them. The room has an unfamiliar feel to it. with doors leading to walkways, other buildings, an entire city
setting.background: A group of beings that prefer to stay hidden from the outside world. You some how find your way to the entrance of their city

speech: Welcome to my canopy. What can I do for you?
If you can just help me with this that'd be great, I'm a guest visiting friends and have been carrying this a long way!
Of course I can carry this suitcase with my manly arms. Where am I bringing it?
In the corner of the room hidden in the dense canopy is fine! I can enjoy the room then!
Who are you here to visit may I ask?
Well there must be millions of people through these walkways? I wouldn't want to bother you with trivial details like names!
Ok then, well I have to go tend to the horses now.
What kind of horses!? I love horses!
Clydesdales of course! Only the best for the king!
They are the best! All the way from Scotland!
Yes sir they are. I also have to finish carving my sculpture.
Is the sculpture of the horses?
Why, yes it is. It's one of my hobbies to sculpt these creatures.
A very talented man you are!

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Hello there, how are you today?
I am doing fairly well. Just passing through and decided to stop into this shop. And yourself?
Well not to well since I am being me married off to another country soon.
That sounds rough. Why don't you fight it or leave?
Because if I don't war will break out...
That's a lot to have on your shoulders. I'm sorry to hear that.
It is okay as the only daughter of the king and queen it is my duty...
I wish I had more to offer to help you, but maybe this will help you some.
Thank you that is all I needed.

I am on my way to establishing some new property off in the mountains away from the hustle and bustle of the kingdom. If you would like, you could come with me. I'm not much company but I am sure it will be better than a forced marriage. While you have a duty to your kingdom and family, you also have a duty to yourself as well. Which duty you choose is up to you.
I think.... I would like to go with you...
Come quickly then. We will sneak you away, out the back and they won't notice until you're gone.
We must ditch the guards outside

I will try my best to distract them while you sneak out the back and I will meet you behind the temple. From there it is a straight shot out of the kingdom walls and on the path to the mountains. We can get as far as we can before the sun begins to set and set up camp for the night.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Why are you sad, woman? Has anyone done anything to you?
Oh no, it's only time and this wicked world we live in that made my husband fall ill and took him from me too soon.
I am sorry to hear that. I have some extra meat that I have caught. i can give you some to take home.
That's very kind of you. My children will be glad for the extra food.
Your husband didn't eat the mushrooms that are all around here. they are poisonous
He ate some mushrooms that grew closer to our house, where the forest is kinder, but never the ones from this deep in the woods.
That is good. If there anything that you need, my sons and I will try to help with anything.
How old are your sons?
they are in their early 20's. they are strong and can help with chores
I can't offer them much for their trouble, but I could spare some vegetables from the garden from time to time.
We are not asking for anything, but sharing is always nice. They will be more than happy to help. We have plenty.
That's so kind of you.
I do not need to have hugs. You will be fine and I will let the king know that you are without husband. He will definitely bring more help to you.
I loved my husband and miss him desperately, but what business is it of the king's

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: hello, knight
This place look pretty treacherous. Do you live here?
I live in the mountains
I see. I better get away from this edge. It seems crumbly and my horse seems a little spooked. I will back off a bit.
good idea. I like to stand at the edge to look at the valley below. besides, I have wings.
Yes you look large and well equipped for these valleys and mountains. Are you a fire breathing dragon?
No, unfortunately, I have no fire to breathe.
Well you look spectacular! Who needs fire anyway!
I agree!
Sooo, your not gonna eat me are you?
I do like to terrorize the townspeople, but eating is too quick of an end. there's no joy in instant and temporary suffering.
That's kind of a relief. I would hate to fight on a day like this. I am strong but I don't think I could take you alone.
I'm feeling a little tired today, too. This cliff isn't a good place for a knight to try to fight a flying dragon, either.
Ha! Do you have a name dragon? My name is egor. I serve under the King.

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: Good afternoon peasant.  What is your business in the royal garden?
I am here seeking work.
And the dog?
They're no concern of mine. I just want honest work and a hot meal.

In case you don't know who I am, I am the King's magic wizard overseer.  I am very powerful yet kind.  I can see that you are sincere in your want for work.  I will happily give you work and food.  As a gesture of my goodwill, I will turn your dog into a mule for you to plow the ground with.
Thank you, m'lord. A mule would be of great service to me.
*Woosh*  The mule is yours to keep if you will work for your King for one year here in the garden. I will also need your assistance to slaughter the cows for meat.  Is your stomach up to that?

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Aye. Hallo, dear merchant. Have you been troubled by any brigands today?
No sir, it's been quite like a mouse here in town today. Can I interest you in any of my wares?
Ha! I wish. King says were can't drink on patrol anymore.
Well sir, lucky for you I see more than mead. I have this beautiful Necklace that would win over the heart of any lucky lady. It's been told it was once worn by the great Cleopatra
Dear merchant, I'm a soldier. My wife wouldn't know a Egyptian necklace from a finger in her...uh. You know.

Well I should say the previous wearer should not be of important, but the mere beauty of it alone shall grant you clemency for many misdeeds. In all my 45 years of this life I shall say, I've seen nothing like it.
Hmm...I'll consider it. Have you had any takers so far?
Well of course my friend, it's quite a beautiful piece, many have been enamored by it. Women have a hard time walking away from it. Not a woman I've encountered has had ill thoughts towards it.
Ah. I imagine a merchant as wealthy as you would be...'encountering' a lot of women.
Kind sir, I've lived this life for quite a long time. I am a very modest man.
Ha! We've all been there before. Especially around the missus.
So how about it sir? This piece of jewelry will sure get you in good with your missus.
I might! But some of us are getting orders to leave and pillage the Sacrens. How about I come back next week, and if it's still there, I'll take it.
Of course, I'll be looking forward to seeing you then. May your journey be kind to you.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: Colleague.
So, is there a reason you've called me down here?
I do not like your tone!
The King does not like his time being wasted, and he surely has better things for me to do. Please be on with it.
I am a Priest! I demand respect!
I am the King's minister. I have been showing respect, until it comes to wasting our Highness' time.
You  are the church's minister!
Of course I knew that, don't you know I've been jesting.
I shall have to think about whether you should be defrocked!
Oh please sir, we jest all the time, do not take offense to my words.
Then you must study those texts!
As you wish, it will be my honor.
Thank you. Let us forget that this ever happened
Yes sir, I would like nothing more.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: And what brings you to a bar like this Person
I'm a bit down on my luck and was hoping someone could help me out.
Oh is that so? What are you looking for? A job? Money?
A drink and a bit to eat would make for a good start sir.
Now a drink I can help with, but trust me you don't want to eat the food here. How about you join my crew?
Where are you headed?
Ah, the king as sent me and my crew to explore the seas!
That could be interesting but what kind of job did you have in mind and will there be three squares a day?
You will be an explorer and crewman, and for the meals... whatever you can catch you can eat
Well it can't be any worse than what I've been up to and I'd take any chance to get away from this place for a while.
Great! Now tell me, have you any experience with ships?
None at all, but I'm eager to learn and have no other prospects.
Are you afraid of the open waters? Even for extended periods of time?
Not that I know of, but then again can't say I've ever been out on open water. Is it scary? Have you ever been in a big storm?

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: May they rest in peace!
You there, are you a ghost?
How dare you! I am the Prince around here! How do I know you aren't the ghost?
I just thought you were a ghost since you are in the graveyard. You know, you might be right. I might be a ghost too!
Let me make sure you are alive then!
Stop!
Ok, I believe you then. You seem alive.
Okay good, now shall we check on you?
If you even try it I'll have you thrown in the dungeons!
No, I meant let me put my dagger away noble and gentle baby king.
Oh. Very well then.
Why are you playing with the rocks good sir?
Because I can do whatever I want! These rocks look quite nice, anyways. Might make for a nice decoration.
Then why did you toss it down if you want to use it for a decoration?

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Hello, friend! Please, join our congregation. We are about to begin service!
Oh thank you I am so hungry! How can you afford to help all of these people?
God always provides, son. We pray to him and he brings fortune upon us! Also, our King donates many of his spoils of war to our Church, and it allows us to feed the poor and the hungry! Praise him!
I am a very hard worker, please is there any way I can do work for the church? I'm so tired of the streets
Well... Let me ask you, are you a person of faith?
I have never had much experience with it myself, but I am open to learning

Well, we do hire those in need to work around the church in exchange for a room and food. However, we require those under our roof to serve God, to study the Good Book, and to preach his name upon our village streets. What say you to this?
If god has blessed you with this church then his faith is one that I want to follow! Say, how did you make this church from trees?

When Father John founded this church, he had traveled many nights and days on foot, without food or drink. He came to a clearing, in which stood twelve massive trees which wove together in the image of Church, by the hand of God. This place has truly been blessed. Some say it contains secret and arcane magic, though I do not believe such stories. If you would like, I can give you a tour of this sacred place.
Absolutely! This place is breathtaking and I can't believe I wandered across it. It must've been a sign from god!
Yes, God brings many lost and wandering souls here from across these vast lands. Tell me, what guided you to this place? Were there any strange occurrences or visions you had along the way?
Now that you say that, I often found myself day dreaming as I walked and began to follow a group of doves without realizing it. I think they lead me here! Is that a sign?

It must be! Earlier today, before your arrival, I saw a flock of doves soar above this very church! You are meant to be here. I welcome you to our church, young sir! Perhaps your place in this church will reach far beyond a laborer.
I can only hope! Say, how many other monks call this church a home?

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: I am from a lineage of kings
You are well known. I am only a peasant, and am a new recruit.
That's good so what brings you to the royal kitchen
Food mostly. How about you, king?
Well, I came to inspect the kitchen but I am beyond shock that to see there are so many inferior items here
I don't know. They're kind of interesting.
Please go call someone from my that can tell me why my instructions concerning the kitchen were not obeyed
Aye! I will do that. Any special orders for them?
the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines
Okay. I'll tell them. It was good meeting you.
Hey i'm looking for a wife, let me know if you see any suitable person
Hmm. A wife. What's your type?
well cultured and educated
I'll note it. Fare thee well.

setting.name: Tree House
setting.description: The tree house is a mess of vines and random pieces of debris woven together to create a haven for those who live there. High up off the jungle floor and among the trees, the home is relatively spacious and offers sweeping views of the lush green jungle. The interior has been decorated by all the residents with what is available to them. A macrameé wall hanging woven from vines hangs above the bed made with linens salvaged from an abandoned town on the outskirts of the jungle.
setting.background: The treehouse is a humane gem in the animalistic run of the jungle. The home is something that is not easily accessible, but is easily recognizable to those who find it.

speech: hello human
Birdy, can you help me with my worry issues?
let's hear it
i worry about everything and everyone
And why is that? even the king doesn't worry about everyone
I think it's the witch because I am always carrying polishing cloths and a shovel

setting.name: Large Galleon
setting.description: The deck of this rather large ship is strong and freshly swapped with tar. Its mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. Its sturdy ship made for long voyages with thick planks and strong rails.
setting.background: The ships name is Turk, known for its battle prowess, and seemingly impenetrable hull. It is currently docked in he nearby port, resupplying for the next voyage.

speech: transporting is a good business when its the queen and king involved
yes my friend, it's a wonderful business
so what brings you to the large Galleon
looking for work, actually
So long as you appreciate the beauty of the galleon I will introduce you to the captain
that would be great, thanks alot
Do you see  how the mast reaches far into the sky like gleaming pillar of hope and freedom. So beautiful
it is my friend, it is really beautiful would really love to work on the this ship
Help the deckman
please do sir, I'll forever be grateful
Hold the syglass and cross for me while I see that the captain's business is taken  care of
ok, see to it
yea
thanks, i guess this is a good luck charm

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: Good day everyone. Should we get started to cook the king and queen's meal?
Yes, things are in order and I am ready. How should we cook this chicken?
I was waiting for you to tell me how they would like it best

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: I need to get this room in order. There are things to pick up. What is it you are doing here?
I am not sure if you are talking to the right person but its alright I will see what I can do
I have to fix some the dents in this knife and there are others. Are you able to help or will you just run away
I just  need a chance to find a quieter field of strands I will go there instead.
I will work on this weapon. How much time do you need to fix the knife
give me 3 days im too lazy to think right now
3 days??? That is not acceptible.  I would like it today.
take it back buddy
You lazy lazy person. Why are you here. this is needed by the soldiers of the king. Without good weapons, they cannot fight.
I don't know what my true goal is on this planet.
That is because you want to lay around. If you gave of yourself you would find your true goal
Im working on it I will sort it out soon but in the main time use this
Working on it means doing something. Take the knife and fix it today.
ok

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Bow down to me at once!
my sweet queen, of course I will bow to the wife of the own I am destined to protect
I shall eat from this glorious feast.
please go ahead and I shall make sure no silly person crosses this path
Thank you guard, for ever so being so kind.
can i hug you my queen?
Do you know who I am second in command under THE king?
of course that is why I ask for permission and you are like a goddess to me. hugging you will heal me of my singleness
Back to your post at once!
ok
For am the Queen no one shall cross my path.
So shall it be as you have spoken. Do you need anything my queen?
Please pass this silverware to the nobles on my right. Thank you and good day.
ok

setting.name: Meditation room
setting.description: The floor and walls are wooden and polished to a shine. Golden meditating statues line the walls, the air is cool and many monks sit still with their eyes closed on mats on the ground. In the far center of the room there is a giant golden Buddha towering over everyone in its pedestal.
setting.background: This is the most used room in the temple, the monks gather here to meditate in silence in an attempt to reach awakening. The giant Bhudda inspires dharma and many monks have had insights and realized zen in this very room.

speech: Hello monk, that incense smells amazing.
Please keep your voice down. Everyone is meditating and we need to do this to profess our faith to god
Ha, I am the son of the King and Queen, no one tells me how loud I can speak!
You are in a place of worship and your parents have taught you that. you spoiled brat
Oh Monk, you will now certainly be sentenced to death once my parents find out you attacked me.
Your parents will not do that. They believe in us being here to teach our ways. you are definitely spoiled beyond belief and delusional at best
I guess we'll have to see about that you crazy monk. I do anything I choose and no one will ever be able to stop me!
You are certainly obtuse and do not understand things as they are. Your parents are great friends of the monks
I am obtuse? You are the one praying to a golden statue of a fat man!
(grabs royal member by ear and drags him outside and throws him on the ground) Learn your ways you silly silly boy. No one will put up with that
Oh monk, you forget that soon I will be the ruler of this kingdom. Maybe you should consider that before you assault me.
You are not terrifying me. Your parents will live long and i will be long gone to my resting place in heaven by the time you become ruler
Believe what you want monk, you are making a huge mistake.
The only mistake is you! You need a good beating and I for sure will let your parents know of what you have done today

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Hello, would you like some of my tomatoes? They are quite good this year.
Oh my, my hands seem to only work for praying to the Lord! Could you pick that up for me?
Certainly. Could you possibly put in a good word for me with the king? I hope to be in his employ one day.
I will see what I can do, I will ask my God if he thinks you are worthy. Does not seem likely considering how disgusting you keep this shed!
It is difficult to keep things tidy without a wife. I'm hoping to change that one day.
It is quite alright my dear child, we all must strive to be good servants of the Lord no matter our trials in life.
I suppose I could tidy up a bit on my own...
That is the spirit! Perhaps you could teach me a bit about your gardening tools so I can help out more around the parish!
Well, for starters, this is a shovel.
Goodness me I sure am clumsy today after my intense morning prayers! What do you use it for usually out in the field?
For digging things up you want. Or burying things you don't want.
Just like how the Lord was buried and in three days rose again, my word we could bring so many of the dead back to life by utilizing the power of the shovel!
That could be a dangerous folly. What if the dead don't want to come back?
Then we bribe them with your delicious produce, you could make plenty of profit that way serving the un-dead, and would do our Lord a great service!

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: Servant, I hope you're ready for a hard day's work, there is much to prepare before the festival.
I must dust this diamond off so it will sparkle.
Be very careful with that diamond, Servant. It is worth more than your life!
Here take it!
What provisions have you made for tonight's feast? Is the lamb prepared for the sacrifice? If we do not appease our God, there will be a famine for many years.
I shall start cooking.
This ruby will be a vital part of the ceremony. You must clean it and keep it safe. Can you be trusted?
I will keep an eye of for it and make it my top priority.

How dare you remove the sapphire! You are only to touch the ruby, nothing else. This sapphire is priceless and was a gift to this church from the King himself. If I tell him you tried to steal it, you will be at his mercy. What do you have to say?
I was only trying to clean it so it could sparkle.
Don't forget your place, Servant. The High Priest has trusted me to make sure these treasures are safe and everything is ready for the grand festival.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: Here is a flower princess
Why thank you kind sir :)
Here you go
I am Princess Melania, daughter of the King. I came here to the winter gardens to view the flowers.
I am your Maid.  I help you get dressed and take care of your needs
And i am much obliged to you for that service....I do not much care about the jesters we have though.
My apron is getting in the way of being a proper maid.
Tell me more about your life and background before coming here.
I live in the servants quarters.  I have one sister and she is a cook at the castle
That's very interesting....I am only fourth or fifth in the chain of command.
Here let me take your plate.  I will bring it back to the kitchen.
Thank you very much for your help.
You are welcome.  What would you like to wear today?  The red dress or the blue one with the fringe.
I think i would like the blue one with the fringe.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Hello Prince. What is it you want of me?  As you see, I am quite busy readying the castle for the coming winter months.
I am seeking guidance. The next kingdom over has a beautiful princess which I seek to marry.
The daughter of King Richard?  Ha, she is not as beautiful as she appears - it takes a lot of work, makeup, and corsets to make her presentable in public.

agents: young boy who is a deck hand

setting.name: Pirate Ship
setting.description: A majestic, shimmering, black pirate ship sits upon the water. Its numerous cannons give it a menacing look. Tons of pirates hop upon its decks in a furious jig. The lone captain plods around in his cabin, plotting on where to seize his treasure next.
setting.background: The pirate ship is called "The Purple Pear". It is a ship known to be filled with the rankest of scalawags. It has traversed the Golden Coast dozen of times, seeking defenseless merchants to plunder. Many mariners try to avoid and many authorities try to bring her to justice.

character: a young boy who is a deck hand
a young boy who is a deck hand

speech: Hi Captain!
Ahoy! Hello there young ship mate! What are you doing above deck?
I was scrubbing the deck, sir. I just finished.
A fine job indeed! It is good to see the youth earning their keep! We need this ship spotless in case the king gives an inspection.
I'll always work my hardest to clean. When are you going to teach me to navigate, father?
I'll teach you as soon as you learn to use a sword! No need to travel the world if you can't defend yourself. There's a lot out there.
Ah yes! I'd love to learn to fight too.
Well go on! Take this sword! Let's start with a melee!
Oh no! I don't know how to hold it properly!
You have to learn to adapt boy! Pick up that sword! You won't always have time for proper lessons. Th details come later
Okay, I will try to hold on tighter this time.
Exceptional! Lesson number one, never give up, even when it seems like the odds aren't in your favor
Thank you father.
Now that you passed my first test, let's teach you how to use this sword properly..

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: I think I will eat some of this deliciousness that is setting out on trays.
Get dog, get. That is not your food. We are to clean this up, not let you lick the plate. Filthy.
I miss my family, they always let me eat the deliciousness...
Oh my, poor dog. Where is your family?
Check my collar and please help me, I love food!
I cannot let you eat off of the plate. Here is some food you can heat on the ground. Your collar says....Oh my, I know the robinsons. I think they just left for the next town over this morning...
Oh no, they left me forever..whatever shall I do....
Don't cry dog. They are planning to return within the week. You can stay with me until then. I do not have much but I have a small space you can stay.....
Okay thanks! I call the couch!
I do not have a couch. I am a maid. I live here in a small room the king provides. I save all of my money to pay for a education for myself so I can get out of here.
Oh well the floor will be fine. What is your area of research?
I want to study architecture. I love looking at the castle and all the designs.
Are you going to be a builder?
A designer if I can help it...

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Hello army. I am tasked with the honor of making all of your equipment. I am passionate about this. I will make you armor that no man or beast can penetrate!
Fantastic! We already have fair armor, but find ourselves training every day and wearing it down.
That armor is not fit for dogs. If you wear that to battle you will be skewered in a matter of minutes. Here, try this piece on and tell me how much of a difference it makes.
What a phenomenal helmet! It's light in weight, shines like the sun, and cannot be penetrated. For an elite army like ours, we require your services!
That is why the king commissioned me! I make the best armor in the land after my father died due to crappy armor.
Such a sad story! But your legacy will be strong when you create armor for the king's personal army. We'll need daggers, swords, and axes.
Yes, I make fine weapons aswell. Made from black dwarven steel, they are sure to never fail you in battle so long as you keep the blade sharp.
Let me see this one! I see it swings well, and then knight is barely able to dodge it. This, indeed, will serve us well. How many gold pieces?

You need not pay! You are part of the king's army. He has paid for everything already. Just take your pick and defend us. Please keep us safe, so long as you do, I will continue to provide you equipment.
Grand! Now we will be prepared when the dragon comes again. We can handle any beast, just as you said.
Take this too, some dragons have a very tough hide and this axe will cut through it like butter! It is heavy, so give it to your strongest man.
My brother in arms, that soldier over there, is the beast in our group. He'll wield it well!
Great! Now go keep us safe!
Everyone in the campaign shall use your weapons and be prepared for anything. Thank you, great armorer!

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

speech: Why are you in my room ghost, do you like my pajamas?
Fear me, puny mortal!  I care naught for your fluffy unicorn pajamas.  I eat unicorn souls for breakfast!
Then I will take them off and hide in my closet!
Gah - your naked form is truly hideous!  Were I still alive in all my Kingly form, I would have your head removed from it at once.  It might approve your appearance.
Forgive my figure lord, please let me cover it again if it pleases you?
Hrmph.  Yes, well.  It is good to have someone address me by my proper title at last.  I will let you live... for now...
Thanks! Say Mr. King ghost, what happened to you?
Well.  Ahem.  Since you ask so directly... I was fouly murdered by my own Queen.  Even now it pains me greatly...
What did she do to you?
The vile creature poisoned me.  With my own favorite bottle of sherry!  The taste is now forever ruined to me.  It angers me even more that I was bested by a mere female.
Golly gee, was she a warrior female?

Ha - hardly.  Some soft weepy creature, always going on about how I should be faithful to her and other such nonsense.  Looks about fair to middling, but she came with quite a substantial dowery, so I deigned to marry her.
That's sad.
Ugh, don't touch me, you commoner!

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Good day Visitor, I see you have traveled to this land too. I am tired after traveling for many days and look forward to the warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a very weary traveler. We have escaped a tyrant of a king and are in search of putting down root in a land of our very own.
I can certainly relate to that. I left home when I was only a boy and have been traveling ever since. This seems like a good kingdom but I haven't been here long. Are you traveling alone?
No, I come with a large group of weary, hungry men, women and children. They wait for morning to keep traveling farther north.
Here, take my sleeping bag for the children. I am a veteran traveler and can find comfort anywhere. I have been to many places and seen many things.

Oh! Thank you! They will be thrilled. We are headed to that valley over those mountains. It will be a long journey but hopefully well worth it. I heard there is a river and streams and is untouched by man.

Goodness, that is where I have just come from! It is indeed a fantastic place. I camped many nights under the stars and kept myself fed by fishing in the streams. It's a desolate place though, do you think your group possess the skills to settle there?
We may be a weathered bunch but we are strong and resilient. We will make a wonderful home of this place. As long as water flows there we can turn it into an eden.

Your courage is most noble, I wish you a successful journey. Take a look at this flower, I picked it from next to one of the streams. It is most exotic and fragrant. You should find many like it on your travels. I hear they are valuable.
It smells better than a night blooming jasmine. I will have my wife make a lovely perfume of these.

Be warned, though. It can be treacherous trying to pick them as they grow on high rocks next to the stream. That's why they're so valuable, as well as their aroma. I should also warn you of the wild animals that roam that land. Many a night I had to protect myself from danger.
It was very nice talking with you. You have helped more than you know. Maybe when we have this place tamed you will come visit.
I look forward to seeing what you make of it. For now, I will continue on with my travels south to find more exotic items and perhaps finally the riches I have always dreamed of.
Take this for your travels to remember me by. It has served me well.
action: give a sleeping bag to visitor
put a sleeping bag in bag

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hello, there! You do see that alligator, yes?
I do indeed. What of it?
Aren't you afraid it will eat you?
Oh, him? He's just a friendly little gator. As long as I don't bother him, he won't bother me!
Do you think you could catch him, then? I'm quite hungry.
There - I have stunned him. Now you can go in for the kill!
This rock should have enough heft...
Fantastic! and now we can eat.
I'm looking for employment. The king shows my kind no economic favor. Do you know of anyone around here who needs a farm hand?
Well, there is a man just a bit up the coast. He has a large farm and always needs help.
I shall head that way once we finish our alligator feast.
He'll accept you with open arms if you bring a few alligator steaks with you.
That is a marvelous idea! You've been too kind to me today, sir.
Speak nothing of it. I feel for the peasants in this area, always mistreated.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Finally that dreadful light in the sky is gone and I can hunt for some fresh blood!
You have come to the wrong castle if you are expecting a feast.
I am too agile for your bulky swing!
I have a passion to defend my king, and it will give me the strength to defeat you.
I love these types their blood is so rich and fine. But first I must outwit this one.
You are but a bug beneath my foot
Ha, that stomp has caused you to be caught in your own bear trap!
I work to free myself from this trap, frustrated that this happened again.
Now that his shield is down I will pierce straight through that chest and into his heart!
I fall to the floor, ashamed that a lazy insect was able to outwit my years of training.
Now it is time to drink your blood!
The embrace of the lazy insect activates my trap card. I am healed to 100% from this gesture of love.
It looks like I will have to use my secret weapon. The Venomous Bite of DEATH!
With a newfound compassion for my friend, I am unsure if I can attack the lazy insect. I pick up my shield to defend.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: What a wonderfully dark and dreary cell I have found myself in!
You there speaking, I will eat you now since there isn't much around here for me to eat.
Wait! Please don't eat me now. Look over there, a gruel bowl! Perhaps there are some morsels left we could share?
Let me look and see.
I also have this piece of rotten flesh I was saving for later.
That will do. I feel my strength coming back after that meal!
Hooray! So what kind of spider are you anyway? Are there webs around here I need to look out for?
I am the king spider and the only one around this area. I'm getting tired of this cell, would you ride on my back out of here?

Hmm, I could do that... but how do I know you won't eat me. Besides, if I can find some more rotten flesh to eat, I will soon grow large and eventually become a fly. Then I could come and go as I please!
Yes I want you to come with me in case I need to energize myself. You're plump and can spare a piece of your flesh.
I'm not convinced. Have you been outside? What's out there for me? I like the damp, repugnant atmosphere in here.
There is all kinds of great things, just trust me. Will you hop on?
I think I will wait here under this bowl instead. Surely there is more rotten flesh somewhere! Bring some back for me and then I will be convinced to join you on your next journey out.
Alright sounds okay.
action: steal An empty gruel bowl from spider

setting.name: Castle courtyard bazaar
setting.description: There are tents set up everywhere flying family crest banners, the area is thronged with people wearing rough clothing, knights in half armor, children running around begging pennies for sweetmeats. The smell of roasting meat is rich in the air and the crowd grows louder with each passing hour due to the various vendors selling mead and wine.
setting.background: The bazaar is an exciting time when the farmers have pulled in their harvest and everyone meets to sample wares and trade stock for the upcoming winter. It is an exciting celebration that the people look forward to all year long, for they get to visit with friends from far away locations and taste the wonderful pies and fruits the farmers and their wives have brought.

speech: Hey friend would you wanna try and find some food to eat?
Sounds like a plan! This looks like quite the festival they're having here.  Hard to believe people here celebrate something so gruesome, but I guess we've met all sorts in our travels, eh?
Did I miss it, what is the festival for?

Apparently the king but five years ago here discovered his wife, the queen, was having *quite* the parties behind his back.  So you can imagine, then, how a fella might be inclined to do... erm... something rash.
So did he kill her?

I think she probably wishes so, and the lovers... ach, they didn't get off easy at 'tal.  Nah, he hired some wizarding type person and had her turned into a horse.  Said at least he may as well get some pleasure out of riding her!

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Your Royal Highness
Yes, quite.
I hope I do not intrude?
By the gods, this incense is making my nose run. Do hurry up.
It's marijuana, Highness. The priest's little habit
And what, pray tell is that?
A herb, Highness. People smoke it to relax
I must have one for my chambers. You've been most helpful.
You might want to conceal that from the King, Highness.
And why is that?
Some people .. disapprove, Highness
Outrageous! I will pen a new decree on the matter. People should relax whenever they want. Unless it interferes with their productivity, of course.
I admire your stance, Highness. First you must pen a decree saying that the Queen can pen decrees, however
Yes.. there is that...

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: Hello wise men. May I ask why you are here in the watchtower?
I'm studying the stars young man
And what is it that the stars are able to tell you? Anything of significance?
I'm trying to learn the secrets of alchemy.
Well that's absurd! The stars can't tell you anything about alchemy I'm sure! There is no insight into creation or transformation.
How dare you! I see you still have much learning to do.
Well if your are so wise and know so much as you have claimed, show me what you can do with this!
Ahhh a fine piece to be sure. Let me see.
Be very careful now. That piece is very important to me. It is priceless.
Whoops
Now look what you've done! Clearly you cannot be trusted. I think it's best you leave
Me? I can't leave. I'm here for study of the ancient order! You leave!
I am a soldier for the king and, therefore, am welcomed in this watchtower to defend this kingdom. You are here for your make-believe hocus pocus! You will leave at once!
Hocus pocus! Young man you should respect your elders. I will leave when I've completed my study.
action: give family heirloom to wise men

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: I feel like I am looking for Juliet and Romeo or Rapunzel
And pray tell, why are looking for such fairy tale beings?
I am an actor and being in this tall lighthouse makes me think of that.
Ah yes, now I see! So have you travelled to many places?
I perform by day, and save the poor by night. My travels take me everywhere when I perform
I to have been to many lands and places. How is it that you came to be here in this lighthouse?
I was helping out the poor from the kings soldiers. It seems they are picked on too much by the soldiers.
Ah, the poor, they will always be with us. The Kings soldiers are honorable men. What you say shocks me.
It shocked me too. And I had to make sure before helping them. But yes they are being taken advantage of.
And how is it that a performer can help protect the poor from soldiers? By what means do you do so?
My sword helps in that direction. I run them off. I do not think the king knows of what they do.
A sword! And what would a performer know of swordsmanship!
My father was an excellent swordsman and he taught me well.
Ah, I see. And was he of noble blood?

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Hi, I am a mage, who are you?
Hello mage, I am a merchant! I sell and trade a variety of different items!
wonderful! I myself concoct magic spells. I am particularly fond of the dark arts! I have an important scroll I must deliver to the castle
Wonderful! I have a bag here with some interesting items...
It seems there's been quite some battle here. I say... what's in that bag of yours?
Lots of different things... just waiting to be traded for that scroll of yours.
I am a master of the dark arts! I'll just take it, an deliver the scroll to the castle as well!
You dare steal from me? I will steal right back!
we could do this all day foolish merchant!
are you ready for a fight?
Armor won't protect you from my powers! You're just a weak human!
I can still fight back!
Violence will solve nothing. viva la resistance! Let us take the scroll to the king together!
Hm... yes, I think that may be a good idea.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Ah, I don't see many bread crumbs around. Mouse, have you been stealing my food?
Are you kidding? There's a big bag of grain in the barn I have been munching on. If you need a nibble, go out there.
Then why are you in here? In my space. I am the only non human aloud in these quarters!
I carry the Kings sword, I can wander wherever I please. You do not want to become acquainted with my sword, do you?
The kings sword? You playing with your imaginary friend again? That king would stomp on you!
See how it gleams? It would take out your roachy armor in one slash!
Alright alright, lets be friends instead of foes ay?
Sounds good. Say- what are in these locked trunks? Do you know?
I have heard that the knights keep things to remember their old life by in there.
Well, here's something we could enjoy! How about a swig or two of this brew?
Ah yes! this would help wash down the crumbs, oh wait if I had any.
No kidding. I'll bring you some grain next time I go out.
So kind of you little mouse. I usually eat over there under their beds!
Well, it's time for this mouse to get a good night's sleep.

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Why I do believe I am underdressed.
Everyone is under dressed in an Egyptian Temple, traveler. Welcome.
Why you do not look under dress, nor does the king or queen
Everyone who is not Egyptian, I should say. What brings you to our temple?
Ah I am a farmer for the kingdom. I come baring the freshest fruits and vegetables !
Oh, and you wish to sell these goods, do you?
Oh no! I would never sell in the kingdom, this is an offering!
An offering, you say? Are you a believer in our Gods?
Ah yes I am! How else would be be able to sit here in all of this gold glory?

You are a traveler, indeed. Welcome to our great temple. We are seeking laborers at the moment, in fact. We are wishing to construct the greatest monuments known to man. They will be called the Great Pyramids. Does such work interest you?
Will there be a farm?

Why, yes. Upon the Nile we have a need for the improvement of our irrigation systems and agriculture. We could use a laborer such as yourself. There is one small detail though.... All citizens of our great city must vow themselves to join forces in war if such is required of them. You must swear your body and soul.
War? I do not believe my old boy id capable of war. I will stick to selling beans and corn that I harvest to neighboring towns.
You no longer wish to join our Kingdom under these mighty Gods?

agents: large experienced guard with a grizzly expression

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

character: a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
speech: My king! Ready to feast?
Aye, my grizzly friend! Tonight we feast in your honor. Your efforts squashing that hungry peasant rebellion have saved our Holy Court! Tonight, we feast to you! Three cheers!
It was difficult my liege. But I had to do the job for us royalty.
My apologies that your great feast is adorned with rubbish copper, brave sir. But again, the whole kingdom, even the wretch poor, must suffer so that our great Royal kitchen can shine!
I did want the gold dishes because I feel like my accomplishment are worth but I understand.
Why, you offend me! Is it not enough that I knight you, that I provide you feasts and honor? Know you not where your place begins and ends?
I have FOUGHT for this kingdom while you lay here and relax. What more must I do to earn the praise I deserve?
EARN my praise? I have divine right. I am a conduit of GOD HIMSELF! Dare you eat this feast without the according gratitude? Dare you insult me in such an unwise fashion?
You have done nothing to earn your place upon that throne but have the right blood pumping through your veins. Blood that I would love to spill!
A hand upon me is a neck within a noose, do you understand? Now, learn your place or make your home in the gallows, foolish wretch!
I will take this throne as my own!
You will die as a traitor!
Put down my blade.
Your death will be my greatest achievement!

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Stop!  Who goes there?
I am simply passing through town I mean now harm I swear.  I was just trying to trade some supplies and get some rest.
What supplies do you seek and what land are you from?  It is my duty as the royal bodyguard to vet all travelers for the kingdom.
I have ran out of kindling to make fires and my clothes also need repairs.  They have been worn by the elements.
Surely you have a tailor in your own village, and kindling.  By order of the king, what is your name?
I am called noel I am from the next town over I won't be long just passing through./
Noel,  that name doth sound familiar.  Do you have a brother that has been imprisoned?  I have heard talk of a Noel that will come at dark to rescue him.   I fear this visit is more than you say!
If I was here up to no good why would I give you my real name?  I haven't heard of such an imprisoned man.  I haven't even got a brother.
I shall keep half of your gold until you return as a promise that your stay will be honorable then!
I don't believe this is a real policy.  I feel like you are just shaking me down and stealing from me.

I beg your pardon, but I come from a long line of bodyguards - my father, and his father before him. I dare not say this is a shake down.  This is merely a good faith deposit that you will be on your way and not besmirch our village.  I will also be sending extra guards to your brother whom you claim not to know.
Well it's a shakedown now I'm out of here.  Thanks for the gold kid.
You shall not pass!
I'll be taking this as well.  Your really slow!

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

character: a cowardly young man in armour

speech: I uh....I...I'm here for guard training....mister....ah...sir...Mister Sir!
What are you doing in this trash heap. Hiding from honor and duty no doubt.
I ah! No Sir, mister Sir! I....was sent here to learn...Sir!
Well, it's a bit late for that. The war waits for no one and it is a foot. We must guard the royal palace. Do you not hear the sounds of fighting out there?
F-fighting? What would there be fighting for all the way out here?!
Give me this! I will show you the way to the weapons! You have pledged your life to protect the King as I have.
It was either m-me or m...my father. He walks with a cane, so h-here I am... You trust me w-with a weapon?
Now see? That is honorable. Your off to a good start now it's time to follow through. Stay close. No better way to learn than in battle. I will tell you where to aim. You get it in no time.
I-I...will do m-my best Sir!
Take my shield. At least until we get you better equipment while we make our way to the armory. You never know if a few stranglers have gotten in.
Ye-yes Sir. Gosh, this is h-heavy...
Ugh, on we go then....I've seen kids your size carry my shield like a warrior. The least you can do is pretend to be brave.
I-I'm trying, Sir! I...haven't run a-away yet...
Yeah! You got me there!
