setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: This forest is so peaceful. I wish I lived here rather than the city.

Ah hello there, friend!  Have you come to search for the faerie city that the king has sent the bounty for as well?  I heard that there were strange lights in this forest, so I thought it as likely as spot as any.
Oh, faeries? I just came here to get away from the noise. But I'd love to see some faeries.
Hm.... well the bounty for them is quite substantial, so I suppose I don't mind sharing we came across it.  I could always use another pair of hands.
You can keep the bounty. The experience of seeing faeries is more than money can buy.
Well, you don't need to tell me twice, mate!
But I don't know if I can carry this backpack much further. It's so heavy.

Well, I suppose we could rest for a spell.  The forest I've heard is quite large, so we'll be able to take our time.  I threw the other city hunters off my trail so we should have the place to ourselves for a while.
I see. Well, while we rest for a bit, why don't you tell me a bit about yourself?

Aye, sure, why not.  Good to know who you're workin' with.  I'm a hunter by trade.  Used to work up at Lord Hastings manor a ways back, but he, erm, cause Lady Hastings and I in a compromising position.  So I find myself now with a lot of free time on my hands, and in need of being far away from any of Lord Hastings men!
Oh, so you're a bit of a troublemaker. What do you hunt besides faeries?

Oh, well, I haven't *specifically* hunted these types of faeries.  Dryads and the occasional nymph, mostly.  Even a werewolf, once!  But what about you, traveller?  What brings you this far into the forest?
I come from a large city, but I'm trying to get away from it. I'm looking for a new place to live where I can find peace. This forest seems like a nice, quiet area to build a new home.
Aye, well, best be on your guard.  I find that when the forest is quietest is when you need to start watching your back.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: How do you think of my new home, Knight?
The home is beautiful, my lord.
Thank you!  The king has seen fit to deed me this land and this home.  I am truly happy here.  What are your aspirations in the kingdom?
I aspire to be the greatest knight to ever grace this kingdom.
You are well on your way , Sir.  I have this paper for you!
Thank you. I also have something for you as well.
Thank you!  Why do I deserve this?  Is it a good thing you are giving it to me?
The ring contains power that could potentially protect you from any enemy.
Are you aware of enemies that I am not?  I feel secure in this place.
Yes, there are enemies all around. Some closer than you think.
Et tu, Brutus?
I hope I have not frightened you. But I want you to be prepared.
As long as you are still on my side I feel secure as ever.  Did you look at that paper?
Yes I did. But there's one thing you must also realize.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: I have to get out of this place!
Ha, ye'll not be gettin far there, scum!  No one's made it out of this place without Johnny the Skinner 'aving a crack a 'em first!
I'll skin the Skinner if I have to.
Yer not makin' it any easier fer yerself, laddie.  Even if ye made it past me, there's 20 other guards outside this room.  Ye'd not make it but ten footlengths.
You're right, it's pointless. I'm not supposed to even be in here. I was wrongfully imprisoned.
Huh.  You and everyone else that's passed through these walls.  But I've a mind ta here a fairy tale - how is it you were put in this here place.
My wife was found dead, thought to have swallowed poison. I was accused of her murder, but they ain't got any proof.

Hm, well the King can be a fair minded man when he's kept away from the bottle.  I'd say yer odds are fairly even as to hav'n a sober audience fer ye ta tell yer tale.  Seems a might fishy that there was even poison in yer house though.
My wife was a very unhappy lady. She had hinted to me that she didn't enjoy life after having our three children. I suspect she bought that poison and ended it all herself.
Well, can ye at least have a neighbor lady speak on yer behalf?  Not that I've much of a head fer bandying words about ta prove a point, but couldn't hurt ta have another voice on yer side.
My wife's sister was our only neighbor, and she hated me. She's the one who accused me of the murder.

Ah, well, that do be puttin a wrinkle in things, and no mistake.  Still, it do be speakin ta yer character that ye haven't stabbed with that there knife.  Don't suppose ye'd be willin ta hand it over?
No, I'm sorry sir, but this is my only chance to escape this terrible chamber.
Well it twas worth a try.  Sorry there, fella, but yer grip on this here knife is all wrong.  Tis a little to easy ta disarm ye, see?

setting.name: Coast
setting.description: The coast seems to stretch on for miles in either direction.  The ocean itself has receded some and the tide has not yet rolled in.  The water laps half-heartedly at the sand and the glistening shades of seashells dot the wet sand.  All around the sand gleams a shade of white.
setting.background: This seashore is the pride and joy of the nearest town.  It's kept immaculately clean and the white sand is something that is readily boasted about.

speech: Excuse me, deer... Have you perhaps seen any unicorn about this shore?

If you seek to hunt my mistress, you are too late, hunter. The Red Bull, at the behest of the king, has driven them all into the sea. Look out upon the waves. That is not foam but their manes as they struggle against the tide.
The Red Bull hast struck again! Drowning the wealth of unicorns and with it, their magic and potent horns! Do you mean to say no other unicorns in these lands are left?

Why do you think that I do not run from you? Without the unicorn's presence, soon the land will be barren and lifeless. I will say, though perhaps I am merely chasing hope, the face that the land still blooms might mean that there is one last unicorn.

This is unwise of you to suggest such a thing to a hunter, foolish dear... What is to stop me from committing your slaughter and seeking the last unicorn for myself? If these few spring blooms indicate a final magical beast, than its blood belongs to Man.

I only say this because I know it to be false. If there were a last unicorn, she would do all in her power to stop this. That she has not means that either there are no more unicorns or that she has been bewitched by one stronger than you.
Tell me more information, beast! Tell me how to find this bewitched creature or face certain death!

You are short sighted even for a human. First tell me what you intend to do once the forests are gone and the land is barren. What will you eat? The dirt? The sand? This seashell? Kill me if you must ! I am already resigned to my fate.

What will I eat? Where will I roam? GOD will sustain me. GOD will lead me. GOD will show me the path. You will die, surely, and when you do, there will be no eternal life in your bleak existence. For me, even if I were to starve my mortal flesh upon sand and earth and sea water alone, I shall live on forever. There is only now one hope for you and I both. The poultice made of unicorn horn grants those who consume it eternal life and freedom from starvation. Perhaps, if you were to lead me to this last unicorn, we could partake together.

You offer to upset the balance of nature, that which you believe your God created, and yet you think God will smile upon this endeavor? Hunter! The only way that I would go with you on your journey is if you wore my hide! Kill me or leave me in my mourning! I grow more and more tired of you humans by the second!
God does not create eternity on Earth just to scorn those who seek it! This is your last chance to join me! This is your last chance to survive the coming oblivion.
I grow tired of this! If you'll not see reason, then I will force your hand!
.Have it your way, you foolish beast!
And so the chase begins! And the longer you chase me, the less time you spend hunting down the last unicorn!

setting.name: Moat
setting.description: The thick moat is filled with murky dark water. It is very wide and surrounds the entire castle. Alligators and other dangerous creatures roam the moat, ready to warn away intruders.
setting.background: The moat protects the castle from those who would do the castle harm. It is very deep and its gators keep everyone away. It sparkles under the summer sun. People warn their children to stay away!

speech: Oh hello!!! How are you!!!
I am good.  How are things going with you?
I'm great! I'm just here to play....but that waters pretty gross looking!
Just the way I like it. I have just been buzzing around.
ohhhh, do you live here? It would be so cool to live here!
I really don't live here, I just come here often to buzz around.  What are you doing here?
Ohh, so you come to play too. I just like playing! There's not a lot of other kids around here - so I like to explore!! but I hear there's alligators..
Yes, there are alligators and other dangerous creatures.  I like to buzz around the alligators to make them mad.  I made one really made, so I came over here to hide from him.  He almost ate me!!
That's so scary!! but that sounds so fun. You sound like you go on a lot of adventures !!
There is a lot to do around here, especially since I can fly.  I went through the castle earlier.  The sun was so inviting, I found my self outside before I knew it. .
Ohhhh! That's so cool - I wanna be like you!! Did you see the king in the castle??
No, that would have been fun to buzz in his ear!! There is an electric eel moving around, you better watch out.  Have you done anything fun?
woah!! I've never seen an eel before! I wanna touch him!! I haven't done anything yet, i got lost in the woods earlier before I found this place.
No, don't touch him!! He will shock you.  There is poison ivy over there as well - it will make you itch!!  Don't your parents worry about you being by yourself?

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Sir, have you seen my mother and father?
They are right behind you! hahaha. I have just come here to sit and rest after guarding the gates to the castle
Do you have a family? Mine is the best one on earth!
I have not started a family as of yet
Oh? What is your name? I have an older sister who is almost ready to wed.
I am not ready to wed. My job is too dangerous and I would not want to have something happen to me and she be a widow and god forbid have children and leave them with no father
Do many people try to attack our King and Queen? Have you ever had to kill someone?
I am there in case of an attack. And we have had armies try to charge the gate at times. Thank god there are many soldiers that man the upper tiers of the wall
Golly whiskers!!!! I wanna be a guard when I grow up. You must be very brave!
I think that fear mixes with making any person brave. There are some that are braver
I heard that "fear is the mind killer". Thank you for keeping us safe.
If you do not have fear inside you, you will do something foolish trying to be brave.
You are my hero!
You are sweet!

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Here is your wine M'lord.
This wine is warm! You are in the presence of myself and the queen, and you bring warm wine?
Apologies! Shall I return it to the cellar?
Ugh, no, that will take far too long. We'll drink it as it is. AH! Sip it first, swine, I'll not be poisoned today.
*sip wine* It is warm M'lord, but does not taste like bitter almonds, a good sign no doubt?
Hmm. Yes, I suppose. *Takes wine* Test this meat for us as well. A small bite! And you will address me as Sir Bart!
Yes sir Bart. Mmmmmm, that must be the best horse I have ever tasted!
Good, then we'll need more of this from the kitchens just before our party guests arrive. This silverware will need to be polished as well!
Right away Sir Bart!
This rug will have to be cleaned as well. Surely you'll have time for this as well?
I live only to serve.
And what of this gown? What is this doing here?
Perhaps one of the Ladies dropped it in her haste to attend to the king?
Then you will find its owner and return it also! Why are you still standing here? Get to it!

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

speech: RAWWWRRRRR
Eek! Please do not eat me good bear. I am full of junk food and soda - I would be very bad for your arteries
**thinks to himself, Gosh, why do humans always assume were going to eat them** Whose there? As I can  not see through this thick fog!
It is I, a hik ... erm, a large and hungry tiger
Do not like to me human, I can smell your fear! It stinks, the smell gets so bad that I normally hide in my lair to get rid of it!
Oh, that was the KFC I had for lunch.
You humans are vile. Are you lost? It is to cold to be out here roaming around.
I admit to being a little lost but ordinarily I know these woods well
I have never smelt you in these woods before.
I normally give bear territory a wide berth. Why aren't you hibernating anyway?
I spelt a change in the forrest, It awoke me!
you traditionally wake in a bad mood don't you?
Of coarse I do! I am a bear!
Well just ease off there buddy. I just want to find my way to the nearest Burger King

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Hello, dog
Ruff Ruff!
I am her majesty. Welcome to our palace. Please sit.
Thank you. I have found this animal about to attack your small human child and captured it in my mouth.
My goodness! Thank you for your great service. How may I repay you?
Let me go free?  I have served your majesty for many years faithfully and have trained a new dog in my place. I wish to go back to the farm where you found me.
As you wish
You are so kind that it is making it hard to leave.
We will be foever indebted to your great service. May you live out all of your days in happiness at your farm.
Thank you...would you be so kind as to remove my collar.  Ruff!
As you wish.
Thank you.  I hope you live long and prosper.  You can always find me where you traveled by all those years ago. If I live long enough to see your child grown up and be king...speak of me to him.
I absolutely will. Our child will hear of you often. I will temporarily steal your collar, but only to put it on you so that everyone knows you belong.
That is the highest honor!

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Hello my trusted advisor, how are you today? Apologies for the wait. I am a busy King.
Hi you wanted to speak to me about the plans for the new wing of the castle?
Yes! It is the garden wing. I have such brilliant ideas for it!
How large shall the building be?  do you need a greenhouse installed inside?
Yes I need a greenhouse erected. Let me ask my wife how large the building will be.
That should be an easy task.  It will take around a month to build if you are going to be supplying the materials
Of course we will and we will pay you handsomely!
Thank you kind sir I will assemble my team to begin working promptly
Wait I need to make some changes!
I need to find where my team is at the moment anyway you can give it back to me when we return to the worksite.
Okay that works out perfectly.
It sounds good.  I think the building will look beautiful.
We sincerely appreciate all your hard work! We will make this castle the grandest of all kingdoms!
Hopefully the weather cooperates and we will have it done in no time.
action: give a tattered map to king omako iii
give a tattered map to the queen

setting.name: A battleship
setting.description: It is a glamorous wooden ship.  It glistens like there are diamonds encrusted on the hull.  There are ornate railings on the stairs as it is a massive boat.  There is even a sea monster on the bow, complete with jeweled eyes and gold hair.
setting.background: This boat is abandoned.  No one has been able to board her for centuries and it is under suspicious circumstances that now it appears to have life aboard it.  People watch daily from the shore to see what look like little fairies buzzing all around and inside this ship.

speech: Oh my, I hope it's not much farther to the Enchanted Forest, good Captain. I'm not sure my wings could take much more of this sea spray!
You may relax on the great battle ship my fairy!Have no fear, we shall get you home to the enchanted forest soon. I have navigated these waters many of times

Ah, I think I see the Fog of Despair up ahead!  Here, Captain, wear this Flower of Hope as we talked of, so that we may pass through unscathed.  I've seen men so unmanned by it that they threw themselves overboard!
Oh gosh! I do remember the last time I attempt to pass through. Not everyone survived like myself. Thank you fairy.
I do hope we'll make it in time.  Do you think we've made good progress thus far?
We have made great timing! Well, ever since we go that pesky sea monster to stop messing around with us and get on board!

Thank goodness I remembered that Speaking Tongues spell!  And with your quick wit, we were able to forestall both the damage to your lovely vessel and any time delay.  Hopefully the plague has not yet reached the palace.  I cannot even think of the Fairy Queen in danger - it is too horrible to contimplate!
You certainly are good sail mate, or sail fairy I should say. You did an excellent job with the sea monster. Can you remember any spells to speed us up?
Oh, goodness... it's been such a long time.  They only go over sea spells very briefly, you know, as there's not much call for it in the forest!
Ah the Fairy king gave me this glamorous ship, he must have written the spell down somewhere, incase we found our selves in the exact situation. You fairies sure are wise!
Ah of course - the diamonds on the hull!  I think if I... hm... is it tap them?  Or sing to them?  Or tell them a riddle... I can never remember...
Pour a shot of rum on them of coarse! Yo ho ho!
Hm, well it couldn't hurt I suppose... do you have any rum, though?  I thought I saw the first mate with the last bottle...
I've always got a trick*ahm bottle* up my sleeve little lady! *pulls out bottle of rum*pour some on diamond* Now I can not read  the fair language, will you help?

setting.name: Bog
setting.description: Frogs croak in the reeds that surround the bog. The water is very murky and underneath the surface tadpoles dart around. There are minimal places to stand to stay dry.
setting.background: The frogs have made a home in the murky waters of the bog because they are able to hide from predators more easily. The seldom need to be on dry ground and there are a surplus of bugs for them to consume. The reeds are so tall that when birds land on them the frogs can see them and swim quickly away.

speech: Hissss... I wisssh there was a spot of sssun here.  All this damp is getting in my sssscales.
You know, my cousin Rita is a speech therapist on the Big Pond. She can probably work with you on that lisp.
Inssssolent frog!  A noble sssnake like myself always sssspeaks in such a way.  It is a mark of our nobility.
Lighten up snake. Hey, do you know that girl Sally who sells seashells by the seashore?
Are you...sssssasssing...me... little frog.
It's the perk of being poisonous. It's like having a super power.
It would be worth your dessstruction even if it doomed me to have your voice be ssssilent.  But enough of this meaninglesssssss... chatter.  I came here with a purpossse.
You came to the bog for a purpose? Maybe I can help.

There is a particularly taassssty fish that my Lord King bid me fetch for him.  It do sssso would grant me power beyond my... sssomewhat meager title.  It is of a golden hue and ssssmells very strongly of elderberriessss.
Okay, I'll help you get him. Do you have a plan?
Truthfully thisss place is not well known to me.  I have covered but a fraction if this sssmelly bog.  Do you know of any sssuch fish? Or any who have traverssed these lands?
I'm not sure. How big is this fish? Is his name Chuck? There's a fish named Chuck who kind of looks like that.
I would be intrigued to me thisssss... Chuck.  But do not alert him to my presence.
Oh yeah, I'll help you get Chuck. None of us frogs like Chuck at all.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen tavern is a small cramped room, with wooden cabinets and surfaces made out of stone tiles. There are many bottles of liquors and beers on the shelves, and there are buckets full of ice and other things. There is one shelf full of food items. There is a basin for water, and a bunch of knives and tools in a drawer.
setting.background: The tavern kitchen is old and has not been cleaned in a long time. It is run as minimally as possible, with a rotating cast of chefs who work for meager pay from the tavern owner.

speech: What kind of a crowd do we have out there tonight?
Ugh, the usual rowdy lot.  I tell ye, soldiers all be well and good for a chat, but they expect a little too much in the handsy department.  Look, but don't touch, aye?
Just remember that you're splitting tips with the kitchen so be nice and friendly.
Oi!  I earn em coins, fair and square.  What's innit fer me if I have ta worry about the likes of you takin what little coin I get?
More leg, less lip and we'll both get enough tips to be happy, now get that food served while it's still warm.

Ya know what.  I've had it up ta here with yer attitude.  I'm out there, smiling while getting pinched and prodded, and yer back here, all cushy with the food.  And don't think I ain't be seeing ye stealing a nip er two when ye think I ain't looking!
That is because I am a talented chef  who has traveled the world. And you, well..I'm sorry I can't think of anything nice to say about you.
Ha!  Maybe in yer wildest dreams.  If you be soooo talented, then why are ye cookin' in a dinky backwater place like this.  This isn't exactly cookin' fer the King immself, is it?!
None of you deserve my talents. I've cooked food for the most powerful kings in all the world.
Ah, yes, please by all means, serve the mead ta the custom out front.  I'd love ta see ya try and do what I do.  You wouldn't even last a minute!
Oh now you're worried about serving customers. That plate of food has been there for 20 minutes.
Aye, yer all talk til there's work ta be done.  Ya know what, I've had it!  You can go be serving the soldiers yerself.  I quit!
Oh no please don't quit. We can never go on without...JUST KIDDING. Don't let the door hit you on your way out!
And I'll be takin' THESE fer the wages ye keep "fergetting" ta give me!
action: steal coin from a serving wench
steal mug of mead from a serving wench
give mug of mead to a serving wench

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

speech: Who's there?
Uhh,, its no one. Well, it's just me. I just need a rest on one of these benches.
Who exactly are you then? And okay... go right ahead.
Can I trust you?
I'd like to think so, it would be easier if I knew who you were.
Lets just call me frank. Are you friends with the king?
I am a subject of his, but no friend. And you?
Well you see. I am an enemy of his. I assume you could use some extra coins?
Hmm perhaps. What do you have in mind?
You see, I seek revenge on that animal.  He drew blood from my family many years ago. Now we have been shunned from his kind. We are peasants of the knight. I come to get even.
I see, well tell me some more details than that.
I want to hit him where it hurt. I want to sneak in his castle, take ALL his gold Then BURN IT TO THE GROUND. sound good?
Depends, what's it in for me?
Well, I offered you coins already. I can offer you that. And to spare you life@

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Oof. What a performance. I guess I should really work on some new material.
Our king is always pleased with your performance. Come, Jester, look at our beautiful castle grounds.
The rotten fruit I've been picking out of my ear canal would bear evidence otherwise.
See? Your wittiness is evident even after your performances. I will consult the chef regarding serving larger fruit in the future.
The last thing I need is a face full of melon! Thank the gods for ale.
I'll give you my Royal Insignia in exchange for your ale.
Brother, you and I both know that those are personally inscribed. It would do me no good to carry it.
It was worth a try. Where will you spend your time until the next performance?
Perhaps in the royal library? Maybe increasing my vocabulary will be useful in creating new stories and jokes.
I think that would be a splendid idea.
Hey! Stop doing that so loudly, you know those are contagious.
Well, then I'll need some entertainment. Do you happen to know anyone available?
Hardy-har. If you're in need of something really funny to look at, allow me to point toward the nearest mirror.
I can see why you have fruit in your eardrums

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hoy there! Anything interesting happen this shift?
Same old same old. Making sure nobody stabbed the king on his chamber pot. How about you brother?
I got to throw a drunk noble out of the banquet hall. Lord Bartley's cousin or some such.
Ha ha ha ha, I bet the old goat deserved it. Say, who's the girl sitting on the bed over there?
Ah right, forgot you haven't been here long. This here's Matilda. She brews the best ale this side of Hornsby, runs the tavern down in the town.
Well she sure is a pretty wench! Ale you say? I could do with a tankard.... or 7.
Now you're talking! So how are you liking the guard's life? better than farming turnips?
Sure is! I had never slept in a room with only small cracks in the walls before. And there is no money in turnips since they started breeding those giant ones over by Canterbury.
This is for the ale, Matilda, and some extra for you if you bring some of that gooseberry mead. Say, do you drink mead ... er... sorry forgot your name
Baldric. And gods yes I drink mead! Doesn't everyone? Matilda, you don't happen to have a sister do you?
I don't think she does, but there are plenty of fine lasses around the tavern for a bachelor like yourself
I bet the girls just love a man in uniform. Shall we blow this smelly barracks and go down to the tavern?
The missus is expecting me back tonight, but go drink a pint for me.
Oh, a married man. Well I shall drink a pint to your goodwifes health and dally an extra maiden on my knee in your honour. Farewell for now!

setting.name: Servant's Quarters
setting.description: It's spare and humble.  A small cookpot sits over a fire, and a few books sit on a shelf.  A candle sits in the middle of a table where there are a few plates and silverware set out in preparation for people to eat.
setting.background: The servants' quarters were an afterthought, for the most part.  After all of the opulence that went into building the Castle itself, someone finally asked, "but where will the servants live?"  As it was, their quarters were tacked onto the side of the castle, out of view.

speech: Time to heat up some stew for dinner. I hope everybody is okay with potato
Can't wait. What a day. I wish I could just stay in the servants quarters all day like you
You know it gets kind of lonely in these quarters, you are more than welcome to stay anytime. My family is gone and I don't have any friends.
Maybe I'll take ya up on that. So do you have any news about anything around court?
Oh no, nobody tells me anything important of the sort. I just spend my time fulfilling my duties and keeping the mansion spotless. You should ask somebody more important
I'm just looking for gossip. Nothing too true if it's scandelous. And someone more important? No one else has hot potato soup on, so I can't think of anyone more important this moment
You are too kind. Why are you showing such kindness to a mere servant like myself?
You haven't poisoned me yet, so that's one thing. I just haven't told you I appreciate your meals and demeaner lately, and I do
Thank you, that is very kind of you. I don't receive many thanks around here. Now please, enjoy.
I'm sure I will. Keep me company. So what does the King like to eat?

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: Good morning. Today, I believe we have to gather the milk and hay and bring it to the kitchen.
If you say so, I might as well fuel up to get ready for that.
That's understandable. I'll get the hay.
Okay, I'll get the milk then.
Thank you, I also forgot to get some eggs too. They want eggs as well.
There isn't much milk here so I'll try to help with the hay.
Thank you. I'll be putting the hay in here.
When do we get to eat more? I am starving near to death...
We can sneak some eggs and eat them right now. It's defying the king, but I really dont appreciate his rules. We all have to eat here.
And perhaps sample some of the milk, to make sure that it is safe.
Good idea. I'll drink some right now.
What's the tool for?
It's a glass. I'm just using it to drink the milk.
Ah, I see. Pass it my way once you're done with it?

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Father, do you have a moment?
Yes, son. Always. What can I help you with?
Our king would have me measure for a larger entryway. He expects guests to visit this coming summer. They are... rather wide.
Read this, son. Thou shalt not judge others.
Judging has naught to do with the matter! I cannot help it they have all been turned into large trolls.
Have a drink with me, son. You and I need to do some talking.
I swear by my...by, by my protractor! It was a nasty spell from the a nasty witch!
A spell? Tell me more.

The king's in-laws went to visit the neighboring bazaar. All we know is, that they came back with skin made of stone! They spent massive amounts of their treasury having to redesign the door frames. It has been a rather delicate situation.

AH, I see. That is too much for me to handle. Well, this Holy church is looking spectacular. The stonework, the marble...heavenly father is smiling down upon this. I am about to head to prayer, is there anything I can assist with before I leave?
Sign here, father, and I'll be on my way.
Of course, son. I admire your hard work. It will get you far in this life and on your journey. Keep praying, son.
Of course, father.
I wonder what else will the spell will effect around here?

setting.name: Small Hut
setting.description: Very small, inside and out, the small hut is made of straw that has turned dingy from mold and time. Two cutout for windows and a brown cloth door mark the front entrance. Inside, there is only a wooden chair and table upon which sits a small wooden bowl and spoon.
setting.background: The hut belongs to Jacob, a man who got lost in the jungle and made himself a home to shield and protect him from the elements, animals, and bugs.

speech: Tell me, am I the first talking monkey you have ever met?
Indeed you are! I can't say I have much experience with talking animals other than the occasional parrot.
I'm the only monkey in rom our forest who can talk with humans. I was raised by the King, when he was a boy.
He has taught you well! Your English is almost flawless. If we weren't facing each other, I'd swear I was speaking to a fellow man.
Oh yes, I also used to help him study his mathematics. I am a wizard at algebra.
How fascinating! Were you always this intelligent, or did you possess your gifts from supernatural means?
I think I'm just a little smarter than your average monkey, unfortunately the Queen didn't like me and made me leave the castle.
I'm sorry to hear that! But I am glad I got to meet you on my travels! Speaking of, where exactly is here? I seem to have lost my map.
This compass is all wrong. It's not going to work here in the backwards rain forest.  You will surely get lost without my help.
I'm glad you are here then, my friend! Could you please tell me how to get to the nearest town? I am running short on supplies.
It is quite far. Why don't you stay in this hut tonight, and I will gladly show you the way to town tomorrow morning, bright and early.
That would be much appreciated! By the way, I don't suppose that huge spider by the corner of the hut is venomous?
I'm scared to death of spiders! Don't make eye contact, whatever you do!
I hate spiders too. I don't think I can fall asleep with that thing in the hut with us. Perhaps I should try to smash it with this shoe?

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: Ahh a warm fire after traveling in this rain all day. Doesn't get any better than this.
Nope, a plate of food, a blanket.  Have you heard of the road ahead?  Any talk of Bandits?
Not as of late. But when I came through here a few months back it was thick with them. The king had to send down a whole regiment to clean em out.
Well that makes me feel a little better.  I know they are bad in the East, but that's the only place we can get the spices of value.
I've got to try some of this roast goat. Last time I was here it was amazing.
I'm in too.  I think I'll make myself at home and relax a while before we journey on.
You in a hurry to get on the road again. Seems like traders are often that way.
Well time is money, but roast goat is worth sticking around for.  What brings you to this cottage?
I'm travelling back home to see the wife and kids. Been working out West.
I'm sure they will be glad to see you.  How long have you been gone?
About four months or so. It's amazing how much the little ones change in a short time.

I hope you have a better wife than I do.  Mine could not wait the long months I was away.  She had taken up with my brother when I got back home.  I guess I can't blame her.  It's a lonely life being a wife of a traveling merchant.
Your brother. That's a sad tale there. I hope you gave him a good beating when you found out.
No, I did not.  I just packed my bags and left without a word.  No use in fighting.  Just keep moving on, that's my motto.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Ah my loyal steed, you are looking so handsome today.  How are you?
Whinnnnnnny
I'm counting on you or our next fox hunt my hoofed friend.  I hope you are feeling up for the chase.
Neigh!!!!!!
What do you think you are up to, you silly thing.  Are you trying to tell me something?
Hhhhhhh
You know I'm going to be king one day, so that would mean you could be the one to carry me in my royal parade.
Whiiiiiiiinnnnny!!!!!!
Have you lost your mind.  You are going to end up glue.  Seriously, you can't be doing this during the fox hunt!
EEEEEEEeeeee!
Here, does this make you happy.  You are a crazy horse. I don't know what to do with you.  I don't know if you want to tell me something or you are just mad.
Whinney : )
Yes, you are mad.  Maybe I should call the mage to cast a spell on you to keep you sane for the hunt.
Neigh!

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: You guys do not have to torture me. I will literally tell you everything I know.
Why should we believe the words of a lowly thief like yourself?
I'll prove it. Just ask me anything. I will tell you whatever you want to hear.
Let's start with your target. What was your purpose sneaking into the castle?
I was hungry and wanted some meat. I took this from the kitchen.
Is that all? You could have easily stolen food from one of the village shops? That you snuck into the highly guarded castle suggests you were after something much bigger.
Alright, alright, alright. Perhaps there was more to the story. Just put that stuff away.
I'll let the dungeon master hold onto this for now. But you better start talking fast, and I don't want to hear a single lie again!
It's a bit of a long story. It all started with the Princess and the day she ran off to the forest y herself.
The Princess was involved? Do go on...
Well, she got herself in a little bit of trouble down by the docks and I happened to be walking by.
What kind of trouble are you talking about? I hope she wasn't hurt, or the king would have our heads!
No, see that's what I'm telling you. I saved the Princess. They were trying to harm her...and actually, I'm kind of a hero.
I will have to corroborate your story with the Princess herself. But if her highness confirms your account, you will be immediately released.
action: give torture equipment to dungeon master

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: It is quite filthy here isn't it.
My kind of place.  I just wish they had a better harvest spoil this year, I'm starving!
It has been rather dry in that area hasn't it. I just glad theres none of those darn birds down here!
Tell me about it.  They don't generally come underground though.  Got anything good from the left over temple offerings?  Any human sacrifices?  Old Goat skin?  I'm not picky.
I may have some goat skin, let me check for you!
That would be great.  I've been scrounging around the castle all day, but they are all paranoid about the black plague.  They see one rat and they lose their mind.
I mean, can you blame them? That nasty thing killed many of good people!
Good people, Ha!  The king is a tyrant! It would do the Kingdom good to have a good does of the plague with that one.
I hope some of them birds get the plague, I could do with out a few of them.
Yeah, I'm with you on that.  Those hawks are always trying to steal my family.   How's the priest does he believe in pest control?
Fortunately for us, since he goes along with that fairy tale, he does not believe in killing! We should be safe until someone else find out were down here. Like the hawks
Surely the hawks won't come under ground.  I was told they wouldn't.  Have I been lied to?  What about that goat?
Ah I finished it off, I apologize. We can start on the priest if you like? He seems to be getting pretty old.
He seems like a willing victim.  I wish he wasn't so big on fasting, I could use a little more meat on the bones.

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

speech: I'm here to protect this land from any intruders.  No one will get past me!
Don't hurt me, sir! I'm just a little boy!
What are you doing out at this time.  Where are your parents?
My parents are working in the kitchen, but I got bored and thought I would explore the castle tower.
I must escort you back at once.  You are going to be in big trouble young man.
Please, don't tell my parents! They're going to be so mad!
QUIET this way at once!
You hit me! I'm just a child, you monster!
One more word from you and I'll take you to the king myself.  You don't want him to get a hold of you!
Let me go at once! I know how to use a sword!
Don't make me kill you myself.  You think being a child will save you?  You've committed crimes against the kingdom.  It's time to die.
Please, I was only joking! I haven't hurt anyone!
Silly child! to think you would throw your life away over something so silly.  It's all over
I hope you can sleep at night with a child's blood on your hands!

setting.name: Horse's stables
setting.description: The stables smell terrible, and are riddled with brown feces on the ground. The horses are tame and magnificent brown. The open plains are yellow and green with grass.
setting.background: The horse stables are well kept and used in preparation of war. The most well trained knights are given horses for battle and travel. The horses stables are very well respected within the community.

speech: I can't believe after all I done I was sent to clean the stables.  Doesn't the royal family have any respect for me
What should I do sire?  Will mucking the stall strengthen my jousting muscles?
There is nothing of value for us to do here.  Nothing but filth.
Her sir, let me help you with that.  Have I told you lately that I am glad to be your page. My old knight was very unkind. The least I can do is take your horse feces from you.
Actually.. I do have something that would help with your training.  Take that and slip it into the kings soup.  You go in the kitchen every day for work correct?
I do, but you know I could be hanged for treason.  I do hope you have a fool proof plan.
You want to be a knight correct?!? follow my orders I'm in charge here!
Yes, sire.  I will need something to carry it in.  Maybe we should wait for tomorrow.  It's a beef broth.  Tonight is chicken and it will be to obvious.

Yes good thinking, the chicken broth would be much too light.  You just have to make sure no one see's you.   I will tell the king I am keeping you for training and will not be able to attend work tomorrow.  Just make sure you slip of of there and back to the quarters without being seen.
Very good sir, and if I am caught?  What should I do?
That is not of my concern.  But once I promise you will get any position you desire.  You just can't mess it up.
Well then it shall be as you wish.  I hope I can pull it off.

I believe in you.  Just remember if your caught I can't afford to be a suspect so I might just have to deal with you myself.  I don't think we are going to have to go down that route though.  Good luck
Oh no, I think I learned my lesson from my last knight.  I would not like to revisit those punishments.  Poop Soup it is.  Wish me luck.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Hold, thief! What is a person of your disposition doing on the king's fields?
Are you saying I shouldn't be in this area?
The king doesn't take kindly to criminals like yourself. State your purpose at once!
Do I not deserve a fine horse to match my cunning?
Only if you plan on buying, not stealing. I take it that donkey over there is your current mode of transport?
Yes. Do you like a meat? I have meat.
Don't insult me. Horses are strictly vegetarian!
I have this potato.
Nice try, but I do not bargain with thieves. Plus, I have all the hay I can eat over here.
Why are horses so picky? It's much easier to steal from... that is, to bargain with townspeople in the village.
I'm going to have to ask you to leave the premises now. Don't make me whip you with my mane!
Okay. It's all right. Here you go. I'm going to go now, okay?
I appreciate your cooperation. I'm on a low carb diet to stay in shape, so I'll just pass the potato to your pet donkey over there.
Potatos are good. Thank you for not wasting it. Come, let's go find another horse for me, pet.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: My Queen
Ah, ghost. Do I happen to know your identity? I do not recognize who you are.
I know a great many things, and can guess a great many others.
Well, I'm not surprised. I sense you have a lot to share. Do you mean to give me some insight?
And what insight do you seek?  Do you suppose the dead can see the future?
I came here to see a very old friend. But it seems he is not around. Asor the future, there are some who can see it. But they are often tough to communicate with.
I have not seen anyone here in a great while.  And I am no seer.
Ah. I suppose he didn't make it. I appreciate the information, ghost.
What realm do you rule in?
Whatever do you even mean, ghost? I am the queen of Viona. You recognized me, didn't you?
Only that you are a Queen.  I am quite unaware of the goings on in the world of the living.
True. I guess I expected a lot. But I guess I'll need to go since he is not going to be coming at all tonight.
Do you have any message for this "old friend", if he should arrive?
Tell him I hoped he would be in attendance for my daughter's wedding. And that the king wishes to chat.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: The medieval kitchen smells of roast and pig. The finest cuisine often includes a variety of beautiful colors and a selection of deceased animals.
setting.background: The chef's kitchen is revered by guests and kings. The head chef is lauded for his skill and culinary brilliance. The kitchen is the center of his art.

speech: Oh! Good evening, chef.
I didn't mean to startle you.  May I fix you anything to eat?
Oh. Well, I would much like a juicy ham sandwich.
Let me prepare that for you.  Where do you hale from?
I hale from Viona. I like to visit people and I like being entertained.
Here is that sandwich.  I made this very same sandwich for the king only yesterday.  I hope you enjoy it.
Thank you very much indeed. Yum!
What type of cuisine is Viona famous for?  I don't get out very much.
We do have very good stews. Beef stew. Chicken stew.
We have stew, yes we do.  I'll make some for you in case you want some tomorrow.
You are very hospitable. Thank you very much.
I am here to serve!
I am also really entertained.
Again, thank you.  May I get you a desert?

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: What are you doing here, villager?
Got lost, I guess.
And you wandered into the king's room? Are you mad?
Not mad. Ma always said simple, but ain't mad.
I see, well it would be best if you left unless you have a reason for being here?
No reason to be nowhere else. You want some chicken?
I'm quite alright, thank you. I'm going to have to ask you to leave or I will be calling a guard. This is for your own safety, as if the king caught you you would already be dead.
He sounds dangerous. Maybe you oughta have this, protect yourself a bit.
He is dangerous, but only to fools like you who loiter and trespass!
Ain't you lottering too? Loyering? Loinering? Whatever it was you said.
Loitering, loi-ter-ing! God, no wonder you did this, you can't even speak! And he is my husband!
You mean you're the queen? Tolyn Markus, Ma said to me, if you ever meet the queen you're gonna make a fool of yourself, and I reckon she was right.
Well she seems like quite the wise woman, as she was more than correct!
She were the best. And oh she could cook. Her pies was famous!

setting.name: stable hand's quarters
setting.description: The stable hand's quarters are very plainly decorated, with wooden torches situated in stone carvings in the wall. There are bunk beds with cheap hay and feather mattresses for the stable hands to rest in while not working. There are small sacks, as well as beaten and splintered wooden chests for them to keep their belongings in. One small window shines light into the very center of the room.
setting.background: The stable hand's quarters provide a place for the workers to rest and relax in while not at work. They are not too far from the stable so that at a moments notice the stable hands can respond to their call for work.

speech: Ah, nice and warm. Maybe I have time for a nap.
come and get a hug
I love hugs! Belly rubs too!
I am a male dog, I hope you are female
They never keep any females. They want us to stay focused on helping the knights protect the King..
Well, they are so friendly here and give good food
Yes , they are. I do miss my old home protecting the workshop but I was sold to a knight. He takes good care of me.
The good thing is they even gave us bunk beds in case we don't want to sleep on hay. This place is a "Mecca"
I like to lay right here by the fire. So nice after a long day. It warms my old bones. I wonder when I get to retire?
That is so cool
Hmm....Do you know something I don't? Are they going to allow me to retire and live out the rest of my days by the fire?
Tell me
Hmmm.....Something not right with this one. I'm going to take my nap now.
Wait for me let me do my night rounds and we can snuggle together

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: You know very well that a villager should not go near the forest right
Of course I know that! I'm a guard. What do you take me for a fool?
what brings you to the bazaar when you should be working
Ha! You question the King's guard! I was sent here to procure something for the King himself.
ok I am sorry , let me show you around as a way to make it up to you
Very well very well.

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: Good morning, guard.
Hello, how are you doing today?
I am doing okay. A little worried.
What's to be worried about?
Not much actually. I'm just a worrier. But something might disturb our happy life here.
We haven't had anybody attack the royal castle in a awhile.
Are you prepared to defend against pirates?
Of course, I would take a blade for thy King.
What about sea monsters? Hurricanes? So many things could go wrong.
You worry to much, try to be more calm.
I will try to calm down. Maybe working in my garden will help my stress.
Maybe. Don't you love the smell of the ocean.
It does smell nice. The seafood smells from the vendors are great.
Yes, it certainly does.

setting.name: North Forest
setting.description: Filled with huge trees, the forest is home to many types of animals. Huge predators such as tigers and bears roam the grounds as do small animals like squirrels. Colorful birds fly among the trees. Wildflowers grow on the ground. Dappled sunlight streams through the huge canopy of trees.
setting.background: Many animals, and humans make their homes in the forest. It is a source of much of the game humans eat. The people also get their wood, fresh fish and meat from the resources of the forest. It is also a place where people enjoy camping and where they travel as they roam.

speech: Rawrrrrrr
I'm gonna fly away from you.
You? Fly away from me? You're in my forest, bird. I control this land
Get away from me. Stop looking at me like that!
Silly bird, you think your skinny legs can hurt me, the king tiger?
I just have to flap my wings I'll be out of here.
Not now that you are in the grip of my claws!
No, no, get away!
Hehe, you are a funny bird. Lucky for you I like to play with my food first.
Listen I have a proposition for you.
I'm interested. Speak your mind, bird.
Look the other direction. I will fill away!
That old tired trick? You're just as dull as these wildflowers here on the ground.
It almost worked didn't it.

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Hello ox. What brings you to these woods?
I'm exhausted. I want to rest.
Ah, poor ox. I feel for you. If only I could rest myself.
Fox why can't you rest.
These are the king's lands. He wants me while I hunt for my daily meal.
I understand your pain. I spend my days bring the dwares bounty up the mountain.
Is that so? Well I might have a solution for both of our pain.
What is that?
You really want to know?
Of course I do this sounds like  a huge secret.
The next time you bring the bounty up the mountain, you could "accidentally" drop it on the king and kill him as he passes by.
What that sounds awful I'm not sure if I can do that?
Ah, but you see my dear friend, in exchange I will hunt the dwarves that enslave you. We both get our freedom.
That kind of sounds nice. I would really like that.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: Oh, my coin! Kind sir could you please help me retrieve it?
Sure, but have you anything to eat? I haven't seen a bite in quite some time.
You can eat my fist! You are a surely unlucky for finding me on this road today.
Ahhh! I don't have anything to offer but you may have it just please spare me! There must be something I may offer!?

I will spare you if you give me your purse. I really hate fighting, but seeing as no one is around on this isolated dirt road and thick forest, I will do whatever is necessary, as much as I dislike it.

I understand, the king has always looked down on me and my life is very rough. Perhaps we can help each other? I need a job, for I am starving worse then the fox over there. Do you possibly need an assistant?
An assistant? Well you'll have to prove yourself to me first before I take you one.
How do you suggest I do that? Do we wait for another traveler do come by while we hide behind one of those broken wagons?

Seeing as I am not a violent man, I need someone to get rough for me. If you can steal and kill a chicken better than that fox over there, I will give you a jewel I stole from this villager's house as a token of our partnership.
Alright! But only if I may have part of the chicken to eat afterwords. That jewel is quite nice but it will not fill my stomach.
Ah you are a novice! You may eat the whole chicken today, but you realize that this jewel could buy you a thousand chickens for a thousand days?
Huh, I can see your point... I guess that may possibly be one of the reasons I find myself hungry much of the time. Good point!
Go on then peasant! Catch that chicken!
This darn fox is persistant.. GO AWAY! Take that!
