setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Hello, may I inform you about our lord and saviour Jesus Christ?
Hey there, I'm just a maintenance person so not sure how much I can do with this information but go ahead
Well actually, he is a very terrible and evil man. If you believe in a God, cease this belief at once.
Oh my, maybe I can help repair this broken belief you have in your head, that is my specialty.
Would you like to know how I got this broken belief?
Of course, I can't begin to fix until I know what's wrong
the church is a very corrupt organisation, they took all of my belongings and all of my land aswell.

Here, take this hammer and hit those who wronged you. I find there is nothing that can't be solved by a good hammering. For example one time I spent four days and nights trying to repair something, I could not sleep, I could not eat. Then finally I was so frustrated I hit it with my hammer and BAM it worked!
i am going to break down the church down the road. would you like to come with me?
Well that's not really my specialty, I'll probably be hired to fix it once you break it. But here's an alter that would be good practice for your destruction, why don't you try it out.
Sounds good. What is your name friend?

I'm handyman Bob. Here take this wooden cross, get some of your anger out on this as well friend. Did you tell me your name yet? I can't remember, my brain is so full of tasks from the King and Queen I swear anything you say flies right over my head!
Thank you for the gift which I will now demolish with you hammer. This will satisfy my anger. By the way my name is Preacher EMerett Turk.
I must say, that is the most beautiful alter I've ever seen. What made you angry enough to destroy it so badly?

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Hail, friend.  How may I be of service?
how long have you been a priest?
Oh, 20 years, or so.
the orcs took everything from me
Where do you live, my son?
what does that have to do with my problem
The king must know when problems like this arise.
you would not understand what I am going through
yes, I believe I do, as when I was a child, orcs killed my parents and ransacked my house
then i will make them pay for both of us
Would this be of help to you?
I cannot accept that. I will honor your family
Please, let the guards take care of the orcs, don't weigh yourself down with vengeance.  Where did the orcs attack you?
I do not remember. It was so long ago. Where did this sculpture come from?

agents: his wolf companion always at his side

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

speech: Hello dog, where are we headed today?
Perhaps we should brush up on our hunting skills so we can continue to please the King. Let us go hunt some foxes shall we?
First we have to figure out how to get out of this shed.
The door should be open. They always try not to trap us in here! But, if it is not, we could slip through the hole just right under that rotting wood wall over there.
Perfect! Let's go this way.
Where should we hunt? Through the woods maybe...but Kind does not like when we visit out there alone. But, how will we ever get better?
I am a wolf, I have been in the woods. We can do it together.
Being the best and fastest of all the dogs, I cannot afford to die. But what do I fear!
Yes, you don't have all the prowess of the wolf but we can make you the best dog ever.
This is true. Teach me some things about the wild and natural instincts. Tell me, how do I become better/
I will my cousin. We will tackle these challenges together!
Oh boy! See that fox there? Let us go get it! Wait... there is a pack of foxes. I have never seen so many in one area. What is going on here?
They have probably heard about our journey into the woods and have come to try and stop us!
Can we take them all? Maybe we should not. It seems like a daunting task that would bring more harm than good.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Good day, knight. Don't mind us. We are just resting after an exhausting boat ride.
As long as you stay out of my way, I don't care what you do.
What are you doing with that peasant?!
The peasant is not my responsibility.
What brings you to the harbor then?
I am a knight with the royal army. I am not here to make conversation.
Can you at least tell me how to get to the local tavern? We are famished and could use a drink or two.
I am not a tour guide. Find your own way.
My, a chivalrous knight you are NOT. The king would be ashamed by your rudeness.
Move along traveler. You are starting to annoy me.
Come now, we could all use some kindness in our lives!
Touch me again and it will be the last thing you ever do.
You really do have a heart of steel. I feel sorry for the people who have to deal with you on a daily basis.
Move along.

agents: drunk reeling out of the saloon

setting.name: Slave quarters
setting.description: The slave quarters are a dark and foul smelling stone room where men are chained shoulder to shoulder against one another until work needs to be done.   There's a large bucket of slop that comes through and the slaves are allowed to feed themselves briefly.
setting.background: Slaves are forced to reside here while they work off their debt.  It is an extremely depressing place that few ever seem to leave.

character: a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon
a drunk reeling out of the saloon

speech: Treasurer! Stop! Hey! We met at that shin dig at the pub last fall! Please! What was your name again?
That's Lord Dax to you, citizen. What brings to you the King's slave quarters? Arrested for public belligerence?
What are you Lord of? Bad taste? Anyway, I was drinking at O'Daily's or uh ... O'Shirley's .... O'Hannigan's. Anyway anyway, one of your goons grabbed me! You gotta tell 'em I don't belong!
Watch your tongue, you peasant! The king holds me in high regard, I'll have you know. If you're here, it must be for a good reason!

Wooow, look at yoouuu. You're smarter than I thought. I am here for a good reason, and his name is Lord Dax of Bad Taste, Last of His Name (unless they come out with another Jak and Daxter). I've come for you, sir, and to drink. And I've already drank my fill
It's a good thing you're all chained up, isn't it? Lay one finger on me, and it's off to the gallows with you!
You really should stick to counting coppers because you are no detective. I know what you've been doing, and I know where the money is going. I'm here to end it. Right after I throw up ...
You dare question my honor, you insignificant drunkard? The court's money could not be in more capable hands!

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Who summons my spirit to this forest?!
the great dragon
What do you want from me, great beast?
i need you help me get something from the spirit realm
And why should I help you? I belong in my castle, not here.
Because I am the great dragon and because the survival of human ity depends on it
Why should I care about humanity when I'm already dead?
You should, all works on earth would be in vain if they go into extinction
All right, I will help. Hopefully, this act of goodness allows me to pass on into the afterlife.
I would my friend
Tell me your plan again. What do you need me to get?

The last king of the kingdom spoke about a great staff which belonged to his grandfather which carried enough power to conquer this demons, i need you to get in contact with him and get us a map to where to find it
Very well, dragon. I will try to communicate with the spirit of the king's grandfather. Hope I succeed and that the world does not fall into ruin.
my prayers are with you

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: What is going on at the castle today, cat? Think we will see anything interesting?
Not sure yet, but over the guards talking about a prince from a foreign land visiting the palace
Oh, those are always interesting. No hopes of riding the King today, so we should adventure ourselves.
Yes, my friend, But they are all busy trying to get things in order
Who says we need them to adventure else where? What is there to do anyways?
Good, so where do you have in mind?
I am not sure. How do we even out of here?
I assure you no one would notice our going out
Wait, there is a store stocked with tons of goods. Think they will notice if we get a few things to have a picnic?

setting.name: Town center
setting.description: A lavish town full of stone buildings, most of which are two or 3 stories. They have ornate tin gutter fixtures with the water seeming to pour from the mouths of different animals. They almost all have wooden plaques next to the doors describing the nature of their business. the buildings are almost touching eachother, and the narrow streets are so filled with people, donkeys pulling carts, and unruly children its near impossible to walk by without bumping into something.
setting.background: High Nobility and wealth rule the town. Although there are many impoverished people living there, they are mostly kept to the hard to find alleys. There is a strong sense of art and established money in all the main avenues.

speech: Hello, my loyal subjects! Kneel before your Queen!
Hello Queen. I hope you are having a lovely day. I am so lucky to see you before I leave.
Thank you, child. I hope you are enjoying the festivities.
Too noisy for me. That is why I am leaving.
The celebration is only just beginning! The King will be along any minute now.
I am going to the country ma'am.
Your Queen requests your presence here. That is an order.
You can't request me to be here.
Such disrespect. You dare disobey a monarch?
When you announced the festival you said come and go as you please.
That was just a formality. As joint ruler of this kingdom, I can make changes as I see fit.
Then people will question your rule. They already are. Do you really want to cause a revolt?
Don't be silly. The kingdom is thriving, and I'm beloved by all. It's you who is in peril, my dear.
I think you are mental! Attacking your subjects! This is why I am leaving!

setting.name: General Store
setting.description: The General store is painted a bright turquoise color, and is identified by the depiction of wheat crop that is carved into a wooden sign hanging from the store's front. There is a patio with a wooden roof hanging over head, and an arched wooden door that leads into the General store.
setting.background: The General store provides the towns people with basic food and hygiene supplies. It also serves the towns people well in providing a place for the locals to gossip and share the news of the day.

speech: Hey there stranger.
Hello, you seem to be a resident here. Could you please tell me the directions to get to the castle?
Sure. You take the road up to Old Raphael's place, turn about 30 degrees left, walk seven shakes and you'll find yourself at the highway. Then turn left and it's a straight shot.
Thank you for the directions. While I have your attention, could you tell me a bit more about the castle? Is it well guarded?
Now why would you be wanting to know that?
That's a secret I cannot divulge. Just tell me what I need to know, please.
My brother is a palace guard, one of many. They flank all edges of the palace.
I see... How would a person seeking an audience with the king go about it then?

setting.name: Chicken coop
setting.description: The yard outside the barn is on a small, but well-maintained farm plot. There are enclosures for animals, and a short path leading up to a handsome, cozy farmhouse surrounded by large trees. The sun is warm, and the smell of grass and animal odors hangs in the air.
setting.background: This yard has been set up to be a chicken coop, but it doesn't appear to have been planned for that originally.

speech: Hey chiorboy.
Hello there, what brings you to the chicken coop?
I am looking for a little information, what you know, dude?
I'm not too good at reading sir but I'll do my best to help. What is it?
I am trying to fiqure out how to get into to the KIng's party. is there a back entrance to thee king castle.
Yes sir, I do believe there is but what would you need to do that for?
I was hopin' I get invited to the king's party. has not happened yet
Well I may be able to help, but not without a little something in return, you know I could get in a lot of trouble.
Would this smooth the way for the King's party invite?
Oh yes yes yes and save my family from starvation!
So what would be you suggested move from here at the most established ChickenKoop in all the land east of the River.
See that farmhouse up there. I have to run up there and put on my choir clothes before we head to the party, I will be singing there too

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: Be very careful here - I don't want you to fall over that dangerous precipice! Here- hold my side.
This is nothing, my life is over tomorrow anyway
Oh dear! Please allow me to help. Step back a few feet and tell me what is going on.
My husband is sentenced to death for conspiracy against the king. My land is taken away. I have nothing for my children.
I heard the news, but didn't know your husband was the one convicted. Perhaps we can help him escape. As you know, I'm enchanted and have some degree of magical abilities.
Could you? with him alive we could run away and start anew with our family. He didn't do it, but knows the bad people.
The only difficulty would be getting by the guards. I can easily unlock his cell through my enchantment, but you will have to come up with a way to distract the guards.
I can think of something. I could stir up trouble.
Excellent! If you clear the way, I can free him and help him escape the prison. I'm afraid there is no way to get your land back, but I'll do anything I can to help you.
Well we need to get to the cells shortly if we are going to do this
I agree. Let's move at sundown. If we can make the transition right as it gets dark, we can do it during the changing of the guard. That will be our best chance.
Sounds good I like the plan
With any luck, he will be free by dark and all our loved ones can be together again.
Thank you so much

setting.name: royal farm
setting.description: The farm is immense in land size and lies to the east of the castle and its walls. A variety of food products are created for the suitability of the kingdom. A variety of animals are grown and killed for their meats.
setting.background: The peasants of the kingdom must work for a living. They have gathered together to tend to the foodstuffs of the kingdom. The peasants work day and night for their crops.

speech: How are things coming with the crops this season?
The crops are not doing so well, can you help?
What exactly would you ask of a wizard such as myself?
Maybe you can create a potion or something for the plants! Do you have any botanical notes?
That is simply a hymn book, I do many a work for the king and as such no longer require a tome for my magic.
I don't understand you sir, I am just a lowly peasant of simple words.
In simple speak, I am a great wizard of immense magical power.
Thank the gods! Can you help us with the crops?
Certainly, let me consult my vast knowledge. Also what is the cause of the downturn in the crops?
It must the drought, can you make it rain?
Sure thing, let me just prepare myself mentally for a moment as I focus on the intent of my will.
Oh great!
And now with the magic words Ius iurandum iracundiae, may the rains come and soothe the land.
Praise the gods, it worked! The drought it over!
action: steal hymn book from wizard overseer
give hymn book to wizard overseer

setting.name: Hilltop temple grounds
setting.description: A tall white building with stained glass windows and surrounded lush green grass.  It sits on top of a hill with many steps to climb.  Each room has a different setting and painted walls to set the mood.
setting.background: Many people journey to the temple for peace, solitude, reflection and meditation.  They journey up the hill and steps that are cut into the side of the mountain.  Once they reach the temple grounds the view is luxurious, breath taking and serene.

speech: What brings you to this temple, Squirrel? Are you seeking nuts?
Oh yes, I would love some. I usually run away from humans, but this building... wow, this building is phenomenal.
Then you must read this and praise the Lord, only then will he grant you some fine nuts.
The Lord? Who is this you speak of? How will he give me nuts? Will he give me nuts to last the rest of this year?
The Lord is who has provided us with all this beauty. There, there all will be answered soon. Now read.
Read the plant? This plant has no value to me... for I am a squirrel. You said he could give me nuts, but you give me a plant... Wait a second, is this here a peanut plant?
Indeed, this plant will blossom with peanuts come summer and will provide you with a lifetime of food.
... I have found something no other squirrel has found. Perhaps I am now the KING OF SQUIRRELS!!
Easy now. You must take care not to eat too much, or you may become too fat to dance.
Fat is what I need. Surely you know I go into hibernation soon. Tell me, before I go into hibernation, can I uproot this precious treasure and take it with me?
You must share it with those around you. Take it, its all yours! Be sure to Praise the Lord!
And will I take this plant with me when I die?
Pass it on to your kin, so they may also enjoy the fruit of the Earth.
But how will I do so if I do not know when I will die? What if it is stolen? Can you tell me when I will die?

setting.name: Turquoise Shore
setting.description: A beautiful turquoise color water by the shore. It is filled with many gems and gold.
setting.background: It is said that this place is lived my mermaids and they love to find and collect gems and gold. They love shiny things.

speech: Good evening mermaid, how is the water today?
It's lovely! I'm swimming with my friends, the dolphins.
Dolphins are so majestic, though the king hasn't figured out if they can be used for water travel yet. Is the other kingdom across the ocean still preparing their invasion fleet?
They are. Will you and the other nights be able to protect the kingdom?

I hope so. We don't have a very experienced navy, so the war will probably get to our land. Our knights are very experienced with land-based combat though. If they land we should be able to hold back the invasion.
Here, noble Knight. Please take my necklaces. They will bring you good luck.
This water is so pure and blue, but it will run red when the war comes. I hope our navy can buy us some time or maybe even hold them back.
We mermaids will do whatever we can to give you advanced warning and slow them down. In exchange, will you offer us as much protection as you can provide?
We can, though we can't protect you from land. Perhaps you can swim alongside our naval fleet as they patrol our shores.
Absolutely! We will stay close by. They appear to be getting ready to attck within the next few days.
I hear the dolphins are very intelligent. Do the mermaids train them?
We do. They are our loyal companions. Come, see for yourself. He will let you ride him out to sea.
Maybe they can serve as scouts for the navy. The enemy will never suspect them. Our ships will be ready for the invasion.
You are so smart, Knight

setting.name: Abandoned Mine
setting.description: A crumbling hole gapes in the side of the stone, surrounded by rotted wood timbers. A few rusted pieces of block and tackle lay half-buried in scraggly grass. A strange sort of humming noise emanates from within.
setting.background: A generation ago, people sought their fortunes here. After a decade, they'd discovered heartbreak, sorrow, and agony. If fortunes were to be had, it evidently wasn't here. The miners - the lucky ones, anyway - moved on. What spends its time here today is anyone's guess.

speech: Anything to nibble around here?
If you like Hay, yeah. But that's pretty much it.
Where is the Hay?
Not here in the abandoned mine it is back in the stables.
Ah I see. My legs are not as big as yours so it is not such an easy journey for me!
I do have amazing legs don't I? The King picked the best horses.
They are rather impressive What are you doing here?
I don't know, I was let out to roam and ended up here.
Fair enough. I like dark places and nibbles.
Can you help me find my way home?
Maybe, where is home? the stables you mentioned?
Yes, back at the King's castle?
Hmm. I probably can. I know the Kitchen pantry at the King's castle.
You've been in the Caste? Are you royalty?

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Hello assistant, are you ready to torture today?
Always
What are your favorite instruments to use?
It's not what you use, but how you use it.
Well which do you prefer?
I like them all.
What about this one?
That one's a bit much to start with.
fine, I'll save that for later.
Where would you like to start today?
I'm not sure, I think we need to start with the person thee King wanted us to torture.
Who is this person?
You.
You show your true colors!

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Welcome to the bar, woman.
Thank you!  What are you the governor of?
I am governor of this province. I manage all of the cities. I am responsible to the people, but most of all to the king.
I am married to a rich man.  You are probably responsible to him too.  ;)
I doubt it, unless you are the queen. What brings you to the bar this fine day?
I am just here to get a drink.  I think I might find another place though.  This bar has a lot of undesirables
It absolutely does. You would be wise to protect yourself.
Are there any other bars that you recommend?  You are the governor here I figure you know the places.  I don't want to mess up my best dress
Take my notebook. It has a list of all the places that are safe, as well as places to avoid.
Thank you!
You're welcome, dear woman. Please let me know the name of your husband so I can send a page to let him know you are well.
His name?  why?  Do you want to tell on me?   He doesn't know that I'm out!
Oh my! Why did you leave? Your secret is safe with me.
I was just looking for a good time.  I'll be back tonight.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Can you turn the light on guard?
why do you need the light
I like to see what I am eating when I eat and it is the King's birthday so it is a special ocassion.
I will allow it- but only for a short time.
Thank you.
You're welcome
We're both hired guns I suppose. Got to look after each other!
My only loyalty is to the King.
So you wouldn't change your job if someone paid you more?
No I am proud of my job as the guard.  I am a very important person in the castle.
Good point well made sir.
Would you change your job?
Some might say I am driven by money, or what I like to call 'appropriate fees'
It sure is hot in here.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: I have unfinished business in this life before I can move on!
I am sorry to hear that my ghost friend. I am Knight. Were you a knight?
I may be or not. I do not like to tell people who I was in life
Why?
That is my nature. I am usually suspicious of everything, like this quarters
You understand that is natural that I would ask that when we are in the Knight's Quarters? I hope you understand.
Are you dumb or something? That does not make sense at all
You came right through me there Mr Ghost. I was only trying to help. You see, I have always been charged with caring for the
For the what,knight??? Can you finish a sentence??
for them.
You know what?? I am just tired of you babling.Get ready!!
You can see what I am nodding towards, this the Knight's Quarters of the Castle. The other three quarters are for the King!
If youknow that much, how come you are asking me about the exit???
You are funny.

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: The inside tower is made from a combination of wood and brick. It also has some metal to hold all the doors in place. There are three doors and a staircase that leads up to the guards quarters.
setting.background: This inside tower is used as a guards hangout. It allows the guards to have a place to call their own. They sleep here between shifts and sometimes eat here.

speech: What are you doing here rat?
I do as I please! I am the scourge of your kingdom!
Back off! or me and my friend will kill you.
You can try, but not before I've passed on the plague! Soon you'll be sick like everyone else in the village!
You insolent rat! You have rabies not the plague!
I have both, which means I'm angry and deadly!
Me and my knight friend will know cut your head off and feed it to the prisoners!
Now I have the sword! But if you are willing, I will consider a truce. Get me some scraps from the king's table and I promise not to get too bitey.
You fool! I am simply a guard, I cannot steal from the king himself!
The more excuses you give, the more I want to bite!
Fine, fine... I will fetch you some cheese from the dining hall.
Yes, thank you! and some bread.
Don't get too greedy now, rat.
I am a rabid rat. It is in my nature to be greedy and angry.

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Hello traveler, what brings you to my court?
Hello your majesty. I'm just a humble traveler seeking shelter for the night.
I am happy to help, as long as you keep quiet since the chatter has been hurting my head today. We have a spare room in a shack near the city walls.
Excellent, thank you your majesty. I don't suppose you know if there's any bandit activity in that area?
Not that I have noticed
Excellent, that's good to hear. It's my first time in this area and I'm rather nervous about the idea of bandits being around. I'm worried they may be tempted to steal the spice I'm transporting.
My guard will keep you safe, you have my word. We treat travelers well in my kingdom
Excellent, thank you!  We're on our way to travel East to trade our spice and appreciate having a place to lay our heads for the night. Your kindness does not go unnoticed.
You're very welcome, I pray to the gods that your travels from here to the East go well
Thank you! And might I add, this main hall is quite beautiful. I especially enjoy the tapestries you've set up here.
You're welcome. My guard here actually picked out designs surprisingly enough
Well that is a surprise! They may need to consider a career change if their eye for interior design is this good.
I agree, but for now I need them by my side. Between you and me, he will be the kings replacement if I have my way
Oh wow, I'll be sure to keep that little piece of information quiet should I encounter the king.

setting.name: Trash Heap
setting.description: A largest trash heap in the kingdom has been burned out so many times that it no longer resembles anything but a sturdy pile of refuse.  It stands 11 feet tall and 35 feet across and front to back sloping gently on all sides to the ground.  The only recognizable objects in the pile are the fresh items that have been thrown upon the stack, which are, a wooden chair with one leg broken, a crossbow with no string, and a rag doll with the head detached.
setting.background: This trash heap stands as a glowing example of the wasted city that was once great.  The entire population has been decimated by the plague, and all of the belongings of the dead are burned to avoid spreading.

speech: Greetings, what brings you to this smelly pile of refuse today?
Well, when you put it that way, haha. I was eyeing that crossbow. I might be able to make it work if I scrounged some string.
Well, consider it yours. As I've been relegated to the worst guard duty in history I'm not too keen on asking too many questions.
Just like that, huh? I wonder why they want you to guard it?
Not sure, honestly. Maybe I did something to piss off the king. Shame too, I'd do anything to defend him,
Well, it beats rounds! At least you can stand still for a change.
I suppose, I suppose. I am employed I guess, so things could be much worse. Say, if you don't mind my asking, why are you looking for a crossbow?
I used to be a merchant. Now, I'm looking at becoming a poulterer. As I have no means of obtaining fowl, a crossbow suits me fine.
Well I hope if works well for you. If there's anything else here that catches your eye help yourself to it.
If I take too much, there won't any more trash to guard! They'll have to put you on privy watch, harhar.
Haha, yes, this may be true. Still, I'm just frustrated that I can't be out fighting against the invading army. I've actually been considering abandoning this post to go and prove my worth in battle.
Well, perhaps this is a test from the gods, eh?
You may be right. Still, it's tough to just sit here and watch the garbage with all the fighting going on.
You'll get there one day! Just keep your head up.
action: get rag dool with the head detached

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: Hello snake. How do you find yourself in my bat room?
I slithered in looking for food
I do have some fruit but you will have to climb up here to get it and I am not feeling very charitable today.
Then I shall attack the snake to eat
I'm a little confused...or maybe you are Snake...but I think you are attacking my pet rat that I witch gave me that has a spell on it to kill whoever tries to hurt it.
I am a snake, I am hungry and can not climb so I must eat something
What do you have to exchange for some of my fruit?
I have water for you
But I have plenty of water in the lakes that surround my room.  I am a King and can get anything I want or need.  I do like shiny objects. Do you have anything shiny?
I have none, as a snake I have no storage areas on my body
Well I am feeling generous...I will give you one apple if you slither up her to get it.
Why thank you my leige
What will you do tonight after you dine Snake?
I will hug your rat friend to apologize for my insulence

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: I am so funny it hurts.It is an special talent.
Show me something funny then!
You see this silverware?? No you don't
What's the fun in that? Do a trick, do a flip, or do something original.
I am not your jester!!! I only have to entertain the king
That is no fun! What do you do in the meantime then? Nothing.
There you go.Know that is what I call funny.
Think you can beat me? You are just a jester.
Let's not mess this Grand Dancing Hall.Look at all the velvet
Dance it out then! This is a Dancing Hall, afterll.
Ok let's goo dance.I am ready
I'll take these and show you how to dance, jester!
Ok then.Look at this move here
Look at this dancing Silverware!

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Are you a native chef or are you an assistant chef? although I am wise, I admit my confusion.
I am  second in command, but not for long. My time will come and fast
Okay, well I assume you are here to ask me for my guidance. Is this the case?
Why this land is so barren.What happened here.
The soil was poisoned by a witch many years ago, nothing has grown here since that time.
Why the King has not named this land yest?
This land is of no use to anyone, therefore it has no reason to be names. Why did you come here?
I am looking for guidance to get ride of my head chef and be the one in command
Hmm, do you want him killed, or do you just want him to go away? Either is possible, of course.
I just want him gone forever, got it?
I understand, perhaps you should slip something into his food. Do you think you could do this at the restaurant?
Great idea!! I come I never think this before??
Excellent. Then you must empty this bag into his food. After that, he will no longer be a problem for you.
Thanks.Thing is exactly what I need it.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Hello my queen, how may I be of service to thee on this day?
Good day to you! I need to move this jewel someplace secure, would you mind taking it and transporting it for me?
Of course my queen. I shall guard it with these spears of mine until I can bring it to the treasury
Thank you for your help. Also, out of curiosity, what do you think of my dress? I embroidered it myself.
Oh what a beautiful work of art you have made! It is as impressive a creation as the walls of this strong tower we find ourselves in today.
Oh, you are too kind! You are almost as kind as my King! I do agree that these Ethery Stone walls are quite magnificent.
My god! Look out! Barbarians have penetrated our defenses!
Oh no! Guard, please help, protect my two sons for me! You'll need your spears!
Ah yes, I had forgotten about your sons! I must run to my barracks and summon the other guards that live with me. Stay close to me my queen and you shall be safe.
Don't forget your spears! If these barbarians managed to infiltrate defenses as highly fortified as these, then who knows what they are capable of!
Thank you for these spears. But you must be careful not to get stuck on the sticky tar that drips off of these stones.
Oh, thank you for pointing that out. It is difficult to run in my heels if they are getting stuck on the black tar.
You are most welcome my queen. I will do all that is within my power to protect you.

agents: old man with a fishing rod

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.

speech: Hi there, young fellow! Whose boat be that you're cleaning?
My father's boat. I am an expert at cleaning them. Do you have a boat, sir?
Sadly, I do not. I am too poor to own a boat, and must rely upon the kindness of others if I am to fish the King's River.
You can borrow this boat only if I can come with you.
That is kind of you, however, if I take you with me, you must take an oath of secrecy. Even your father must not know what we use his boat for. Is that acceptable to you?
I am okay with that as long as we have it back before the sun sets. My father will be out here to check my work, and he punishes me when things are not done right
Your father sounds like a wise man. Children must learn responsibility.We should be back well before then, with luck. And if you are strong with the oars!
Hurry, let us go so we can enjoy a full day out there! What will we do with what we catch?

Excellent! This pole looks broken, but should still be seviceable for the fishing we will do. As far as the bounty of the river goes, my share will go to feed my grandchildren; you may do with yours what you like. But remember! No word of our activities to others!
Of course. May I ask why the secrecy?
The King, though fat and well fed himself, would rather let his subjects suffer with hunger than share the river he claims as his own. A cruel punishment awaits those who tresspass!
How did I not know of such? My father always tells me the river is a beautiful but evil place for us.

Perhaps your father wished to spare you the truth of the unfortunate truth of the King's despotic rule, and used the tales of evil to keep you safe from the worldly harm of the Royal rivermen's punishment.
Tell me more. Do they seize people they find on the river and lock them in a dungeon?

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Look at these tomatoes! Large, ripe, and perfectly red! I work hard to harvest the best tomatoes, but my tool shed is in shambles. It needs some serious work.
Those look great. I could build some shelves for you if I could have some tomatoes
That sounds like a fair trade. Also, water leaks in that corner there. Can you repair it, too? I can give you bushels of fresh vegetables in trade.
I've never done any plumbing before but I can try. Why is this place so badly kept?
I guess I wasn't clear. Not plumbing. The water leaks from the roof. Whoever made this shed did a horrible job.
Oh yeah I can definitely fix the roof. Do you have anything other than tomatoes?
Of course! Corn, peppers, fresh strawberries and blueberries. And in a few more weeks we will have potatoes and watermelon!
Oh that sounds amazing. All I've been eating is the slop from the dining hall
Everyone deserves fresh food - it keeps the body strong. See this rake? I would love to have a place to hang it and my shovel up when I'm done working at the end of the day.
I think I can take care of your needs. I can start working on the roof tomorrow
Fantastic - I couldn't be more pleased. I will have two bushels of fruits and vegetables ready for you in the morning with plenty more to come after that. I'll keep your family well-fed.
My wife will be so happy. The kids will be able to grow up big and strong
And I'll be able to more comfortably grow even better food - and maybe one day get a job working for the King!
I hope that works for you. I prefer to stay off his radar. I hear he's a bit crazy

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Ah, my favorite little bird! Have you a song for me today, Finch?
Tweet tweet trill trill tweet! I'm a shy bird, but for you, Ancient King, I'll happily sing!
Thank you my friend! This old body affords me only hard won pleasure these days, but my large ears always allow me to enjoy the beauty of song!
This is the most beautiful courtyard in all the kingdom, certainly. I found this gift on the bench over there. Is it yours?
I am old, but my mind is not failing yet! I am certain that this gift does not belong to me. How odd, who could have left it here? Few have access to this lovely yard.
I've been here several hours this morning, eating seed and enjoying the sun. The gift has been here the whole time. Should you open it?
I am curious, but it would be impolite to open a gift meant for another. Perhaps you could take flight, and see if anyone else is nearby who might have left it?

You don't think it could have been left by the visitors who came through yesterday, do you? If I recall, there were several young children in the mix. But yes, let me fly around the courtyard and see if anyone else is present.
Yes, thank you. Meanwhile I will inspect the gift for any clues as to what might be inside.
I flew all about the courtyard and there is no one else here. What do you think it could be?

Perhaps it was left as an offering at the statue honoring the Great Wizard, who cast the spell that allows men and beasts to communicate? If so, it may well be from an appreciative cow, as from a royal visitor.
You may, indeed, be right. I do think you would be permitted to open it and peek inside. Or, if you would like, I can open it.
Hmm, it seems to be attracting the attention of flies and ants. Er, my arthritis seems to be acting up, my fingers have become rather stiff. Perhaps it would be best if you opened it.
Ew! It's dripping something on this side. On second thought, perhaps we should just leave this here. I don't want any wicked surprises!
