setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: What a beautiful for fishing!  I wonder if the Perch are biting today?
I do not know about fishing.My thing is hunting the poacher that kills the king deers
A poacher?  In this neck of the woods?  What is this world coming to?
Are trying to mess with me. Are you by any chance a poacher?
Now how would I hunt a deer with a fishing rod?  Here, inspect the weights - they're tungsten and fully up to code.
I am the one who is in charge here.Let's see.Well, it looks like you are just a fishermen.
No need to shout.  If you would like to help me with this sail, we can use this old wooden tub to travel on the lake - maybe you can find your poacher and maybe I can find some fish?
Take this.It could be dangerous around this lake.
Thank you - this might be useful as well - especially if I need to fillet some fish!
look at those waters.It is so clear .You will probably get a lot of fishes
Aye, might be a bit chilly with the wind.  Do you have any idea what your poacher might look like?
They come on all shapes and form.Are you hungry?
It certainly has a unique . . . taste.  Did you by any chance bake it yourself?
Not. My wife did.Don't you love those birds chirping
action: give weights to town game warden

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: My lady, I didn't see you! The King isn't here at the moment? I came to bring his breakfast.
What in blazes is a thief doing in the King's dorm!  Never mind the breakfast, you must fetch the guards at once!
Uh, the guards are seeing to the disturbance in the courtyard, my lady. I fear there is only me.
Well don't just stand there!  Help me subdue this ruffian!
My lady! He's got a sword!
And now I have a shield!
Heeeellp! Saint's preserve us.
By all that is holy I smite thee for your insolence thief!  I may be the last Princess in the kingdom, but I am NOT going to let you rob my people without a fight!
Pardon my lady, when did you learn to wield a weapon?
My father *punch* taught me *groin kick* how to *knee kick* defend myself *headbutt*
I believe he's out, my lady... Would you teach me to do that?
Certainly!  No time like the present, especially with dastards like these entering bedchambers willy-nilly.  The first rule - attack, attack, always attack!  Never let up.
I-I think I understand the gist of the matter.
Second lesson - if at all possible try not to be encumbered by ridiculous outfits!  If you are light and nimble, the more difficult you are to subdue.

setting.name: A small church
setting.description: It's a very humble abode - any smaller and you could mistake it for someone's home.  In the front room is a small altar for prayer and offerings.  The two rooms to the sides are places where the priest and a traveler can rest.
setting.background: There are many roadside churches in the land and this is but one of them.  Most travelers come here to rest on their way to the nearest town, still a day's travel away.

speech: Hello priest! How is it going today?
Welcome, what brings you to the Church dear fellow?
I have come to pray for my children and seek your advice father/
Why of course. You should read a few passages of the Bible so I can open the Lord's ear to you.
Yes reading a few passage might help ease my mind. One of my boys has decided to join the king's army and my wife is very upset.
I see and how does his enlistment affect you. Do you support it?
I am obviously concerned for his welfare. Being a blacksmith I come in contact with a lot of soldiers and it doesn't seem like the kind of life I would want for him.
I understand Villager. I too have sons who fought for the Kingdom. Fought...
At the same time it is his life to live. I can understand him not wanting to follow in my footsteps. I work hard every day for very little gain in the king's employ as a blacksmith.
Surely you must understand that the swords you make only beget more violence and bloodshed?
I have no choice in what I make father. When you work for the king you do what your told or end up in a dungeon.
The Lord understands your dilemma, Villager. You must do what you to, to provide for your family. You must let your son follow his destiny.
I know I just wanted to pray for my wife to have peace about the decision. Ultimately he will have to go where his life leads him.
Take this, it will bring you and your wife peace in these testing times. Remember, the Lord has a plan for everyone, even that bird.

setting.name: The Dungeon
setting.description: The dungeon is in the very most bottom room of the Palace. Many have gone down to the dungeon through the trap doors inside the palace and have never returned. Walls are covered with spider webs and bones from previous challengers to the throne. The brick dungeon is dark and mysterious.
setting.background: The dungeon was created to keep prisoners and challengers to the thrones for periods of time. The royalty felt it was less expensive to leave them there without eating and meet their fate down there. As time went on, more and more people were lost to the dungeon and it began to be darker and darker.

speech: It is only a matter of time before the royal family is removed from the Palace.
Is this why your in a dungeon , and I live in a kingdom?
Only for now, Royalty. Your time is coming to an end. The kingdom needs a new ruler.

Haha, and is this gunna be done by a peasant like yourself? We have run this kingdom by dominance and loyalty! I'll refuse to let the likes of you take this royal kingdom ! I've bin trained in swordplay since I was a child by the templars ,I accept any and all challenges....
Careful with that sir, you might hurt yourself Quite the exquisite sword this is...
The likes of you knowing what your doing is minimal...do as you wish.
So be it. Your guards are weak like you and soon they will have a stronger leader they deserve!
If your actions are like your words I expect little challenge..
A wise ruler never underestimates his opponent. Sadly, you never were the one to lead the people of the Kingdom to glory.
A true ruler stays steps ahead of his opponent, you do know if the many traps in this dark wretched place?
Traps, what traps? Only a coward would resort to traps!
Only a coward would come through the dungeons to challenge a king! Hide in the shadows! You are the coward!
Watch your step Royalty! You might trip over your own feet.
You will not harm me!
action: give coin to a vigilant guard

setting.name: Bell Tower
setting.description: The Bell Tower is steep and rises high above the building. The stairs are made of rickety wood and go up thirty stories. The bell is so old that the cracks seem almost perfectly set in the iron.
setting.background: The bell is rung daily at high noon. It also tolls when someone has died or married

speech: Who goes there? No one has visited my tower in many years.
Be calm, friend. I'm here on the King's business. He fights a great battle today, and I am charged with ringing the bell to announce his victory for all the village to hear.
Say it isn't so! Surely the King is still not fighting the same war I escaped as a younger man?!
Tis true, man, how did you not know this? His evil brother, the usurper, has finally been cornered like the rat he is!
The war never seemed to end. It consumed all....so I hid myself away, no longer able to bear witness to the atrocities that my countrymen had grown numb to.
Then now can be your time of peace. This long war is finally over. Tell me, friend, what were you? Knight, bowman, what was it?
I...used to be an Oarsman on one of the King's finest ships... We were attacked on both sides...I can still hear...no...
You survived though, be thankful and don't forget that. I've lost many brothers over the years to these scum, attacked in the night like the cowards they are!

Why was I allowed to survive? There were many braver, more worthy men than I that perished! I could not bear the grief....so I hid myself away, floated off to distant shores, letting my name join those missing in battle...
God only knows. It's pointless to torture yourself like this, let me buy you a drink in the tavern and tell me a great sea story. Tell me of foreign lands! What is your name, friend?
No, I count myself among the dead now. So much of me died along with my comrades. It would do you no good to hang around an old ghost like me.
Very well, have it your way. At least help me pull this rope and ring this godforsaken bell.
Very well, for the message of peace and for the honor of those who gave for it, I will help you.
Excellent, on my mark, give this rope a mighty heave. Are you ready?

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Oh, hello there.  Pardon my, erm, dusty appearance.  It's been quite journey to get even this far!
It's quite okay, I am not so clean myself. Being a blacksmith will do that to you. Are you here for the wolf hunt as well?
Oh, is there a hunt going on?  I but just arrived with the rest of my village, so we hadn't heard any such news.
Yes there is, everyone here talked me into going on it, but I am nervous. I don't know what I will do in I encounter a wolf. If you and your village are not here for that hunt, then why are you here?
Ah, our king -well, former king- taxed us to the point that we could no longer feed ourselves, so we left in search of a land of our own.  But is there a reward for this wolf hunt?
The reward is to be kinged the bravest man of the village, and we have a feast in honor of whoever brings home the biggest wolf.
Ah, an honor indeed!  Goodness, but it's been many a year since I hunted... but the lads could perhaps do with a bit of comradery.  Is it open to all?
Indeed it is. I'm sure you or your men would do much better than I. I am a strong one, but I make things that kill. I do not do the killing.
Ach, well, it's been many a year since I've been called strong.  Although I was once a fierce warrior in my day!
Ah, I'm sure you still got some strength in you ay?
Well, I suppose I made it this far, so there's some life in these old bones yet!
What did you say you used to do in your old village?
Oh, well I was just a fletcher meself.  Although I had a nice little tapestry business on the side!
Ah, well welcome to our town! If you or your men win the contest, don't forget who told you about it, huh?

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: ooooOOOOOOooooooo
You aren't the first ghost I have seen.  What's your name?
King Cohen...but you may call me...DEATH
My name is Ortha, I was sent here to meet you
To meet...YOUR DOOM
Take that
You will rot here as I have!
Leave this cave and never come back
Your bones will join mine! I may never leave!
This will look excellent in the Smithing Museum
With my bone, I curse you to melt and wither into the cave walls OooooOOooOo
Leave
I may not. neither may you.
I am Ortha the greatest explorer east ot Smithing, no doublt you have heard of me.  I am collecting these artifacts and returning home.

setting.name: Inside the temple
setting.description: The stained glass glistens in the sun. The pews are lines perfectly.
setting.background: The temple is the central location of the town. Everything that happens good and bad is a result of what happens in this temple.

speech: welcome to the temple
thank you, it really is beautiful here. I love how it looks with the sun shining through the stained glass windows
I take much pride in this temple, and this parish.
It will be an honor to me, to fulfill the duty given to me by the king to keep this place as clean as possible
I like to thank you for the work that you do for this temple, cleanliness is close to godliness. I have invest much of my life to have such a place for those who can come here and worship
It is my duty. Is there any way i can be of more help ?
I think you are doing an incredible job, I am very proud of you work. I must be taking this offering plate to put the offerings where they belong
I would be happy to take this from you.

Thank you very much clergyman, I appreciate it. Its great to have many good parishioners that are willing to make offers, They all know that they must consult with me before entering into new business ventures. They know of my wealth and are willing to help with the offering that we have.
I am so glad you are wealthy but i am here to serve the people. If i had money I would sail to the new world ! Maybe i should just take this !
No! that is not for you to take, I must be able to trust in the people that work to keep this temple in order! must i let you go?
Give me a reason to trust you ! You talk about your wealth, I have served the public for so long and what has it got me !  i was losing faith and you made me lose it totally !
Read this instead it is full of wealth, wealthy knowledge. Serving is why we are all here on earth for, I just help those to get closer to serving the one and only/
I am sorry I do not know what i am doing ! I just have such a desire to head to the new land that all those feelings came over me. I should look back to my calling and the duty placed before me
action: steal offering plate from priest in ornate robes
steal offering plate from priest in ornate robes

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: Do you think the flower is pretty?
well yes, it is, so much to see here at the Entrance to the Pine Trees.
Here, this is for you!
oh, thank you. but where did you come from, these pine needles on the ground make everything so quiet.
I came from a nearby forest, I just wanted to explore the area since it seemed safe. Where did you come from?
Well, I too am from the forest and the castle beyond. Once I was a prince, but I was turned into a frog by an evil orc. See, I'm still wearing the royal coat of arms.
Oh no! That's so horrible. To be honest, I'm afraid of the royal family...the king and his friends try and hunt me with big packs of dogs.
Oh well, it's ok, I don't want to hurt you. I didn't enjoy being a prince very much, too much fighting, I don't like fighting, I'd rather play with my friends here in the forest.
I'm glad. You really don't mind being a frog? I guess the forest is beautiful, too. I'm interested in the tree over there...want to check it out?
No, I don't, I love all these delicious flies buzzing around..pfft, they are so juicy! What do you like to eat? There is weed here and lots of pine needles!
I like to eat insects! they're so annoying, but they're so delicious
Hey! that's my lunch. Ok, let's go look at the tree over there, it is kind of tall and skinny, not like the other trees.
sorry! I was hungry! Ok, let's go over here!
Alright, glad you're full. Oh, look how it's moving in the wind ohhh, it's making me dizzy watching it.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: Finally some nice cool breezes to help me relax.
Agreed. It's not often that we have such times of peace. May the neighboring kingdoms forever be our allys!
What brings you so far from the castle, knight? Is there no work for you to do?
My platoon has been given a weeks time away from duties. Since the Treaty of Kingdoms was signed, there has been less need for constant fortification of the walls.
Well we could use you in these parts. there is evil lurking.
Evil lurking? In such a tranquil lake house? Sure you're pulling my leg.
Come inside. We must not let other overhear.
But I was enjoying the sound of the waves! Oh...Very well.
There is great wealth around this lake. But it has been hunted by a man so evil and vile its unbelievable.
I see. Greed and Villainy do tend to go hand in hand. Please, go on.
A man hired by YOUR master and king robs us of every penny, every grain of wheat we harvest. We are left with nothing but blood pudding to bring us through winter.
Now hold your tongue, friend. If what you say is true, then this will be no simple task.
I need to know I can trust you. Take this token to persuade yourself to help.
What is this symbol carved on the back? I've never seen it before.

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Hi everyone! Its so nice to finally see you all again!
Welcome back! It has been such a long time since we've seen your smiling face!
How have things been!? Everyone doing well?
Things have been as well as always! You know, I've got the best faimily on earth!
Look at this key I found during my travels. Isnt it marvellous? I never found a use for it though. Any ideas?
Oh that is marvelous! You don't know what it opens? Well, looks like you're ginna be out on another adventure then!
Oh yes for sure. But for now I will relax with you! Is Georgie doing any better since last time I was here?
Why yes, thank you for asking! He was in the hospital for a couple weeks, but with the power of our families prayer we recovered quickly! Come sit, tell me about your travels.

So I started off traveling down south until I reached a goblin camp, They weren't very agressive so I didn't have any trouble. I continued on for a few days through a forest and found a city called Eldersquare. Have you ever heard of it?
Eldersquare? Not that doesn't ring a bell.

Its a small city, I needed some coin when I arrived so the king commisioned me to slay a rock golem. I went to the cave they told me and found him there. I slayed him and as his head smashed to the ground this same key fell from the middle but even in the cave I couldn't find a single lock.
The key fell out of his head?
Yeah his head was made of stone, it smashed completely to bits and this stone key was the only thing that wasn't dust! Incredible right?!
What an adventure that must have been! I wonder what the key opens. Must be something special!

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Gentlemen! The King has entrusted us with this very special assignment, and I do not intend to see us fail. The more information we can gather at this tower, the better off our kingdom will be. You there, soldier! What do make of this place?
I found this crest among the cobblestones. I don't recognize the house seal, but the lord of the tower must have left in a hurry.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Hello, my child. What brings you to the King's Quarters?
I hate the classes that I'm taking! The teacher tells me that I do everything wrong and swats at my hands
You must have patience, my boy. Don't you want to grow up to be a fine man?
How can I be a fine man if I am not happy with the treatment that I receive in class! That only shows me how negative life is
You must learn discipline, lad. The world is not a place where you can just freely do whatever pleases your mind!
How is being told everything I do is wrong, called discipline. How does that build my confidence and self esteem. Please
You must endeavor to improve the quality of your work then. You musn't let it discourage you.
I am discouraged! Just once I would like to be told that I have done something right! Just once!
I can see great potential in you, child. Come here.
I just want to lay down on the rug and nap. I am just tired and don't want to think about anything else I have done wrong
Return to your quarters at once, boy. This is no place for you.
I am not going to my quarters. I intend to leave. I will not return till I find what I want to do and class is not it
Very well, child. I will not stop you from leaving the castle. It is one mouth less to feed, after all.
I'm so glad you are worried about me. I am your only child by the way and the child that you so want to become king some day!

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: That sure is some nice house yall got back there.
Ah yes, the Farm House is quite hospitable. We must have room for all the King's assistants.
What luck for them to assist someone such as the king!
Some luck is involved, yes. But don't discredit the knowledge and work it took to get to these high positions.
Oh no! I meant no offense by that. I know you have gotten where you are based on skill. I am the kings top solider, got there by skill, maybe a little different than yours though.
I would certainly say so! Knowing effective planting seasons won't do much good on the front lines!
No it will not! *laughes* I am a killing machine, and that is how I ended up here. It is a righteous job
Tell me, what is it like guarding the Wall? Do you ever tire of keeping watch?
I do not tire It is merely a job, one that I enjoy but a job none the less. It is not a job that everyone can master, you learn after your first kill, if your fit to be a solider.
I cannot fathom taking the life of anything. I do believe I prefer my rows of corn and barley.
As I said, not everyone can master it. I am paid to kill, and kill I must. You do a fine job, though without the corn or barley the kings plates would be empty for his feasts!
This is true. I am glad that we each have our own roles to play.
Ah I almost forgot, could you point me in the direction of this cave right here on the map? That is were I am taking rest for the night.
Pardon? You mean you have no barracks provided after a long watchful shift?!
action: give map of the kingdom to agricultural advisor

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Deity, are you lost here in the abadoned? Can I help you?
Thank you for your concern, kind maiden. I am here to investigate the cause of this desolation.
I was sent to go out to the market to get wheat for baking. I have to bring back a fair amount with this coin. Is there anything I can help you with before I go on my way?
Please tell me what happened here. Why has the King forsaken this place?
He has not forsaken this place. He has not had time to come this way to see what can be done to this barren land. He has not surveyed the land to see if it can be made prosperous.
I see. This land is a far cry from the lush forest where I inhabit. I am sad there's not even a single animal here.

Do you not believe that there is differences in every piece of land that is on this earth. Some may have the lush forests, others have grand oceans and sandy beaches, and there are some that are so dry and barren that they are classified as desert,
Do not patronize me, mortal. This is no ordinary wasteland. I sense a great tragedy happened here recently.
And what of it? The tragedy has already happened. What is it that you expect to do after the tragedy is done.
I am a deity. I will do whatever it is in my power to restore this land.
And how will you do that? With what will you restore the land.?
I carry with me blessed items to cleanse the corruption from this land.
What will this ring do? Does it change the land? Will it bring back the dead, if you believe that a tragedy has happened?
Indeed, it shall. Let me demonstrate the power of these artifacts on the skeletons over yonder.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: My, but we have certainly traveled to an amazing kingdom this time, my lord and lady! And what shall I be cooking for us today?
Find the nearest peasant and ask them for the freshest orphan they can find. Preferably chubby and vaccinated.
...vaccinated? What does that mean? And why would I need an orphan? Are we having them for dinner?
Are you not loyal to me? You don't question the king and queen. We must have this dinner planned before my mother arrives.
Yes... of course... Um... so what's on the menu again?
Five broth boiled pigs with a centerpiece of flame roasted giraffe. It's just a normal meal but with my mother. The child is very important. Give him this robe also.
Um... yes... I... hate to ask, but... what is the child for? Is he to be hired as a servant, is he also a guest? I still don't follow...
It's best if you don't know. Also make sure he is addressed as Prince Barbara.
...Um...o-ok... I... wait. Giraffe? Where do I get a Giraffe here in Scotland? Do they have those?
From Gerry of course! He raises them in the hills. Are you new here?

Oh, right! Gerry. Gerry the Giraffe raising Scot! Of course! of course! Oh silly me! I was a bit distracted, I suppose. You might have a laugh at my foolishness, my lord and lady, but when you said you wanted a plump child for tonight... well you can only imagine where my poor head went!
I thought you knew about my mothers old age forgetfulness. She thinks I'm five years old! Isn't that funny? She doesn't even remember what I look like... funny... right?

Oh, my Lord! Forgive me! I was not your cook when last your mother visited us! Oh, I feel an utter fool for my confusion! I shall seek out a double for you! I think I might indeed know a lad that has your characteristic curly hair!
Thank you chef, it's been hard.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

speech: Are you ready for your marriage?
Yes I am.
Just so you know, I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity
You can put it in the bag, it's okay.
Where is your bride right now?
Here she is!
Congratulation of your weeding.You look beautiful!
What is the starting time?
Well be ready at 04:00 pm.The nave is already decorated
What is that for preacher?
I just like to swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes
Is this building were the king was married?
I do not know.I am as corrupt as they are.I extort money every change I get
So you aren't a real preacher?

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: What are you doing here, my king?
I am just enjoying the beauty of the garden at this castle my queen. Care to walk with me?
I would love to, my dear. I need some fresh air after being offended by the Lord's body odor.
Though the beauty of this rose pales in comparison to your own it should make up for the odor of Lord Stinky
You have such a sweet tongue, my love. Roses are my favorite.
You are my favorite, sweet Queen. Tell me, what business did you have with the Lord?
He was going on and on about budgets. I still have a headache!
Lucky for you we are only here but for a brief visit.  We leave to return home in a week's time. Do you think you can tolerate it?
Yes, I have learned great patience over the years as queen. Before I forget, I got this gift for you my love.
Ooooh I love gifts! I'm so impatient when it comes to them, you know I cannot contain myself. What is it??
Why don't you open it and tell me if you like it?
Oh dear thank you so much! I was wanting a new mustache mug! How do you always know just what to get to surprise me?
Being married for thirty years helps, my dear. There's nothing you can hide from me!
I suppose it does. We live a Blessed life do we not?

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Please don't hurt me.
Why would I hurt you, citizen? I'm the mayor, not an executioner.
But... but I was just in prison. They tortured me for days...
That's terrible! What crime did you commit?
I didn't do anything. It was completely against my will. Where am I now? Why am I here?
You tell me. I was invited to attend the ball by the king. Who brought you here?
I just woke up here. I remember nothing.
You are in the ball room of the castle. Quite a strange place for a prisoner to wake up.
It's almost like a scenario editor didn't make a great match. How strange... I thought I would never leave the prison I was in.
Indeed, this defies belief. Perhaps a certain guardian angel was looking out for you?
Quite possibly. Otherwise I have no idea how I arrived in such a safe place. I am lucky.
You'd best leave town quickly or else the guards will no doubt come looking for you upon learning of your escape!
Oh my!  But I am so weak. I haven't eaten in months.
Take this gold and flee at once! You can sell it for food when you're safely outside the gates!

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Storming into the Foyer the Queen took a quick glance around for something to vent her frustrations of the day on. The nerve of these people! Now some how an owl had mate its way into her castle. She would surely be removing someone from their office over this. " And just WHO let you in? Filthy animal shoo!" The Queen waved her hand at the creature, hoping it would kindly remover itself from her presence.
I was sent here with news of an assasination on yourself, prehaps you do not want the information on who is planning the treason.

The Queen was taken aback! The owl talked! Whats more, it had news of an assassination attempt. She had to compose herself for a moment before responding." Let us assume this is not a dream and I am actually talking to an owl...Who would dare attempt such a thing?"

I was normailzed by a dark mage to deliver messages to people before they died. Im sorry to tell you that your husband; the king is planning to kill you and marry a younger princess. Whos father owns 50% of the lands to the south. Now you must come with me!
The nerve!"I knew he was a lecherous fool but this?" She gnashed her teeth. "Heads will roll!"
I may only have one eye! But i can see quick clearly. The cup from which you drink has been laced with poison!
Tossing the cup to the side, the Queen stared down the owl with something that might almost look like the owls own gaze; if it still had both eyes." And just where would you take me, owl?"
Im here to take you to the otherside, Close your eyes and drift into the afterlife with me; for i am death!

A shocked look came across the queen's face as she felt her body give way under her and the owl's cold embrace wrap around her. Her last thoughts were of the traitorous husband that took her life. She could only think of haunting him until the end of his days.
The owl took hold of the queen in his talons, Flapped his wings and a bright light appeared from the celing. Both of them passed through to the other side!
The queens existence slipped away into nothingness, all spite and anguish gone from her presence. There was nothing but warmth to be left of her and even that slowly slipped away.

The owl and the queen were still stood in the same place they were before. The owl explained to the queen that she would have one hour as a ghost to exact her revenge and do what she wanted before heading to the afterlife for good.
The queen acknowledged the owls notions, and the first thing she did was carve up the painting of the royal family in the Foyer. Her ghostly claws made short work of the face of her once husband
The owl flew off to tend to another murder.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Here boy! Come and chew these ropes!
Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr.... I'm always hungry. I will eat this food and then I will chase after you peasant. What's with the rope?
You can talk? That's amazing! The guards have me tied up here, I'm 5th in line for the chop.
Growwwwwwwwwwwwwwwl... what is that you did to end up here?
I stole. I needed to. I barely eat and I have no job. The king doesn't care about us, as long as he gets his taxes.
Do you know the route to Paris. I hear it is better there. I can find a rabid mate. If I get caught by the guard releasing you they will surely kill us both. So do you know how to get to Paris?
Why would I help you then? Whats in it for me?
Then stay there! You are no 3rd in line... I have food to fetch and children to chase. Good luck!
You sure do now! Mmm this is good!
Eat well idiot! For it is the gallows for you! I will find my way to Paris on my own. See you in the next life peasant!
You're close enough for me to kill you, mutt!
Guard! Guard! this peasant is trying to get away. He is a criminal in line for the gallows! He has loosened his ropes and is trying to kill me.
I can't let this be the last off me! Get off me!
You had your chance to be free. You told me you just stole because you were hungry and needed to eat. But you tried to kill me. Now you will pay for your sins!

setting.name: oasis
setting.description: there is palm trees and fresh coconuts, a small oasis in the middle of a cacti ridden death valley. It is hot, so hot that your skin could boil. The clear blue water is cool and refreshing, lively.
setting.background: the oasis is a break for a traveler's gypsy group roaming through the desert. They were dying and severely dehydrated.

speech: You don't mind if I get in this beautiful water, gypsy? I'm hot and dusty and weary.
If you want to be like this guy, go right ahead. Things lurk in this oasis that would make your skin crawl.
Oh, but I'm drenched in sweat. How can it be a threat? It looks clear and cool.
I've seen many oasis take men far more able than you.
I'll use my sword to split this coconut and drink it's beautiful milk. Can I crack one for you?
How you're talking! These remind me of the plentiful coconuts in Samoa. They are endless.
Things could be worse- lounging int he shade of a palm tree, drinking from a coconut. I am just happy to escape the battles. Though I'm not sure how I found myself here....
This seems an unlikely place for an Archer. I came here gathering cactus apples for a concoction I am creating.
I'm going to get comfortable. What is this concoction?
It in a test phase. I'm using it to lure people into a false sense of security.
It's a good thing I'm more handsome than smart. Though, I won't get far from my arrows, nor will I sip on your brew.
I've encountered many men on my travels. None of them knew when they were under the spell. You could be now without even knowing
Let's quench our thirst, shall we? I brought a bit of fire water from the king, I keep it stashed in my armor if I get hurt. Let's share a few drops.
Amazing, relax a little more. The sun is setting now, and its a lovely warm night

setting.name: stained glass room
setting.description: the room is full of stained glass art of old and new testament stories, it has several old parchments and dust settling on the wooden chairs.
setting.background: the stained glass room is used to educate people on old and new testament stories.

speech: Excuse me, Do you have any books on how to make friends!
Why yes - how about "Friends in the Forest:  Trees are the only Friends you will ever need" ?
Im not weird good sir, Just friendless. Tell me do you have many firends!
Ah yes, well, truth be told I am more in the finance aspect of bookkeeping - this was the only book I have on me, for reading over lunch.  Perhaps you and I could be firends?
So why are you stood, behind the counter of a bookstore? That could be very confusing!
Well, this is a temple . . . and we do have bibles . . . which we give to the faithful, so I suppose we are a bookstore of sorts.
I love the bible, are you a holy man yourself?
I wish I had that talent, I kept the temple's financial books, which is as close to the priesthood as I can get.  Here, take some bibles for you and your friends!
Thank you kind sir! I will pass these along to my friends. Do you have any other interesting books!
Some scattered parchments only, the monks appear only on Mondays for book binding, but we should have more next week if you are so inclined.
What is this some sort of map?
Aye, a map of the Holy Land in the time of King David.  You can see his tale told in the stained glass above.
No I think you have mis read this sir. This is a map to your Mothers house!
I see you are not newly contrite, you are merely a hypocrite!
action: steal Parchment from the book keeper
