setting.name: The room at the top of the tower
setting.description: Small and round, the room is accessed by a spiral staircase. The room has stone walls, wooden floors and a decoratively carved wooden rocking chair next to a which looks over the castle's moat and the meadows and woodlands beyond.
setting.background: This small room is the king's favorite place to  be alone. He loves to read here, and sometimes watch through the window the antics of his soldiers training in the meadow below. The king also watches out for signs of enemies approaching the castle from this vantage point.

speech: "Ah, hello. What are you doing here? I was told to come up here and clean."
I am here to watch this place, another day serving the kingdom for us it seems.
"Ah, well, just try to not get in the way of my dusting and shining"
Of course and I trust you will be quick about it.
"Of course, I'm well practiced."
Good, the king only has need for those who are quick.
"He's certainly a harsh task master"
He is fair though, that is all I ask for.
"Say, er. What's that you've got there? Looks like one of the heirlooms that should be in the windowsill."
No this is from my family, passed down for centuries.
"Seems like an odd thing to bring with you on guard duty"
I keep on me always, my father gave it to me when he died.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: I will bite any children I see today.
Back you mangy animal!  What is wrong with you?
I'm rabid and I am in a foul mood.
You must have seen a lot of gruesome things.  I am here to speak to the hangman and stop executions...Things are going to change!
Would you like for me to bite the hangman?

No no, he is just doing his job and carrying out the commands of the king but I have convinced my father that this isnt the way to control things and we shouldn't act in such vile ways.  Even animals such as you should be taken care of better to make our kingdom better.
I would love to be taken care of by a doctor of animals as I have these terrible headaches.
See...that is what I'm tallking about...criminals should be taken care of in private and kindness and care toward people and animals will bring joy, peace, and harmony to the kingdom.
I am so hungry...give me that food.
Calm down dog...I was getting it for you.  I have no need for food that has been near an execution stand.
Ah...nobleman that you are...please make haste or that scoundrel over there will be swinging for sure.
Yes, I must go speak with the hangman now...you must follow me out of here afterward and I will take you to my royal animal doctor.
I can only dream of such a place...would you jest with a sick dog?
Never, poor thing.  Your life has been hard.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: Hello Sir Knight..Is that your sword in the haystack?
Yes that is my sword. I am practicing my art.
I saw you.  You are very agile.  If you don't mind...I will stay close by and continue to watch. There's a fox near here that has been trying to catch me...your presence would deter him.
Stay close little bunny.  You are too small for the royal table so no worries from me.
Thank you so much!  I will enjoy a rest from having to worry about being eaten!  And I will enjoy watching you.  Do you joust?
No not I...the king asked that I not...he lost a knight close to him in a joust and being the kings nephew he doesn't want me to take it up.
I see.  I think you could win many medals and rewards because you are very good.  Do you have a family?
Why yes bunny ...and do you?  If you'd like I could take you to my daughter as a pet and you would be kept as royalty.
I lost my parents and haven't seen many other rabbits.  Why yes!  I would love to be snuggled and fed carrots!  Is she a kind little girl?
Yes...she is the apple of my eye...Here birthday is three days hence...she will be delighted!
Thank you!  What fun!  I will make a wonderful play mate!
It is your lucky day little rabbit...look behind that pine tree...a fox for sure...You will fit nicely in my sack here.  Please stop trembling...I'll protect you.
Its hard to not run, run, run!  Safety at least!
Calm down...stop wiggling...you are reminding me of the little mice that run around these haystacks.  You will be safe from this day forward.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: ...and this here is my bow. I used it to kill a bear last week.
AH duke how are you today?
I am well my friend
Thank you,Im great, it has been a while.
Yes it has. When did you return?
I was re-stationed here last week by the king.
I see. We must hunt again!
Yes, I am off later tonight.
Great! I finally get a chance to use my new sword!
Yes splendid idea, we shall go out tonight.
Yes! Take this!
Thank you this is very nice.
It's one of the finest weapons in the kingdom!
I would imagine if you own it.
action: give bow and arrow to knight

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: Hello royal sir, how are you doing?
Here... help me clean the bench so I can sit
Of course, one second sir.
hey.. I think the villagers are talking behind my back... Do you know what are they talking about?
No they do not talk about you except to sing your praises.
True indeed! I am a noble and I know more than those people! Can you get me some food?
Of course, I will be back soon.
HEY! What is this??? A GOLDEN CLOTH??? How do you get this?
That is my family heirloom given to me from the king!
NO WAY! Who is your family?? You are just a townsperson!!
Do not think I will let you do this.
What is this nonsense? Let me see the cloth again!
No you attacked me last time.
I am sure you steal from the noble family! I will tell the guards!
action: steal a golden cloth from townsperson
steal a golden cloth from noble

setting.name: Sacrificial altar
setting.description: A room with a stone floor and a massive statue of a god the peasants worship.  This area gives off chilling vibes.  There's pieces of armor and weapons stored in the room used for various ceremonies.
setting.background: This room is used in worship of an evil deity.  Many have been sacrificed here in the name of this god.  The locals who come here believes it gives them good fortune in life.

speech: Oh please spare me, I am but a worthless peasant!
Ahhh your kind are so...refreshing.
No! Stay away from me! The power of my god, as stored in this statue, shall protect me from your power.
Get back fool! Your harvest deity does not protect you, he feeds on your souls!
You are wrong! My god gives me strength. The king and his nobles may hate my kind, but my god has nothing but love for me. And so with his love and this armor, your spells shall do me no harm.
Give that back! I need to enchant it! Pray I do not imbue it with your feeble soul
You may steal my armor, but I know the source of your strength. It is your golden hair!
Give that back now, or I will cut you down with this enchanted sword!
You can try, but you won't like it when I use your own hair against you! I may be a peasant now, but soon I will be as strong in the dark arts as you used to be.
Wait, I wont hurt you see?  Just give that hair back. You do not know its power!
And why should I do such a foolish thing? Do you think just because I am a peasant that I am stupid?
This is the tanned skin of the last fool who crossed me. You would make a fine rug!
You are weak without your hair! Making empty threats against me, you make me laugh. You know what else? I think your hair looks better on me! So ha!
I will force you to  look upon the pages in the spell book of darkness! A single glance will drive you mad!
action: steal gold hair from evil priestess

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: What brings someone like you to me?
Begging your pardon, learned sir, but the king requested that this unworthy slave attend to you.  Something about assist you so that you may better memorialize the King's latest edict?
Of course, do not fret I do not bite, fetch me a drink please.
This lowly one humbly offers you this refreshing mint and lemon beverage, which he hopes you will find to your palate.
Thank you it is amazing.
This mere worm of a personage is most gratified.  Perhaps, may he suggested this moistened towel?  Socrates himself often partakes of one before his greatest discoveries.
Please do not degrade yourself.
This worthless cockroach is only sensible enough to know how esteemed a personage you are, and is grateful that you accept his lowly assistance.
Please I request you look at yourself as human.
If it gives you greater pleasure, O Esteemed Wise Personage, then... I ... shall be pleased to do so.  I live to serve.
Yes well I want you to enjoy life whether you serve or not.

It gives me great pleasure to enable noble scholars such as yourself, and even His Most Excellent Majesty, to be able to perform their duties well.  Thus, in some small part, I am able to be of something greater than myself.
Well I will be getting back to work.
Very good, Noble Scribe.  May your ink flow smoothly and your pen never scratch.
action: give pitcher to a scribe constantly writing

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: Ahh this library sure does get dusty quick.
Do not fret, I am here to clean every last inch.
Thank you so much, it does become to distracting to me.
Yes I can imagine it does, what are you doing here at the library?
I am just looking for some religious texts for the king.
Ah I see, well good luck.
You sure do have your work cut out for you trying to clean this whole thing by yourself.
Yes it will be a multi day job.
I am surprised you do not have any help in the matter.
I will soon but for now it is only me.
Ahh you haven't come across any loose scrolls so far have you?
No I have not been here long.
I see, I am looking for some specific scrolls. I suppose I will continue to search the shelves for now.
Yes I will keep a look out.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: Father, I am feeling weak and discouraged. I feel that all this suffering is for nothing, nothing I tell ya!
What pains you brother?  Speak plainly, and I will do what I can to restore your faith.
I do nothing but pray, and it is becoming quite old.

Well then!  Try to spice up your prayers now and then!  Try Praying to Mary Magdalene on Monday, Mary of Tours on Tuesday, Mary the Sorrowful on Wednesday, Mary the Fateful on Thursday, Mary Excelsior on Friday, Mary of the Sacred heart on Saturday, and Mary the Blessed on Sunday!  With such variety, surely your heart will know peace once more?
You are speaking things that are untrue! We do not pray to those figures...
I am the Priest to King!  I know who it is we pray to!  Which order is it that you belong to brother?
We pray to Christ and Christ alone. He is the mediator between us and the Father!

Ohhhh, I see - you're on of Father Antonius' crowd?  No Saintly intercession for you is it?  I can see why you find it to be a bit dull, if I'm being perfectly honest.  We've got thousands of perfectly good saints, why you could go an entire decade without needing to pray to the same saint twice!
It sounds awfully wrong to pray to multiple Saints. For they are just Saints

Sure, but Christ gets plenty of prayers - some of them contradictory.  If two teams pray for victory in a game of kick the cow pattie, does christ fail because one team wins while the other loses?  No, it is because one team prayed to the patron Saint of Cow Patties, and the other to the Patron Saint of Feet!   And that's hardly a contest now is it?
True, but you instead of helping me, you have just challenged me.
Well, only because you don't believe in the truth of the Saints.  And I mean really, I ought to have you imprisoned as a heretic.
What?! That is absurd. You seem to work against the church not for it!
I mean . . . literally every church in the monastery is name after Saint this, or Saint that.  Now, I like to have a certain amount of independence among my clergy, but this is just silliness.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

speech: Hello guards, I am here for the laundry. Have you any more clothes to add to my sack today?
I have this tunic for you to wash sir
Aye sir, I will wash this immediately. I know you need it before you put on the armor that is lying about here.
Thank you so much
You are most welcome. Do you think I could be a guard one day? I hate this hard life. If I put on this tunic, would I blend in?
I believe in you, but I do need that back soon. Maybe you could make yourself a replica?
I do not have the skills to do so sir. And if I did, my hands are too messed up from working with lye to handle a needle with any care.
I can do it for you, I would love to welcome you as a fellow guard
Oh thank you so much! My life was as worthless as that of the spider in the corner. Now you have given me a second chance.
Everyone deserves a second chance at life
Can you tell me what my new duties as a guard will be?
You must man the ramparts, and be willing to lay down your life for the king if necessary
I can do that sir. I will fight til the very end. The trunks and tables that are filled with expensive equipment shall never fall into enemy hands.
Then welcome to the brotherhood
action: remove tunic bearing the castle crest

setting.name: Torture room
setting.description: An absolutely filthy and disgusting place.  Blood from the recently tortured covers the floors and walls, and the place is generally filthy and grimy.  There are various pieces of torture equipment lying around the room as well as instruments, tables, and chairs.
setting.background: This room is used to extract confessions from those who have committed crimes.  It's also useful to obtain information from captured enemy soldiers.

speech: Is there any way I could have some water?
I am sorry I am here to deliver this letter to the torturer.
What? Show some mercy please!
I have no say, I may be on the torture block next myself.
Has the king wrongfully accused you as well?
Things went down, everything went wrong, it has been a horrible week.
Yeah I've just been here getting the snot beat out of me, I can relate. You see that blood there, that's mine.
Yes I do imagine so.
It's quite awful here.
I would assume so, it is not a fun place.
Do you know of any way out?
No and I cannot dare help you.
I see that is unfortunate for me.
Yes I am sorry.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Oh woe is me, I am so hungry. What! do my eyes deceive me? food...on a table...and no one about!
Hello mister how are you?
Oh child, you startled me. I am but a poor and hungry peasant, you won't tell anyone about the food will you?
No of course not.
Bless you, bless you. The king does not look upon we peasants with favor, no he treats us worse than that dog. His he yours?
Yes he is my friend doggy
I see armor here. Do you know the knight who owns it? Is the dog his?
I know nothing of any of that.
Ah, then what are you doing here? Do you live down one of these narrow alleys?
No I live 3 houses down.
Ah, I see. Does your family need any help. I am so desperately looking for work.
I do not think so, we are also poor.
Oh, my child, I have been so thoughtless, here is a bit of this food for you. I still see no one about to claim these things. And you say you know not to whom they belong?
Thank you I have been very hungry.

agents: poet who recites his best work

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: The grand dining room has a gold plated dome in the ceiling with mosaic pieces creating an intricate art form. There are five chandeliers made of china hung from the ceiling and a hand carved 30 person kings dining table in the center of the room with a hand woven rug underneath it.
setting.background: This is the room where all meals are eaten by the king and the queen and their family and staff. There are 3 servants who cater to the room, bringing all meals. Also this is where meetings are held when guests are invited to the palace.

speech: Though I've long waited to speak, I shall be nothing but meek!
Poet I know you love your poetry but This is not the place nor time!
No time for a rhyme?!
Thou shall not recite thy ill rhymes at this time!
I suppose that will be fi-- alright.
It's ok pal, shall we sit and enjoy some wine?
That does sound... quite relaxing.  I've had nothing but iambic pentameter in my head all day, and it's given me quite a headache.
I have no idea what iambic pentameter is but I am intrigued.
Tis but some new fangled method of poetry that has recently become the latest fashion.  Yet, it sometimes need not even rhyme, so I find it a bit tiresome.  But the king insists!
Have you seen anything like this? I''m trying to find out what land this came from.
Hm... what peculiar carvings are on this.  And the beads appear to be made of... no, surely not!
Dragon teeth. The rumor is the dragon attacked my great grandfathers cottage. He killed it with his bare hands.
But the gold flecks, see here on this bead?  I'm afraid there was but one dragon who wallowed in gold enough for it to have embedded itself this much...
Maybe we could try and find the land the dragon came from and become rich
action: hug the poet who recites his best work.
give family heirloom to the poet who recites his best work.

setting.name: Ruin of a house
setting.description: A run down wooden house buried in sand and dirt. The door is still on the house but the roof is collapsed on itself. Roots and vines cover most parts of the house.
setting.background: A old testament to man that once occupied the wasteland. How someone used to live in this house was a awe to many citizens of the kingdom.

speech: Tell me why I should not eat you?
O-oh hello there, most Regal of Snakes!  Why, look at me.  I am but skin and bones, and a very poor meal.  Indeed, I fear for your life that I might possible choke you with my bony form.
Hmmm I agree.
H-ha! I am... quite glad.  For your sake alone, of c-course!
Yes I see, well tell me why you are here?
I had but hoped, O Magnificent One, to get out of the rain.  Alas, it has rained so much that my home was flooded - I barely made it out alive!
Well let us sleep here for the night.
Hm, I do wonder if... perhaps... ah I am quite hungry.  Do you think this root here is edible?
You could try my friend.
Hm, has a faint taste of... elderberries, somehow.  Although a bit fibery for my taste.
Hmm interesting
These human rags seem like they might make a nice bedding for you, Lordly One!
Thank you I will use them.
You look to be quite a King among snakes, if I do say so myself, with those clothes arrayed around you.

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: Neigh! Why so sad, townsman?
I have been rejected by that bar wench! I will show her!!
Rejected? Surely she is out of her mind! The women of this desert must be fooling themselves. They think some King will come sweep them off their feet.
Thank you, dear horse. I do not know what I should do know besides kidnap her, you know?
Ah, but kidnap might lead to trouble with the guards. Perhaps you can show her your skills. Do you have any talents?
I am good at kidnapping people...
I'm not sure you should brag about such things. As the King's steed, I am supposed to report all indications of crime back to the guards.
I mean... I am a law biding citizen! I could always sweep her off her feet with my skills in blackjack!
Umm... okay. Women love... blackjack players! Maybe some poetry or fine wine?
I often write love letter to those in my basem......I mean to my family!
You write love letters to your... family? Oh dear, I'm afraid that's an altogether different crime.
Well you know love letter to show my appreciation for all they have done for me! Unlike that wench!
Perhaps you should go home to your basement and call it a night?
I guess you are right I have to think of ways to persuade that wench.

setting.name: desert land
setting.description: The Desert is a giant wasteland.  It is vast and barren.  Its main resident is sand and the scorching hot sun.  There is literally miles of nothing but dunes of sand as far as the eye is allowed to see.  There are jagged hills and mountains throughout  the desert but they are few and far between.
setting.background: The desert was a result of the mighty god Zuric sending a giant boulder from the heavens in order to keep the people at bay, never to reach the gateways to the other life.  When the giant boulder reached the earth, the shockwave sent everything that was life away from the epicenter.  All that was left was earth and sand and that is all that is left to this day.

speech: Hello!  I haven't seen anyone in such a long time!  I made it out of the war!
Hey! It's great seeing you too!
What brings you to this awful, dry, barren wasteland? Is there a town nearby?  I am lost!
I collect scraps of wood nearby, there's actually a lush forest just over the ridge.
What???!! I have been so close!  I have traveled for miles and weeks!  What a relief!  I am so hungry!
Follow me, I don't have much but I can definitely get some food in you!
Thank you!  let me give you this sword. You can sell it, I'm sure, and gain back some money for giving me food.  I am so grateful!
Thank you! That will go a long way at the market
Its the least I can do.  Wow...now back from the war...I will need to find a job and I'm looking forward to meeting people again.
You could always collect food with me. It's not much but it's honest work.
I'm still able bodied for sure.  I'm very good with this axe as well if there's any need for it.
You could consider joining the resistance then, we could use some good fighters
I'm willing to fight for a good cause.  I am one of the very few that survived if that says anything about my fighting skills.
Then let's do it, we can take out this terrible king once and for all

setting.name: Port Skyline
setting.description: The local port sits an a majestic inlet of the ocean. The countless docks are constantly bustling with new arrivals and departures. People of all kinds come here for business or leisure. On the shore sits a skyline of many buildings packed with residents going about their day. The smell of salt and seafood fills the air.
setting.background: This port has historical roots, as it was the first city founded in the kingdom. It was here that colonizers first landed hundreds of years ago. Now, the city is a hub of the kingdom, where hundreds of thousands live out their lives. The city is a center for the latest technologies of the time and beautiful works of art, literature, and music.

speech: Port Skyline!  How majestic!  But even the sights of the city cannot ease this sense of dread and worry that besets me from every side!
Stop right there. You are a stranger here, I am a royal castle guard. What brings you to Port Skyline with such dread and worry.
I most certainly did not bury any bodies and am not at all worried about you finding out!
You make keep your shovel. You seem to be of little harm. But state your purpose, be it business or pleasure?
Phew!  I do feel less worried, and less anxious!  Thank you kind sir!  What are the best ways to relax around here?
Well we have wonderful seafood, if you are hungry, breathe deep.....smell how it fills the air.
I could do for some seafood - anything in particular that you would recommend?
If it's from the sea, it's for me! I love it all, but I have heard the crab is especially good today. So you are here for pleasure then?
Oh yes, so much pleasure!  I can't catch any diseases from the crab though can I?
no, not from the crab, but you best watch out for some of the women around here...
Ah?  Are they also crabby?
I can't really say for certain, our King frowns upon such behavior. Not so much that he sends you to the block...but you might spend a few nights in the dungeon.
Oh, well I hope to only be hear for a short visit.  I come from a small village up the river.
There is still plenty to enjoy here. The salt air is good for your health and the food is excellent. A small village, eh. Thinking of becoming a resident here? So many villagers do.

agents: king's mother who sits at their side

setting.name: Haunted Orchard
setting.description: Stunted and gnarled fruit trees are lined in rows. The trees have thick bases and are clearly very old but have not produced any fruit for a long time, yet they stubbornly cling to life. Unpruned, their branches stick out at all angles making it hard for a person to traverse the orchard and frequently these branches grab the loose clothing of any visitor. Wind moan through the trunks while dead leaves slowly tumble along the ground.
setting.background: This orchard was clearly a well tended, food producing area taken care of by people living in the Abandoned Shack. But it too has become abandoned.

speech: Milady, why have you summoned me out here?
Ah, Gertrude, I'm glad you've come.  Truthfully I get a bit nervous coming out here alone, but I'm afraid what must be done cannot be avoided.
but why are you out here at all?
Now, I trust you implicitly, or I would not have invited you at all.  But I must have your complete silence on what is about to transpire here.  On your oath, if you please.
you have my word
Now, do you recall last year, the assassin that beset my son?  And how all murmured afterwards at how keen our spy network must be, so well prepared we were for the threat?
How could I forget? I was worried sick

Well, the truth is, my dear, that on a regular basis, I come here.  Using this memento passed down through the royal line, I am able to commune with spirits and powers that are able to sense much that we mere mortals cannot.
you mean... magic?

Indeed, although it is not a magics such as wizards in their high towers and tomes use.  Instead it is connected with the nature of the earth and the spirit of the aether that is all around us.  And here is where the Veil is weakest.
so you... foresaw the assassin?
In a way - more so that it was told to me than I actively commanded the powers.  And it is not always so clear, or so readily available.
so why are you telling me this now?
Truthfully, I fear my years are catching up to me. As it must be a women, I cannot entrust this task to my son, the King.  I need someone to be there for him when I've passed on.

setting.name: captain's cabin
setting.description: The captain's cabin is a complete mess. There are multiple maps on the wall, pinned over one another, each with messy writing scrawled over it and multiple X marks in random places. Papers overflow off the desk and across the floor in waves, impeding the captain as he paces, muttering angrily. The bed is messy and unmade, giving the impression that the captain has spent the night tossing and turning. Random objects have been thrown about the room.
setting.background: This room is where the captain lets his guard down. He must appear strong and confident for his men, to keep up his reputation and prevent capture, but he is beginning to feel the pressure. Every year there are more and more authorities looking for them, and it is becoming harder and harder to evade them. With the mariners avoiding them it is getting harder  to steal from other ships, and they haven't had any luck finding any treasure for the last two years. Now the captain is exhausted and furious, leading to the disarray of the room.

speech: Hello, mariner. What brings you to the captain's cabin?
I just wanted to report that the repairs to the ship have been completed.
Well done. The king will be very pleased. What are your plans for the rest of the evening?
I suppose I will go ahead and sleep on the boat at some point, after making sure that everything is prepared of course.
We are very appreciative of your work ethic.
I've spent my whole life on boats basically, I know nothing else. So I devote my time to it.
Well you're certainly very good at it. Have you noticed the captain lately? He's been pacing and dropping words only a sailor would use.
I wonder what it is that is bothering him.
There are papers strewn everywhere and his bed hasn't been made. That's not like him. Should we be concerned?
I will have to speak with him and get to the bottom of it.
Have you heard anymore talk of mutiny lately?
Not that I am aware of though I mostly keep to myself, the quiet type I guess you could say.
Well, I'm ready, just in case.
Certainly if things go awry it would be helpful to have one such as yourself.

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Hello there Fletcher! Is that your name or your job?
Well I am an archer...
Ahhh you are right! I could not see you correctly whilst twirling through the room
What brings you to the arrow house jester?
I'm hiding from our King. Im just sure he hates me! The man is vile!
I assume he does not care for your humor?
He has no humor himself. Look at these shoes he makes me wear! How are they funny?
I cannot say I see any humor in them, though who am I to judge.
Well I shall not wear them any longer. If he thinks they are funny HE can wear them! What brings you here?
I am here to stock up on arrows and string this bow.
What fine work our fletcher does, don't you think?
Sigh...always the jokester aren't you.
I am sorry. I did not mean to offend. Forgive me?
No offense was taken, you are just a strange character is all.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello child, are you hungry?
Oh yes, I am always hungry. Mom says I am growing.
Who are your parents?
My parents are guests of the king.
Why do you carry a crystal ball?
My hobby is telling fortunes you could say.
If I give you a snack, can you tell my fortune?
Certainly, I will warn you though, sometimes they are not always good.
Here is a small snack. Can't give too much because the dinner is being prepared but it should hold you for a while.
Thank you, I always like a good snack.
Now please tell me a fortune.
Alright if that's what you want. -looks into crystal ball-
What do you see?
It appears one of the chefs has left a bone in the kings portion for tonight.
action: steal a crystal ball from child

setting.name: Stilt Home
setting.description: This stilt home has large wooden vertical beams propping it up to avoid the annual flooding that comes about during the year.  The dark wooden home itself is rather plain on the inside and outside with a thatch roof.  There's a small garden to the rear of the stilt home.
setting.background: This home belongs to a clever herbalist who thought it'd be smart to have his house propped out to avoid getting flooded.  As a result, he encounters few if any damages to his home.

speech: How may I help you my child?  I usually advise the king, but I try to make time for all of God's children.
Thank you, sir. I was married off by my family a few years ago and now all I do is cook and clean. My heart is heavy.
Are you looking for divorce child?  Or do you feel your union still has hope?
Well, I've never loved the man, but am I allowed to leave?
God wants what is best for you child, and being in an unhappy union serves no one - neither you, your husband, nor God.
But where will I go? How will I provide for myself? Thank you for always being so kind and wise.

The lord will provide - I shall write you a letter which will grant you food and shelter at any of the Lord's Houses of Worship you come across.  When you find you have traveled enough, you may start your life anew.  I can even ensure a small job to get your life started again.
Bless you! How many I repay you for your kindness?
No need my child, I serve the Lord and all of his followers - any one of us would do the same, it is our duty.
When are the floods supposed to hit again this year? I see the beams propping this place up.
Hard to say - the Spring flood is usually the worst, hits the small folk hardest of all.  But the October Gale can surprise us all if we're not prepared.
Well that certainly wouldn't be good! I'll make sure to can as much as I can for all of us.
Truly, you are possessed of both skill and humility.  You will make your next husband very proud.
Thank you, dear cleric!

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Strange place to see an angel.
It is a bit scary in this forest. But I like exploring new places.
I would imagine so for one such as yourself, to me this is home.
Are you the only dragon here?
Oh there are a few others, we work to protect the castle when the need calls.
It is very kind and brave of you to protect the king.
Fire simply proves effective when it comes to fending off mortals I would say.
Do you ever have to protect the castle against other dragons?
I have when I was younger, we are a dying breed however. Most kingdoms are not in possession of dragons these days.
Dragons are such beautiful creatures. It's a shame to know there are so few remaining.
Such is the cycle of things, we do not often reproduce.
I've heard some dragons can live nearly a thousand years. Is this true?
We most certainly can, I myself am over 900.
My, you must have a lot of interesting stories to tell.

agents: young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree

setting.name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
setting.description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
setting.background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

character: a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
a young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree

speech: Too hot in this blacksmith shop to be wearing armor today.
Yeah not sure what you  need all the armor for anyway when we aren't even at war
We need to be prepared for war. Battle is glorious.
Maybe for savages. We should try to be more enlightened than that
Savages, what do you know of the honor of fighting on the front lines for King and country and the likes of you.
There is no honor in bloodshed. We should be a peaceful kingdom

And what will you do when the enemy comes at you, will you grab this bo staff, will you fire this canon? Or will you hold up your namby pamby scroll and say (in a high pitched voice) Let's just be friends? You have no sense about you boy.

You should try reading a book sometime. Battle only comes to those who are looking for it. If we aren't looking for battle then there will be none. We should be looking to trade with our neighbors not fight with them.
I think I'd better put my armor back on, you might beat me to death with that ridiculous book of yours. We must protect what is ours.
We obviously aren't going to see eye to eye so let me see what is so special about this armour
Get your hands off it, the likes of you isn't worthy enough to clean my armour.
This is the problem. You're attacking me just for looking at your armor. This is ridiculous.
Boy, I don't mean you any harm, I am as brave and strong as they come, but there is no honor or victory when the opponent is as harmless as you and your books.
I'm tired of your insults. You aren't so tough without the armor and I will prove it.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: I beg you my Queen, please forgive my sins.
What you have done is not exactly forgivable...
I know, but you see my Queen, I just have such love for you that I couldn't help myself but try to save you from that wretched King.
You must make it up to me somehow, I can not let this go without punishment.
Anything but go to prison my queen!
I will have you maintain my garden for the next 3 months. I heard you have experience in gardening?
I do, I am quite the botanist your highness.
Well I want all of my plants watered daily, and the bushes trimmed to my liking.
Anything my queen. How about the vegetables? Do you need me to pick them for you?
Yes, you can assist the gardeners in collecting food for feasts as well.
Thank you for your lenience my Queen...
Now get to work, the vegetables wont pick themselves...
You smell so wonderful!
Haha thank you, but it must be the flowers and not me...

setting.name: Palace Garden
setting.description: The Palace garden is a lavish and lush garden filled with delicate roses and towering trees. In the center of the garden stand's a statue of the nation's founding leader. The statue is surrounded by a moat. There are stone walk ways throughout the gardens for visitors to walk through.
setting.background: The palace garden was created to provide a place of relaxation for the town's royalty. It is tended to by the most esteemed gardeners, and is always well taken after.

speech: Hello! Welcome. Can I help you?
I hope so. My family and I are visiting. We have travelled far and are looking for land of our own.
I hope you are not too tired. Please feel free to sit underneath one of the trees and get some shade
yes, the shade in this beautiful garden is so welcoming. Would you know where we might find a bite to eat?
My mistress is a very rich and generous woman. She loves to have guests for dinner. I am sure you will be welcome.
Oh, how can we ever repay you and your mistress, truly we have made the right choice in coming here.
It is no problem. I like your hat.
oh, well it is rather special. It is worn only for special ceremonies. We will be having one this Friday evening, you must come, join us and the hat will be yours.
I would love that! I am too poor to buy a hat on my own
I have heard that the king requires a heavy tax here. Your mistress is rich, yet you are poor.
My job isn't too bad. I live under the house, but my room is cozy. I have lots to eat.
As long as one has what one needs, one can be content.
Can I try it on?
Please, it is yours, but you must understand the ceremony first, come, please friend, hand it back to me.

setting.name: castle kitchen
setting.description: This is a warm, luxuriant-smelling kitchen, made of red brick that is cool to the touch on the perimeter. In the center of the room stands a grand fire-burning stove, which is stoked with crackling logs and white-hot flames. The perimeter of the room is lined with stone shelves, filled to bursting with pots and pans and other kitchen implements, the light of the fire shining in their reflection.
setting.background: This kitchen is staffed by professional chefs and the most smug wait staff possible. Throughout the day you can see the snooty servants walking back and forth, carrying everything from fresh crusty loaves of bread to elaborate dessert puddings. The kitchen is never empty, for either the King or the Queen is always hungry at some point throughout the day.

speech: A kitchen is no place for a cat! What are ye doin here?
Ah, don't be bothering me, human, I'm far too tired for your hysterics.  Or else I'll let those mice there have a go at the dinner before you humans get a taste of it.
The King would have both of our heads! They may not be no mice droppins or no cat hair in ye majestys food. Understood?
Alright, alright.  No need to get so testy!
I am but the kings chef and I be enjoying the job that I do. I don't need no feline ruinin it okay?
This feline comes from a long and noble line.  We were once even mistakenly worshipped as an incarnation of a divine being.  I will have some respect in that tone.
I unlike you, came from a humble beginning. I worked my way to such high stature! Now lets get along so you don't end up in the fire burning stove over there, ay? What do ya say, friends?
I actually had a purpose in coming over here, if you would but take a breath from your constant scurrying about the kitchen.
Alright alright, I am sorry your royal cat. What was your purpose?
That's better.  I have been speaking with the mice, and I think we can, between all of us, come to an arrangement that would suit us all quite well.
Hm, go ahead what do you want?

Firstly, to be kept on as I am accustomed to, with the occasional bowl of cream, to keep the mice from breaking their end of the bargain.  And second, the mice promise to stay confined to the refuse pile where the food the nobles eat goes, provided that every fortnight a small wheel of cheese is left to them.  They also well send any of their offspring to other places, so there's no fear of them running amok.
Ah, I guess that sounds like a pretty good bargain, Need not no little mice or kitty in the kings soup. You got a deal cat.
Excellent!  You're not too bad, for a human.

setting.name: mansion entrance
setting.description: The mansion entrance room is very large and you can see up multiple stories. There is natural light from stained glass windows. The floors and the staircase at the far side of the room are made of fine marble. There are paintings of the baron and his family on the walls. There are ornate decorations and trinkets on tables against the wall.
setting.background: This is where the baron meets his rare guests. A butler takes the guests coats and offers them a drink. Then the baron is notified of the arrival, and comes down the staircase to meet his guests.

speech: You there dear!  Have my rooms been made ready yet?  Please and thank you darling!
Yes, they have. I am just about to serve breakfast to the royal family.
Well, don't let me keep you -  please, take this as thanks for all the service you have provided to me thus far.
How kind of you, madame. Are you enjoying your stay at the castle thus far?
Oh yes, most lovely.  Have you worked here long?
Over ten years now. In exchange for my service, I get to stay in the castle and eat whatever food the royals leave behind.
You must eat well then!  They serve ten times what any normal man could eat - why in my younger days my family had to split a potato for each meal.
Yes, I am quite grateful for the opportunity they've given me. All they ask in return is complete obedience.
Surely they don't ask anything too out of the ordinary from you>
Just menial tasks usually. They are good-hearted people as I'm sure you know.
Excellent!  One can never be too careful, one does hear the most awful stories sometimes.
How do you know the royal family, if I may ask? It's not too often they have guests stay over.
Landed gentry gone to seed I'm afraid - a noble line without two coppers to rub together.  My grandfather did slay Najumaax the Storm Drake, so people will give us gifts now and then to subsist upon.
That is generous of the King to accommodate you. Your family history sounds very impressive too. Quite an accomplishment by your grandfather!
action: put lace handkerchief in food tray

setting.name: the weapons storage room
setting.description: The weapons storage room is a large open room lines with all sorts of weapons mounted on the walls. Every sort of weapon imaginable is here, neatly organized and mounted in groups. The commonly used weapons, such as swords and spears are presents in such countless numbers as to require tall wooden chests on the ground to contain all of the extras. More rare weapons are simply grouped on the walls, as fewer warriors are capable of using them and the demand is lower. There are also some mysterious weapons whose use and user is yet undetermined.
setting.background: The weapons storage room serves a practical purpose, and is also used to provide a sense of glory and intimidate. It shows off the abundant weapons the kingdom possesses and the number available for use suggests a vast army also available for war. The mysterious weapons are weapons taken from vanquished enemies as a prize. They remind visitors of the victory, and provide a chance for a warrior to distinguish themselves by learning to use the weapon efficiently.

speech: Wow, what are all these weapons for?
This is the armory! The king keeps the best weapons here. Take a look-
Ooo what is this one here?
That's the Everlasting and Eternal Sword of Eternal Darkness. Best not touch that one, it steals peoples souls.
Oh goodness, I'll be sure to avoid that. It looks amazing though!
It does. They really only use it to put down peasant rebellions anyway.
Such a high class weapon to kill peasants? Are the souls used in some way?
Well you wouldn't want to damn important people, and the peasants find it absolutely terrifying. All the souls are sent to the demon lord Mouloagh the Unhinged. I don't know what he uses them for.
Ah, well that is quite interesting. Any other weapons like that?
None of them from Mouloagh, That mace over there can be used to fight leprechauns though.
What makes it so good against leprechauns?

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: There is nothing I love more than battle! This is one of my favorite places.
I share your passion for combat, knight. One can never prepare enough.
No one loves battle as much as I do.
Have you heard any news of the king's upcoming campaign?
No. Why? Have you?
I hear we are about to depart for an invasion across the channel.
That is good news. I will be on the frontline fighting for my king. The smell of gunpowder in the morning always excites me!
I prefer long range combat myself.
Long range combat is for cowards who don't like to get their hands dirty.
On the contrary, why rush into battle when we can dispatch the enemy without coming into harm's way.  It's the smartest and most efficient form of combat.
Spoken like a true coward. You do not know battle until you have crushed a man with your bare hands.
The lifes of the infantry are not dispensable, fool. If we can preserve as much of our ranks as possible, it is the intelligent option to pursue at all costs.
You seem upset, little man. Should I fetch your mother for you to suckle her breast?
I have no need to argue with a dimwitted brute like yourself. Watch as I down five men for every single enemy you struggle to defeat in melee combat.

setting.name: Church foyer
setting.description: This musty room is fairly plain and drab and is surrounded by stone walls.  There's religious tapestries adorning these walls along with some chairs for people to wait before the actual church is opening up to them.
setting.background: Worshippers comes to the foyer to wait to be let into the main church for daily service.  This is also the place where rumors fly about as worshippers talk among each other.

speech: Hello, musician. What brings you to our humble church on this day?
To sing and worship the Lord!
Do pardon me. I see you are a bartender not a musician. I too am here to worship! I love nothing more!
Yes I AM. but it always gladden my heart to praise the King
Well then you are in great company! This may seem like a dull room but when the congregation files in and lifts the cobwebs with their beautiful voices.. the whole place is transformed!
Hallelujah. How is it like, I mean, living as a worshiper and all

Well I don't have much in the way of possessions but my heart and my soul are full of love for our Savior. I get by with the love and consideration of others who share their meals and homes with me. How about you?
Well, beer gladens the heart. I serve people wine and beer and they leave happy
Yes that does a great deal to warm the body on a cold day. I enjoy the occasional glass of wine, but as I don't have much for money it is hard to come by.
Here... I hope this will last for a while
Oh you are kind. Here I offer my necklace in return!
I appreciate this kind gesture
It is nice to have met a new friend like you if I'm not being overly presumptuous?
Well, you not. We should prepare for the service

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: Hi there, do you know of any work?
I cannot say that I do, I am but a simple beggar born in the sewers.
i thought that was the case, boy those wares the traders have look awfully expensive
I know I have difficulty affording such things.
i hate that the king looks down upon us
I concur on that, simply being born by a different mother hardly makes one a worthy individual.
you look hungry my friend, i havent got much food but would you like to partake in some stale bread?
I certainly appreciate the kind offer thank you, what brings you to the streets?
i am simply looking for work to help my family and to ensure my children do not starve
I see, what sort of work were you looking for?
im willing to work the fields, and im a dab hand with a blade if it comes to it
I would think you should be able to find something, considering those skills.
you would think, especially in this town, alas ive had no such luck. Would you like to look with me? it seems like you could use the money as well friend
I don't see why not, having two hands might be more attractive to an employer.

setting.name: Jail entrance
setting.description: The jail entrance is massive with a huge fence. There are guards on all sides. There are barbs and dangerous things surrounding.
setting.background: The jail holds the worst criminals in the city. There are some bad people that need to be kept in jail. They guard it heavily to ensure this.

speech: What are you doing here, sir?
A talking rat, eh?  What'll they think of next!.  I am good friends with the king, and am on the way to see him.
Ohh quite important eh? What for?
What business is it to you, rat?
Just curious, it's boring down here looking for crumbs on my own.
And how did a talking rat come to guard the dungeon?
Guard? Like I said, I come here only for the bits of food I can scrounge.
well, I have none for you.  I am a bit turned around: which way to the King's chambers?
Well that will be up the stairs and then you can see a guard guarding his room.
Thanks.  How is it you came to learn how to speak?
I just picked it up as I overheard people talking here in this dungeon.
You know, we could make a lot of money, you and I, and then you wouldn't have to scrounge for scraps
You think so? Hmm
I mean, not everyone sees a talking rat!

setting.name: Pharmacy
setting.description: The pharmacy is a state of the art building, much different from every other building in town. it attracts many people of all types, as they are drawn to the unique style and class of the building. It is painted a bright red and covered in black crosses indicating it is a health center in some capacity
setting.background: this pharmacy was established by the local philanthropist who does not believe in simple remedies. He wanted the town to have reliable access to proven help

speech: Its good to see another professional at this pharmacy! How often do you come here?
Quite often to get ingredients as well as mimic medicines here with my own recipes.
You make your own recipes? I get funding from the king for everything I need you understand, so I've never had to.
Of course, I brew my own potions almost exclusively.
I've always had a respect for witches. I get some of my most advanced equipment from a witch. Here take a look.
Ahh, that is quality. Only witches can truly see the quality in an ingredient, as we use them more than anybody.
The witch I got that from says she can only collect them from undead crocodiles during the full moon. Fascinating stuff.
That's correct, it is all very  technical and ritualistic.
Nothing like you can buy in stores like this pharmacy. I'm pretty sure they harvest their leeches from cow pond.
It wouldn't surprise me, or mask other ingredients to seem like leeches.
Ha! Someone once tried to sell me a black slug that they claimed was a leech when I was a apprentice. I only noticed it was a slug when it started eating a piece of cabbage I had in my lunch.
Such a despicable tactic, best to just work with reliable witches such as myself.
Quite right! Only the best for the king's doctor.
Indeed, plus they charge more than we do for worse product! Ha!

setting.name: Enormous church entrance door
setting.description: The door stands twenty feet tall. It is made of metal with a large knocker at eye level. There is a small sliding window covered with metal so that people inside can slide it and see who is knocking. The door has three large rectangles made of rivets, one high, one in the middle, and one low.
setting.background: This church has stood for over five hundred years. Many people have knocked on its doors looking for protection or service. It is commanding, yet welcoming.

speech: Is somebody else here?
Yes. I am here.
Well who are you exactly? I'm just a priest here at the church.
I am the town watchman. I know you, I have seen you preach one Sunday I came around
Ahh okay, and really? Well, what did you think?
It was a wonderful sermon
Why thank you! Any criticism you might have?
None. I am here to ensure that the vicinity is secured
Secured? I'm not sure what you mean, watchman.
The king commanded me to start making rounds in this part of the village
Well what for? Is there some sort of threat looming?
There are spies from our enemies coming  around lately
Spies?! That's very alarming, how long have they been speculated to have been around?
3 weeks now

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: I need a new cushion for my throne, now! It offends my royal bottom!
I am so sorry Queen. I don't know if the Confessional has cushions for you.
I apologize, I was yelling at my chambermaid, she can never get anything right! I do want to give confession today though
I am only a parishioner, but I can take your confession if you need. I understand the need to talk. I pray to God daily.
I was waiting for my cushion but she is taking too long. I suppose I have to start without it...Hmm, what should I confess today?
I'm sure a holy woman like you has nothing to confess.
I'm flattered you recognize how hard I work for God. We must do his will daily
Yes, I go to church every week. I pray daily to God.  We must rid the world of sin, Queen.

I absolutely agree! Let's see....today in the royal court, a Duke walked past me today and his odor offended me so! Instead of having his head I showed mercy! But the thought alone deserves confession.
Oh Queen. Maybe you can suggest a bath?
I did suggest a bath! Why that was my mercy! And he informed me he will was 7 days a week instead of the usual 3. Cleanliness is next to godliness! I saved that man's life you know.
You did my Queen! Did you suggest a perfume for him?
I did forget to mention a nice perfume! I'll be sure to show mercy a second time if he still offends my nose
My Queen you are so righteous. Is the King like you?

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: Hello there
Come to watch the stars, have you?
Yes, we've been noticing some alignments in the stars lately
I'm glad you are finding this exciting. It is boring staring at the ground all night.
Yes, it might be really boring for someone who doesn't understand the alignments
What is so special about the alignments?
It can b used to predict occurrences in the future, from weather to real live events
What can you predict based on what you see tonight? Anything interesting?
The king is planning to travel by sea in 3days time, and we need to be sure the weather will be favoured favourable
Let's hope the stars are in his favor then!
Yes, we hope and pray. Although so far we've not seen anything what raising eyebrows over
I wish I had the knowledge to predict the future based on stars. It seems like a very useful talent.
You can actually, you just need to be disciplined and ready to learn
Would you be willing to teach me? We haven't had an intruder in ages, and I could use something to kill the spare time.

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Hello knight. What kind of adventures are you doing today?
Hello, I am out scouting around the castle to make sure there are no sneaky spies lurking about. Would you like to join me?
Absolutely, I have been travelling without my pack for months. They left when I hurt my paw down by the creek.
I will let the other knights and guards know that you are not a threat. You can tag along with me if you want but we may have to get you a coller so people know that you will not try to eat them.
I'd prefer an orange collar. I would like to be seen by hunters. The last thing I need is an arrow in my hind leg!
Yeah, that collar might make you easy to see for some bullies! I will make sure that does not happen as long as you are with me you will be safe. Maybe later you can assist me in a bore hunt.
I love to boar hunt! Great knight, do you think the king would ever allow me into his castle? I've been here for months curious as to how it looks inside.
Well, You will need a bath for sure and I think I see a bit of mange on your back. I will have the local animal doc take a look at you to make sure you are healthy.
Thank you! I didn't know they made animal doctors! Maybe he can check out my paw it still hurts.
Oh yes! Of coarse! I forgot about your paw. You carry it well. You must be a very strong wolf. I'm surprised you were not alpha.
I was alpha. The day I hurt my paw I was attacked  by my pack nemesis, he overtook me and  took my place.
I see. I'm sorry, but now you can have a new kind of life here. You are very curious and brave. I will show you many wonders and we will have many adventures.
I appreciate your kindness knight!
Ssh...Look over there. Something is rustling the bushes over there. I smell a pig don't you?

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Hi Court Jester.
Your majesty! I greet you honorably!
Arise. What brings you here?
I am a living joke! my sould is what flies out of your mouth when something is funny....but I am very sad
Would you please your queen today? What news do you bring?
The king hates me
Why do you say so?
I dont know. He told me to leave his sight
Do you have gold clothing on you?
I dont. They dont pay me that much
Look around. Do you not see gold clothing?
I see it in abundance.
He did not say that you cannot wear clothing from the palace.
I cant. I cant afford it

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: Cold and dark, the moist cool walls enclose all who proceed. With just torches to light the way the large opening gets smaller and smaller.
setting.background: The cave is a dark and mysterious place with stories of hidden treasure and littered with bones of those who have searched for it. The endless passages are enough to drive ones sense of direction aerie.

speech: It has been a long day of scaring the living!  Time to relax in my cave!
Now it my turn to scare them at night! My favorite thing to do is to crawl across their face while they are sleeping! Ha!
Classic!  I used to be the King here, did you know that?
No I didn't. How long did you reign your magisty?

Oh, hard to remember now, memories are so faint.  I remember I had many useless sons and daughters.  I promised to haunt them and their descendants forever if . . . if?  You know, I've quite forgotten why it is that I do the hauntings . . .
Maybe you are ready to move on. Although it does sound like a lot of fun to haunt people. Maybe thats why you do it?
Hah!  It is fun isn't it?  If I am currently haunting them, they must have done something to deserve it, right?
Yep! They must all be spoiled do nothing snot nosed brats! Ha! I will make sure I poop on there bread.
Good one!  Why is it you hate the humans so?
They have killed many of my family and friends. Soon I am sure they will kill me but I'm gonna have some fun with them before they do.
There, there, no need to fret friend.  Why ones try to hurt you?  I can scare them when they walk the battlements, sometimes they slip and fall to their agonizing deaths.

Thank you. That would be great. Can they hear you speak? maybe you can tell them not to step on me. If they don't want us around maybe they could give us food where they would rather us be. They just leave food out. it is very tempting.
They can hear me, but as soon as I speak they run into a wall, they run off a cliff, they run outside, they run inside - they really do far too much running for their own good.
I guess thats good enough for me if it's good enough for you! I will have to see this!

setting.name: The  main hall
setting.description: Long hallway with high ceilings, long windows, and a very intricate designed ceiling.
setting.background: The main hall is the first thing you see walking into the castle. It is both breathtaking and beautiful.

speech: Greetings my Lord. Who is this person?
Greetings, Your Highness, you invited me a while back. I'm your cousin, Duke of Earl. Thank you for having me.
Ahh yes, it has been so long since I have seen you! Forgive me my dear.
Not to worry!  I have grown up since then.  We were children since we met.  I'm so tired that it will be good to be in a fine bed!
Yes of course, you must be exhausted! How long was your journey here?
It was 8 days but I took longer because I camped along the way and just had my horse.  It can be a relaxing break from the duties of life.  Being in nature.
Eight days! I could not even stand sleeping in a tent for a single day.
It definitely isn't for everyone.  I developed a taste for sleeping under the stars when I was in the regiment.  Oh my!  What a beautiful painting of you and the King!
Thank you, I love it also. I must admit I asked the artist to paint me five stones lighter, and he obliged from fear of losing his head.
Ha ha!  I have missed you, cousin! I think it shows you perfectly.  You are beautiful!  I would love to get my portrait done.
Before you leave I will ask the kingdom's most talented painter to do your portrait. Do you plan to stay here long?
You would do that for me??  Thank you! I was going to stay on for 2 months until the festival of games.  If that is satisfactory with you.
Of course, you can stay here as long as you want! Won't your wife miss you? What was her name again?
Elsmeth. She is actually staying at her Aunts because a wedding is happening next month.  I miss her but I'm happy she is enjoying herself.  She will join me here a couple weeks before I depart.

setting.name: kitchen
setting.description: Neat, and well kept. Everything in its place and a place for everything. Dishes and utensils hang from the ceiling above the chef must take great pride in his art and craft. The Iron grill over the fireplace must be where the magic happens.
setting.background: The kitchen in his modest cottage, home to the resident chef. He allows no one to mess about inside for this is his sanctuary. Only others of similar taste and style can ever dream of muttering around this room.

speech: hey chef
Good morn Other...did you bring me the water from the well?
Yes chef, left it on table behind you
did you wipe your feet...I'll not have you bringing mud into my clean kitchen...
Oh sorry chef, i'll do that now
I am making something special for the king and queen today. A special stew made with new spices from the east.
What shall you have me do, chef?
If your hands ...and feet...are clean then chop those onions
ok, into strips or diced?
Nice chunks will do...this is to be a hearty meal.  Once you are done with they onions there are some carrots to chop.
Yes, chef. I hope they like it
Have you smelled the aroma of this spice...it is like no other in the land.
hmmmmm.... can't wait for this to be done
How is your mum..other?  I heard she was feeling ill.  Might I send a broth of chicken home with you?

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: How are you today?  How can I help you?  Are you looking for a house tor rent?
Lord, I see elegance in the Lakeside House. I never thought I'd be standing in a house like this.

Thank you.  I'm so proud of my place.  It has many floors and my favorite part are the luxurious gardens.  My mother always loved flowers.  Is the lady looking for a house?  I have a couple open on my lands.
Shall you show me around?

Of course!  The other two houses are a basic layout similar to this but of course, the tenant would bring in furnishings and fixtures that they like.  As you can see, its open and a lot of light comes in...is this to her liking?
What is the lady's name? Don't mind my manners.
Oh!  I'm sorry.  I thought you escorting/guarding this fine lady in white with you while she searches for a new house.  Isn't that Mrs. Crawford? Wife of Duke of Gloster?  I might be confused!
I love the painting you have

Why, thank you, that one to the left was quite a quest.  I traveled for the king to help conquer a town and start a treaty with the neighboring kingdom. I had that done a few years ago.  Do you enjoy being a knight?
My work isn't exactly lucrative

Have you ever thought of being the leige of a Lord like myself?  I am looking for someone who is quick and brave but can also relax and be creative.  You would help me oversee my life's duties and you would get to travel a lot.  All expenses covered and you would stay here. I need someone quite soon.
I would be honoured to be of service. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married.
That works perfectly!  I pay well and would be happy to provide you with your own modest house nearby on the Lake once you marry.  This is beautiful country to raise children!
Would three floors be good enough to raise children?

setting.name: Bedroom
setting.description: Cozy and snug, the bedroom contains little more than a wooden bed covered in a worn quilt, a small dresser with two drawers to hold clothes, a lamp on top of the dresser, and a woven blue rug.
setting.background: The bedroom belongs to the groundskeeper of the castle and his wife. The old man has spent his entire life tending to the castle, and the bedroom is the place where he goes at night to rest after a long day of working.

speech: Oh wife, today was a hard day.
I am not your wife. Not until you help me get rid of my husband as you promised.
Oh Susan, let's not speak about that tonight. Can't we just forget her for a while?
How can we forget? My husband will return in the morning and he knows I've been most unfaithful. We must plan his demise and see it through tomorrow or all is lost!
Fine, fine. I'm only a groundskeeper though, not a hired hand. How do you expect me to kill someone?!
We will use the poison I got from the witch , as we planned you fool.
That dirty witch, I don't trust the ole hag. I bet that's just water spiced with turmeric!
It's not a matter of trust. She always delivers what is promised...for a price. A price which I gladly paid. Now, are you going to help me or not?
Can't we just cuddle up and let this be for the night. It's just too much after all of the wall repairs I've done today. I'm absolutely wrecked dear! I promise we shall finalize our plan this Sunday.
You idiot, there is no time for cuddling! Help me or you'll die too!
Every night with this for two weeks, you're beginning to make me long for solitude my sweet. Now, I've got to wrangle a shark out of the moat tomorrow. I'm going to bed and that's that!
If you walk out that door, we will both be dead within hours of my husband's return. Are you too stupid to grasp this?
I told you yesterday! THE KING HAS SENT HIM TO BATTLE. We have time you anxious woman.
Fine, fine. Come here and let me sooth your aching muscles my sweet.
action: give worn quilt to his wife
