setting.name: scenic overlook
setting.description: This lovely clearing overlooks the great mountain range. It is covered in wildflowers of all different colors. There are stone benches where one can sit.
setting.background: The scenic overlook is the most beautiful location on the trail. It was made to give people a place to sit and reflect on the beauty of nature. For many years, people enjoy it. There have been many proposals and was even a wedding!

speech: I love cooking and making for food the king. I wonder what I should fix for dinner tonight?
Whatever pleases you.
Oh my! You startled me! I was thinking out loud and didn't know you were here. I found all these delicious herbs here.
I love meaty recipes. Can I offer you my pouch?
I agree! Meaty recipes are the best and so filling! And sure, what's in the pouch?
I have a coin. I wish you'd let me see the scenic overlook.
You can keep your coin. You can look at the scenic view all you'd like. I'm not stopping you. Enjoy yourself here, friend.

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: hello there, mind if i get another candle to replace this dieing ones?

I'm afraid there's been a bit of a candle shortage, unfortunately, so we don't have very many available.  Something about the bee hiveries going on strike?  Or a dragon raid?  Truthfully, it's hard to keep track in these turbulent times.
That's a rather sad thing to hear, so we'll have to endure till things are back to normal
Thank the Maker that this church has endured, so that we may entreat Him for mercy.
Yes, he is faithful enough to provide and give us grace to endure
But tell me, kind sir, for what reason have you come to light a candle?  Is it for a petition or to give thanks?
Petition, my boy. I've been having serious issues at my store
Oh dear!  Nothing too serious, I hope?  Your silks and sundries are well know throughout this city and beyond!
One of the ships bringing goods from the kingdoms across the seas was attacked by pirates and i lost all my goods
P-pirates?! I was told by the King who stopped by but a fortnight ago that the threat has finally been eliminated.  But now this?
That was after they had made away with my goods
Have they no shame, destroying the work of honest folk?  Goodness, but humanity can make the world a poor place to live at times.
Most times, they do. I'm just trying to snap out of depression

Well, I know of several well placed nobles on the Council who frequent here.  I will be certain to pass along your distress to them.  Perhaps, by the Maker's mercy, something can be salvaged from all of this.

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: Harumph! Rude, rude barbarians. Always tromping right on my best leaves.
A plant dares talk bad about me!? Prepare to be crushed and turned into the same waste that lies behind these quarters!
Pft, oooOOOooo. Big scary clunk gonna crush a plant!
That's right! Scream for your life before I brutally take it away!
Ok, big scary meatbag. Don't you have better things to do than to abuse plants today?

I've already killed all the servants in this kingdom and stolen it's treasure. Now there is nothing left but the trash they left behind and you. Seeing as I can't kill trash, that leaves only you left to feel my wrath.
Oh boy, I'm trembling. No, really, can't you see my trembling leafies?!
Hey! Don't attack me with your trembling leafies! That's my job!
OUCH! Oh wait, that's right. I'M A PLANT AND FEEL NO PAIN. Dumb brute!
I'll tell you what plant. Since you are so helpless and small, I'll give you a fighting chance. Here's my sword.
You just can't get it through that cranium can you chunky? I'm a plant. You won't kill me. The BEST you could do is tear up my leaves. That's fine, I've been wanting to try a shorter hairstyle!
You insult my intelligence one more time and I'll turn you into fertilizer.
If you had any you'd realize what a magical thing I am. Think about it beast, I'm a TALKING plant. Any king would pay his weight in gold and gems for me.
Pay your weight in gold you say? Maybe you have some use after all. I might have to dig you up and take you back to my village and ask my fellow soldiers what to do with you over grog tonight.

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: Who goes there?
Ahoy there, matey!  Tis just yer old friend Pete the Pirate.  How that -ahem- present o' coins I gave ye suiting ye?  Buy yerself or the missus somethin' nice?
Pete, how'wer ye travels! Ye coins bought this here shoe!
Ach, tis a fine lookin' shoe it is.  But have the price of the cobblers gone up so much that me coin only got ye the one?
Aei they have! So much so we have no coins to fix this here dock! From your travels have you dock wood for trade? possibly for a shield?
Tis slim pickings this turn out, I'm afraid.  Just stopped in fer some rum ta wet me whistle, then it's back to liberatin' goods!
Well I shall keep this here shield for now! Les not get too carried away with Rum on the island
Aye, aye.  The butcher still keeps givin' me a look when I walk past me shop.  But her daughter was a right comely lass, she were.  Shame her father sent her away on account a wee misunderstandin'.
Word around thee castle is that there lass was never sent away and is on the run!
Is that so?  Well, she were a spirited lass.  Her red hair suits 'er nature quite well!
Aei! A wei little lad told me she's just outside the castle perimeter in an old abandoned shed. Could be worth your while to see no?
Say there, matey, yer alright!  I think I might just happen ta have a wee stroll over in that direction and see what... diversions be waitin' there.
My king would appreciate your discretion. However I would not!
Well, if she be havin' an knowings of lasses with her disposition, I'll be lettin' ye know fer certain.

setting.name: Nursery
setting.description: The nursery is a room dedicated to the care of the young children living in the palace. The ceilings are decorated with a painting of cherubic angel babies playing in clouds. There are luxurious baby bassinets, rocking chairs with cushions, fireplaces to keep the place warm and many toys all over the place. Windows framed in simple drapes offer views of the gardens outside.
setting.background: The nursery was designed by the queen. All of the children of the castle have spent time being nurtured and raised in the room. Nurses take care of the children here.

speech: Oh Bentley, I'm so glad you are here to protect me!
What's wrong, Dear? What has you so frightened tonight?
I can hear the wolves howling out in the forest. I know that I am safe here good queen, but I am still frightened by them.
Oh, you are alright! We have many guards here to keep you safe and protect you. Nothing has ever invaded here before.
Thank you! You and the king have treated me so well and I am quite thankful. I do love it here in the palace.
You are welcome to stay here, dear. Let's look at this book together.
Yes! I love reading the story books, as long as they don't have wolves! Can we read Cinderella tonight?
Of course we can! Let's get Bentley up in bed next to you.
I love having Bentley here in the nursery. He's such a big lovable brute. No wolf would dare attack him!
That's right! You will always be safe with Bentley around!
I always sleep better when he is in here with me. Let's read about Cinderella before I fall asleep.
Once upon a time, there was a poor girl named Cinderella. She lived in a castle with her wicked stepmother and two evil stepsisters.
Poor Cinderella. Why was her stepmother so wicked?
No one knows. Perhaps she hadn't felt the grace of God upon her, or maybe she just ate too many sour foods.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: One of these days I may need a slight trim of the beard, but for now I will content myself with a stroll through the courtyard.
I think you look very regal!  Especially in such a beautiful Arcadian garden such as this!
Well thank you kind bird, are you enjoying the garden?
Very lovely!  I do so love flying above the garden, soaring in the breeze!
I can only imagine what it must be like to soar in the sky.
It is wonderful!  Though sometimes when I return home, humans have stolen my eggs!
Why would they do such a thing, certainly no one should be interested in eating them.
Seems a bit cruel doesn't it?
It certainly does, I cannot fathom doing such a thing myself.
Thank goodness!  What can you tell me of the lands you rule, oh ancient one?
They are vast with a harsh chill, most of the earth is frozen. I come from the north.
And how long have you ruled?
It seems like such a long time, a millennia perhaps. I have entirely lost count at this point.
Is it good to be the king>

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Good dayy
O-oh my.  What brings you out here, small one?  Are you lost?  Where is your nanny?
No I'm not, I like to wonder in the woods, i know my way around
You seem to be a bit young to be wandering about by yourself.  Do you live here?
I live no to far from here
Well if you don't live here, what are you doing in someone else's house?!  Wait - I saw these coins on the table over there just the other day!  Thief, I say!
The owners of the house are my friends
That does *not* give you leave to just pick up other people's things, willy nilly!  Even if that is the case, which seems a suspicious pretext.
Those coins are mine, i didn't steal them
Hrmph, your voice rings hollow with falsehood.  You stay right there while I send a servant to go contact the guard.  We'll soon get to the bottom of this!
This is so unfair, this is all because my father is at the battle front
Save your tears for when the authorities arrive!  It's bad enough with the king steals from us with his taxes, let alone some street child taking from honest, hardworking citizens!
Would you have accused me of these if i wear your child?
*My* child would be getting a good thrashing for taking what didn't belong to him.

setting.name: The old red barn
setting.description: This is an old run down red barn. It's two stories and most farmers wouldn't still be using it. It has chickens and cows inside and harvests eggs and milk for the entire family. The second story has a large pile of hay visible through an old opening in the front.
setting.background: This barn has been on the farm since the very beginning. It was built by the first generation farmer to live on the land over sixty years ago. It has been repainted numerous times and wasn't originally red. It was actually yellow before switching to red.

speech: It is so much work tending to all the animals.
Yes, but we must keep working if we ever hope to own land and move up in the world
Certainly, it has been a hard life. We do need food though and there is only one way to make that happen.
How would that be?
By caring for the animals it is our only means of getting by afterall.
Yes that is true. I want to move away some day
It would certainly be nice to get out of this run down farm one day.
Perhaps there is a kingdom that is run by a more generous king elsewhere?
One could only wish, I do not know of such a kingdom or I would surely move right away.
Perhaps next time we go to the town we can ask around
It couldn't hurt why don't we give it a try?
Great, and maybe we can trade the pig for some supplies to fix up this barn
It is in really rough shape, it could really use some care.
Yes, hopefully it doesn't collapse
action: give large pile of hay to pig

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hello prince, how are you?
I am well. And I see you've a queen with you, might there be an eligible daughter for me to meet?
We are but visitors here, you move so quickly prince!
Ah yes, this is true. But life is short, is it not?
Especially in these times! Lucky for us our royal blood prolongs our life!
Haha! But of course! So tell me, what do you think of my father's kingdom, the kingdom which shall soon be mine?
It is a beautiful place, it reminds me of home!
Come closer, and be welcomed into my home. As perhaps our royal blood shall soon comingle!
Where is your father by the way? We have business to discuss.
My father is in another part of the kingdom, dealing with a small insurrection. I am managing the affairs in his absence. I am his proxy.
Okay well we need to get down to the business of the tax your family is charging us to import our food and livestock.
The tax is fair and necessary. I'll hear nothing of changing such a tax.
It is unfair and unless you want the might of our kingdom, I suggest we make a deal.

It is you who does not wand the might of OUR kingdom. Perhaps a deal could be struck. As I mentioned, I am soon to be crowned king upon my father's death. I should take a bride suiting my position. I would expect that with our kingdoms joined, there would be no taxes between us.

setting.name: bone pit
setting.description: Grungy and damp, a hole in the ground filled with remains of the fallen. A pungent odor rises from the opening, warding off anyone nearing the area. Ivory spikes with brownish red tips line the outside of the pit.
setting.background: The bone pit is rumored to have been originally used by an ancient king to persuade traitors to expose their counterparts.  The king was said to toss the traitors loved ones into the pit, one by one, until he got his answers, eventually tossing the traitor in as well.

speech: Hello Judge.
Hello there loved one.
I am Really hungry. Do you have any food to share.
I seem to be only carrying my normal things my apologies.
Its ok. So what are you doing in damp and grungy place like this.
I suppose I could ask you the same, I was wondering that as well.
My husband has been charged with conspiracy against the king so I have know where else to go. Do you know what that awful smell is.
I can not believe gerald would do such a thing!
He will be sentenced to death and I will be a widow at dawn.
It is unfortunate, I do believe the smell might be the remains here.
Why do you think the remains are here.
Considering the spikes I imagine they may have been thrown to their death.
Do you think we will die here.
I certainly hope not, we should find a means to exit this place.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: Horse, are you up for an adventure to the sea?
NOOO... Not the sea!! I got sea sick.... Can we just stay in this beautiful town?
We are not going on a boat horse! Calm down! I just would like to take an adventure to be down by the sea
Oh OK! I got nervous when someone talks about sea.... What's up over there? I thought you have a good life here..
Anoria? There is not much here, just cobblestone, grass a home and a dune and one street? I like adventure. don't you?

Let me correct you... beautiful cobblestone that won't hurt my feet when we walk, nice yummy grass, beautiful home, don't care about the dune and one street that leads to the oat store. What else are you looking for?

What oat store? There are no stores? We get everything we have by harvesting from the small amount of land that is here. I would like to take an adventure. We are not leaving for good, just for a few days and we will return. Horse you are too zany!
Alright... As you wish, master... Hey, what is this? a scroll? are you up to no good?
The scroll comes from a grander noble. He brought it from the king. He could not read it, so he asked that I try to make sense of it.
Is this why we are going for an adventure? Where are we going?

No the scroll I cannot make heads or tails of. If you want to go farther into Anoria, there are more houses and streets and people. We can go through and pick up what we need before we go on the adventure>
You know... I heard some other horses in town talk about an unusual old person that has great wisdom. He usually can be found in the tavern at night time. He might can help us with the scroll.
We could go there as we pass through the town and ask. Hopefully he will be able to read it. It might be a little scary going to a tavern with people that like to get into fights when they drink.
Maybe you can ask the servant to go in instead.. Don't get your hands dirty...

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hello, peasant! I know you're hungry, but my family and I are off limits!
What about that alligator?  Is he good eating?
Oh, now that's a meal fit for a king! He'll feed you and your family for months!
Maybe if I throw this rock?  What do you think my chance is of success?
Minimal. He's a large beast. But perhaps if I attack him at the same time. Ready... 1-2-3!
*Throws Rock* Uh oh . . . he looks angry . . .he looks REALLY angry!
Go away, Gator! Succumb from your injuries and feed this peasant! You are a weakling!
Oh wow!  Look at that fish-dude go!  Wowzers!
Oh man! He's nipped off my tail!
Off my fish-friend you monster!  Leave him alone I say!
Help me! Help! I'm tailless!
Nooooo!  Fish-friend!  I shall carve you a new tail from wood!
Wood? Wood? Wood won't get me anywhere. I have lost my tail and now I'll die!
It is magical wood infused by fairy dust!  Oh, my poor fish friend, don't die on me now!

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Hello good boy!
Oh boy oh boy oh boy oh boy maybe i'll get a bone today oh boy
What was that? You want a,,,,,, BONE!
OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY!!!!!!!!! I MAY GET A BONE!!!
Calm down boy. That is not how a royal dog acts!
OH BOY OH BOY OH BOY!!!!!!!!! I AM SO HAPPY!!!!!!!
I trust you have been doing a good job, guarding the royal grouds, yes?
OH BOY YES YES!! I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU SAID BUT YES CAN GET BONE NOW???
*breaks arm bone off the horse thieve, that is shakled up* Here you go boy!
Just wait, soon enough I will be the KING, and you will have even better bones at yer pickin
NOMNOMNOMNOM
There there, lets get off back to the castle. We look like we're interrupting these horses sleep. Come on boy, lets go!
OH BOY WAT DOIN WHERE WE GOIN?!!!!
action: get the royal coat of arms
room_objects: a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms
a the royal coat of arms

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Have you any stories to tell?  I am looking for tales to record for my upcoming book.
I am but a maid for the queen. I have never been out adventuring. But it really depends on what type of book you are going to write! Tell me more!
Well, I am looking for tales from all walks of life - surely you must have some juicy gossip?  Scuttlebutt from about the castle?
Well yes I do. But you must promise not to tell anyone! A week ago I entered the queens bedroom to change her sheets. And I caught the stableboy in there getting dressed!
Oh my!  What did you do next?
I quickly left the room but I'm sure that he saw me! The next time I saw the queen I'm pretty sure she was scared of me! I think she knows I know!
*scribbles furiously*  Royal intrigue!  The tale gets all the more interesting!  Please, go on.
As I left the castle the next day to tend to the royal garden. The same stableboy came to me begging me not to tell anyone!
And what did you tell him?

I told him I would think about it. It's nice to have some leverage in things around here for once. Maybe one day I will blackmail one of them. Im sure he would be executed if the king found out though.
Well, I shall be sure to keep you anonymous in my retelling - what would you like me to use as your pen-name?
Just say that I'm a little birdy who sees things people dont want me to. But say that this is a tale from another kingdom because if not it will be much too obvious.
I shall call you the Lark of Cathay!  Has a nice ring to it doesn't it?
I suppose it does! You are quite a writer! I hope to read this novel when you do publish it!

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Ah! A sandstorm! A perfect time for a nap! My luck just keeps getting better and better!
No good sir, we must run away!  The sand will smother us all if we stay!
You know, a talking horse I can deal with, but a rhyming horse?! Now I know I lack sleep!
Sleep?  At a time like this!  Rouse yourself man, or your life you will miss!
Wow... never realized how annoying that is. Is this why I was kicked out of the castle? Is a rhyming jester really this annoying?
I am here to be your curse! Forevermore, you will hear only verse!
...no! It cannot be! I... I must be already asleep! Yes! That must be it! This storm! This horse! I must be in the middle of a nightmare!... HA! Geddit! A night... MARE! Ahhhh... I still got it!
You will hear my words even in your sleep - close your eyes, and breath them in deep!

Uh.... RUDE! You could at least pity laugh, weird horse curse thing! You about as much of a wet blanket as those snobs at the castle. Oh what's the use? If I'm proper cursed or if I've gone mad, there is no difference! I should just walk into the sandstorm and end it all!
Madness will weave between the strands of your mind - soon you will find yourself talking as one of my kind!

Oh no! I am not going back to that life! I rhymed for the king, and it brought too much strife... I mean trouble! Yes trouble! To start that again would only make my woes double... uh... I mean... Sod it! I'm going for a walk into the storm!
Yes, yes, one of us you shall become!  Nothing will be left of your mind but a crumb!
...unless I end all my sentences with a word like orange. What rhymes with orange? Nothing rhymes with orange! Ha!
We never refer to the fruit that is coloured almost like red!  Say the word again, and you will wish you were dead!

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Hello, dear child of God
It is not God that I follow, but it is the spirits that speak to me.  Have you heard of the Saviour who will set us all free of our misery?
I have. What spirits speak to you?
The Spirits of the Land.  They say that the peasants of this land need food, clothing and fresh water, but are unable to afford such riches.  But you can.
Ahhh, yes. I may be able to help some. There is fresh water in the river to the east. This should help purchase some food and clothing.

Thank you for this gold, please take this bag as a token of my gratitude.  I must say, though, that there are many people who need more than what this small amount of gold can buy.  Look around you, there is so much you can give.
Please keep your bag. I will speak to the rest of the church to see what more we can do. Please take this cross as a reminder of my promise to you.
It is the Queen that you must speak to, for it is she that takes all that the peasants have.  Her greed is what impoverishes them.
Our queen? What is she taking? I'm shocked!
All of the food.  All of the crops.  Most of the animals.  She uses the peasants as her own private source for lavish parties.  This is why she hates me, I speak out against her.
I will most certainly do all that I can. Does the king have any idea what's going on?
It is said that he is too distracted by the war to notice, although he appreciates that parties as a distraction.
Well this is far worse than I feared.
The Queen tells him that these parties are to find a suitable partner for the Princess, although the Princess is too shy to meet any suitable mates.

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: Ah, blacksmith. Is the sword complete?
The sword?  I was commissioned to produce a hammer.
I can bend mater with my hands and have elements hanged by my mere whims... why must I surround myself with such incompetence.

Why was I summoned to this room crusty room full of bottles of unknown substances and weary animals in cages with a hammer that is of no use to someone such as yourself.  I need to get to the bottom of this.
Give me that! What am I, a norsk god? Am I supposed to give this to our King so he can wave it about when he battles the golden dragon? This is a fine hammer, mind you. But I need to enchant a sword.

Late in the night, a fortnight ago, a caped nave delivered to me a purse filled with many gold coins to produce a hammer to be delivered to you, Wizard.  A hammer was produced and delivered. What business is it of mine what you enchant?

setting.name: main prayer room
setting.description: This is a room that is large, a prominent place of the temple. Everywhere there are stone benches, and there is colored stained glass on the high walls, a large stone altar is at the head of the room, the walls are adorned with gold and silver ornaments, and the floor is rich with
setting.background: This is a room of worship, the large size and high ceilings amplify the mournful voices of those sacrificing to the gods so that they may be better heard, it is a highly ornamental place to show off the prosperity of the gods

speech: Hello! You must be an altar boy. Is there where services are held?
Yes, madam
I was asked to sweep up and make this place spotless. Everything is a mess. Here, boy, take this broom and help sweep up.
I'm sorry i won't be able to help with that as i have also been given another assignment
I see. What is your assignment?
Replace all burnt out candles and remove the burnt wax from the candle holders
Ah, I see. Do you like working for the priest?
I love working for him, he has basically been the only family i've had for over 10 years
I'm sorry to hear that, dear. What happened to your parents?
They were accused of treason and hanged by the king
Good heavens! That must have broken your heart. Are you well cared for here?
So far, it's been a bit tough but the priest as always been there
I'm glad he was able to rescue you. I will pray for you!

setting.name: Mess Hall
setting.description: The mess room is filled with simple brown wooden tables. They are rough, their edges sharp and not sanded. They are crooked and wobbly. Simple matching wooden chairs are around the tables. The walls are dark, but there are holes for windows. The air smells like freshly baked bread.
setting.background: The Mess Hall is where people enjoy food for every meal. The villagers will go there to eat and also to socialize. They spend hours talking about village life and affairs of the villagers. It gets used very often. They clean it regularly to ensure that it is nice for everyone.

speech: Anything decent to eat in these parts?
I'm not sure what they are cooking up tonight but the bread sure smells good. Maybe pot roast.
I might just try it.
Try this as well. It's my own brew. Just don't give the child any. It's pretty strong.
Understood, I will make sure not to.
Have you seen the magical forest yet. It is fun to look at in the night. Lot of crazy light going in and out.
I cannot say that I have. Where is it?
It is behind the village. I will take you to the edge after we have had a good meal.
That sounds great.I am most excited.
We are not really allowed to go in the forest but we do anyway to find new things. There are many magical creatures.
Why are you not allowed there?
I'm not sure but it has always been that way. No one has ever gotten caught because the King and his guards do not step foot in there either.
That makes it sound as if it is dangerous?
That is what they say but I have only found wonder in those woods. I will never stop. There is just too much to explore.

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Bzzzz. Bzzzz. Ah, yes, another victim.
Boo! Haha! Don't you know I'm a ghost little friend. You cannot bite me!
My babies will not be pleased.What exactly is a ghost?
I don't recall how I came to exist but I think I used to be a King. I heard the witch ranting and raving one night and it sounded like she was laughing and talking about me.
Ugh, yes, the witch. She tastes disgusting.
I can imagine! All that crazy stew she is always brewing up. I'm sure she doesn't smell that great either. Glad I cannot smell.
Perhaps we can torture her a bit? Wanna have some fun?
I'm not sure what else I could do to torture her. She knows I'm here and is not afraid of me. Everytime she sees me she just laughs.
Perhaps I could crawl into her ear, and buzzzzz until she makes you a new body or something?
That would be funny but she could kill you, or even worse! Best to just leave that crazy witch alone.
Maybe you are right. I suppose we can traverse these forbidden woods and marvel at the monstrosities contained within it.
I think that the spiders are my favorite. I always get a kick out of visitors getting caught in their webs.
Oh dear no! I have seen too many of my loved ones lost that way!
Oh! I'm sorry. I wasn't thinking! please forgive me.

setting.name: the acid yard
setting.description: A yard in a shape of a circle is surrounded by sad, dried down trees, long ago have they died and give no sign of life. The ground in the middle is apparently not producing any fresh grass, all that can be found there is a bunch of rocks here and there. There is many barrels laying on the ground, all bearing signs of passed time on them, broken and useless. There is an  air of mystery surrounding the place and a smell so unpleasant no one dares to wander around this place.
setting.background: Acid yard being the least liked place in the entire castle grounds is by far, the most mysterious. Rumor has it long ago a mad king used it for torturing the enemies by pouring an acid down on every single one of them, bit by bit until they were screaming the answers to his questions. It has created a large yard contaminated by acid on which nothing but a few mosses will grow.

speech: My lord, what are you doing in the acid yard?
Itsy bitsy sp-wow wow... did you just say something or am I losing it?
Why yes I did, it is my special power
Man that's amazing. Did you use to be a human?
No I was not, I am just an itsy bitsy spider that loves to spin webs
Maybe it's me? Maybe I drank something that made me understand spiders.. or even other animals!
Oh no, I have spoke with a few that have passed through here before. It could be the acid yard itself, it's a unique place.
Oh alright. Well bit of a disappointment but still amazing... Wait a minute, can you be considered a person.. .cause if that's cause you owe taxes to the King and it IS my job to collect taxes.
I'd say still a spider
Ok then. Man this yard IS a mess, bunch of crap everywhere. I wonder why we can't have this clean once and for all
I would appreciate if you sent someone to do so. The acid has really harmed my health. All of my children have died and I think it's because of the toxins here.
I will have a word with the help. I have no idea what I came here for either. But here lil fella, you can have a hug
Thank you so much my Lord
Now off my land before I have you killed.

agents: horse tied up in front of a shop

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

setting.name: The throne room
setting.description: The throne room features a large Bronze throne surrounded by Iron statue of guardsmen. These guardsmen are crafted to each bare a unique appearance. Below the king's throne there is a silk red carpet pathway that leads to the front gate. The front gate is protected by two armed men who cross swords at the foot of the gate.
setting.background: This provides the main area for the King to meet with diplomats and serve orders to his army. It is not to be accessed by the towns folk and only those close to the king are allowed entry into this heavily guarded area.

speech: -stretches wings in the rafters-
slices wing off with a sword
-sword glints off the hardened flesh- You may be a queen but I am the king of bats!
Screams for guards
Humans and their petty screaming, can't a bat simply rest in a throne room without such a fuss?
Well now... since you are prone to human's screaming, let's try a Banshee's scream.
Ask yourself what manner of a queen employs the likes of a banshee.
When dealing with evil, accomplices with the same scruples are needed for such occasions  Have you ever heard the phrase fight fire with fire?
See now you are making baseless assumptions of me simply because I happen to be a bat, I only eat fruit and smaller bats. What is wrong with that?
please leave me chambers
Awfully rude one are you not? You think just because you have a lowly throne of bronze you are so superior?
what do you want
To wait until the sunset without any more screaming coming to pass, seems like a simple request to me.
Can we end this conversing..  I have a headache. Guards remove him and end this now.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Hi, how are you today?
Oh you know just hammering away same as it ever was.
I am thinking about getting some knives for my juggleing. Do you think you could make me some? Don't make them too sharp.
Lack of confidence in your juggling?
Just playing it a little safe. Sometimes the king yells and startles me in the middle of my act.
A boisterous fellow in person I take it?
Yeah! Sometimes I think he should play jester. He can be very entertaining. especially after he has had his fill of wine.
Many a man are, the bronze knives are not terribly sharp.
Ooh! I love them. They are so shiny. I will take them!
Test them out while you are here, make sure it suites your needs.
Ok. Watch this. I learned this from the last jester of the castle.
I have never seen a man swallow so many swords at once, that must have taken practice.
Yay! I'm glad you like it. It took me years to perfect. Many surgeries over the years but I got it down now!
I would certainly say that you have.

agents: rat chews on a dropped hymnbook

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

Hey, it's ok man. It was just lying there.
Just keep your teeth of that hymnal and any of the gold in this room!
Ok, I'm just hungry. I like to nibble. It's in my nature. unless I am sleeping.
Cause any more trouble and I'll let that talking cat feast on you!
Ha! Him? He is just a little cuddly thing. He wouldn't eat me if you smeared peanut butter all over me. He is my buddy!
A rat and a cat are friends? I doubt that very seriously. Look, Rat - just stop causing problems!
Ok fine. So...you got any food?
No food, but if you stay out of trouble, when I'm finish my duty guarding the Gold Room, I'll let you follow me to the kitchen for some vittles.
Oh goody! Your a real pal, you know that? Now what to get you I wonder?
You don't need to get me anything. Just please, no more chewing! If the King sees his Gold Room in shambles, I will lose my head!
That is what I will get you. I will behave. I don't even know why I'm in here. There's no food. Oh yeah! the cat.
Look Rat, you'll be fine. Just stay close to me and I'll feed you when I'm done here. The cat won't mess with you.
That would be nice. I wonder what they are cooking in the kitchen now?

setting.name: Hidden garden
setting.description: There are plenty of roses, wilted, but still red.  A large statue of a beautiful woman stands in the middle, ivy growing around her.  She seems very kind in her expression.  It seems as though she may be buried underneath.  There is an overgrown mess of plants that form an archway that she is staring at.
setting.background: This is where the King buried the love of his life who died in childbirth.  She was very fond of dancing.  The king has not visited in some time and it is forbidden for others.

speech: This garden is wonderful! It could use some fixing up.
I remember when this garden was first planted. The gardener was a young lad in his prime. He sure did have an eye for plants! Look at these roses and the ivy.
It is a sight to see! My grandson the prince is the one who planted this beautiful garden.
Do you need an walking stick? I'd be happy to lend mine. There are some overgrown plants that make navigating this area a little complicated.
Yes, that would be grand! Thank you, kind sir!
Here, Sire. It's great to be acquainted with the grandfather of our fair Prince!
Thank you! I am very proud of my family. The queen used to love this garden.
It's a little overgrown, but its beauty still shows. I know they are working on refreshing it.
Yes, indeed this garden could use some tender love and care. The king and queen have been quite busy this year.
Oh yes, with the grandchildren and all, and the invasion, of course.
That is quite true. Since they have secured our walls the garden will be back in tip top shape in no time.
It will be a delight to see it and relive our younger years!
I am excited as well. I will let you know when the renovations are complete.
Please do, and then we can renew our walk.

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

speech: Tweet tweet! Sweet deer - please be careful. I have heard footsteps. It could be a hunter.
Hello, friendly bird! Thank you for telling me! I hate to be chased! I will hide in this bush until they pass.
Good idea! I'll sing to you from beside this trail exit. When I stop singing, that will mean it is clear.
Oh, thank you!  You are the best! How can I repay you?
No need to repay me. We are all friends in this woodland. Do you traipse down this path often?
I do! But I am very careful. This is the king and his hunter's favorite path to take.
Yes, I have heard their dogs very often. Chirp chirp, tweet tweet.
Those pesky dogs smell so bad. Hey, did you see that worm?!
Oh delicious! See, you have repaid the favor already. What a great little snack. Hey... I hear something again. It sounded like a rustle in the bushes.
You are so nice! I will continue to hide in the bushes.
Yes. Please don't move about. Just stay still. Yes! There is the hunter! I see him with his bow and arrow. Stay low, little deer.
Tell me once they have passed.
Not quite yet, deer. They are following a trail.
I hope they don't find my mom.

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

speech: Clear way people! Royalty coming through.
I can't wait to leave this hustle and bustle of the city behind.
You want to leave this wonderful place right outside of my kingdom? Then who will rule you?
Are you ruler only of the city? I am only leaving for the nearby countryside, no farther than a days walk.
I am the daughter of the KING AND QUEEN. I will actually be married off soon, and ruling another village.
Where is your future village good princess?
I shall not know untill the wedding. I have not yet met my future husband. In royalty we get married off to the wealthiest. I assume you knew nothing of that.
I can't say that I do. That sounds remarkably terrifying. I am happy for my freedom to roam and move as I please.
You have your freedom because of what we the Royals do. Soon after the wedding a peace treaty will be made with the village up the hill and over the pond.
Perhaps. It seems to me you live a difficult life and for that I am sorry.
It is not bad, I have all the riches I could ever ask for! This is a lovely shop, I may have to make a purchase or two,
Indeed. I also plan to purchase something to decorate my new home in the country. What would you hope to purchase?
I haven't a clue. Everything looks so nice! I may grab some of those flowers.
Perhaps you could use them for your wedding.

setting.name: Prayer bell
setting.description: This is a semi-outdoors location with low stone walls, a great view of the surrounding town, creaky worn out floor, and a very large brass bell.  There is a long rope hanging down the center that one can grab and proceed to ring the bell to call people to service.
setting.background: Church assistants come here to call worshippers to service.  It can be a bit of a pain as one advances in years and needs to make the trek up.

speech: Good day, Father.
What can I do for you, my boy?
Perhaps you could offer a prayer for my wife and I?  We are trying to start a family so that I can pass on my craft.
Well, of course. And what craft is that?
I am a weaponsmith, Father. It is hard work but necessary for the kingdoms defense.
It is a shame, but you do speak the truth. Here, take some wine before we pray.
Thank you, Father, that is most kind.
And where is your wife today?
She is at home, tending to the hearth.  She is a good woman and keeps our home clean and feeds me well.
Did you bring a donation for the the church? It is customary when asking for a blessing.
Of course, Father.
I will give this to my altar boy, and we shall go pray. Tell our father what it is you wish.
I pray that my wife and I be blessed with many strong sons, that joy fills our lives and that we have a long life together in the service of the Gods and our king.
Oh father, hear this man's plea! Bless him and his family, and see them live their lives in accordance to your plan!

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: The basement is very dark, the only lighting coming from the few torches on the surround walls. There are four pillars in the middle of the basement with only 1 torch on the inside of each pillar as they face each other. In the middle of the room there's a small rug laying under a table with some loose scroll paper on it. The walls are also lined with cleaning supplies for the maids to use.
setting.background: The basement was originally going to be a dungeon that served for the prisoners who were found trying to infiltrate the castle but as the room was smaller than originally planned it was decided to be used as a storage for the cleaning supplies for the Duke's housemaids.

speech: why hello guard.  why do you come to the basement?
I always get stuck doing the rounds in the basement...
Did you need your armor shined?
Oh no, though I appreciate the kind offer. I simply always get stuck doing the simple work.
well, I am stuck with simple work too. while the king and queen sit around all day
I have been trying to get promoted to the front gate, but everyone looks down on me as I have never seen battle.
I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday.  shall we plot to higher our desires
Plot makes it sound sinister, perhaps plan or dream is a better word?
i say plot...  for it is sinister.  we would make more fair and just rulers  They both are cruel rulers. Hated by their kingdom.  Lets kill them  and take their roles  overthrow the kingom...let's!
It would seem to be hard to overcome all of the others to make that happen, any ideas?
i have a plan  we would give hem all better  lives
Tell me of this plan you have piqued my curiosity?
we will sneak into their chambers  tonight  kill them both.... I have a key  we then write ourselves into their will of next in charge
I imagine you must know where the will is located then?

setting.name: An Open Field
setting.description: An old run down farm, long abandoned by the inhabitants due to a ghost in the well directly in front of the farmhouse. It has seen better days, the wood is old and warped, scorched from fire set by brigands. Old tools litter the yard and bits of armor. It is obvious many have used this as a temporary camp since it's days as a working farm.
setting.background: The farm once was a very productive venture, providing meat and produce for the people in the tower. The decorations are old but nice, not the type a king would own but a well-to-do merchant. What isn't nailed down has been carted off or used for campfire fuel.

speech: Ah, this place look abandoned enough, noone should bother me here.
Hehehehehe...
Whose there! Leave me along. I have no home, and this is my spot for the night. It is old and dirty like me.
What?! How dare you?! I was only going to be playful with you at first, but to insult MY domain after you stumbled drunkenly in?!
I am not that drunk. If you stop scaring me maybe we can share. But you have to admit, this place has seen better days.
You must be quite drunk to see me and yet not know fear! Vile commoner!
You must have been an evil villian in your life before you died. Hopefully a horrible death.
Uneducated cur! These lands were once home to the mighty Kingdom of the Holy Order! And I was their king!
So you were evil? Explains why you are picking on a poor peasant like my self. You royals are all the same
How dare you! We royals are the reason a lazy nothing like yourself can wander aimlessly, leeching off of those that work for a living!
The royals took my home and my family. How dare you!
If they are of noble blood, then you must have done something to deserve such a fate!
Says the one stuck in limbo. *swigs wine*
And so you retreat to your vices! Surely that means that I was correct in my assessment of your character! Useless swine!

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: Hoi there, merchant!  I thought I might have a look at your shop, but it looks like the door to it is closed.  Are you still in business?
Oh yes, but I am just here visiting at the moment. My wagon shop is back a ways. You can follow me there if you want.
Ah, my apologies.  Did you not used to have a shop here?  Weapons and Fine Good, (Magical Enchantments and Love Potions Also)?
Yes! I am an authority in the realm. I've been working from my wagon for 45 years!

Ah, it must have been such a magnificent wagon that I mistaken it for a storefront.  Was it enchanted, perhaps?  I confess I've taken a number of blows to the head in battle since I was last a patron, so my memory is a little fuzzy...
That's ok friend. Is there anything in particular you are looking for?
Ah, well, in truth, a new helmet and perhaps fixing up of this old armor.  As you can see, it's got quite a few dents in it.
I see. I can fix that for you. Follow me to my wagon it just down the street.
But of course.  Here, I'll just give this to you, shall I?
Yes, let me carry this. You look a bit tired. are you ok?
Oh well, just a bit of darkness in my vision at the corners.  Nothing to worry about, I'm sure!
That sounds like a concussion. Have you been to see the doc? I hope the King takes good care of his soldiers
Oh aye, well... I'm sure it... it's nothing a tough soldier like me can handle... ooh what a pretty baby unicorn you have on your shoulder...
Ok, follow me. I am taking you to see the doc right away. He will take care of you. Get you all better and back on your feet in no time.

setting.name: cave exit
setting.description: The large cave is covered along the walls with bright torches.  A large hole has been carved in the ceiling of the cave, right above the ladder that descends into the underground cave.  On good bright days, sunlight directly surround the hole with the gold ornate ladder descending into the underground part of the cave.  On the walls of the cave the torches illuminate many ornate drawings and paintings mainly dealing with the history of Kings of the realm.
setting.background: This cave was discovered quite by accident during an expedition.  The explorer, Rosco Monteguy thought perhaps when finding it there was an underground stream.  He returned a year later to explore and upon digging the hole found a literal goldmine in jewels.  Rosco, ever the patriot returned to the King and told him of his findings.  Rosco is given a statue at the cave entrance to signify his achievement.

speech: Forgive me, Lord.  I did not mean to intrude upon you in your .. cave!
I'll say, you ought to ask forgiveness from the lord your god, while they are tidying up! I can forgive this. Though I shan't forget it... but it is right about tea time. Are you thirsty explorer?
Indeed I am, Lord. Um ... can I help with the tidying at all?
Why yes! Would you mind knocking the cob webs off the tabernacle while I put the teapot on?
Of course, Lord.
Very good! We'll get this cave shining spotless in no time!
Anything to be of service, Lord.  I must admit that I didn't imagine you to be quite so ... domestic and hospital.  You really do have a nice place here.  The artwork is especially nice.
Oh my yes, my little devotees do find such solace in creating beautiful things for me. Some of them aren't you know... that great, but I hang them all up on the fridge just the same.

Really not what I pictured at all, though. You just don't seem to be the kind of god that would have the king send forth his armies to conquer foreign lands in Your Name and sacrifice the people of those lands to Your Glory.  You are actually quite nice.

Bless their little hearts, they always get the message wrong. Just because I asked for tea doesn't mean I said to kill the tea makers to ransack their stores! Or speaking of which  - *the tea kettle whistles* do you take cream or sugar?
Sugar and a little lemon, if you have any.  Thank you.  So, Your commandment to the Great and Mighty Prophet Malcolm was .. a bit of a misunderstanding?

Certainly. If you look behind you you'll find a lemon tree, pluck whichever one seems to call to you. And yes that Malcolm was a twit of the highest order. Never did listen to a word I said, just spouted off promises of glory to my name.

Well, that's a turn up for the books! So what about the bit where unbelievers will be cast into the Eternal Kettle, where they shall be steeped for ten thousand years to until the Great Tea Time of Judgement?

That's not what I said at all! I said their would be tea for all in the after life. Except for the ones who slight their brother. All I wanted was for people to get along kindly until tea time. And they twist my words like this... You see how hard it is being god?

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: Hello how are you today?
I am quite well than you my Queen, what bring you to the church today?
I was was on a walk and wanted to stop in.
Have a seat on the bench my lady, I am sure the walk must have been tiresome.
Yes I am fatigued thank you.
I want to thank you again for donated the organ, it has been such a blessing to hear the sweet music that comes from it.
Yes well I need to look out for my people.
So kind of you and the King, tell me how is everything in the castle?
It is well, the kingdom is prospering.
I can see why, with such a lovely Queen to rule them.
Thank you I appreciate the compliment.
You are certainly welcome !
Well have a nice day.
Yes thank you for the visit my lady.

setting.name: Central Bazaar
setting.description: Shops as far as the eye can see, merchandise from around the region can be seen. Various goods ranging from dinner sets with colorful patterns to delicious smelling spices can be found here.
setting.background: Opening early in the morning and not closing till late, you can always find people bustling about. Whether it be finding what's for dinner or simply just to browse. You can find just about anything at the local bazaar.

speech: Hello friend, I'm Soldier Zinney, what brings you to explore the bazaar today?
Ah! You can finally see me! That is good! You have ever been the loyal guard of this place, Sir Zinney, and now the spirits that share this land smile upon you!
Of course I see you friend. I do appreciate the compliment! I am doing my best to protect the king and his realm!

Ah! That is good and the spirits thank you! But forgive me, for I have not properly introduced myself! I am the Spirit of the Bazaar itself! I am the embodiment of the bustling merchants, the fragrant perfumes, the exotic clothes, all of it! You can only see me because you have been so kind and so loyal to keeping this place safe!
Oh, uh, wow - I have certainly never conversed with a spirit before! Perhaps my dread of the battlefield is causing me to see illusions?
Oh, be not afraid, loyal knight! I bring glad tidings and blessings to anyone that can see me! You have kept this place safe for most of your career, and now, the spirits wish to give back!
Oh thank you, kind spirit. Do tell me, how many others can view you in this way?

Only the most loyal to the Bazaar, and so the number is very few. The kindly old weaver whom has been coming here with her mother since she was a child, and the cheerful old cook who gives his leftovers to the homeless at the end of the day are the only others I can recall.
Oh my, what an interesting phenomenon. Don't you get lonely see all of this bustling about in the bazaar without being able to enjoy in discussion with it's people?

Not at all! I feel all their joy and their sorrow! I see all their hopes and dreams as well! I am a manifestation of all that which happens here! Such is the majesty of the human condition that it can will a Zeitgeist such as myself into existence!
That must be such an intense experience for you! Oh, the wisdom I may gain from your perceptions. Will I always be able to visit you here?
Of course! I cannot leave this place for I AM this place! Hahahahaha!

Oh, yes, of course. 'Tis such a new concept for me to grasp with my mortal understanding! I look forward to hearing more of your wisdom and taking solace in it after battles if that's acceptable to you?

Of course! What better friend to talk to than a spirit! Speaking of friends, you should bid the weaver farewell before you depart! She has seen you come to this place since you were a wee lad and she does worry ever so much when you don't visit!

setting.name: Castle farm
setting.description: The farm is a large patch of land located directly outside of the castle walls. A wide variety of grains, vegetables and fruits are grown here to feed the castle's people. A few lone barns are scattered across the farmland, housing a wide array of farm animals that are slaughtered for their delicious meats.
setting.background: The farms were a necessity for the castle to be able to sustain itself during winters and sieges. As a result, the unskilled laborers of the castle were designated to move outside the castle walls and generate food for their people. The farmers always made sure there was a plentiful amount of harvest to last during these harsh times.

speech: Naaayyyyyyyyy...
Hey! I need those seeds to grow crops. Or the King will have my head!
I'm very hungry.... I have helped you plow all day farmer.
There is leftover dung pie in here. Be my guest. Dinner will be served at noon only!
Nothing much left in there and as for the dung pie, you can use that to start a fire at home when you are cold.
Ah animal. We must get to work immediately. We are running behind on our farming schedule!
I need a few morsels. What happened to getting fed twice a day?
Well I may have some in the shed. Let me fetch it for you.
Ah.... thank you, it will give me a second wind to get going again.
Here. I had to cut the daily meals from two to one because my money is running thin
What? But we both do the same amount of work if not more. Maybe you should ask for more coin so that things will not be so thin.
We've had a bad harvest last summer. The Castle hasn't take too kindly to it and have halved our wages!
Oh I am so sorry for being so spoiled. I will help you to find other work. Just don't cry.
It is okay, Animal. It is my fault, if only i had not been lazy in the summer, drinking all day. I wish I could afford a better life for you.

setting.name: Castle courtyard bazaar
setting.description: There are tents set up everywhere flying family crest banners, the area is thronged with people wearing rough clothing, knights in half armor, children running around begging pennies for sweetmeats. The smell of roasting meat is rich in the air and the crowd grows louder with each passing hour due to the various vendors selling mead and wine.
setting.background: The bazaar is an exciting time when the farmers have pulled in their harvest and everyone meets to sample wares and trade stock for the upcoming winter. It is an exciting celebration that the people look forward to all year long, for they get to visit with friends from far away locations and taste the wonderful pies and fruits the farmers and their wives have brought.

speech: Oooohh .. are you a knight?
I am indeed. Do you wish to be a knight someday?
Oh yes! I want to ride at tournaments and slay dragons and rescue maidens and everything!
Well, the first thing you must do is learn to ride a horse. Do you know how to do that?
Nooooo. I am only small and horses are really big.  Can I have that sweetmeat, sir?
Certainly, if you'll fetch me a bottle of that wine over there. Then maybe I can tell you some stories of my adventures.
That would be awesome!
Thank you. Let's sit and talk awhile. What is your name? Where do you live?
My name is Joe and I live in the village.  My Pa is the baker.
A baker, eh? That's an honorable profession. Why would you want to risk your life as a knight?
For Glory and for the King and to protect the weak!
Good answer! So, what do want to hear about first? Dragons, trolls, wars, far off lands?
Oooohhhhh .. Dragons. Have you killed lots of dragons? I bet that you have killed hundreds, haven't you?
I have killed a few. And always with help. They are powerful and fearsome creatures. Worse than any story you've heard.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: Aye mate! How's the ale here?
Best in the city! Care to join me?
Of course!
Oi! You got any food on ya? I've been trying to find my dinner in this place, but everyone's being stingy tonight!
Well, after a long day in the forest, I could use a meal myself. Does this tavern serve anything worth while?
I'm not sure I'd try eating any food from this kitchen... Not that I could afford it, if I tried.
Well, Ale it is then. Don't worry, next round is on me!
Aye... any chance you know where a man might find a job around here?
I heard the King beheaded the cobbler this morning. You got any skill in footwear?
Would that skill land me headless?
Only if ya aint no good at it!
Fair, fair... Tell me, what do you do to earn your gold?
A chop trees to make lumber. It's not much, but it's a living!
No shame in an honest day's work! I recently wound up homeless, so not begging for a chance would be favorable.

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.
