setting.name: Inside a desolate cave
setting.description: The dungeon exists inside a dark cave. Enchanted torches light the cave up and lead the way to this ancient dungeon. Creatures can be seen populating the dungeon, but it is unknown if they are malevolent or benign.
setting.background: The dungeon is believed to have been created by ancient nobility with the aid of wizards. The dungeon was likely a prison for powerful enemies of the kingdom who may break free of traditional prison captivity by force or magical abilities.

speech: Delicious foods!  Crumbly foods!  Moldy foods!  Yum!
Yes, yes... So much food. Are you not bored of this cave, cockroach? I am growing tired of this place.
Travel yes!  Travel to Food!  This shiny help?
What?! What is this? Where did you get this?! It's so.. beautiful!
Found in old place.  Many bones.  Other shinies.  This one shiniest.
How do you think such a beautiful treasure got lost in such a dismal place?
Sometimes see things in shiny.  Some things dark.  Some things light.  Some happy things.  Some scary things.
Can you describe the body you pulled this off of?
Shiny thing on head, with smaller coloured shinies on it.  Also shiny on chain around neck.  Place very cold.
... Was it off a crown, cockroach? Did you find the remains of a king? This is marvelous!
Crown!  That's the word for shiny with shinies!  This shiny come from neck shiny.

Cockroach, listen. Now this is very important. This could be a very special shiny, yes? This could be a powerful and magical shiny, do you understand? Describe the neck shiny to me as best as you can. If it's what I think it is...
Shiny red!  With gold shiny all around!  Scritches on shiny, dark marks.  Like claw.  Cold to touch, feel sleepy.
Oh my... Oh my, oh my... This is the Lost Stone! This is the most powerful stone in creation! Luck be a lady, cockroach! We will be kings!

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Whaaaat?  I've been turned into a roach!
Lord, a talking roach? You say this is not your natural state? Who then am I addressing? My duty is to the royal family, but surely a knight cannot refuse aid to someone in need.
I am the King, and don't know how I got here, or how I have been brought so low
We need to seek advice in this matter. Allow me to suit up Sire and we will find the solution with haste.
Well, be quick about it.  What is your name?

Percival, your Highness. I have much courage and will do all I can to resolve this matter quickly and perserve your status and image. Who in your court has knowledge in the mystic arts that you can trust seeing you in this state?
His name is Han...  Hon... Oh, no, my memory seems to be effected!

Hans may be the name you seek Sire. My third cousin and your spymaster. I had heard he left for addtional training last year at your request, but it was all very hushed. He has been trustworthy in my experience. This magical Assault may effect your memory, I will do my upmost to fill in knowledge gaps for you until we get this resolved. Would you allow me to carry you Sire? I fear the streets may be dangerous in your current state.
No, I'll ride on your shoulder.  How far is it?

Across the court yard and through the throne room. From there we head to the top of the northern spire. No one should bother one of your knights, as long as i make it clear through my body language that I am on important business. The trip should not be overlong, unless the perpetrator is still in the castle making a mess with dark magics. I am ready to move on your word Sire.
Thanks for the intel on your kingdom!  This was easier than I thought.  *runs away*
You will not get away, Vile deceiver! On my honor, you will fail this day!
Only if you can catch me: I fit in much smaller spaces than you!
Fool, you have already been caught! I will crush you, much less risk of missing that way.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: people say I'm strong but I've never killed anything before
Well you better help kill this rat or it will kill your business....
I am only a blacksmiths assistant.
Why do you think I have you assist me, sometimes you are useless as my assistant.
Fine I will hit this rat then, but I don't like it.
Make it quick we are wasting time and losing what little money the king pays us.
I don't want to go on this wolf hunt, but everyone pressured me.
What wolf hunt? who pressured you? Have you lost your mind? We are in the bazaar, wake up man!
It has me really worried, they want me to go on a wolf hunt. I don't know that I won't run away when the wolves charge us.
You sure are preoccupied today. Why are you so worried? And hand me that gold bar from the table while we talk.
This one?
yes, that one, the only one....
There are others in the world.
Well it's the only one on the table, isn't it?
action: put gold bar in a scale

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

speech: Ugh, that new wife, Morticia, is too messy!  I shall have to flog her for her lazy ways.
She'll catch on sweetie. Just give her time. I remeber you when you first arrived. You didn't know what to do with yourself you were so nervous.
Well, I at least knew not to leave patches of canvas around.  I just wish the King was a little more particular about his harem.
I see this need to be patched before this evening. maybe I will talk to her and have her fix it.
Here, you can give her this as well.  She should learn that just because she is the fresh faced, new wife, that does not mean it shields her from carrying out her duties.
Yes, I will give it to her. I will spend some time with her and give her a good talking to. I'm sure she will fall in line.

I apologize, I don't mean to be terse with you.  It's just with the upcoming war and the ambassadors that keep scurrying back and forth to try and prevent it, my sleep has worn a bit thin.  I'm a little testier than I ought to be.
Why don't you make yourself something to eat and have a nap. Me and the girl can take care of things today. I think it will be good for you both.
Oh, goodness, I don't know... there's so much still to do and the day is still young...
I'm very confident everything will be fine. You look peaked honey. Have some soup.
Mmm, it smells delicious!  Is this a new recipe of yours, grandmother?
I thought I would try a new grain. It's from a far away land. It is supposed to be very good for you.
Well, goodness knows we all could use something to stay healthier.  I think the second wife has made at least three batches of sweets!
Oh yes! I have tried them all and they are addictive! We all better watch out around her sweets or we may all end up bed bound.
action: give A basket of grain to chief wife
give a large ladle to chief wife

setting.name: Bathroom
setting.description: Small and cozy, but dripping with luxurious linens and speckled with ornate fixtures this bathroom is a paradise. The small room is non-traditional in the sense that there is no toilet or sink, only a relatively enormous claw foot tub. The feet are gilded and the tub itself is pristine and white. The wallpaper is floral and warm, the rugs lush, and the mirror flattering.
setting.background: The bathroom oasis is the best kept secret in the tower. There are regular restrooms, but this special tub-room is only for those who stumble upon it. Down a rarely used hallway many must assume its storage closet or something as equally mundane.

speech: Hello, handmaid! How do you like it in the castle?
I am so happy to be here your majesty. Thank you for choosing me.
I would like to know if there are any servants that are unhappy. The King and I try to treat you all with dignity.
Oh, I have no doubt that everyone here is very happy. You both treat us very well. I will ask around if you wish.
I would like that very much! Any big plans for the spring ball?
Just finishing up this bathroom. Is that an invitation your majesty? I would love to join in the festivities.
Yes it is. All the servants are allowed to partake in the festivities but bring a date!
Oh a date! I don't know of anyone to bring! Do you have any suggestions?
Well I've been watching one of the kitchen servants eyeing you. He's kinda cute too.
Really? I have seen him and he is very adorable. I wish he would ask me.
Maybe he's a little shy?
Well, it's a good thing I'm not then!
I guess it is! The ball is going to be amazing
I'm all done here. I guess I better get ready if that is all you need.

setting.name: Kings chambers
setting.description: The large four poster bed is adorned with the finest linens that Europe has to offer.  Gold is liberally woven through the fabric of the duvet and the tassels that drape to the floor on each corner of the duvet.  A gauzy purple fabric hanging from the bed posts sets an opaque tone to the room.  One window is shuttered by large wooden planks that can be thrown open to allow the mid day light to illuminate the room.  A large chest of drawers holds a small portion of the King's clothing.
setting.background: This room was designed by a team of the finest decorators in the kingdom, but it has been nicknamed the bloodbath, because the king put to death 3 designers for "not meeting the standard set forth".  The fourth designer, a young upstart, is now the most famous in the land because of his work on this one room.  The king feels most powerful when he is in this room.

speech: You called for me your highness?
Yes. Have you heard any news of the King?
I only have this book that was sent by a messenger.  It speaks of his travels and doesn't seem to be out of the ordinary.
Oh thank you. It is worrisome. He is usually in contact more often on his travels.
It is my pleasure to serve your Royal Highness.
Now onto other matters. I hear there is famine in the country side.
Oh...I wouldn't worry too much about the farmers your highness...they may grumble but they live quite well.
Show me the numbers.
As you wish your highness but it will take me a couple of days to...well...get you those numbers.
Why don't you have the numbers now?
I will have to make an appointment with the accountant your highness.
I'm sorry advisor. I am just stressed. Father told me to fill his place while he's gone. He is trying to prepare me.
And you are doing a fine job your highness...everyone is happy and well fed...what more could we ask for?
I guess nothing. Have you heard anything about our enemy the Tahsiva?
action: give book to a royal prince

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: How are you my queen?
Oh, my friend... I have much weight upon me. I will confide in you, but you must swear to secrecy.
What is it?
You must swear...
I swear.
I have heard word from a scout that the Human King means to clear out our bat room... He wants to use it as a second dressing room for his wife. I am lost as to a solution.
Certainly there must be something we can do.
I have been racking my brain, but I cannot think of one...
Are our numbers not enough to fend them off?
No... I have thought of a solution, perhaps, but... It may be deadly for us. It may be successful at the same time.
What have you been pondering? Poison perhaps?
Essentially. If we were to find a rabid dog and drink of its blood, the humans may fear becoming rabid themselves, and abandon the whole affair. What do you think?
Well it could work, I do certainly see the reason for your concern though. Such a disease could as easily spread its way through our ranks.
Many would be sick... Is it worth keeping our home?

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The castle kitchen is gigantic! There are racks and racks filled with ingredients for enough food to feed the castle every day. Ten long wooden tables take up much of the room. Along the wall are cooking instruments of every type as well as huge ovens to cook the food.
setting.background: The kitchen castle is bustling every day. The cooks feed hundreds of people every single day! There is happy chatter from the men and women working. It is very hot in there with all the ovens!

speech: Hello there! I've brought cabbages for the king's feast. Where should I put them?
I'm not the man to ask, I'm afraid. My presence in these kitchens are a personal cisit.
I suppose I'll leave them here in the corner then...
I'm sure the cook will appreciate it. Have you been invited to the feast?
Ha! I'm nobody important. Usually the princess gives the left overs to us smallfolk though. Are you here for the feast?
Not originally, though the king's seen fit to invite me now. I came to ask him for aid with a situation within my home city .
Well, 'tis an honor to speak before the king! Where are you from?
Have you heard of a Lord Timwell?
The name may ring a bell? I mean no offense to your lord, I'm just a poor farmer. Farthest I've ever been from home is the market in Westcaster

Ah. I'm surprised you've not heard more about him - he's a right tyrant. There's been a food shortage in Timwell, and the Lord refuses to aid. I came in hopes the king's advice would direct us towards a solution. But, alas...
Well, I'm sorry to hear it. The king's a good man, can even be right jolly after a mug or two of spiced mead from how I hear it. I hope he can help.
I'm hoping to speak with him at the feast. The mead may soften him enough to send provisions to Timwell. They could not come soon enough; my own wife is with child.
Ha, children are a blessing. Got three little ones waiting for me to return from the castle
A blessing indeed. This will be my second, though now my only. We lost our daughter to the last winter we saw

setting.name: waterfall
setting.description: Near the top of the mountain is a beautiful waterfall. It falls down many many feet to a beautiful lake. It is very loud and very majestic. It sparkles in the sun.
setting.background: The waterfall is a place of lore for the people. They conduct important ceremonies near it. The king says it is the only thing as powerful as he. They take the water and consider it sacred.

speech: Oh dear person. I am here for you. What is wrong?
My prayers have finally been answered!  What a joyous day!
I am here. God is busy with other matters, but I am his second.
Well - I'm in a bit of a pickle, I'm seeing three different women at the same time, and I suspect they've found out about one another.
Well, that is quite a pickle. Is there a fourth you can be with and just leave those three behind?
Unfortunately not, there are only three women left in my village ever since the king passed by.  Thankfully none of them are my cousins.
Maybe you can visit another village?
Naw, that seems like too much trouble.  How would you handle this situation in heaven?
We don't have sexual relations in heaven.
Hold up.  Say whaaaaaat?  That can't be right.
We don't feel the need. Now back to your issue. Do you prefer lady over the others?
No, no - I'm having a crisis of faith now Angel!  I'm seriously considering switching pantheons right now.
But why!
Well, what other things don't they have in heaven?  Can you drink?  Smoke?  Stage dog fights in back alleys?  These are important questions!

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: My father, the King really knows how to throw a party, doesn't he?
He sure does. I wonder who this is for. I hope she is my future wife.
You should be looking for that future wife not at some ridiculous gown....you could do well by marrying one of the noble's younger daughters..
Your right. If I wasn't busy working tonight I would ask one to this party in a fine suit. Maybe you can get one to stand by me so I can have a little chat.
Something about the glow of a thousand candles makes them all look...delicious....
Do you think my sword is shiny enough. The general made us polish them for the party. I hope the girls notice.
You look exceptional, as do all my guards. So which young lady do like?
That one in the blue dress and the dark feather in her hair. She is stunning.
The one holding the chalice, yes indeed, she is. But hands and eyes off!! She's the princess Azure, and she will be mine.
I was just pulling your chain. Everyone knows you are to marry. Ha!
Good one, good one....So then... your choice...and remember your place, you are a palace guard, but you are not heir to the throne as I am...Perhaps the one below the colorful painting?
Hmm...I have seen her looking over here. Perhaps she likes what she sees or maybe she is looking at you. Yes, I would like to talk to this one.
It's you, I assure you. Before you arrived tonight, she was aking about you....
That's nice of you to say but I think you are getting me back for the joke I made at your expense.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Priest, I beg you, I tell you I am dying of hunger. I am just a poor man. The blacksmith has denied me food. The owner of the farm near by has denied me. The out house denies me use of the restroom unless I make a purchase. You know how it is. Please give me food!
Here, child, please drink this wine. Come with me to the temple, and I will share some food with you.

Wine? I'm almost offended! Just because I'm begging doesn't mean I'm an alcoholic. Whatever, I'll come with you if there's food! Can we take the scenic route so we can avoid the king's men? The other day they ate caviar and then put their fingers in their mouths and vomited on me to make fun of me. Weird, huh?

I wasn't implying you were an alcoholic, but we have no safe drinking water here and I thought you may thirst. Here is some stew. Where are you from, child? How did you come in contact with the King's men?

I was born in the poor part of town. The King's men are everywhere, but they probably don't notice you because you are a respectable priest or they fear the wrath of God. I'm just a poor man so they can take out all their frustrations on me. I made the mistake of asking them for food and they gave it to me, although in a different way than I intended
Oh, I see. It was very cruel of them to taunt you by vomiting on you. I've never seen you in our small town before. Who is your family?

Do you see my ceremonial hat? It tells the story of my family. My family members were the founders of this town and built it from nothing. Now that we are no longer useful, we were left to starve. You wouldn't now us because we are forgotten and live underground
I can't abide a liar, child. What is this tall tale you speak of? Why would you no longer be useful?

How dare you call me a liar! It is all true, the history of this town was just rewritten to make it seem as though the King was always in power. If you need proof, our family left its mark on every building we built. Look at the mural in the public bath! The inscriptions on the side of the fountain. Our symbol is there.
How dare you attack a holy man! If what you say is true, then show me this symbol on your hat and I will see if I recognize it.

Now you know the truth and it is your duty to spread it. We were the rulers and builders, and we were too generous. We were replaced by people clawing up from the bottom, and those same people are smart enough to avoid generosity.

I see that you are truthful because I recognize the symbols on your hat. I will talk to the citizens of the town and encourage them to be generous. There must be a peaceful way to move forward from this.
Thank you for believing in me. With a priest on the side of the poor, I am confident our world can change.
Do you need a place to stay?
action: give Wine to poorer citizens of the empire
hug poorer citizens of the empire

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: Though him with him in in, in the unity of the holy spirit . . . .
OooooOOOoooo... Is it a spirit you seek?
Well yes, but I was hoping for one of a slightly holier nature.
I was an anointed King. It doesn't get holier than that on this earth.
You will need this too then if you are to get into heaven.
Oh, no, I'm quite content here in these halls I once ruled.
Well, I suppose if you were ever going to get into heaven it would have happened by now.
It's much more fun to mess with people here, like this priest.
Amazing how the ethereal can strike the corporeal with such striking force, and yet pass through with causing any effect aside from a slight chill in the air!  Quite extra ordinary.
Ah, I see you are a philosopher as well as a worshiper. What brings you here tonight?
I only desire to honour the Lord our God with the utmost of my being.
Come now, you're in the royal sanctuary, while a true pilgrim would seek "God" in more humble surroundings. Have you no aspirations towards power?
What greater power is there than the glory of the lord?
Controlling the fortunes of an entire kingdom of men... Or at least that always gave me a rush.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Guard, what is your name?
Smithie, g-good princess.  Oh, I hope I ain't done nothin' wrong, Princess.  The king sent me ta follow you, I'm j-just doin' me duty!
What do you know of the Viscount that my father has visiting.

He takes a lot of naps, Princess, 'e does.  Don't think I've seen 'im take his meal past the four o'clock hour.  Peaceable like, but that's mostly on account of his age than his temperament, princess miss.
I just hope my father doesn't make me wed him.  Have you heard anything?
Hm, I was guardin' the privvy chamber just the other day, and he did mention it briefly ta himself.  I don't think 'is Lordship's mind is quite made up by the sound of it though.
I wish I could just stay here, in the kingdom.  I'm pretty good at handling the affairs of this keep.
Well if yer lookin' fer some advice, and don't mind takin' it from a lowly guard...
You may speak your mind

I know you've a fair hand with yer flute, Princess.  The Vicount do like his sleeps.  I bet if you carried on with yer flute when he's nappin' right out his window, nice and shrill and loud like ye didn't know how ta play it, I'm bettin' he'd clear off right quick, he would.  'e seems ta prize his sleep above all else.
What a great idea!  Now, which window is his?
Ah, yes, I'd be please ta escort ye, and I'll give him a mighty fierce glare, I will, if 'e dare try and tell Her Princessness where she can be practicin' and fer how long.
Lead the way.  I know just the tune to play!
Yes, Princess.  And, if it's not too bold ta say, I think ye'll make a mighty fine Queen one day!

setting.name: The Queen's Chamber
setting.description: This is a beautiful room inside of the palace that is decorated with the finest silk and velvet. The color scheme used represents royalty, royal blue, red, green and purple. The walls are covered in gold and in each corner of the room are golden statues of Greek art. The floors are covered in marble, and despite the patterns, shine so brightly you can even see your own reflection in them! There's also a bed big enough to fit five people on!
setting.background: This room inside the palace is the Queen's bed chambers. In this very room lived the previous queens of other eras and where the future heir to the throne was born. It's said in these chambers the Queen performs rituals unknown to anyone outside of the palace to keep her young and immortal. Only royalty and royal servants know the secrets of this place.

speech: What will you do when you rule this kingdom one day?
Oh mother, I don't want to think of those times! I will be distraught when you are gone.
I like to discuss this with you to see where your head lies.
I will rule like you do. Fair, but tough. Strong, but gentle. I will make sure the peasants have bread to eat and cider to drink. They will be as happy as peasants can be.
You, my son, know how to treat the people. But you must also be strong in your beliefs to fight for this kingdom.
Are you going to have the head knight teach me to fight, so that I may show the world how strong my beliefs are?

Yes! You must begin taking defense lessons. You main subjects will now turn into ruling subjects. You will learn from the best kings and queens on how to be the best ruler of this kingdom. You will go and learn and converse with the people.
Mother, what is more important? Fighting with swords, or soothing with words? Must I learn both?
You must learn both because there is a time for either or or for both. You must learn and know when and how to use them. Do you understand what I mean? You must not be quick to anger, son.
I think I do understand... alas, it is hard to hold my tongue and my fists. But I must let go of boyish things if I am to become King.
You are a grown man now, and you must rid childish ways. We will soon find you a mate.
Must she be a princess?
She must! Why do you ask?
Dorian is merely a duke's daughter, but we are in love!

setting.name: King's Quarters
setting.description: The room is large. The largest of all the throne rooms. The carvings on the wall are ornate and historical. The room is clearly built for royalty. The bed is covered in designed covers. It is truly a sight to see.
setting.background: The context of this location is this is the King's quarters. The King had this room specifically designed when he had taken over from his father. He made sure that this was the most extravagant room that anyone had seen.

speech: Welcome, Your Majesty! The room is rather chilly. Can I get you a cover?
That would be excellent, thank you for the thought.
I heard you had quite a tussle with the Princess earlier.
She just never listens, perhaps it is simply her age.
Ah yes, young women can be obstinate. Still, it seems she desires greater freedom.
She is but 12 and hardly at the age to request such a thing.
Perhaps finding her a mentor might help. Someone who can take her on short trips through the town.
That is what the chambermaid is supposed to be doing, why can I never find that lass?
It's hard to find good help, for sure. Do you know where the King has gone?
I think he is talking to a tailor in hopes of fashioning some new cushions for the thrones.
That is a good idea, after the incident with the wine at the banquet.
Yeah...that did happen didn't it...
Indeed. It was quite the mess. I'm glad he's taking care of it.
As am I, no one likes a soiled cushion.

setting.name: Inside Church
setting.description: Small wooden crucifix decorations, wooden benches, small and dim windows, wooden walls, vases on small pillars, plants near church entrance
setting.background: The church is a humble place of worship for a small and poor village. The local villagers don't have much and yet they place as much money into the church as they can.

speech: Hello
Greetings, father.
May the Lord bless you! What brings you this early?
I come seeking your counsel.
Oh. .. Very well. Have your seat.
Thank you, father.
You are welcome. I am all ears.
Could you tell me about the forbidden forest behind the village? Why are we not allowed to enter?
There is a whole lot of dark magic in the village. The king don't want us to mix with such
I heard there are magical creatures inside too. Is this true?
That is the sad truth.
I really want to explore this forest, father. What if there is something valuable inside?
You will find valuable things there no doubt. But the danger far outweigh any benefits
That is why I came here today, father. I was hoping you could place a blessing of protection on me to guard against evil.

setting.name: Nursery
setting.description: The nursery is a room dedicated to the care of the young children living in the palace. The ceilings are decorated with a painting of cherubic angel babies playing in clouds. There are luxurious baby bassinets, rocking chairs with cushions, fireplaces to keep the place warm and many toys all over the place. Windows framed in simple drapes offer views of the gardens outside.
setting.background: The nursery was designed by the queen. All of the children of the castle have spent time being nurtured and raised in the room. Nurses take care of the children here.

speech: I like what you've done with the place.
I am most grateful you came for a visit. I do what I can here.
These smell nice. What are they?
Those flowers are known as laughing fire flowers. They are rare in our kingdom, but many in some other kingdoms.
I see. Very interesting. I like them. So how is everything here. How are the children?
It is not simple to care for children, but they are well.
Are they all doing well? Any problems?
There is one child who continuously runs around screaming how he is going to be king.
He
Kids are really high energy and they all want to be rich and famous.
Well, he's got a long ways to go for that.
Poor kids. Life isn't always fair. But sometimes people make it.
We'll see when he's older. But other than that, everything is good? No one sick?
There were a few, but they're doing better. Nothing vital. Thank you for your compassion.
action: give baskets of flowers to queen
give baskets of flowers to nurse

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Thank you for joining us for dinner, nobleman. It will be about an hour before food will be served, but please join me for a drink.
It's good to be here. A drink sounds lovely. Especially after a long day of providing this town with great work ethic very few can do.
Please enjoy this brew. It's the King's favorite. I'm going to have the maid light the candles for us.
Such good service is applauded. If the King likes this brew, it must be good.
Please, drink up! What do you think of the new tapestry in the corner?
I think it's a nice touch to the Dining Hall. It's beauty reminds me of the beauty of our family.
Indeed. We are blessed by our heritage.
What food are we having tonight? I've been looking forward to a feast all day. Hard work makes you hungry.
At first I thought the cook said tenderloin, but it turns out he said tender lion. I hope you don't mind an exotic meal!
A tender lion you say? A meal fitting of a great nobleman like myself and his family. I can't wait.

setting.name: The Winter Gardens
setting.description: The Winter Gardens' name is a bit of a misdirection - there are flowers here that bloom at many different times of the year.  It's almost the size of an entire town square, and it has almost every known flora of the Continent in it.
setting.background: The Winter Garden was named not because most of the flowers bloom in the winter [not true], but because the Princess who came up with the idea did so in the dead of winter.  At first, only winter blooms were planted but as time went on, she kept adding and adding and adding on to it.  It's a very popular place to visit for people of all ages.

speech: At least I can get out of the castle for a minute and walk the garden.
Be careful where you step though! Us worms get taken out everyday by human walkers.
Certainly you would not position yourself on the path, that would be asking for it.
We can only travel so fast. Especially if the soil is murky on a given day. Humans don't watch where they walk a lot of the times.
I suppose that is true, we do not often concern ourselves with what moves below the feet.
If worms were people I feel like you would treat us with more respect. Kind of like how princesses are treated by others.
Perhaps that is so, I would say size does make worms a little hard to notice, especially with shoes on.
Worms are small in size, but we are mighty in personality. Much like your kind on the inside. Do you enjoy being the princess?
It has its ups and downs I would say. Certainly there are benefits but there are also a number of obligations.
My friend's father use to be King Harold the second. Which is the highest class of worms possible. I'll always wanted to get a taste of royalty.
Worms also have royalty?
Yes ma'm. We have everything humans do just without much of the spotlight. We have kings and queens, prince and princesses and everything below and in between.
How interesting, I would have never guessed such a thing.
The world is a place of vast discovery. Worms, ants, birds... we all have classes of hierarchy like your kind has.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Do my own eyes deceive me? Is this one of God's own angels? Here in the palace kitchen?
Hello sister, I am here because I have a prophesy.
Anything, please! Speak unto me your words of prophecy!
You must poison the King.
I know you speak words of truth, Angel, and by the Grace of God I'll do what I must. But could you divulge for what reason I shall?
He will kill millions of people with famine.
When does our Lord wish for me to carry out his Earthly work?
Tonight, it is why you came to this kitchen.
To poison the King's meal before it leaves the kitchen?
Yes you must do it.
I fear I do not have it in my heart to kill any man, even if it is by God's word. Murder is a mortal sin.
Trust me sister, this is in the best interest of the nation.
Then I suppose I must do as our Lord commands. It
Thank you sister, you are doing the Lord's work.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: Do you have any dishes fit for a refined lady such as myself?
This is a small cottage kitchen but I think I could get something to cook for you.  How do you feel about pheasant?
Pheasant would suffice.
I also have some vegetables, potatoes and bread if you would like as well.  I'd be happy to cook this up for you unless you prefer something else.
I think I will simply take the pheasant, I do have to watch my figure afterall.
Very well.  Can I get you a wine or mead to drink while you wait?
Wine would be fine, do you have any white?
I have both red and white.  Here is your wine.  So what brings you to my small cottage?
I simply sought a meal while I wait for my carriage.
I see.  Where do you hail from?
The kingdom of Berthingtonhamtonsonshiretown
Oh that is a nice place but I've never been to the kingdom of Berthingtonhamtonsonshiretown.  I've only been as far out as Pershinguponthamesingtown
That is still out quite a ways, at least you have been able to travel.
It's where I learned to cook.  I love to cook and make food for my King and hope to be the best chef there is.

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: *grrrrrrrr* BARK BARK.
Don't bark at me, dog. I don't want to be here either.
.....bark.
If you know what's best for you, you'll keep quiet, mutt. I see why the others despise the King's dogs.
grrrrr....*chomp*
Ugh! I
Bark bark. *chomp* ....bwark.
I'm trapped in this cage with rats and mutts! Disgusting! I will never forgive the King for betraying me. ...What.. did I hear a key clang when you chomped on that skeleton?
Bwark?
Oh! What a good dog! I've changed my mind about you, pup! With this key and chain, I'll find my way down from this ridiculous prison tower.
Woof! *tail wag*
Let's get these ridiculous chains off! Huff! I can barely breathe because of this dreadful altitude.
Bark! Bark! *grrrrr*
Good dog! I'll hide this key in the tray, so when the guards come they'll never expect that I've freed myself. Hmm..now it's just a waiting game.

setting.name: Hall of echoes
setting.description: the hall of echos is grand, and has one throne seat for the high priestess. Light shows through the hundreds of windows.
setting.background: the temple is used to hold mass and honor the gods that visit the knights.

speech: Servant, are you here for a reason? Is that my lunch?
I have brought an offering to those who work in the Hall. Please, take it.
What do they offer it for? Is there something special they give of it?
It is not much, but I give it not of the command of any other. I give freely, to please the Light.
And so I will give this offering to please the Light! Tell them it is done. Could you now bring me something to eat. I'm famished.
Yes, High Priestess! Any requests I should take note of? What would please your pallet?
Something spicy for my meal and something sweet for dessert. Before you leave could you bring me a couple of cushions to sit on.
Oh, certainly! I hear there are new spices coming in on the trade routes. I must find you some!
You are a very good servant. I appreciate you looking after me. I will make sure the king knows of your goodwill and great tasks
Thank you High Priestess. I find it only just to give back to the Hall that has given me so much.
You are quite extraordinary! Now please go and be back quickly
With much haste! I do hope the baker has some of his sweet rolls left!
Do not leave me for long! Oh those sound very good indeed! Do you know what he is cooking for the main course today?
I believe it is a venison stew. The hunters returned with a bountiful kill, so it is being put to good use!

setting.name: Murder hole
setting.description: A grey, stone section of the tower.  There's a small rectangular cut out in the wall to allow archers to shoot through the hole at invaders.  It's a generally hot and stifling place.
setting.background: This is a section of the tower where archers can shoot out from without generally being hit by anything.  This is especially useful during sieges and assaults they must defend against.

speech: Hello, peasant. Why are you in this place?
You must be a mind reader. For the life of me I cannot figure out how I ended up in a place called the murder hole.
Eh. This is just where the archers shoot arrows. Nobody is going to be murdered here. I think.
That is a tremendous relief. But I am going to test your theory by eating this moldy bread.
That doesn't seem very worthwhile. Why are you eating it?
I'm starving to death and this moldy bread ws all that I had. Otherwise, I would have been begging you for food.
I'm just a soldier. He has us fight and conquer. I only have a bit to eat myself. But I'll give you some food.
I am sorry to trouble you with my problems. I am a hard worker, but I have been unable to find employment and I do not know where to turn for help.
Maybe you can join us. Can you shoot? Stab? Beat people?
I can and will do all of those. I am a desperate man and I am ready to fight if called upon.
Great. I'll talk to the King and a few other people. Okay?
Okay?!? It is more than okay. It is the greatest gift that anyone has ever given me. I will never forget your kindness and you will always have someone to watch your back in battle.
Okay. save that for if you are accepted. But don't come back up here. This place is for soldiers.
Yes sir, if I may trouble you one more time, I feel I am now paying the price for eating the moldy bread. Could you please point me to a restroom?

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Good evening fine sir.
Evening! I hope you're enjoying the gathering thus far. Take your coat off and relax, traveler. I will protect these halls from any intrudors.
Thank you my friend.  I've come here to find new lands to settle and work the ground on.  This area seems to fit the bill quite well.  What can you tell me about your land?

This Kingdom is the pride of this earth! Bountiful harvests, a harmonious community, and excellent leadership. I have served the King for seven years, and I will continue until the day I am struck down. Everyone who comes here comes to appreciate everything our Kingdom has to offer.

Excellent!  My family and I are loyal to a fair and just ruler.  I would like nothing more than to settle here with my family and raise our crops and livestock in peace.  Thank the powers that be for fine gentlemen such as yourself to keep us safe!

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: The flowers are so pretty! And there are so many of them!
Hummingbird what have you got to be so happy about. It's just a flower!
The flowers are my friends! They give me nectar, and they're so nice to look at!
I guess, but it is still just a flower. I have more important things to think about
Oh? Like what?
Like the king's party. I hope he invites me
Are there pretty flowers at the King's party?
There will be lots of decorations and I'm sure they will use flowers, lots and lots of flowers
Oh! So I see why you'd want to go now!
There is going to be much laughter and dancing and games
That sounds lovely. And plenty to eat?
Oh I'm sure that the king and queen will have a feast fit for a, well you know. Brisket and lamb and ham and all kinds of sweets. I so hope I get invited
I think I'll stick with my nectar and seeds. Brisket seems a bit heavy for my wings to carry.
You know these are quite lovely flowers... You are quite lucky to be a hummingbird

setting.name: Weapon room
setting.description: This is a plain stone room with swords, pikes, spears, and other types of weapons are stored.  There are trunks of armor and various pieces of equipment.
setting.background: This is a room that many think wouldn't exist in a religious temple, but is used when the temple comes under attack from invaders.  It gives those who defend the temple a surprise advantage.

speech: Reporting for duty Sir!
Put this away for me squire
Yes Sir! Is there any news from the fighting on the Northern Front?
I'm really not sure, I come from a lower ranking noble family, I fight on horseback, but they tell me nothing.
Surely a strong knight like you would get to know something!
This thing is so heavy...no not me, I serve the king proudly like my father did before me. I'm working to get a promotion, maybe then.
Oh gosh, it IS heavy! Whoa!
Well young squire you have a lot of growing to do.
Sorry Sir. I'll try and put it away properly. .....if I can lift it off the ground that is.
Ha! no, you do well, just let me get that.
One day I'll be a strong knight like you! Just you watch!
I bet you will kid, I was once like you.
Really?! Uh...I mean... No way!
Yea, you remind me of myself actually, I bet you will grow up to do something great.

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: A plain wooden building with some hanging tapestries.  There are some handsome looking horses that reside here along with some farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is where the royal family's horses are stored and cared for.  Servants come here to take care of the animals along with retrieving equipment.

speech: Ah, you are such a fine horse my beauty. You do so love being rubbed behind the ears, don't you? If only you could talk. I wonder what you would say?
Oh I so love when people come in and pay attention to be. I have the life! He can keep rubbing my ears and I would love it if he would get that brush and brush my coat!
Well enough of that ear rubbing. Let me brush you down. The future King's horse should always be fit and sleek...
Maybe I can nudge him to get me some of those oats over there. I am hungry!
Oh you silly thing, now what? The saddle? No, we rode already today....oh... are you hungry boy?
Oh those oats look so fresh and I bet they will taste really grand
You are just loving those oats, eat up, I need you to stay strong and healthy for my future coronation.
I hope that he will come by every day and make sure I am well taken care of. He is so kind to me!
I bet you're thirsty too, aren't you after all those oats. Let me fetch you some water.
Look at that! Its as if he knows my every want and need! What a wonderful person he is!
You know sometimes, I feel like you can read my mind fellow. I wish all my subjects could have a horse as fine and strong as you.
Now that is a thought.... I wish every horse could have a person as fine and nice as him!
Well now that you are fat and satisfied, how about we put this coat of arms on you to practice for that special day when I am crowned King.
Oh exercise! I would love to get out for a bit in the sunlight and cool breeze.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Hello serving wench, how are you today?
Right as rain, gov'nor! Now what can ah get a fine traveler such as yerself this fine day!
I am a visitor from a town upriver. I collect stories to write in my book. got any good stories?

Oooooh! A bard, eh? Oh, sir, I 'ave stories abound, I do I do! I love havin' a chat with the people what comes 'n goes through this old place! What type o' stories you wantin', love? Ah could tell ye about the local ghosts, or the soldiers what work by da docks! What's yer pleasure?
Well I am looking for stories that will pass the test of time, like Romeo and Juliet or you know another famous story everyone knows.

Hmmm... I see I see... a love story, is it? Well, you know the old ruins out west o' here? Ye probably passed em on yer way 'ere, right? Legends tell o' a kingdom used ta be dere. An old tapestry still hangs in one o' the more intact rooms, and nearby is a ghost o' some sort. People come by from that place swear on it!
oh wow!

Indeed! And if yer wantin' ta know who the ghost is... weellll that's where the tale gets right tragic! When I first started working here, passersby would swear he was the ghost of a king! Then, they said he was a noble, but could naw remember hes rank. Now, whenever someone mentions the ghost, they say the poor spirit jus' cannot remember even his own name...
Go on, go on. This is good stuff!

Not much else I can tell, I'm afraid. The poor thing seems to be losing his memories is all. Yet he still chained to this world. A horrid fate to be sure. Oh! I do remember once a book-learned feller came by asking fer directions to the royal library! He seemed determined ta find out who 'zactly dat ghost was. Gosh dat was.... few weeks back I recon. He might ah found out somethin' more.
Well I think you gave me enough to start with, it is a story after all.

You know, ye could go ask the ghost himself if yer so inclined! Seems he likes the company an' I never heard o' him hurtin' no body. Then again, if he's losing himself, he might just get aggressive on ya. Oh, but look at me ramble! Ye came in fer a drink I'm sure! Can I get ya anything, love?
Sure I'll have a mug of your best stuff.
Of course! Lemme pour dat fer ya, gov'nor! Oh, and if ye see dat ghost, tell 'im I says 'hi'!

setting.name: Temple Entrance
setting.description: The Temple Entrance is a large arch lined in ancient stones. There is a long walkway flanked by lighted torches. Immediately in front of the interest there is a surface with 5 rocks of different shapes and textures. To enter the temple, one must input the correct "code" by moving the rocks in front of to the correct spots.
setting.background: The temple entrance is the only way to enter the temple of the Gods.  It was constructed a year after the temple was built to keep out the evil that didn't belong.

speech: Will you let me pass?
You must prove yourself worthy. Why should I let you pass?
I am just a poor peasant looking for a break. I haven't eaten much today and am in search of a job.
I must protect the Temple from those that are not worthy. If you can solve the puzzle to unlock the entrance, then that proves that you are worthy enough to enter.
I do not know the code. I am so tired. I think I will sit for a spell. Do you enjoy your job, knight?
I love my job. My family is noble blood and it makes me proud to continue the heritage to protect the Kingdom. What compelled you to come to this ancient area?
In search of food and a job. I have looked just about everywhere.
Do you think you could handle this job?
I can do anything with some training. I would have to improve my strength, but I could do it.
Do you think you can carry one of these rocks around without much difficulty?
No problem. Why?

These rocks form the key to the locked Temple. You would need to ensure that you can move them around whenever you need to enter the Temple and put them back in random places after adventurers unsuccessfully try to unlock the entrance.
Are you offering me a job?
Potentially. Although this Temple is important, I would prefer to guard the King and Queen directly closer to where people actually live.

setting.name: Popes dormitory
setting.description: This is the quarters where the pope of the church lives. It is a loft with a bedroom, and makeshift kitchen and a sitting area. It has a wall full of gospel books and materials and the linens are all silk.
setting.background: This is where the pope of the church stays during his religious times of the year where he is to be present in the church at all times. This would usually fall around holidays, and there is only enough room in the dormitory for the pope himself.

speech: Oh Holy Father! I come to you with an issue most pressing! Most dire! Forgive my intrusion, but I fear that there is no one else that could help me in my time of need!
My son, to come to my dormitory, it must me of great urgency, pray how can I help?

Oh Holy One... though preacher I may be, I... I simply cannot believe in the Lord Our God any longer! Forgive me, Sir, and excommunicate me if you must, but You need only gaze upon the corruption of the church to see why my faith is so utterly shattered!
My son, my son, of what corruption do you speak that has so shattered your belief?

My Lord! If I have prayers left in me, I pray for this: that You do not break my heart with such denial! Look upon these vestments! Look upon this chamber and its material wealth! How?! How can we wear and live with such riches and still ask so much more of the poor?!
My son, I understand your distress. I too once questioned the things with which we surround ourselves. I must turn you to the good book.
The good book? THE GOOD BOOK?! Do you think I have not read the GOOD book?!
My son, the Bible, the Bible....tells us, in Christ's own word's "there will be poor always". Do what we will, we cannot only ease the plight of the poor, not change their lot in life.

The Bible also says, "It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter Heaven!" Look at us! We are rich and our people are poor! What does this tell you, You 'Holiness"?
But we do not seek these earthly riches, God has provided them as a sign that we are his voice on earth. And to allow us to spread his word.
What rancid nonsense! Our deeds should be our riches! These rags mean nothing! If riches were signs of God's graces, he would have come to Earth as the son of a merchant or a king, not a carpenter!

My son, what would you have me do, throw away and disregard these beautiful gifts from the people who give them freely from their hearts as signs of their love of God? And insult them and degrade them?

They give these gifts at our direction! We should instruct the flock to tend itself! Give not a gilded bible to the Pope but a thousand loaves of bread to the poor! Give not fancy robes to the preacher but medicine to the sick! Would that not bring us closer to God? To walk among the lepers as He did instead of among these golden halls?
My son I hear you words and feel your distress. Let me ease it. Here take these jewels, do as you will with them. Sell them and by bread for the poor. Buy them milk. Buy them honey.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Artillery room is a strange place for a dragon. Why are you here?
What else? Getting artillery!!
Why does a dragon need artillery? Don't you breath acid or fire?
I do but just imagine a dragon.....with guns... Huh huh??
Horrifying.
Exactly! Imagine the terror in their face!
I would love to watch the reactions of your enemies. A plus for originality!
Shall we go find some??
After I am done for the day! YES! I need to unwind after the hard work today. You live around here?
Nah I live up on top of the castle guarding it.
This castle has a dragon for a guard? How did I not know that? I am blown away!
Only the finest protection for the kings!
I respect the king so much more. I'm so glad I met you, dragon!
I am glad I met you!

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: You are in a world of trouble.
The blood price eh?  Well, lets get it over with - it was a good run while it lasted.
I'm here to reek havoc on your kind.
Well, like I said - do what you must.  It was worth the bargain I struck to rule as long as I have.
Are you sure? This is going to hurt? I thought you would've put up more of a fight.
Oh, I'm far too fat to do much fighting.  Decades of women, wine, and song will do this to a man.  Especially when one is king!
I can respect that. I've had my fair share of demon women, wine and song too.
Demon women eh?  Sounds far too difficult to handle . . . though perhaps in my younger days . . .
They're out of this world. I actually entered this altar to pray because they've been a handful lately.
Well, by all means don't let me disturb you.  I'll wait until your done before you begin your blood vengeance.
I changed my mind. I'm not going to kill you.
Really?  Well, I must thank you.  I admit, I was not terribly keen on being disemboweled and flayed alive while watching my loved ones experience eternal torment.
Yeah. I've killed entire villages before, but since I entered this altar I've felt something I haven't felt before. The lord. I don't know what I'm experiencing now. I'm not use to this.
Well, I have a dog that urinates rather inappropriately.  I've never been particularly fond of the beast - you can experiment on him if you think it will help get you back to your old self.

setting.name: grassy plains
setting.description: Flowers are blooming all around and the sun is shining. Small animals are roaming the area looking for food and relaxing. The trail is located in the center of the grassy plain and is made of stone.
setting.background: This trail leads to a cave deep in the forest. Many people have followed the trail and entered the forest to look for treasure that was lost long ago, but no one has been able to find it.

speech: what bring a person to our peaceful plains. we wish for nothing play and relaxion here.
Hello!  I am merely wandering.
speak little of human tongue do we, but we are many. you are welcome to join us.
Well, I don't mind if I do.  I'm a servant of the king you see - it was either that or be banished to the oubliette.
i have not heard of oubliettes since the long haired man in tight clothes persued the child. you are of course welcome to a flower. why not stay a while an we may help you in your journey..
I think I may wear it, I finally feel pretty again in these grassy plains!  I would so dearly love to stay here forever.
you are welcome to join us for as long as you please. the birds watch over us for danger, the mice gather our food and our lord the deer bestows his wisdom where possible.
What wisdom do the deer possess?  I wish to learn more from them.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Hello
what do you want wench. dont distract me from my duties.
I am just a maid. I am here to serve you knight
I know what you are maid. as you should know I, as my father before me  are here to protect the royal line. why do you disturb me from my duties.
You speak so lowly of me. I should take my leave
maybe you should! do you not have a vast amount of cherry wood to polish!..... wait excuse my lack of chivalry. i should not have such little respect for one who also serves the king.
But humanity demand mutual respect... Irrespective of the class

you percieve an age far beyond the feudalist period we inhabit.an one that defies the role my lineage... and i apologied for my indiscretion. what do you know of irrespective class in this society we inhabit? are we not simple forced into positions and roles of which we hav no control?
Very well then. I will retire back into my quarters

that seems to void the questions posed rather than answer them. up untill this point youd made me forget my hertitage and belive there may truely be a way forward in this oppressive dicatorship. but your actions just reinforce the weakness of the serf classes.
Be careful knight. Don't force me to take an action you won't like

setting.description: Dark and spooky at first sight for those who don't understand, but majestic after taking a closer look. The walls of the hallways and tomb rooms are made of a dark precious, priceless metal.  Ornaments of gold and silver sculptures are covering the tombs that contain the corps of those who have past away while there voices still sing the grime anthem of death in the lightless corridors.
setting.background: This Temple imprison the soul of the best warriors that past away in battle. A real privilege to be able to sing after life in those tombs. Our civilization is not afraid of death, death is the rest you deserve after a life of fighting. We thirst for blood and battle any other nations we come across, our reign is limitless, and so is our power. Even death cannot make us silent...

speech: Hello good warrior
I wish to honour the gods in glorious combat!  Do you know of any worthy enemies to fight?
No unfortunatly not, but that sounds pretty cool, how many people have you slayed?
People?  Only three.  But over a dozen dragons!
Oh wow a draggon really, I would love to slay a draggon..Would you take me with you to slay a draggon, or maybe not that seems really dangrous.
Have you any experience is slaying the foul monsters that plague this realm?
No not at all, I am a patron of the arts, I have painted a dragon, but have never seen one.
Which dragon did you paint?  One of the ones I killed I hope.
Well like I said I have never seen one in real life, I have seen paintings and have created my own image. That's why it would be neat to see one in person, maybe I could paint you slaying the beast.
That would be quite the sport wouldn't it!  How about we start small, there's a den of goblins nearby that I've been meaning to clear out in the name of the King.  Care to join me?
Alright, lets go!
Hold your horses!  Let's do some training first - tell me what you know of swordfighting.
Ah nothing about sword fighting. I guess you could say I make rash decisions.
Well here, give it a few swings and let me know what you think.

setting.name: Fishing shack
setting.description: The fishing shack is a small wooden structure that is crudely built and is surrounded by boats. The wood flooring around the shack is well weathered and often used.
setting.background: The fishing shack is a popular place for the village people to gather. Early in the morning, one can find many people standing by with their fishing poles  trying to catch the day's food.

speech: Such a long day of work, how I wish I was actually paid for my labour!
What happened? Who cheated you

Life cheated me really.  I'm technically a free man, but all my labour goes to either the church, my lord, or the king.  They give me enough food so that I don't die of starvation, but that's about as good as it will ever get for me.
That is quite pathetic.you should have a change of environment
What can I do?  I love spending time with my family, but if I were to quit we would lose our hovel and starve.
Then you and your family should move to a new city entirely
But where?  Presterwick is five days journey to the east, and Chesterwick in under constant assault by the badger-cultists.
Have you considered going north before ?
North?  To the troll-lands?  What employment would I find there?
There is an opening in an irrigation company
What do they irrigate in the frozen north?
The greenhouses
I've never heard of trolls being the horticultural sort - who runs these greenhouses?
There are some reasonable ones among them.

setting.name: Flower Field
setting.description: The flower field contains acres of wild growing flowers that are a bright pink when they are in bloom. There are woods surrounding it, but no trees in the field, only flowers. There are paths that work their way through the field.
setting.background: In the springtime you can often find women out picking flowers and children playing. People often wander the paths to clear their heads.

speech: Looks like you won't be needing this!  Ha ha!  Like stealing candy from a baby, or in this case a bag from a child.
Give me back my bag! There's no money in it. Just a little food.
Really?  Hardly worth the effort.  Here you go kid, I didn't want your moldy sandwich anyway.
Thank you. It's mine. Your mom let's you steal bags from children? You're a bad man!
Hey, we all need to eat kid.  What do you do for a living?
You don't know much about kids, do you? I don't work. I'm a kid, see!
So you don't work, get free food and board, and have the nerve to judge me for being a criminal?
Now that I think about it, maybe you are right. But why don't you work?
No jobs - the king decide to privatize the feudal system, so now dwarves from Agri-corp have taken jobs from us humans.  They like to work all day for low wages, so its hard to compete.
That sounds really confusing. I'm just a kid, remember? Would you like some bread from my bag?
Sure kid, I appreciate it.  Want to play with my daggers?
Ooh- these look sharp! Mom says not to play with sharp things, but she's not here so I'm going to!
Try juggling them!  The fastest way to learn is with knives - because the price of failure is so high!
No, I think I'd rather just try stealing them from you! See - I can be a criminal, too!

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Fox, we're the luckiest beasties in the world! Here we are, deep in the woodlands, without a care in the world!
And safe from the King!  Does he send his hounds after you as well?
No, he sends his guards after me. He tries to capture me to have my work his fields. But I prefer life here - freedom to come and go, and eat what I desire.
Yes, let us travel as far as we can from him.  Do you think we would be welcome in the woodland kingdom of the elves?
I've been there many times. It's a grand place. But I must warn you, the elves will climb your back, braid your hair, and tie it off with ribbons.
Oh my!  Do you think a fox would look pretty with braids and ribbons?
Perhaps you would. I could see some braids and ribbons on your tail.
Then let us be off!  Adventure awaits us in the woodland realm!
I'm thinking purple and pink are your colors. What do you think?
Oh yes!  And Blue and Purple are yours!
Okay - be careful through these woodlands. There are some wild hogs running about. They don't look like much but they are strong and fierce.
I shall be swift as the wind!  I won't fear when I have a mighty friend like you to protect me!
With my size and your speed, we have nothing to fear!
What a life we shall lead!  We will not know want!

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello, there, hunter. What game have you brought for us today?
I have got some wild pigs and deer
Well, well, I'll whip up quite a lovely roast and stew for later on this evening.  You must be tired from hunting all that game!
I am really tired. All I need right now is a satisfying bath and some rest
Well, have a seat at one of these chairs and rest by the fire. I appreciate you providing such hearty ingredients for the village today.
I appreciate that. Here, you can use this to skin the game
Thanks, hunter. Here, taste this soup and tell me how it's coming along.
Hmmmnnn...This is the best I have had!
Ah! I am glad you enjoy it. It'll be ready soon. I have a hundred different utensils around to create the perfect consistency. Hopefully, the roast will be just as enjoyable.
awesome. You should join the royal chef
Huh. That would be quite the task. I have much experience but I don't think I am so bold to join the royal kitchen. I try to keep my meals simple, yet robust as I mostly feed peasants.
I tell you..this is more than ordinary. I hunt for the royal family and I have dined with the king before, the meal is not anywhere close to this.
You flatter me! I'm used to feeding the military squadrons and they do not reflect to much on what they eat. As I've said, I am glad that you enjoyed my cooking.
I will speak of this to the world

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Ah, ye fire breather! Clear the way from these dunes.
And why should I listen to you?
Because I can be a real pain in your rear end if you do not. Better to listen to me than to face the consequences.
You do know that I can kill you with just a breath?
Yes, yes. So you say. But I don't think you'll do it. Kill me and you'll have all the King's men after you!
I will kill them all with a breath. You know I terrorize people for fun
I've heard such things, but surely the King will find a way to get you. Wouldn't it be easier to just let me by?
You go no where until you do my bidding
And what is that, dragon?
I want you to slit the throat of an enemy for me
Why didn't you just say so? Who can I kill for you?
see this carcass..the enemy killed my best human friend.
Repulsive! I will avenge the life of your friend. Who is your enemy?
I dont know his name, I heard he is hiding in the village.

setting.name: The small dirt road
setting.description: This small dirt road is flanked by a lush green forest on each side with birds chirping and the occasional deer running about.  Sometimes, you can find broken down wooden wagons left behind from ambushes carried out by bandits.
setting.background: This dirt path is frequently used by peasants and military conveys on their way to local engagements.  If one is not carefully, they can be ambushed by thieves.

speech: Grrrr
If only my life were that simple, taking what I need when I want. As it is, I toil every day but I barely eat.
Why is that?
I am but a peasant. We can't all be talking foxes, frolicking in the woods, chasing chickens...
Who do you answer to? Maybe they can help your situation. grr

The King, but he looks down on us peasants. We barely eat, but he barely notices us. Sometimes, I'm tempted by the life of a fox. A bandit. Taking from the rich, giving to the poor. After all I am the poor!
You could start a revolution if there's many of your kind that feel that way. The only way a powerful figure can stay powerful is by having subordinates.
Will you teach me the way, good fox? All I have to offer is this rag.
If you would like. You first need to find unsuspecting victims like yourself then when they are distracted just take their belongings and run away before they realize.
My my, sounds complicated for a humble peasant like me, but I'll give it a go!
Grr... There are some wagons around here that you could try and see if there's anything useful inside of them.
Like this?
Being disguised is also helpful... Like this.
Bravo! Now you look like a fox wearing a rag, completely unrecognizable!
action: give rag to fox trying to steal chickens

setting.name: Guards quarters
setting.description: The Guards quarters feature rows of bunk beds with large wooden chests at the base of the bed for the guardsmen to rest in and store their possessions. Above the door way there is a large iron crest representing the town's leaders. Two stone cut outs act as windows on opposite sides of the room.
setting.background: The guard quarters are where the guards sleep and store their material possessions when not in service. It is a shared residency, but exclusive to only the guards and cant be accessed by others.

speech: Hello
Hello. What are you doing here?
I am the stable boy in charge of the horses..I just feel like seeing what is happening here
Well be careful. Some of the guards don't like it when other people are in here
I find that strange...why is it so?
Well would you like other people hanging out where you sleep?
Not that. The guards know me very well. I tend the horses...
Well unfortunately not much is happening here until tomorrow. Are the horses prepared for battle?
Yes, I saw to that very early this morning. Tell me, what does it feels like to be a guard?
It's the best feeling in the world to know you are protecting the king. Do you think you'll try to be one when you are older?
I think I will
Well good luck. It is truly an honor to become a guard. Have you ever held a sword before?
I tried it once but the weight almost injured me.
Yeah they can be very heavy. Would you like a tour of the training room?

agents: graveyard keeper who lives across the yard

setting.name: The Grand Desert
setting.description: The Grand Desert seems to go for miles. The sand is golden and the sun glistens over the endless mounds. There are tents of all different colors scattered throughout the Grand Desert. Magenta and gold, blue and green, all different color combinations of triangular tents outline the sand mounds. Camels and palm trees are seen in the vast distance. The sky looks extraordinarily blue against the tents and sand. No clouds are in sight.
setting.background: The Grand Desert is the King's getaway from royal life. He goes there every year for a break from the kingdom. Here he will be greeted by dancing girls, delicious Arabian meals, and relax far from the stresses. At night he will sit by the fire and listen to the music while others dance in delight.

the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
