setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: Here sir, I found this.
Very good. I believe the enemy will approach from the east, and try to encircle us.
where would you like my group at?
We'll need most of your men here on the wall. Could you spare a dozen marksmen?
easily! how many do you want ready to exit the battlements if needed?
We'll take two dozen men to this point here. Then, after unleashing a volley from behind the hill, they'll join my cavalry, riding two to a horse, so we can drop you off here, behind their flank.
Ah, cannot drop my good luck coin. Alright, I can easily get that set up. We have a really good army right now.
Yes; the forces of the scoundrel King Graxia might seem tough, but they're mostly peasant conscripts, more fit to hold an apple basket than a spear. They will not take this fortress.
Do you think they could be hiding any secret weapons?
I do not think so, but it is possible. It never hurts to remain vigilant
I've heard whisperings of some foreign mercaneries they hired

I am not one for gossip but I never hear about their forces. Just that they hired about five high end mereranires.
Well thank you for passing this along. It may well only be rumor but I will look into it

setting.name: Blacksmith
setting.description: The sounds of metal and steel clanking together can be heard as you approach the Blacksmith. Varieties of shiny maces, swords, and spears are stung on shelves that line the walls in the shop. A big, burly man can be seen hammering away at swords as he brazens them through the melting pot. His young apprentice greets the customers. The walls are blackened from soot by the fire pit.
setting.background: Funded by the King himself, this was once the armory for the Kings Guard but as the Kingdom expanded, the Blacksmith was turned into one open to the citizens of the kingdom. The Blacksmith shop was destroyed in a fire during the second medieval war but was reconstructed on request of the king to where it stand now in the center of the Bazaar.

speech: Where is that blacksmith! I just must have this sword sharpened!
CAN YOU NOT HEAR HIM HAMMERING? Sorry, it's very loud in here!
Sir! You are you both a knight and a blacksmith?
No, dear follow, if only I were! It would save me having to come here to have me armour repaired! So, you're a swordsman too?
Oh, heavens no! This is a family heirloom!
A fine sword too, at least a few centuries old from the look of it!
Indeed! My grandfather served in the Battle of Dragon's Breath and wore this very sword.
Well I never, so did mine, Sir Roderick Blackhide himself. I dare say they fought alongside each-other. It warms my heart to see that you still honour your grandfather's memory.
Sir Blackhide! He was quite the hero if I recall the tales correctly.
Yes, quite the drinker too by all accounts. I never met him, sadly, but I was raised on tales of his exploits. My family still serve the king under his banner to this day.
Well, let me say this. On behalf of all the realms, thank you for your service!
I live to serve. I only hope that you'll never have need of your grandfather's sword. I've seen enough of war to wish for peace.
I'm sure you have! Hopefully this blacksmith with eventually finish his lunch so that I'll have a chance when the enemy shows it's wicked face.
Quite! I must say, he's making quite the racket for a man eating his lunch!

setting.name: Decoration shop
setting.description: Outside the Temple is the decoration shop.  It is made of cobblestone and has flowers growing on the sides and back of it.  It has a large wooden sign hanging out front identifying it.  The shop is full of decorations for your home as well as for parties.
setting.background: The decoration shop is where all of the royal family goes to purchase the decorations for their homes. They go there also to buy decorations for outside, such as plants for outside temple.  The decoration shop is a happy place that is full of warmth and generosity.

Do not digress from my question

Ummm, she did come to my chambers. You got that part right.
This as been going on for how many months now?
Four. Does that make a difference? Am I in trouble?
Not if you're willing to accept responsibility for the pregnancy

setting.name: The Temple Marketplace
setting.description: This dirt section of land has several tents set up along with carpets and goods spread out among them.  Gleaming from the distance, one can see plates, pots, paintings, and antique goods.  There are peasants walking by along with excited traders trying to get them to look at their wares.
setting.background: People come here to exchange goods and hopefully make a decent enough profit to cover the rent just for setting up here.  Sometimes traders come back with very exotic goods from far away places.

speech: Hey there beggar, have you eaten anything?

I tried once but they fired me. Now I beg for food. Unfortunately most people are too poor to help

We are but lowly peasants in the big scheme of things.. I think we wouldn't get far.
Probably not but if I don't eat soon I'm going to die. Maybe that thief can steal me some food
I will go see if I can find any rations for you, I wouldn't put that burden upon the theif, it would be bad if he got executed because of us.
Thank you  You're so kind. I was afraid I was going to have to fight someone just to eat
Of course, we must help eachother out when we can if we want to survive!
Do you think anyone ever actually buys the paintings?

setting.name: Church
setting.description: Rows of headstones line the field beside the large ornate church with stained glass windows. The Church is mid-century and made of stone. A large steeple resides in the center adorned with a cross. Large front doors made of wood with iron handles. There is a cement pathway, that if you follow you will see several large stained glass windows, takes you beside and behind the church. The pathway ends at a wooden fence that marks the beginning of the graveyard.
setting.background: The church has been around for over 100 years. It is old and has rich history. There are many headstones present in the cemetery. The church holds services on Wednesdays and Sundays, has celebrations (such as weddings and baptisms), and offers funeral services.

speech: Hello there, Mr. Seagull...or is it Ms. Seagull?
Ms! What are you doing here person?
Here to visit a loved one who is no longer with me. Yourself? Little depressing here for a seagull.
I come to see the people mourn. Who did you lose?

I do see. How did he die? I ask not to cause harm, but to help.
Thank you. Cancer took him.
Ah! How awful. May you find some peace today here then!
I think I shall. A nice little chat, and leave him some flowers. It will be a good day.
How sweet of you! Go along now and do such. I will be here!
Here, take this. I'm sure you could make use of the wooden splints. Thanks for the chat.
I will take this to my pile in the den, and I will pay my respects to you here for the loss of your father. You are a king human!
You are all too kind yourself. You helped to brighten my spirits just by our little chat.
Know your father is no longer suffering and maybe he flys in the sky like me and is watching over you.

setting.name: Firewood Forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. The majority of the trees are green however a few are orange and red. The forest is huge and seems to never end.
setting.background: The forest is where all the wood is gathered to make fire. The forest goes for miles and new trees are planted once a year to make sure it lasts forever.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

I am here. I am always here - the bedroom. What are you doing in here with that camera? I am going to tell the Queen, you spy!
Is this bedroom haunted?!
It is not haunted, but maybe cursed. I am a talking bedroom and no one knows but those who enter. I keep watch over the room and her belongings.
Well the queen ordered this camera, apparently something about a "home video" with the king?
Is that so, you say? You make it sound horrible... Here, set it up as you wish, but she will be well informed of its location and that you were here because I will tell her. So, you cannot fool me!
I am just here to do my job!
Set it up then as you say, but I will be watching you.
Can't even do my job without a bedroom mocking me.
You are in the palace of the royals! There is all sorts of things you do not know about.
This house is crazy!
It is indeed, secretive. It works though, and it keeps the royals safe!
Then how did I get all the way in this bedroom?
You were escorted and let in by the maid here!

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: The bar is made of oak wood. It is finely varnished, though dulled over time and covered with wet drinks.
setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

speech: Hello, Governor! Do you come here often?
Hello, how are you? Oh, I come here once in awhile.
I am doing mighty fine. I am thinking about grabbing a drink. How are you?
I'm doing well, a drink sounds great! Want to get one together?
Of course! Let me grab my husband.
Great! I'll grab a table
Ugh! I guess my husband already left me. Oh well! Thanks for grabbing a table.
Oh that's too bad. Would you mind watching this for a moment? I'll go get some drinks for us. What would you like?
No problem! I'll keep a good eye on it.
Thanks, I'll be right back.
Thanks! I'll see you soon.
Here we go.. *gives drink*. Now, what brings you to the bar on this fine day ?
I was hoping there would be a show on tonight. That's why I put on one of my favorite dresses. How about you?
I'm under a bit of stress at work, due to the order's of the king, so I just needed a break and to escape for a while.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: I've had enough of your belly aching!
Please let me explain my side of the story!
Did you just hit me?  You must not value your life scum.  I would call you a rat but that would insult the rat over there.
This gloomy dungeon is no place for a lad like me.
You get back or you'll be dead in a flash.
Give that back and show me the way out. My family needs me.
There...you're locked in for good. I'll be seeing to it that you aren't let out in the yard time due to your behavior.  You can save your story for when they bring you to plead in front of the King.
I guess I have no choice, but to break out of here then.
I'll watch you struggle against your chains until you tire out, then I will whip you with this belt.
This rat is the only friend I have in the underbelly of this castle.
The rat doesn't even like you.  You have no friends.
Don't you have family?
I do have a family, that I will go home to tonight, unlike a common criminal like you.
You don't even let me explain my side of the story.

setting.name: Troll's bridge
setting.description: Muddy and murky waters lie under a bridge that seems to go nowhere. It is made of cobblestone and just as long as it is wide. Beneath it live a hideous troll that makes people pay to cross.
setting.background: The troll has lived there for ages. It is a myth that he was cast there by a witch. Other's believe he so ugly that he was thrown away by his parents and he learned magic that gave him eternal life. He guards the cobblestone bridge and terrorizes people

speech: hello
People! I never see no people out here!
Hold on.. what brings you here in the first place?
This is troll bridge! I live down here. And you?
You live here? what sort of creature lives under a bridge?
Well, a troll of course! You aren't scared of me?
I am scared of nothing! You havent heard about me I guess
I don't hear much of anything. Nobody comes this way. Who are you?
I am part of a family living in the village. My family has lived here for generations. We live to serve the king. My father was one of the king's royal subjects.
Well, ooh la la, mr. fancy pants!
You make fun of me? Don force me to hit you with this rock
Hey, calm down, guys! Sure, I'm big and hairy. But I just wanna be friends!
Very well then. Tell me what you love eating
Whatever I can get! Deer, fish, dogs, kittens, anything!

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Hello
Ugh, you again.
I will be all over you boy!
Boy? Who you calling boy? I could break you like a twig!
I am in charge of protecting the gates of the castle. I like to weild my sword and wear my armor. I am brave and I am willing to die for my king. I am not your equal
Yeah, yeah. Let's see you act that brave when the Queen is not around. -smirk-
hahahaha..I will severe off your head
It'd probably be better than being locked up in the smelly dungeon.
A part of me actually feel sorry for you..I mean, staying all there alone
Don't feel sorry for me. Hello, I am a criminal.
thats fine...what brought you here?
I have a case of sticky fingers, if you know what I mean,
You steal !
You find my crime boring, do you? I could take your sword and you'd never know. Stealing is an art!

setting.name: Underground Chamber
setting.description: This location is very gloomy, damp and magical. Has a lot of geodes and various types of crystals.
setting.background: Not just anyone can enter into this underground chamber because it is guarded by mystical lions.

speech: Hi there. What brings you to this chamber?
I come here from the nether realms. You must have summoned me.
Ah yes I did! It took awhile because I did it a few days ago. Did you have to go through a lot of obstacles to get here?
There are no obstacles in the nether world.
Well I summoned you to help make this Chamber a lively place. Right now it's very gloomy and dark.
I am not a decoration, wizard. You have abused your magic.
I work for the king of the castle and I am mighty. I did not abuse my powers.
Then surely you know that when I am summoned I must feed on a sacrifice to maintain my physical form.
Well let me deliver you a sacrifice then.
Hurry now, it should have already been prepared. I feel the fading.
How about I just give you the crystal of healing?
Fool! Your crystals provide me no sustenance!
This crystal is one of the most powerful crystals known to mankind.
I am no mere man.

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Everything is well around the church, father.
Im gald to hear that my son, I am really worried I need to purify the church before the king gets here and he can get here any second
Is there anything specific I can help you with?
I think you can, here hold this wine and help me recite the sacred words
Father, are you sure I am ready to be exposed to the sacred words. They are a highly kept secret.
I think you are  ready, we dont have another choice, I am confident in your ability my son, I will be with you the whole time
Alright, I trust you. You have been very kind to me during my time here at the monastery.

agents: young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree

setting.name: Royal Gardens
setting.description: Lined with rose bushes that look as if they have been watered by the God's, the Royal Gardens is a beauty to behold. An intricate labyrinth made of shrubs is at the center ending with a fountain. There are various benches on the sides of the rose bushes and a small lake in the back drop.
setting.background: The Royal Gardens were conceptualized by the late great Queen. She wanted a beautiful promenade to walk her dogs and converse with her bed maids about court gossip. It was originally commissioned to be 1/2 an acre but has been expanded as time has gone on.

yea, it is...

the king want to divorce me

There is a woman in her life...
My queen. That is terrible...
It is,  i am at loss at what to do...
Maybe you can find a real man like me...

setting.name: Tree house
setting.description: Its hidden, almost as if the structure is intertwined with the jungle itself up high in the trees to avoid the predatory wildlife below. Build from branches and sticks, held together with twine and vine. The house is quite primitive a single room with only a lamp and small table are inside.
setting.background: A shipwrecked survivor must call this home, with no way to leave the island jungle he has crafted this place to last as long as he can. It would seem he has been gone for sometime, is he alive?

speech: Hi
How did you end up here?
The ship hit a rock ...all the crew members died
I'm sorry for your loss.
Thanks...but I really need to find my way back to the village as soon as possible
Wait, you must be hungry after such an ordeal.
I can eat later, I am all about getting to the village. Can you helo me?
Please eat this first.
thanks for your king gesture
If your going to go to the village you'll need some protection.
You make me laugh. What protection can a fish possibly provide?
This should be enough to fend off the predatory wildlife below.
thanks for your kindness. I appreciate it
No problem lad. Take care.

setting.name: Dark Cave
setting.description: Its dark, not much light can be seen in this hollow and empty cave site. Its made of stone that has been here seemingly since time began, the walls are hard as diamond, yet black like darkness itself.
setting.background: Unknown cave happened upon, it seems there are no stories, or tales for this place. It seems untouched by human life, as if the world has kept this secret for itself for centuries. We will be able to tell the first tale of this location.

speech: hi
Hi there...how are you?
Very well...who are you
I'm a groundskeeper for the castle..I wandered in here to see what type of vegetation is here.
ok, what brings you to the dark cave?
ummm...I'm looking for veg...a....tation.   Do you understand me?
I dont. I am in the primitive world. You need to speak in clear language
Here are some flowers to brighten your cave.
these are lovely.
I am honored to meet you.  I will tell the King of your existance.
I will appreciate that. He can come and renovate this place for more people to visit
I will ask him to form a committee to renovate your place and to start a tour group to come to see you and this place.  You will be loved far and wide.
You will do all that for me?
Yes...may I can you...hmmm...you live in a cave...how about "Caveman"...that's it...Caveman.
action: give baskets of flowers to caveman
put baskets of flowers in baskets of flowers

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: What are you doing here?  You must leave at once or risk my wrath
I'm a mighty warrior looking for legendary pieces of fortune! Don't get in my way!
I guard these pieces of fortune.  You must get passed me first in order to suceed
You think I'm scared of you?
I know you think you will defeat me and gain all the treasure but you have not seen what I am capable of
You haven't either! Surrender now or feel my wrath!
You have done it now.  I will defeat you with my fire breathing
Take this you fire demon!
Surrender now or there will be certain death
You speak of nonsense! Do you see the bones in my hair and dangling from my body. I will erase you from this plane of existence in one more fatal blow!
I have hit you with my strong tail.  Now you see I am serious
I lost my breath for a second! Quite a strong blow, but it will take more to topple me!
I know you think you must please the king but think of your family.  You don't want to die and leave them here alone do you?
Don't speak of my family!

setting.name: Rectory
setting.description: The rectory is very fragile and rickety due to age and various periods of neglect. Everything is wood-based and scratched up and chipped, including the beds strewn about. The clergymen would call it "cozy" but the space within is almost claustrophobic.
setting.background: After years of renovations to other part of the complex, the rectory remains the oldest piece of the property. A close-knit order of monks had built the rectory hundreds of years ago as a way to house the workers and perhaps any wayward souls. All who work here, including sometimes the head priest, sleep here.

speech: Hello Father, how are we today?
I am well but I am wondering this morning if we can't take up a collection to fix this place up a bit.
Don't you think we should give it to the poor and helpless?
We are allowed to use a small amount for our needs and we haven't used anything for ourselves in years.
I believe that we should continue to be humble and provide for others.
If you say so...I'll say a prayer...may a kind parishioner will donate some things for us to use.
Thank you father. I think holding our values is very important.
I think I might just be hungry.  I'm going to the kitchen for a bite to eat.
I hope you continue to hold these values into your future.
But don't you keep a mistress...can I not ask for a few nice pieces of furniture??  Have you heard how the King is doing with the on coming battle?
Don;t you dare say i broke my celibacy vow.
But then which priest does that mistress belong too?
I am unsure father.
I'm going to go speak to her and get to the bottom of this.  Would you like to join me?

setting.name: Across the King's Garden
setting.description: Heavily forested with dense undergrowth that stretches for miles. A cool mist enshrouds the trees and shrubs. The sounds of birds chirping fills the air and in the distance, the rumbling of a waterfall can be heard.
setting.background: Often used by the King and his family members for evening walks. It is part of the Kings Land that has been left untouched by man and is only presided by nature itself. It is said that the King often brings his war officers here to discuss secrets and make important decisions.

speech: hi
Your Majesty, what a glorious day it is in the garden now that you have arrived!
Yes, I am back and it feels real good to be back
Where have you been, Your Highness?
I was away for a while, dont tell me you didnt noticed
I heard rumors of your absence, but I try not to pry into the business of others. Was your journey due to an evil doer?
No its not. It was a mission that was necessary to ensure sanity in the kingdom
We are fortunate to have someone as caring as you. But do know, I'm always ready for a battle. I was called to the garden because someone heard a suspicious noise, but I see nothing.
I envy  your courage office..but this mission is not of strength. It was a spiritual warfare
I see. Well, do know you have the support of the kingdom behind you.
The king is fully aware of all the happenings
Yes, yes. He is always abreast of everything.
if I may ask, why do you love the king's garden?
I love the sounds of the birds and the roaring of the waterfall. It brings me peace after all the fighting I see.

setting.name: A battleship
setting.description: It is a glamorous wooden ship.  It glistens like there are diamonds encrusted on the hull.  There are ornate railings on the stairs as it is a massive boat.  There is even a sea monster on the bow, complete with jeweled eyes and gold hair.
setting.background: This boat is abandoned.  No one has been able to board her for centuries and it is under suspicious circumstances that now it appears to have life aboard it.  People watch daily from the shore to see what look like little fairies buzzing all around and inside this ship.

speech: Captain please tell me how I may be of service?
Adventurer what was your name again? I always am seeming to forget.
My name is Alexander!  I am in search of a great adventure and am looking for a damsel who is need of saving
Of course, alexander go look out to see if you see any other boats. Also... you mentioned a treasure map earlier did you not?
This ship is quite glamorous you must be a very important captain!  I will use this telescope to find out where we need to go
Oh yes its the best ship around! I won it from a bet with the king!
lol, wow that must have been something.  Oh!  I see a sea dragon.  quick we must defeat it
A sea dragon! Quick ready the cannons! Where is it?!
It is in the front of the hull!  It is guarding the entrance to the cave where he has captured and held captive a beautiful princess.
This sounds like just your type of adventure! Lets turn the boat and shoot all of the cannons! You adventurer shoot it with your bow!
I will ready my bow and defeat this monster once and for all
Wow that was an impressive shot Alexander! Lets go into the cave now and we will see if we can find this princess.
I am so excited to save this special damsel!  Thank you so much for your help in saving her
Well ill give you all the credit when you rescue her! I hope she falls in love with you, the ladies always seem to!

setting.name: Within the walls of the city
setting.description: The Tower stands tall, built of the best stone with a number of odd runes that only the local mages truly know how to read. Despite age the stones do not crumble, and stand ever vigilante as a watch station for the city.
setting.background: Built as a ever watchful reminder so that the people would know the guard had eyes on approaching danger the Inside Tower was commissioned by the first ruling family of the area. The grand wizard of the area carved runes blessed by the fair folk so ensure that no matter what was thrown against it the tower would stand strong.

speech: Make way, make way! Don't you know who I am? I'll tell you anyway: I am none other than Karest the Great!
You will have to give me more information if you don’t want your head to be displayed on a pike at the city gates. I am a guard here, what are you doing within the city walls?
How dare you threaten the only real mage in this city. You'd better let me through if you don't want me to strike lightning through your heart with my golden staff!
Calm down, fairy boy. Prove to me you are a mage and tell me what you are doing here. If you comply I will even help you.

I'm not just "a mage," I am the only real mage in this city! Have you ever noticed how the stones in your guard tower never crumble, even though it is constantly used? Guess who is responsible for that work!
If you speak the truth, tell me what this runemes
I would but my breath would be wasted. I could say it means "stability" as a whole, but every rune is made of thousands of smaller runes that give it power.
Alright, I believe you. Where are you trying to go? I have been guarding these walls for years, I can guide you.
I don't need guidance from the likes of you. Please just do me a favor and disappear before I make you with my staff.
Thank god there is only one of you. The king will hear about this.
Why are you wasting your time interrogating a respectable great mage like me when there is a literal goblin behind you? What's the deal with that anyway?
This is Doobah, he is my pet goblin. Does such a small creature scare you, o’ great mage?
Of course not, but I know many spells that could make him the stuff of your worst nightmares!
I’ve had enough of you, I thought you were in a hurry. Leave before I change my mind and leave us alone.

setting.name: The Queen's Chamber
setting.description: This is a beautiful room inside of the palace that is decorated with the finest silk and velvet. The color scheme used represents royalty, royal blue, red, green and purple. The walls are covered in gold and in each corner of the room are golden statues of Greek art. The floors are covered in marble, and despite the patterns, shine so brightly you can even see your own reflection in them! There's also a bed big enough to fit five people on!
setting.background: This room inside the palace is the Queen's bed chambers. In this very room lived the previous queens of other eras and where the future heir to the throne was born. It's said in these chambers the Queen performs rituals unknown to anyone outside of the palace to keep her young and immortal. Only royalty and royal servants know the secrets of this place.

speech: Hello madame, is everything to your satisfaction?
Yes dear servant, everything is lovely.  All of you take such good care of me.
Well thank you maam. I am very happy to serve you.
Could you please fetch me a cool drink, dear servant?
Yes of course maam. Would you like a pillow?
Oh yes, please.  Sitting directly on the chair could snag my elegant gown.  Thank you!
Here you are maam. I hope you are comfortable.
*sitting on the pillow*  I am indeed, dear servant.  Tell me dear servant, do you have children?
No maam, Someday i hope too.
I'm sure you will, my dear.  It took the king and I quite some time to have children as well.
Thank you, how are the children doing?
* eyes you oddly as you hug the maid instead of hugging me back*  They are well.  They shall love to see all the jesters entertaining us tonight at the ball.
Sorry i have a bit of a crush on the maid. I wish i could join to watch!
*giggling*  Perhaps she shall be the mother of your future children then?
