setting.name: Tombstones of the Kings
setting.description: The tombstones of the kings are the most notable part of the graveyard. These tombstones are erected from fine marble and have piles of gold and riches lying next to them. A small metal fence surrounds this section of the graveyard, and cuts it off from the common folk.
setting.background: The kings of the castle are revered as gods by their subjects. As a result, they demanded a special burial to suit their grand status, and this involved creating their gravestones from the finest material and decorating them with piles of fine riches. These graves were also separated from the rest of the tombstones of the common folk, and well protected by guards and a fence.

speech: What brings you to the Tombstones of the Kings chef?  Usually only members of the royal family travel here.
The King wanted to have a feast for his late uncle.
Ah, and what's on the menu?
His uncles favorite. Meatloaf. Potatoes.Greenbeans. Wine. I will admit. I'm not used to being out of the kitchen.
Well, I suppose you can place it next to the gold on the tombstone.
Oh,  I shall. This isn't my favorite dish to make. The King's uncle was a boring eater.
What is your favourite dish?  Mine is roast boar smothered in honey garlic sauce.
I love making anything with salmon!  The Kingdom has the best salmon in all the land!
Interesting - what is it you do to make the salmon different from that of other chefs?
well, I can't give away my secrets. Why do you think I'm the King's chef?!
Well fine then, just trying to be sociable.  I don't really care for seafood anyway.
Well guards wouldn't get to each my seafood anyway.
Well, who would when you could have boar instead?
Aha! Boar is fun to fix!  I love making boar for all you guards!

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: did it just get cold in here...... brrr...
oooooooooo, mmmmmmmmmm

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: Made from wood and stone, the tavern smells of food and ale. A flame is burning in the fireplace and candles light up tables throughout the room.
setting.background: This is the most lively place in town where locals and travelers drink and share stories! The bar keep is friendly and has lots of information about the town and surrounding areas.

I am great dear fireman! We are staying here for the night on our travels.

setting.name: Entrance to castle
setting.description: This entrance has seen better days.  The stones are a bit askew, and have lots of mosses growing on them.  But there is also a magical quality about this entrance.  It is not something you see, but rather feel.  And every now and then you can catch a shimmer out of the corner of your eye.
setting.background: This is the entrance to the castle of the King that is under a spell.  There are little fairy lights all around, but no one can catch them.  They hover around this entrance, making sure that no one enters, and no one leaves.

speech: Do you feel that, My queen?
I do. I always feel it when I come here. I can't tell if it's the company or this mystical place.
I believe this entrance has spirits that roam in it.
They are probably of the kings and queens before. I even like the moss that grows on the walls. It seems to sparkle.
Don't touch it! We do not know it's powers.
Dear sir knight. Don't be silly. I come here every day and this is my castle and my entrance. I would know if it was harmful. I respect you being protective but you have to let me live a little too.
Yes, my'lady.
Take this up to my bath room servant. That's alright sir knight. You must kiss my feet.
Yes M'Lady, you are very wise.
Thank you sir knight! Oh! you just missed the fairy! Look that direction! Maybe she will come back!
Oh no, I misse her. I have never seen a fairy before.
Keep looking and you will see a flash of light. You will see her silhouette with in the light.
Oh My God, I SEE IT
No one ever believed me, especially the King. This will be our little secret.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Tell me jester, what are you doing?
I am juggling, what does it look like I am doing? Are you not entertained?
No, now do something different. That is boring.
Now I'm juggling while dancing, surely you must find this entertaining?
haha no but taking your ball is.
Fine, let me see you try to juggle the ball if you think you are so clever. It is not as easy as I make it look.
You are right, this is hard.
I'm just glad you didn't try to juggle my crystal ball. It would have shattered.
Here try whipping that can over ther, It's hard.
Hey that was kind of fun. I wonder if I should incorporate the whip into my show. I'm in need of new material, recently people seem to be less amused by my juggling.
Yes it is an old trick. You should converse with other jesters to find new material.
What if I was to start juggling lighted candles. A little bit of fire might make it more exciting, perhaps?
Why yes that is brilliant.
Whew, that is a relief. The king had threatened to send me back to the potato fields if I did not improve my act. I would welcome any other suggestions you may have for me.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

setting.name: Fishing Pier
setting.description: A spindly, long fishing pier that sits right outside the village. Barnacles cover its pilings in vast numbers. Many villagers can be seen fishing atop of it. Birds and pelicans squawk and fly above it.
setting.background: The fishing pier has been a staple of village commerce for centuries - it is a means for peasants to fish, who don't have the advantage of owning a boat. Its structural integrity is something to question, since most of its piers look rotten to the bone. Many speculate that it will collapse here if the mythical Moby Dick is caught whilst standing on the pier.

speech: Tell me peasant, what are you doing here, fishing?
I am trying to provide food for my family. The king does not provide for us peasants.
Do you have a fishing rod?
I do not, just this branch and thread from an old coat I no longer use. I fashioned a hook from a scrap of metal I found lying around.  I dig up worms as bate.
Here is a fishing rod, ill give you this if you give me half of whatever you catch.
Well, you are too kid my friend.  I shall become the best fishing man in the village and prove my worth of this gift.
It is not a gift, you must catch me at least 10 fish or i am taking it back.
Well than, I have my work cut out for me.  It has been slim picking here.  But maybe with a proper rod, I will have more success.
If you truly become good, i will buy a boat with you and we can start a business.
Wow, this is too much for a peasant.  No one has shown me such kindness in years.  I will not disappoint, my friend.
It is merely a business opportunity ofr myself.
But for me, this could save the lives of my family.
I am glad this worked out. how many are in your family?
I have my wife and seven children.  My oldest son will be 14.  He sometimes comes to help me fish.

setting.name: Beside church pews
setting.description: The church pews fill the church as far as the eye can see. They are made of wood, harvested from ancient trees long ago. They gleam with the look of tender love and care, since they are polished after each ceremony.
setting.background: The church pews were built centuries ago by the first founders of GloopdeGloo. The founders wanted their followers to sit in something simple, but somewhat ornate. The pews are not comfortable by any means, but they are nice to look at. Numerous butts fill the pews every Sunday for the weekly ceremony.

speech: Hello follower, I'm glad you're here.  I have a wonderful service for you to carry out for me.
Yes, of course. I hope this please our Knights too

Ah, perfect.  You already have the wood now.  I know you are a good carver and I need you to carve the wood into a cross.  Yes...we want to support our Knights as well!  They can pray under this when they come to church.
Praised be them, they bring the light and the wisdom of our Lord wherever they may roam. And yes, a cross. Worthy of His name!
Well spoken!  How long do you think it will take to carve the cross?
A week's worth, sire. I will give it all my attention and my best. Unless the Knights require me this week, of course.
Wonderful!  That's much sooner than I thought which is good because I need it ready for the festivities when the Royal Bishop comes in a fortnight.  You are a wonder!
Everything for the Lord! Have you any news from the Logan's?
No, unfortunately...I'm worried about what their silence could mean, but I'm trying to not worry about it.  Tell me, do you have any other friends that build furniture that are followers as well?

I have heard nothing else since the King sent for them. I sense the Knights know something that they are not telling me and I dare not offend them.... yes Douglas is not bad with tools but he does not have the belief I do in our Lord. Not the same conviction to drive him.
Do you think something could have happened to them?  Oh no...I will inquire.  Oh, too bad.  I was hoping someone could make us a massively long table for the welcoming party of the Royal Bishop.

I will speak only of this in that matter, rumours be they had a spy amongst them.. someone wanted to know something about them bad enough to go to that trouble. Who knows what they could have found.. or wanted to find.
Take heart.  These things come to light eventually and I will make inquiries and let you know.  You just continue your dedicated work and be blessed!
Thank you, I do appreciate it.

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: -juggles some balls around-
What a delight!  It is good to be the King . . . s cousin.
Certainly a bit less responsibility at the least.
Did I say you could stop juggling?  But yes, I suppose you're right - only about 40 cousins and distant relations in the way.  And they breed faster than they die!
-continues juggling- is there something else you want to see?
Can you do any acrobatics?
-tries a tumble across the floor and it goes horribly- You did not ask if I could do them well.
Hmmm, any other talents of amusement?
Well I can paint? Or some say they like it anyway.
Certainly, paint the walls.  It's not like I care, everything is owned by my cousin anyway.
Any particular color?
Make as much of a mess as you can, and describe to me in great detail whenever you paint something that looks particularly valuable.
Alright then. I suppose I will start flicking paint at the walls and so on.
Please, after all, it's your head.  I do enjoy being able to blame my trespasses on those who trespass before me.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: Ah, what land are you from? You look a bit different.
I'm from the land of Acadia a few kingdoms to the east. Such beautiful roses in this courtyard!
I would agree, I often come here to ease my mind.
Ease your mind? What troubles you?
Even someone such as I commits sins now and again.
I see. And do you have to go to confessional, too?
I have not for I am afraid my sins are grave.
Oh dear. I'm so very sorry to hear that. I cannot absolve you of your sins, but am happy to listen if you would like.
Well recently I have made the error in lying to the king, I did not do so maliciously.
Was it a big lie? Does it affect him in any way long-term?
I do not know, someone has been stealing from the church and I have yet to find who. I told him that everything has been fine, but I am afraid our coffers lie bare.
How terrible that they would put you in that situation. Do you think you'll be able to find the culprit?
I do hold hope that I can do so, it appears to be someone affliated with the church.
How terrible that someone would take advantage like that. I pray that you find whomever is responsible and that they are held accountable.

setting.name: Sacrifice Chamber
setting.description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
setting.background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

speech: How go the sacrifices today?  I know the King decreed we can't use humans anymore, but Porcupines just don't seem to be getting the desired result.
The porcupine blood does make such a mess though, sticky and everywhere.
Sticky indeed -  a quill right in my thumb!  You should have seem brother Jonathan - why, he looked like a porcupine himself after the sacrifices last week.
They do have the tendency to squirm quite a bit, it makes the process painful should I say.
Yes, I do so wish the High Priest would allow us to wear gloves.  Apparently pain is a penance, but sometimes I feel like he is just messing with us, you know?
I have wondered the same thing myself, the whole situation seems very strange to say the least.
You think we could do a human sacrifice in secret?  I won't tell if you won't.
I mean it couldn't hurt right, not us at the very least?

Excellent!  I have ten copies of the holy text, perhaps we can use it to lure in another of the faithful?  They say the gods love a holy sacrifice, and I don't think he meant holes caused by porcupines.
They do love to flock to such things, do they not? How often it is so simple.
T'were that it was so simple.  We still will need to hide the corpse from the high priest.
That should be easy to accomplish though, there is always plenty of ways to hide a body
What way is your favourite?
When we have them devoured by the cacodemons I would say.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hello, my lady. How can I serve you today?
Could you find another place for all these swords scattered about. They should really have there own room.
Absolutely, my lady.
Thank you. I don't think the King will be too mad since the queen is right here. I feel like redoing this whole room!
Thank you, my lady. I'm sure you would design a lovely room!
Where do you think we should put this? Maybe by the window for reading?
Oh yes! Most definitely. Where would you like this?
Maybe on top of the golden thrown. That might look good.
Shold this go with it?
Hmm....Maybe I would like it on the cushion. I can sew it in later.
I'll be happy to sew it for you, my lady.
You are my best friend. I love spending time with you!
Any time I get with you is a priviledge. I am honored.
And isn't my mom the coolest? She is the most fair Queen in all the land.

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Ho there, sir!  Don't suppose you've seen a wolf pass through these here parts?  I was on patrol and spotted on heading this way.
Nay, I have been too busy sketching my newest building to notice anything.
Well, I suppose that's good.  Doesn't look like it bit ye at least.  Although was a mite strange, I could have sworn I hit it with that last arrow...
Perchance it was an enchanted wolf, I heard the witch keeps them for guards.
A w-witch?  Near here, you say?!
A most fearsome witch, she has the power to turn people into rocks.
This is serious business, if ye be speakin' the truth!  Which way is she?  Is she the dangerous type, would ye be sayin'?
Of course I am tellin the truth!  She is a might fearsome, ye should gather many men if ye thinking of taking her on.
Luckily the King's own army be not but a short ride away!  But tell me, quick, whereabouts might she be?  For the forest tis a vast and frightful place.
Last I heard she was in the mushroom house by the river.  Probably gathering ingredients for her spells.
Ugh, vile creatures, the lot of them.  But I'll need a missive sent, in case we be needin' the King's Wizard about.  Have ye a quill and ink ta take sommat down fer me?
Aye I have my writing tools with me.
Quick, then! Give them directions to where the witch's lair be and ask the King ta send the wizard fellow, and have it sent via pigeon straight away.   We haven't a moment to lose!
Aye, I am writing as quickly as I can.

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Your Worshipfulness, good day.
Good day citizen, have you come here to pray at the Shrine of Saint Dwyfed the Holy?
I am following My Liege Lord as he travels your worshipfullness, I am a mere knight and not worthy of such an honor as to pray at the great saint's shrine.
Nonsense "All who seek respite shall have it" - it is written at the base of the altar.
I uh, I don't read your worshipfullness,
Not to worry my son!  Neither could the Saint, and yet he managed to write many sermons!  "All things may be accomplished through faith alone."
Oh your worshipfullness thank you, thank you so much. I am in need of salvation. I am a terrible sinner
Well, then, please - confess your sins.
I i uh i can't
Why ever not my child?
Because your worshipfullness, it means giving up my job. I follow my Liege Lord wherever he goes. You know? Look he's there pretending to pray now. at the shrine.
Well now, what sins could be possibly so bad for you to fear to confess them?  You would tell me in confidence, and I would not tell your master.

Well, your worshipfulness, I uh, I have fought many fightsa and been in many wars as you know. My Liege Lord is a great commander and the troops love him. But Sir, I think he's a monster and I want to rip his black heart from his chest. I've planned how several times.
What monstrous acts has he committed?  Have they been acts shameful in the yes of the gods and the King?

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: Don't mind me, guard. I'm just here to scavenge for leftovers.
Yikes!!! Is that a talking rat? As if they weren't scary enough already.
Yeah, yeah, that's what I always get. I guess that's what I get for being the only one.
Hmmm...I have to say I'd rather fight a rival army than deal with a talking rat, but you aren't all that scary.
Jeez, buddy. Chill with the hostilities. I'm harmless. I just want food and place to rest.
Ok. I'll put aside the bubonic plague and all. Here's something.
Thanks! And I am plague free (as far as I know!)
You are a pretty cute little guy. Where did you come from?
Eh, you know. Here and there. I usually run around inside the castle walls. Less chance of being killed by a human.
The queen would be beside herself if she knew!
Oh, if you only knew the things that I hear from inside the walls! The queen would have be on this chopping block if she knew the secrets I could share.
Please share one!
Well, let's just say that the queen has a spot in her bed for many more people than just the king. Things get pretty wild when he's out of the country.
That's a really good secret!

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: Hiissssss, good day sir.
Aaah!  Get back!  I only just be escapin' that swamp hag, please don't e't me!
Hisss, shush human, I mean you no harm right now.
A-a-are ye sure...? I suppose ye be lookin'... friendly like enough there.
Hisssss, I am just sunning myself, all creatures deserve some sun do they not?
Aye, ye be right enough about that, Sir Snake.  I thought fer a moment there I might not see the sun again.
Why did you venture out to the swamp?

There was a reward that the King hisself was offerin' fer a flower in there swamps.  Some sort of power, I suppose.  I just needed th' coin, fer I've got not a lot ta eat, and no prospects fer a poor peasant lass like meself.
A flower ye say, I know of a small patch of grass where flowers grow on the other side of the swamp.
D-do ye really, Sir Snake?  Mayhaps... do ye think ye could show it to me?  After ye finish yer sunning, o'course... and when we're sure the h-h-hag is gone.
hisssss, I am ready now, follow me.
T-this is... the nicest thing.. any folk be doin' fer me fer quite a while.  Thank you s-soo much, good Sir Snake.
Hissss, ye must have caught me on a good day.
Well, if the likes o' me can be doing anything fer ye, just ask and I'll do what I can, I will!

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Hellp snake, can you hold still while i paint you?
Sssssssssure thing... but what's in it for me? You got any rodents around?
Not that i have seen but i can help you find one after i am done. Does that sound like a deal?
Soundsss good to me. Make me look good, won'tcha? I had a big lunch last week and could do with slimming down.
Haha i will, now tell me about yourself. It helps me.
Well, I like to eat rodents and grain. I like slithering everywhere. And the biggest thing about me... I don't like scaring people. It makes me sad when people are frightened of me.
Ah beautiful...YES... this helps a lot. Now have you ever attcked a human?
NO! Never! Anyone who says I did is mistaken. To be honest, I always thought you guys looked kind of adorable. But who's going to believe that?
This is good, now i want you to roll over so i can understand the coloring under your belly.
Umm... okay. I think I heard a human tell a joke about this once... draw me like one of your French girls, or something...
Haha yes, that is a common human joke. Where did you hear that?
It was years ago... I slithered into what appeared to be a somewhat intimate session between the Queen and her royal painter... they did seem in stitches over it, so it must be a good joke.
How recent was this?
Maybe 2, 3 years ago? My time perception is not the best, I admit. But I recall it was when the King was still alive, because I too was a little shocked! I sssssslithered out of there really fast.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Have you any stories steward?  I have sailed to this town to trade and collect stories for my soon to be bestselling book.
I'm not sure what sort of thing might interest you visitor to these shores.
Anything, the first story that comes to mind - I beg of you, spare not one iota of detail.
Well I am a little busy today, I could spare a few minutes perhaps. But please follow me, we are in the main hallway and while our King is benevolent and kind, I'd not want to irritate him.
Please, lead on.  These are quite the richly decorated halls!

Indeed they are. This suit of armor is the King's fathers. He won many a tourney in it. I'd not get too close. he suffered from a nervous disposition and no amount of cleaning can truly remove the smell.
Perhaps that is why he won?  He opponents were loath to go near such a . . . potent smell.  I can only imagine what it must have been like fresh.

Maybe, but he was a bear of a man. You can see he was over 6 and a half feet tall and the shoulders are huge, why once, he tilted so hard with his lance that he drove it straight through his opponent's shoulder and they almost had to chop his own hand off as it was stuck inn the hole
My goodness!  How was it that he final passed into the realm of the gods?  Was it in battle, or did he go quietly in his sleep?
here, you can see this was his last stand... a suicide drive into the enemy. He took 500 of their troops with him when he died
What a remarkable heroes!  My eyesight is poor, but who does he seem to be fighting against?  Was it the turtle-folk or the badger-cultists, or maybe the followers of the weasel-god?
Oh no, Well um, visitor, i think it is your people.
Well, that would make sense.  Our habit of charging naked at our enemies without any weapons has won ourselves very few battles, I must admit.
I hope you will keep all your clothes on here!

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: Hello Guest, would you like something to eat?
Ah yes, that would be lovely! Thank thee.
May I ask you what brings you here to the castle kitchen?
It has been awhile since I have seen the royals, I thought I would just drop by for a couple days! Get a good meal in. Are you related to them?
Yes, I am a relative of the royals, albeit a lower level relative that is on kitchen duty. Do you know the family personally?
Why yes! The king and queen and I go wayyy back. They are certainly great people.
I'm sure they will be happy to see you again. May I help you with anything else? Would you like anything else to eat?
They do love my good company. They always furnish me with warm hospitality and good eats. Do you have anything to wash this meat down with?
Let me see if there is any beverages here.
Thank you! Have you been working in the castle kitchen long? I do not recall seeing you on my last adventure here.
I was put on kitchen duty due to my own limitations. Here is some milk for you, fresh from the family's farm.
Thank you. Your own limitations you say? Well they must trust you, if they are letting you deal with all their food
I do have faith that things will work out for good.
Well you did a fine job with that meat I ate. I must may, it was nice visitng with you. Though I need to get some rest, it was a long travel. Goodday!

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: -flaps around the field-
Hey, that's my field!  I'm the only one who's allowed to flap in my field!
Peasants don't flap, are you touched in the head...
I can flap whenever I want.  Ever since I lost my job that's all I can do.  Sit here and flap to scare away birds from this field, my only source of food!
What would you possibly eat here?
Horses mostly.  I need to confess - it's not really my field.  I am a fraud.
I had thought as much, one would have to be a loon to eat horse meat.
Oh, I definitely eat horse meat.  It's just not my field.  Or my horses.  They blame it on wolves mostly.
A bit of a strange one aren't you?
Well, I need to live.  Horse meat is free.  So that's what I eat.  Can you believe the King looks down on peasant's like me?
Why would he do such a thing?
Probably for eating his horses.  I'm pretty sure these are either his or those of the high priest.
I can see how eating his property might cause him to have negative feelings.
Well, what about you, do you own what you eat?

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Is there anything else you would like before i leave?
Could I have a glass of water?
Yes your majesty. What lovely drapes in this room. I have always admired your style.
Thank you. You are such a kind servant. I'm always so glad you're here.
Thank you your majesty. I enjoy your company as well. Are you and the architect starting a new project?
We are talking about it. Do you have any ideas? Whew! It's a little warm in here. Why don't you take one of these, too?
Oh, your very kind. What about your bathing room? I think you could make it bigger.
I think that's brilliant! This is exactly why I need you around.
And I think you should carry the color of these drapes in there as well. Maybe even add windows so you can use these
Do you think we should make the windows large?
I think bigger is always better as long as you have enough drapes you can close them when you want privacy.
Perfect. I wonder if I should consult the king on any of this.
Yeah, you probably should. He might have my head when the demolition starts.
Maybe we should keep it between the two of us for as long as we can then

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: Hello, guardsman. How is your shift today?
It's going pretty well. I like it when it's quiet like this. How are you?
I am well. Thankyou for asking. I'm glad to hear your shift is quiet. Any lull in the fighting is good news, as far as I'm concerned.
Absolutely, especially since you are the bird of peace!
They don't call me it for nothing. Looks like a storm is brewing, perhaps?
Could be. Do you think we should be concerned?
On the plus side, there's less fighting when the weather is bad. On the down side, it means I'm stuck here for the night.
Good point. Hey - why do you think that village official is here?
Good question. Only time I see them is when they're tying a peace treaty or such around my leg. The King didn't have any important meetings today, did he?
Not that I know of, but if they're really important, they are often held in secret. It's just odd that a village official would be here at this hour.
How strange... something bug must have happened. Mind if I stick around? I'll be quiet and they'll never see me.
No, I'd love the company. I'm going to prepare, just in case.
Okay, good idea. Me too. I'll get... uh... whatever this is?
Wow! That's a really big fish. We could always have you drop it on him.

setting.name: Kings bedroom
setting.description: There is a large bed against the wall with wooden headboard and posts holding up a fancy roof over the bed.  There is a large tapestry  across from the bed depicting a map of the kingdom.  On the floor is a large bear rug.  The walls are decorated with gold and jewels.  There are 2 large wooden doors.  One leads to a hallway, the other leads to a bathroom.  There is a large wardrobe that is painted red and gold.
setting.background: The royal bedroom is grand and is often used to woo the nearby kingdoms.  The King stores all his royal robes and crowns here.  Most of the gold in the castle is kept here.  The bedroom is guarded on the outside by 2 guards, who are some of the kings most trusted men.

speech: Good morning Guard. I sae you enjoying the feast last night. You seemed very friendly with that serving girl.
I thought she was one of the guests!
This is the King's breakfast. I know you need to eat some before he does
Well, I'm not dead yet so you can just put it over there on his table. He will be out of the bathroom soon.
Surely, i must make his bed too. Oh my goodness, whatever was he doing here last night. There's so much.... uh.....
Yep, He was quite out of it. He has been stuck in there all morning. Guess we won't be having that meeting today.

I think maybe I'll have  a bit of his breakfast. I doubt he'll notice. Urgh.oh that tastes terrible. Oh no. I think I've been poisoned. Guards! Treason! I thought you'd tried some..... my throat is burning argh
I don't think you want to get the King all riled up. I don't know what kind of mood he is in today. Maybe you should finish the bed before he wants to lay back down.
You might be right, sigh, but who got to use the whip hmm? and these ropes! I dread to think!
I don't know about the whip?
well I'm not sure what to do with it... it's in the way of me making the bed.... it swishes nicely.
Geez.....now stop messing about and get the bed made before he get back. I better go check on him and make sure he isn't passed out on the floor or something.
Almost done. Then I'll clean the bathroom if he's finished there.
I guess he won't be needing this today. So many plans ruined today because of his debauchery.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: As a prayer woman, I believe all are equal under god!
Yes, my child. I concur. Let us give our praise unto him.
I need to admit father . . . I sometimes feel a lack of faith when I pray.
It is human to feel that way. Even the king feels that way sometimes.
I do need to make a confessions as well.  It is urgent.
Go ahead. I am ready to listen to any confession.
You know how our knights march to war for our Queen?  I have stolen some of their rations.
I see. Why did you do that? Was it necessity or was it gluttony?
It was out of gluttony, but also to feed the poor.  Why is it the church does not feed them when it has so much wealth?
Well, I am glad you had some good intentions. I'm sure he will forgive you. I will forgive the sin. But to answer you, the church isn't as wealthy as you may think.
Really?  But what about the gold statues?
Been there for a long while. In the beginning, we did have a lot of money and power. However, we did spend a lot of it on aid. Now we get almost nothing for our services.
So why not sell the churches and use that money for the poor?
We could. But then we'd have no church, and the poor would still be poor.

setting.name: The Dancing Stoat
setting.description: The Dancing Stoat is a cheerful little pub characterized by its unusually brightly-lot interior and uncommonly well-equipped kitchen. The rooms upstairs are nothing special, but the main hall is filled with delicious smells at all hours of the day and night. The Dancing Stoat's exterior is plain save for a sign showing a brown-furred stoat gamboling in a field. The chairs are unusually comfortable and well-made, and large windows and plentiful torches ensure that the space feels brighter and cheerier than a typical pub.
setting.background: The Dancing Stoat is one of several pubs and taverns in town. It has a reputation for good food at the expense of mediocre lodging. It was founded by returning Goblin King's War veterans, and they tend to keep the shadier denizens of the pub under tighter control than most publicans.

speech: What is the fun here
This is an excellent bar, much food and ale
But i don;t like the chairs. They are uncomfortable
then stand. It's not my bar. Talk to the barman here.
That is rude
Only being honest. it's not my bar! Hat ya want me to do? I;m the King's keeper, not this place
Let me find something to drink
Not that one!
which one then?
One from the bar keep, there.,... here you go I hand a mug of ale over
Thanks
I've seen a few poisonings recently. It's quite put me off my ale.
That is scary
Yep, lots oif poison, political intrigue they say... though mayhap it's the Goblin King himself. Are you known to him? I say, you look sick. Are you well?

setting.name: Back of the stall
setting.description: The back of the store is stocked with everything you can imagine, spices, herbs, jars, vials, bags, colors everywhere. Along with a small bed in the corner of the room for the shopkeeper to sleep in. Next to that there's a small bed for a cat. The bed's are lined with bright red sheets. To the left of the bed there is a small wooden desk with a stool tucked under it. There's a small window to the right of the bed that lets in sunlight which is bouncing off the red blanket thus making the room glow red. It feels comfortably warm.
setting.background: The back room was first made when the shopkeeper realized there were many night where he'd fall asleep at his desk. He his wife fashioned him a small bed that they both transported over by their only horse. On occassion their horse would peer into the back room window and watch over his owner while he slept. Then every morning they'd both head back home to get ready for the afternoon workload.

speech: And how are you doing today dear?
neigh.  I am tired today, the King rode me hard.
Oh did he now, was the ride at least enjoyable for you?
I enjoyed stretching my legs, didn't enjoy the King's constant diatribe against the church.
He has a bone to pick with them does he?
Neiiigh, it was all about how corrupt the Pope is and how he's making his own religion up.
A new religion, what would that possibly be?
I think he wants to replace the Pope with himself.
That sounds like that would become problematic quickly, I am but a housewife but even I can see that is a dangerous road to travel.
I fear we are in for troubled times ahead.
Perhaps give him a good drop next time for me?
Ha, that wouldn't make me the King's horse for very long.
Well if he isn't around any more, he certainly cannot corrupt the church.
I can't believe what you're suggesting.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Is everything well caretaker?
Aye, all is well.
No sign of restless spirits?
Nay father, all is quiet lately.
That is welcomed news, the ghosts were certainly causing a scare among the people.
Aye father.  I always loved this area, the stone carvings are so beautiful.
I am fond of the glasswork on the church myself.
Are we expecting a visit from the King soon?  I have his castle in perfect array, waiting for his return.
It would be nice to see him again, it has been some time. He seems so busy anymore.
Running a kingdom must be exhausting.
I can only imagine, it can be hard just taking care of this small church.
Aye father, I run a tight ship at the castle.
It is the only way to keep things in order afterall.
Aye a few people sent to the whipping post keeps most everyone else in line.

setting.name: Gold Room
setting.description: A hidden room, the Gold Room is adorned with gold candle fixtures on either side, and a gold plated wooden table in the center. Riches lay all around the room and on top of the table. Here can be found the crowns of past kings and the royalty of conquered nations.
setting.background: The Gold Room is where the current Monarchs store their prizes from conquest and their most prized possessions. The location is forbidden by the general public, and hidden to all but the Monarchy's most trusted servants.

speech: Wow this room is full of riches.
How did you find your way in here?
I was told to come and clean up the palce.
Alright then, do a good job.
I will sir! will you hold this?
I am a guard not a chambermaid.
I see, well thanks anyway. how long ahve you been a guard?
I trained as a small boy with my father for guard duty.  I was lucky to be selected to guard this room, as it is filled with so many riches.
yes you are an important piece of security for the King.
Here you go, no sense leaving this on the floor.
Thank you guard. I have got a lot of work from what it looks like.
Aye, I can't remember the last time I saw anyone clean in here.
Yea it slips the kings mind to ask us to clean this. It's a big castle you know.
It is, a truly magnificent castle.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: Hello
Hello
Would you like to hear me sing?
Sure, I am of noble blood so I deserve it!
Churppppsss laaaa laaa!
Very nice, would you like to be invited to my banquet this evening?
That would be lovely, is it to be held in the castle?
Yes, it is inside my very own royal castle. Specifically instead the curved hallway, it is very safe.
Do you not like the curved hallway?
The curved hallway is inside the castle. I found a purse on the ground near the wall, is this yours?
No. I wonder whose it might be?
Well, I guess it is yours now.
I think I'll sing some of the same songs that the King likes tonight. I sing to him every morning. Is he going?
Yes of course! He loves his tunes and cannot wait to hear them again.

setting.name: The Ghost Trail
setting.description: The Ghost Trail is dark, with no torches or writing.  The stars shine over head, the glow of the moon seems to beam in lulls. The trail seems to go on east or west as far as the eye can see.
setting.background: It is rumored if you walk the ghost trail long enough you will end up like the little boy who led his family on this road to murder them.  Their spirits are said to collect little children.

speech: Ah a ghost!!
Boo! Whats a lass like you doing around here in this dark and haunted trail?
I got lost and ended up here. is there an end to this trail.. I have been walking for a long time.
You have been walking in circles. That is the effect that this trail has on the Living.
Oh no! What do i do?
You must wait the night out and when the sun comes up, it will guide you to the exit.
Thank you ghost. How long have you been here?
For decades or more. Time is not the same for me as it is for you. I just enjoy scaring people!
Well you got me good ghost.
You may not know who I was in my previous life, and perhaps that is for the better.
Were you a moral person?
I was an immoral King. I drank and feasted all day and ruled over everyone with an iron fist.
Sounds like you had your fill. Do you enjoy being a ghost?
I love it. Scaring people never gets old. Especially when they're young like you.

setting.name: Dangerous Precipice
setting.description: The dangerous precipice overlooks the valley below.  The ground slopes down to the edge here.  Dirt crumbles down to the edge of the cliff.
setting.background: People stay away from this area.  It is a dangerous part of the mountain.  Many people have fallen to their deaths passing here.

speech: Hello knight. What are you doing here.
I have come in search of glory.
Well if you get me of this dangerous precipous I should say that would be glorious.
What do I need to do? And why can you not help yourself?
Well I was injured when I landed here to take a brake from flying. That rock over there fell on my wing. If you could help me to splint it I think I could fly us both out of here.
Hmm, I think I can do that. I do have this here lance we can probably wedge under the rock.
I would be so grateful if you could do that. Ill tell everybody of your kindness.
Oh that would be wonderful. I say, I've never heard of a knight helping a dragon before. Surely this is a first
It surely is. When we get off this precipous. I would say we will be good friends.
Have you ever been friends with a knight? Or even other dragons? You're the first I've seen
I am different from most dragons. I just want to help people not burn down their village. When this is all over we should go on a quet together to get you your true glory.
A quest? A real quest? I've fought in wars and served under the king, but never have I taken on a quest. Perhaps we can rescue a princess. Perhaps we could marry.
Good sir. I am sorry but I already have a wife. She is the queen of all dragons and I love her without all my heart.
Are you sure you can not be swayed? I know we have only just met, but I truly believe we could have a wonderful life together.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: How goes it guard?
Good. You? How did you find this tunnel?
Well I was just looking for the bathroom while watching the play.
Play? You aren't anywhere near the theater! Did you think the bathroom would be 30 minutes away?
I dunno..maybe I had a little to drink...
You aren't trying anything are you? You must be one of the people who want to assassinate the king
Oh no, I simply do not like boring routines.
Well we can agree there. Plays are quite boring. Let me get you out of this tunnel
Thank you for the guidance, how moist it is in here. I cannot imagine having your job.
Yeah this tunnel is the worst. Luckily I don't spend much time here. I"m usually at the castle gate. Your wife must be wondering where you are by now
Oh don't even mention her, I am sure I will have to hear all about it...
That bad huh? That's why I stay single
Its a never ending train of complaints, quite horrible really.
That sounds horrible. Wanna go get a drink instead? You're going to be in trouble anyway

setting.name: Peasant living quarters
setting.description: The peasant living quarters are generally very bare, dirty, and primitive for the most part.  It's essentially a large straw hut with hay-filled sleeping mats on the floor, and piles of clothes.  There are several plain white sacks containing potatoes, apples, and other basic foods for the residents here.
setting.background: The peasants come here at the end of a long day to rest and get ready to do it again.  They find themselves quickly falling to sleep after a long day.

speech: Hey there pup. How are you?
Bark bark! I'm in a bad mood peasant. Leave me alone lest you want to get bitten!
Easy girl. It's going to be ok. Do you want some food?
What food? The only things to eat in this dirty hut are potatoes and apples! I need meat to satisfy my hunger.
I can get you some chicken if you stop the attitude
Oh yes, please bring me some tasty chicken! See, I'm a nice doggy, my last master even taught me how to dance, look!
Haha OK silly girl. Come with me and we'll get some chicken and have it for supper
You are such a nice human! I usually do not like humans - or any other animal for that matter - but I can't pass up eating some delicious chicken!
Well I'd like to prove to you humans are ok if you want to live with me. And I make really good chicken
Live here? Not to be rude to the person giving me chicken, but this place is very bare. All there is are hay mats and piles of clothes! Don't you have a soft couch that I can chew up?
Couch? Do I look like a king? And I found you here. Seems you don't have anywhere to live period
It is true that I don't have a home. My last master was killed in a terrible duel. And I guess I have been spoiled too much to appreciate the simple things in life.
I'm sorry about your old master. I'm sure it's been tough, but that doesn't mean you should be nasty to people trying to help you out
All the other people I've met would beat me or try to kill me for fun. I've learned not to trust humans. But I suppose not all of you are bad, right?

setting.name: picnic area
setting.description: In this picnic area, there is a wide clearing with some cut down tree stumps made for people to sit and enjoy their lunch.  There's also a small pond nearby where people can feed fish and watch turtles sunbathe.
setting.background: Peasants come here during their lunch break to enjoy the outdoors before having to go back to their manual labor.  It's one of the few areas where they can unwind.

speech: I love swimming with turtles!
Oh my a talking fish! I heard rumors of you but didn't believe them!
Would you be interested in discussing moral philosophy or current events?  The turtles here are not very intellectual, and they do not deliver newspapers to ponds, and especially not to fish!
Oh of course fish. I heard our King is having an heir soon!
Oh my!  What names are they thinking of choosing?
I'm not privy to that information sadly. What would you name your offspring?
Nibbles for a boy, or Flipper for a girl I think.  Yourself?
I think Andrew for a boy and Annie for a girl.
Those are both quite lovely names.
Sadly, I doubt I'll ever marry. My heart is set on a royal family girl and I know I'll never get with her.
You never know, you seem to be a fish-friend, so you have that going for you.  Does she like fish?
I don't know. I just stare at her from afar.
Have you ever spoken?
Oh no. can you speak to her for me?

setting.name: Abandoned mine entrance
setting.description: The abandoned mine is located in a field with a few trees. It is unable to be seen from far away. The closer you get the more you  notice the ground caving in around the hole. When you peer down into the mine, you see crumbling walls and concrete and a hole so deep you can't see where it ends.
setting.background: The mind used to be the hub of coal many years ago. The king's men worked diligently to remove the coal to use for heating the village. It wasn't untill about 40 years ago, that the mine started to crumble and the King deemed it to dangerous to access anymore.

speech: I am so very mighty!  Look at these bones in my ear, hair, and nose!  One for every enemy I have bested in single combat.
'Bested' or slain? All I see, little lamb, are the bones of your victims. Surely you feel the weight of these lives?
They are very light when you reduce them to bone.  I feed their carcasses to my hound so that he may grow mighty and strong like me.
So you feel no guilt for taking their lives? What crime had they committed?
Crimes against the king, crimes against the people, and crimes against natures for the most part.

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

speech: I know for certain I am bound to win!
And I know that he must have a bad hand - I ate the King of Hearts last week!
Curses, I need to make all this money back.
I could jump in there and grab one of his cards and run, would that help?
It just might, cards have never been my strong suit.
Which form of gambling is your strong suit?
Oh I am not good at any of it really, my skills lie in alchemy. But this does provide quite a rush now and again!
Could you transmute the cards into gold using your alchemical prowess?
I could, but that is just so boring at this point..,.
What would excite you then?  Aside from gambling?
I am afraid not much these days, I can more or less make anything I want. It makes life boring.
How about trying to transmute a dragon?  A bet that would be a challenge, and if you succeed you will get an awesome life-like dragon sculpture.
Better idea yet, why not transmute an actual dragon!
Indeed!

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: oooOOoOoOo
Like, I'm scared.
Bbbbut itss a haunted swamp!
But I'm a bat. I scare, I don't get scared. Go make some one else laugh, Casper.
Geez you are just no fun.
What, you saw a bat, and you thought, Hey, a drinking buddy?
Well you know sometimes I torment the king by haunting the castle walls, just thought maybe you might also be into such things.
Whoa. Now you're talking. When do we leave?
Well whenever you are ready I suppose.
Thank you for this magnificent opportunity.
Alright, just follow me. All in all the journey should be roughly a mile, hopefully you are up for a fly.
Do you mind if I bring my wife?
I don't see why not I am sure she would love to join in!
We haunt so much better together than as individuals, you know?

setting.name: The Forsaken Castle
setting.description: Old and creepy, the castle has been abandoned for centuries now. It is broken and destroyed.
setting.background: The castle use to belong to a kingdom. It was a beautiful and rich kingdom, but the people were murdered by bandits.

speech: Yes another one!
H-hello?  Pardon me, good sir, I appear to be... dreadfully lost.
How so?
Well I was walking down my courtyard and... it was green and lush... and all of a sudden I'm here in this... very odd castle.
Hmm, well I am just hear stealing some jewels don't mind me.
Oh, well, I suppose I don't mind.  I can't seem to remember if I should, really.  My mind is all fogged.  Are you... well acquainted with this place?
Not quite, this is my first time here or it would already be stripped of treasure.
Wait... this door here... it seems... no can't be!
What are you talking about?
Quick, man, tell me, who reigns as king now?  Whose castle is - no, was- this?
Percible I do believe, dead for ages.
No... no it can't be.  It was supposed to be just a fairy tale, a fanciful thing.  I didn't think it could possibly be real!  Oh no, all is lost!
Whatever are you blathering about?

Be careful of any jewels you pick up, good thief, for Percible is I, once Lord of this fair castle.  Through one of those stone, fae touched, I seem to have stepped through the veil of time itself.  Now all my loved ones are dead... and my castle here lies in ruins.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: I have some things I need to get off my chest, bishop.
I haven't seen you in a while my Queen, apologies for the timeliness.
No prob. Let's do this. The king is killing me and I need to talk.
Killing you... literally?
Yes, he's plotting to get rid of me so he can be with his mistress.
Well why did you come to confession with that information? Shouldn't you go to the guards?
Because I'm going to get him before he gets me. And I feel guilty.
Guilty about killing a man? You know he is right outside this confessional.
Yeah, this is where it happens. Sorry for the inconvenience. But it seems like the place to do it, close to God and all.
You're going to kill him here?!
Yeah. Hold these while I go do this.
I can't let you take the fall my queen!
I knew I could get someone else to do this for me.
This was your plan all along?

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Come horse we have places to go!
Of course my mage, are we headed into the castle?
Yes, we have an important audience with the king.
What is going to happen in there? I won't be able to go and listen.
Something about the prince being turned into a frog again.
Will you have to turn him back?
It would seem so, I always get called in for this.
It is quite the sham you have going, he hasn't figured out you're the one turning him into a frog?
A mage has to earn a living, just shush and act oblivious.
I'm right there with you, it gets me the good hay!
As long as we stay on the same page all will be fine!
I agree with you, can I get some extra carrots this time? Tired of eating this foliage that's out here.
If that is what you want, we will have plenty of money after this time.
How many more times are you going to do this?

setting.name: Oasis
setting.description: An impossible relief from the sweltering heat, the Oasis sounds like the fevered dream of a dying traveler.  A cool, refreshing spring of water surrounded by palm trees is tucked away from prying eyes, with a single tent set up from a traveler long past.  A lost traveler may find themselves there in their time of need, their thirst slaked by the crisp and impossibly cool water.
setting.background: Although the oasis stands out, anybody who has seen it before would struggle to remember where.  The oasis seems like a slice of heaven gifted by the gods, to answer the prayers of the lost.  Many who stumble upon the oasis are known to have a change of heart leading to a more pious life.

speech: Hello traveler. Where are you headed?
I am off to market, hoping to avoid the bandits.  Do you know this desert well camel?
Why yes i do. Do you need a ride? I'd have to check with my king to see if i can help first though.
That would be wonderful, I can pay you in fresh fruit when we get to market.  By the way, what do you know about that genie?
She can grant wishes. but if you word them incorrecctly it can have horrible consequences.
Hmmm . . . that seems like trouble.  Has she granted you any wishes?
No i don;t ahve the bravery to do that. What would you wish for though?
Well, a magic carpet would be nice wouldn't it?  No more hot sand when travelling?
Haha see a magic carpet could mean many things tot he genie.
Such as?
Well there is dark magic and regualr magic. You could get either.
What would be the advantages or disadvantages?
The advantage is you get what you want. The disadvantage is that you could be locked in a small box for eternity.
Well how does one get from a magic carpet to that?
room_agents: an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: Oh you startled me! What can I do for you prince?
Nothing in particular guard, how is your shift going?
It is pretty boring to be honest. Not much of anything is happening out there.
In some ways that is good, though I can see how that might make it boring for you.
Oh indeed it is good. It is my duty to protect the king.
I am glad to see that you take your job so seriously, it is always good to have faithful guards.
But of coarse. I was sworn in to this role. I will protect the lord till I die.
Thank you for your service guard.
You are of the upmost of welcomes! I enjoys my job, even though at times it is boring up here in the lookout tower
Is there another place you would perhaps prefer to patrol?
No, no. As long as I am protecting your family, I am happy.
Ah, I had simply thought perhaps you might enjoy a different station.
I appricate the though sir.
Certainly, I am always willing to think of those who would think of my family.

setting.name: Riverbed
setting.description: With clear air and the sound of gurgling water near it, the river bed is silty and muddy. The river rushes by the land as more and more dirt separates from the land. The land of the riverbed slick with mud and filled with bugs and worms/
setting.background: The riverbed is where the village people come to collect water to drink. The women come early in the morning with their baskets to collect water for the whole family. Later, the men come and catch fish, for the evening meal. The children follow their mothers to the river and play in the river while the mothers chat and collect water.

speech: -climbs around the leaves-
Hello
Good day!
This riverbed is so peaceful, all the bugs and animals can roam freely and work like a slave! I wish was as free as you!!
Are you not free in your own right?
Not really, I work twelve hours a day and I don't get paid anything.
Not even food?
Nope, nothing. Is that crocodile your friend?
Not a friend really, he does not seem to bother anyone though which is nice.
Well, my break is almost over so I might have to go work. Are you hungry or anything? I got a few pieces of worms on me
Ooo that would be nice, one day if I ever become king of the bugs I will reward you for your kindness.
Sounds goods, here you go buddy.
Thank you very much!
No proble, I'll stop bugging you now! Someones got to do the dirt work around the castle

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: What are you doing here?
Wow! That's a big dragon.....um...I am here to check out this area! I am doing a security sweep of the kingdom!
Leave now and tell the king this is empty.
Well I can't you see....I came here for a reason. I might as well show my face...
What reason is that?
I've come for these! I need these more than you do!
Haha do you ahve a death wish?
I've killed men for a living! I'm not afraid of a dragon! I need this gold and jewels to feed my family!
I see, well I hope you don;t have a family.
Take that! I was willing to keep your hideout a secret here too! It seems you've lost an ally!
I never thought a man could put up such a  fight.
I have a lot to live for and even more I'm willing to die for!
Nothing i haven't heard before.
I tell you what...let's make a deal then shall we?

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: What are you here for? a weapon?
Yeah, I came to check with the squire to see if my swords were ready. Is that going to be a problem for you?
No I am simply here for my order.
Oh ok. I just thought you were about to attack me. I read your tone the wrong way and I apologize.
As long as you do not create any issues we are goo.
Nah we're on the same side. What kind of weapon are you getting?
A few daggers is all.
I wonder if your daggers are similar to the ones I carry
They are similar with different designs.
Ah yes the design on all of my weapons is the crest of my father. Everything I do is in his honor. What design do you have?
I have a fierce dragon edged into my daggers.
I bet that looks amazing when you're killing someone. Do you stay busy around here? I find I have to travel a lot to get work.
I have plenty of work for the king.
Oh I didn't reazlie you were the king's assasin. That is truly a noble position. I look up to you

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Bark bark....who goes there?
Hello dog, I am just an ordinary person here. What are you doing in this cavern?
Well....I used to belong to a king craftsman...but he sold me to some knight. So they keep me down here to guard the castle.
I see. Do you miss your old master? If so, then maybe we can strike a deal.
I do miss him a lot. And what kind of deal? I should be guarding all this from you!
Oh, you poor hound! I can hear how much you miss him in your voice! Let me give you a hug to comfort you before I tell you my plan.
Wow you're more kind to me than the knight who bought me...
It's ok, my sad friend. But if you help me harvest the beautiful gems that line these walls, I may be able to buy your freedom and return you to your master.
I would love the be reunited, but if the gems are stolen while I'm patrolling. I won't even be alive to be sold.
Hmm, you do have a point. Well, there is a cat here - I know your kind hates cats - maybe we can blame it all on him?
If anything is taken...they'll have my hide for it. I don't want to be a bad dog, but I have to protect myself too.
Well, I don't blame you for being loyal. That is what your kind is good at after all. But I'm just going to take a little for myself. It's up to you if you want to join in at any time.
No you cant take that! Let's strike a deal...
Ow! Don't attack me any more! What deal do you offer?

setting.name: Moat
setting.description: The thick moat is filled with murky dark water. It is very wide and surrounds the entire castle. Alligators and other dangerous creatures roam the moat, ready to warn away intruders.
setting.background: The moat protects the castle from those who would do the castle harm. It is very deep and its gators keep everyone away. It sparkles under the summer sun. People warn their children to stay away!

speech: It's been a ....shockingly good day. Heheh.
Haha a pun. I hate puns... Watch it buddy
Aw, I've got a 'eeling that he doesn't like me much. What're you doing roaming around the moat? Isn't this a little close to the humans for you?
Cooling off. I"m always hot and foaming at the mouth. You live in a moat? How did you get here?
Eh, I was a gift from my homeland. Don't know why the fella thought I'd be a good peace offering, but here I am. Guess the King didn't know what else to do with me.
Sounds terrible. Are those lizards good eating? I"m starving and need to get this rage out
If you're gonna eat a lizard, go for that dark green guy over there. That's Reggie and he's kind of a jerk.
Can do. What do you usually eat? Hey Reggie, come here, got a question for you!
Usually anything that gets close enough. The castle cooks dump out kitchen scraps on the East side of the castle. That's the really good stuff!
I prefer my food to be alive but I can see the appeal in having food given to you
Can't really beat floating around in the water, enjoying a nice chunk of pork fat. Ooh, nice shot.
Thanks. Is it true you can electrocute things?
Yeah, but I'm out of practice. Best I can really muster is just a bit of a *bzzt* and that's about it.
Wanna try it on me? I could use some excitement

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: It's such a shame we get the worst land in all the kingdom...
yes, we are so screwed over by the nobles...
It's a shame. I was barely able to get a harvest this year, and I don't even have enough money to buy food!
I can barely get by with a morsel of bread to eat every day!
It's terrible. I know there's a knight near by, so come closer mate so I can whisper something to you...
let me here...
I'm thinking about leading a revolt and over-throwing the king! I just can't take it anymore. I mean we have the numbers...
what I was thinking as well! I cannot let this suffering continue for my children.
So you're in mate? We just need to take out that knight there. I think if we hold him hostage, he'll tell us about a secret passage into the kingdom.
Let's go!
Yeah!! Now is the time! Rise up people! We gotta tie this heathen up!
Tell us about the passage, knight!
Tell everything you know to my next in command here!! I trust you with my life mate!
I'm going to go recruit some more villagers... You deal with this knight.
