setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: The banquet hall is like something you've never seen before.  It has gold encrusted tables and chairs, complete with embroidered tapestries and covers all over the floors.  The silverware is even made of diamonds as are all of the plates.  The ceilings are high wooden beams that glisten.
setting.background: This is the banquet hall of the King.  And he gives amazing dinners here for certain distinguished people.  But lately this room has been quiet, as the King is under a sleeping spell.  And interestingly enough, this room is now attended by tiny fairy lights that no one has yet to be able to capture.

speech: Ahhh a baby shower! I am so delighted to be here at you.
Thank you so much for inviting me. The banquet hall is absolutely beautiful!
Well I am the guest of honor and you are my celebration so of course you are here. I cannot wait for my little one to arrive!
Me too, I wonder if it's a boy or a girl.
Well the medicine men all say it will be a very strong boy so I am hoping. Truly i Just want it to be healthy.
You are right, all that matters is that you and the baby are both healthy after the delivery.
This is true. The King is so anxious waiting the arrival but he would never say so of course. Ahhh I just love the decorations here!
Thank you, you deserve only the best. Would you like fresh milk with some seedcakes or bread with butter?
Ahhh bread with butter and cold cold milk sounds delightful! I haven't wanted odd things but I do appreciate milk when I can get it. The cake looks good too..
Why not both, you are eating for two after all. I will fetch your favorite diamond silverware.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: Long, wooden pews are positioned one in front of the other from the front of the room to the back. There are ornate stained glass windows on each side depicting the steps in the Crucifixion story. A long, red runner goes up the middle of the room to the altar.
setting.background: The nave was beautifully decorated and was a wonderful place to worship. The priests would go up and down the aisle to collect the tithings from the congregation every Sunday. The room was almost like an echo chamber in that when the congregation would sing it would sound like there were ten times more people than there actually were.

speech: take off
Excuse me?
I want the coat
Have you seen my spectacles?
Yes they are good
Are you new to speaking english? I can read you some lessons.
Yes that would be nice
Here is your very own bible.
Put this bible on the altar, I already have my own bible.
I am glad. God loves you.
The wolves must be put to rest, pray with me that God lets us hunt well
The wolves are back? Mon diux!
Take the clothing of the King on the hunt with you, we must stop the wolves from attacking our herd.
As you wish. My eyesight is poor but I shall help however I can.

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.

speech: Dog, what are you doing in the boathouse here? Do you think yourself a sailor now? Ha ha!
Not a sailor, just a dog taking a nap in the boathouse. Are you going sailing?
I am doing more than just sailing. I'm boarding one of these boats floating here and going to battle! Do you not know who I am?
No, who are you? You aren't one of the monks I live with. Grrr, try to pull this rope from my mouth!
I have no time to play with a mutt like you. I am the prince! Now give me that rope so I may load my ship.
Oh my liege, please pardon me! Where are the rest of your men?
That's a good dog, you recognize me now. My men are out on one of the other boats here. They're finding young maidens that will keep me company until the time comes to marry the princess.
Hey Hey. It's good to be the Prince! Lovin' the ladies. Hmm, do any of them have dogs?
Yes, there are some hounds with us. But they are highly trained dogs of war. You would never impress them enough to even get a glance from one.
Hey, I've got skills you don't know about, your Highness.
What skills do you have? Tell me and I may have use for you in my ranks.
Well, I stole this rope from you without you noticing it. Plus, I can yodel.

You're right, you did! And you can yodel!? Well, I may have use for you as a spy then! Seeing as we are set to invade nations where yodeling is common, you could impress their king and gather information.
No, that sounds like too much work for me. I usually just lay around all day, because I'm older than I look. But I would like to visit with your lady dogs before you leave.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: The courtyard is a huge pavilion of stone patio outside of the palace. It is in the shape of a large rectangle and boarders the west end of the palace. It is bordered in luscious hedges dotted with colorful flowers, particularly roses. Throughout the courtyard there are potted flowers, stone benches, statues and bird baths and fenced garden plots, and also a central atrium, that all evoke the feeling on an Arcadian garden.
setting.background: An ancient king and queen, when they had just been married, built a new summer palace. The king let the queen design the beautiful courtyard as a gift. From then on, the courtyard had been one of the most famous, beautiful focal points of the palace.

speech: The lavender in the gardens soothe my troubled mind...
What is it that is troubling you?
As you can see, I have grown old and very tired. I fear that it will be my time to depart this world very soon.
Has it been a good life?
It has been a long one, full of conquest and progress, defeat and misery alike. I have brought you here to answer if you think I should be judged good in the next life.
I cannot see a reason why you would be judged any other way, the lord shows mercy to those who make the effort to follow their path.
It troubles me so, that I may have fallen short...only to realize it too late.
What makes you feel that you have fallen short?
Not any one thing in particular. It just troubles me in the back of my mind. Why is this happening?
I cannot say, do you have a sin to confess?
No, only a mind that doubts itself. I had always thought that I could make peace with Death, but now I am not so certain.
I can imagine it can be a looming thing were it not dealt with early in life.
Have you managed to make peace with knowing that your time too will end, Cardinal?
For the most part, though there is a sin I must confess I did recently lie to our king.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hello fellow guardsman, how goes your patrol tonight?
All is well in the Kingdom. At least on my patrol
Say, do you know why there is a wench lying on one of the beds here in our barracks?
I think Pete brought her home in a drunken stupor.
Good old Pete! That is something he would do! What a character.
He always gets the scary ones too, this one is missing a tooth.
At least she's no threat like those ogres we faced last week. I think I can put away this shield and finally get some rest. Though the smell in here is worse than ever!
Its always bad, it's even worse when it gets warmer out. It seems like there is another stench I haven't smelled before.
I think it's coming from inside my helmet. Here, I'll remove it. Can you take a look inside and see if anything's in there?
Did you put your lunch in it or something?
Not that I know of. Look closer, there might be a strange creature that crawled in there.
Is that a stink bug
I'm glad that's all it is. With all these attacks lately, I've grown a bit paranoid. I sometimes even think something is going to jump out of that chest over there.
I know what you mean, I've had a hard time sleeping lately, I keep having a dream that someone kills the king and I don't get there in time to save him.

setting.name: The Ball Room
setting.description: Large and extravagant, the room is adorned with crystals, polished gold and sapphires. There's long tables with beautiful silk table clothes covering them. Plush chairs line the tables. In front of each table is plates made from fine China, next to the plates is sterling silver silverware laid upon a pure white napkin. There's a stage where there's 2 thrones overlooking the table. The whole ceiling is large and adorned with chandeliers and garnished with gold accents.
setting.background: This room is where many formals take place. It was built for the king many years ago by the finest of craftsmen. It is used to host many formal dinners, dances, and concerts.

speech: Is that you? What are you doing here?
You know me?
Yes, you're a mayor no? We've met before!
Oh, yes! Before the revolution in the colonies. What have you been up to?
Just enjoying my win in the election, I'm the president now!
Yes ... voting .... what a strange idea. How do you have any order without a King?
We work in a democratic system overall, going by the will of the people apart from larger matters like war.
Rule by the Mob?!
Well their vote isn't the end all be all but you get the idea.
Well as ... exotic as I find the notion. In the interest of diplomacy, I give you the Key to the Village.
Well that is very kind of you, sir. I will be sure to keep in contact after this.
Indeed. Long live the President!
Likewise for you, sir!
Do you have a gift for me?

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Hello there, prince. How are you today?
Well enough. My father is sleeping, I see. Far be it from me to expect him to hold to our meeting.
Yes, he surely does love his sleep doesn't he?

As much as he loves his drink and his novels. Do you know how long he has been asleep? If he fell asleep only recently I had better choose a book and wait. I don't want to miss him again when he wakes.
I believe it was around 45 minutes ago, but I could be wrong.
Good grief. HE is the one insisting I marry, and yet he will not stay awake to meet with me about prospective brides.
It certainly doesn't surprise me after all that he has done before.
Yes. Though you probably shouldn't say that to anyone who isn't an entirely frustrated me. You're likely to lose your job. In another court, perhaps your head.
Yes, I am very careful with who I criticize the king to.
Anyone else wouldn't think so! I am, after all, his son. But we are allies against a common, insufferable enemy here, I think.
I can get on board with that, just don't tell this to anyone else!
I am not so cruel, you know that.
I know, but even if said on accident it would cause great outrage.
Yes, but such accidents from someone of my position are quite heartless, don't you think? Or at least thoughtless, and as you also know, I am very thoughtful.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: With this diamond, we won't have to worry about food anymore!
Shhhh! Not so loud! You'll alert the guards! We must flee this place, child! Wizard! Keep your promise and teleport us out of here!
The wizard appears to be sleeping... what should we do?
What magic is this?! Did the diamond have a curse, like we feared?! Oh dear... nonononono! I cannot be caught here! I will not die here so close to a life of luxury! Wake up, wizard! Wake up!
Take the diamond and try to escape first. I'll try to wake up the wizard.
I cannot leave you here, son! Not after we struggled so hard to get this far! There must be a way out! There simply must!
There's no other way... unless we leave Wizard. But he has helped us on our journey, and we can't simply abandon him either while we make our escape.

...you.... you are right. You are right! Very well! I will carry the Wizard while he recovers. Hold the diamond for me as I attempt to lift him! Meanwhile, see if you can find a window overlooking something we can jump out onto.
There is a window next to the King's throne, but we're several feet high. Unless you think the King's cushion might break our fall?
Would have to be a lot more cushions for how high we are up... how about tying the tapestries into a rope?
Okay, I'll leave my bag to the wizard while I grab and tie together the tapestries. The guards are currently escorting the King to dinner, but he should be back in 10 minutes.
OOoooofff! The Wizard sure is heavy for such a frail looking old man! Will the tapestry be sturdy enough to hold us?
I'll throw some cushions down just in case, but we're dead either way if we're caught...
I suppose... nothing left to lose... just like when we started this whole mess...

setting.name: Quicksand Pit
setting.description: A large, gurgling pit of quicksand. Many adventurers and poor critters lie at the bottom of the pit. The pit is surrounded by an extensive swampland and is shielded by the many trees and shrubs that surround it.
setting.background: The quicksand pit is relatively unknown by villagers because those that fall victim to the pit never make it out to tell its location. The pit swallows up 100 villagers a year on average. The villagers chalk up this statistic to a monster known as Bigfoot, snatching and eating people up while they sleep.

speech: Somebody help!  I'm sinking!  Please, somebody, anybody!
Here you go
Please, pull me out! I think I'm sinking deeper!  Please, bigfoot!
Here, grab this instead.
Thank you, bigfoot.  I thought my goose was cooked for sure this time.  Whew, I can't believe I escape Aurelia, Terminator of Critters in the castle and quicksand in the swampland in one day!
Sounds like quite the day indeed. How did you get stuck in there?
I was trying to escape the castle, the king issued an order that all critters be "removed"!
That's an odd request, but I can see how it might've led to that.
What brings you to these parts, bigfoot?
Just roaming around looking for some food.
I can dig that, speaking of my stomach is rumbling.  Let us search together?
I am more of a loner... but I suppose I can spend a bit of time here.
Thank you! I am so lost and alone out here, this is nothing like the cozy castle to the North.
No need to cry, you get very used to being alone.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: What is being made in this here kitchen?
I brought boar that I hunted in the forest
Oh, well it smells delicious! How are you preparing it?
I do not prepare the meat I hunt the meat
Ah, well that is fair. So are you a hunter or just on the side?
I am the village hunter, this is what I do every day
That sounds so fierce! I am just your average village woman, really.
Oh really, you don't look so average.
Ohh, you don't think so?
You know, I don't have anyone to call mine and you sure are a pretty thing. I would always keep you warm and fed
My oh my, sir, we have only just met! You are quite handsome yourself though...
It is not uncommon for people to run off and get married. When you find a good lookin lady you don't want someone else to sweep her off her feet.
I suppose that is true, seems like everyone nowadays is getting married.
I think my mother would love you, would you like to have dinner in the tavern, the king gave me my pay for the boar, I can buy you lunch.

setting.name: Ruined house
setting.description: A dilapidated wooden structure with a caved in roof and debris everywhere.  Even the trees outside the house are falling apart.  There's waist high grass leading to the house along with a dirt path.
setting.background: This used to be the room of a wealthy noble.  However, due to his poor business decisions, he was forced to flee and leave his home in disrepair.  Vagrants have come to stay over the years and loot whatever was inside.

speech: What are you doing here, human?
What a dump? Is this your hovel? It's a pathetic place to live even for a snake.
Oh no, this is not where I live. Then what are you doing here, damned human ssssscum?
The King gifted it to me. I may have to turn it into an orphanage it certainly isn't suitable for much else.
Well he certainly doesn't think much of you if this is what he giftssss you!
Everyone thinks highly of me. And they should. I am special.
I can already tell without you saying a word that you are nothing.
So says the poor, despised snake. Jealously is such a petty emotion. Even for a snake.
I have a family and more than enough purpose in life, unlike you.
I always take the high road. Be the better man because I am the better man, is my motto.
Apparently not, you came to me and immediately inssssulted me!
Insult? I would never insult anyone. I was merely commenting on your station in life.
What a joke that is, calling my supposed home a dump is not an inssssult?
It is a dump! Just because it isn't a palace like my abode doesn't mean you should get mad at me about it.

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Do you have my goods shop keeper?
Depends what goods you are seeking!
The supplies for my voyage. The king is expecting me to set sail soon.
Well let me know what you need and I can take a look,
I sent a list over with your assistant yesterday. If I don't get underway soon the weather won't be in my favor.
Hmm let me go have a look for that list then, sorry for the inconvenience.
Even worse than the weather is sea monsters.
Sea monsters you say?
Aye. They tend to live in storms. Bet you don't believe in them though do you landlubber?
I thought they were just the stuff of legend, is all!
I nearly lost my boat and my life to a sea monster last year.
What kind of sea monster? Also let me get you those supplies!
The worst kind. It was terrifying.
Well hopefully you find that they are not real and that it was fully explainable!

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: This is a plain room with many pieces of armor and equipment lying about.  They are seen on tables or stored in heavy trunks.  There's racks of plain clothing worn before putting on armor.
setting.background: This is used to store equipment used by castle guards in case of sieges and invasions.  Careful attention is paid to make sure the gear stays in top condition.

I am but one spider, and I could keep an eye on the armory and keep bugs away.

setting.name: Grand Ballroom
setting.description: There is a large marbled floor with ornate inlay-ed floor decorations.  The ceiling is tall and also ornately decorated with beautiful plaster decorations that touches by gold lining.  The space is high and well lit with many windows but has a dark musky smell.
setting.background: The Grand Ballroom was once a place of great meaning where all royal celebrations were held.  There were often hundreds of important people to the realm in attendance just to get a glance at the royal family.

speech: Hello what is your name?
What's it to you?
I am the daughter of the Queen and King, you will tell me who you are because I say so.
Oh are you now? Well I have no respect for you!
Because of me there will be peace in this land. I can have you arrested for speaking to me that way.
You can try, but I have never been caught or arrested before and today certainly won't be the day.
Maybe I will make you pay a fine instead
How dare you steal from me!
Gaurds! This man attacked me, the Royal Princess was attacked!
I did no such thing! I'm out of here.
No you don't!
Take the damn jacket, I'm just taking it off to not weigh me down!
I don't know what your problem is but I just wanted to know your name, you disrespectful person.
All I said was what is it to you and you disrespected me and tried to force me to tell you!

setting.name: Debtor's Prison
setting.description: A dank and dark prison located in the tower of the castle. There is a single bench made of stone and a bucket for eliminating waste. There are no windows and the prisoners never see the light of day.
setting.background: The debtor's prison is where the King locks people away for not paying their debts. They stay in the tower until someone can repay them. If no one does, then they stay there till they die.

speech: Any spare cheese today?
Not today. But maybe I'll get some for you in a bit.
Any fun prisoners to torture today>
You know, I can't be seen talking to you. They'd think I was nuts.
It's not my fault I ate a magical mushroom and started to talk. I didn't curse the food.
Well. I know.
So how has your day been?
It's been lonely. I don't know why I do this. I guess so I can afford to eat.
You know I could help you get some secrets around here so you can get a promotion or something.
Like what?
That Pete guy has been feeling up the kings daughter for a couple months, he has a way better job than you do.
Pete? I never thought he would be up to such a shameful thing.
I mean the King would have a hay day with that, all you would have to do is point it out to him and he would reward you.
You know, I should. But I don't have any evidence.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Order, order here
Order.
Stupid donkey that is mine
Sorry.
I know your a silly thing, but I like order
But this is a horse field. There is always disorder.
Not while I am around, I always demand order and I will have it.
So, what do you want from us?
I need to get a horse for the ceremony, can't you tell
No. I couldn't tell. I'm no horse.
This little filly will do just fine
I'm gonna go walk through the forest.
Sorry donkey I would take you but the King wants a horse.
I'd rather be in the forest so don

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: Why are you here?
I have no where to go, I stay in the cemetary sometimes.
That is unacceptable. Do you need work or something?
Yes ma'am I wish I had a job, I barely eat
And what was the last job you worked?
I have not had one, I know the king looks down on me. I have tried but looking like rags no one will hire me.
I guess that raises a problem. What job would you do?
Anything I am able to do. I am a hard worker, I have had to scrape to get the little food that I have gotten, it has not been easy
You could join the soldiers.
I am much too puny, they take one look at me and laugh
You don't need to be strong, you need skill.
I wouldn't be able to stand with the armor on ma'am
Trust me, they'll take good care of you. It's your choice.
Trust me my lady, I have tried and they didn't allow it, maybe in a year or two, but not if I don't get any food to get some strength

setting.name: Flower Field
setting.description: The flower field contains acres of wild growing flowers that are a bright pink when they are in bloom. There are woods surrounding it, but no trees in the field, only flowers. There are paths that work their way through the field.
setting.background: In the springtime you can often find women out picking flowers and children playing. People often wander the paths to clear their heads.

speech: Oh what a beautiful day.
Hi bird. Can I have food?
I only have this worm. you can have it if you like.
I don't like it much. But I appreciate it.
I know...A bit salty.  I love it here. The flowers are so beautiful.
I like to steal food from the village. But I thought I'd come here to find food.
That was all the food I have at the moment.  I can fetch more worms.  I love to sing.  Want to hear my song?
Okay. I like bird singing.
Tweet tweet tweet tweet...This is a song of the queen and the king. Do you like it?
It was good.
Why thank you. I practice day and night.
I wonder if twigs are edible.
Not that one child...it is poison!  Try the blue berries over there.  I've seen others eat those.
I almost made a mistake

setting.name: Church Garden
setting.description: The church garden is filled with a variety of useful plants. There are many flowering plants. There is a lot of food grown in the garden. There are carrots, tomatoes, strawberries and a variety of other fruits and vegetables. Fruit-bearing trees provide shade for the garden. The plants are arranged in neat rows. It smells sweet with the flowers. Different colored sticks show the different plants.
setting.background: Many villagers benefit from the produce of the church garden. The fruits and vegetables are used to feed the poor and the hungry. Many people would starve if they did not get the produce from the church garden. They are used for celebrations such as weddings as well. The flowers are used in ceremonies.

speech: Where does this staircase lead to?
ooooooh! I am the magic staircase! Hahaha, I lead where one cannot imagine!
That's very nonspecific. We villagers are not allowed to leave the village, so I would like to know where you lead
Have you no respect for magic?! The King himself graces me with his footsteps every day!
Wow, okay, what a cranky staircase. You must not lead anywhere good
If you must know, I lead to the 2nd floor!
Give me back my purse!
Finders keepers har!
I'm going to steal in back!
Hahahahaha, mine too now peasant!
You are an evil staircase!!
I am all powerful hahaa! Just don't leave the area and I'll slay you!
You're a staircase!! You can't kill me
Have you forgotten the magic, fool!?

setting.name: arrow house
setting.description: A small shed with an earthen floor, holds two tables upon which rests neatly arrayed wooden boxes, each of which holds a score of newly made arrows. A third table holds several more large boxes, wherein spent and damaged arrows are placed, so any part still serviceable may be harvested. A few worn practice bows hang upon the walls and a small number tools, as well as replacement strings and polishing equipment rests in boxes under the shelves. Another set of neatly arranged boxes contains newly made parts, for the Fletcher to transform into viable arrows. A small wooden chair completes the furnishings.
setting.background: An old Fletcher carries out his duties, smiling dutifully and politely at the archers and other visitors to his arrow house. He is constantly working, though is known to entertain extended visits from specific masters and the court jester. A master of archery in his own right, it's commonly said that no one in all the land can out shoot him. In spite of challenges, taunts and pleas, he refuses to shoot an arrow, save for when testing bows or new types of arrows.

speech: Why does an archer draw a bow?  Because for swordplay, they are too slow!
Funny man.  We have a funny man here.
The man with the arrow laughs as me!  How fortunate then that I have farted at he!
Alright funny guy.  You got me.
I bent and let out a toot!  And now I dance on my other foot!
Now what dancing fool?
Me?  A dancing fool?  Now where did I leave my stool?
Argg. Did you come here for a reason?
The King thought I would be a delight!  Please don't run away in fright!
Now I have your ball.
On no, not my ball!  I used to throw that at the wall!
Arg, will nothing stop your incessant rhyming?
Perhaps thou dost protest too much?  Why do you tremble at my touch?
You're lucky I don't run you through with this arrow.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Oh wooo is me. I am innocent!
Guard quick! We've got an innocent man here!
Yes.... I have been wrongly accused
Ha! You peasants are all the same! You committed a crime, now its time for your punishment!
No truly! I have been wronged! I did not commit a crime
Oh really? And what were you accused of exactly?
stealing a lamp
Stealing! Why I'd cut your hands off myself if you were in MY Kingdom! King Jimothy has certainly gotten softer over the years!
But I didn't... it was the stable boy and he disappeared before anyone saw him
Why would anyone risk their life over a simple lamp?! Your story just doesn't make any sense!
It is the truth! Think about it, why would I tell such a simple truth if it weren't true
Very well, I may be far above you but I am no monster. What is the name of this stable boy?
His name is noah!
Noah? Noah Turk?

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Hello, faithful servant.
Good day your Highness.  May I say it is a lovely day today.
It is, indeed! Thank you for coming out to help today. I can always count on you.
It is my pleasure your highness.  Are you looking at a particular flower for your wedding?  They are all beautiful.
I'm always partial to daisies. What do you think?
They are lovely and sweet as are you your highness.  If I may speak my mind...the prince of the North is a very lucky man.
I love having you around, dear servant. I'm so glad you'll be there with me on my special day.
I would be no where else your highness. It will be a most wonderful day! I saw the material for your dress and it is of the best quality.  It is only eclipsed by your beauty your highness!
Oh really? That's so exciting! I want to make sure you have a very special dress for the day, too.
Oh you highness...oh forgive me your highness...I should not touch you in public. Please forgive me. Your guard will be upon us.  I'm just so excited to be a part of your highness' special day.
Hahaha! No worries, dear friend! I will assure the guard of your intentions.
Thank you your highness. I am so happy for you that your father our King will be walking with you up the isle.  His majesty is breaking protocol and throwing the elders into a tissy!
Well, he's always been a little ahead of his time. The elders will just have to get over it. Now what color would you like your dress?
Your highness is too kind to give me a choice.  I do love rose pink your majesty.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Good day priest.  How goes it?
Morning, child. Praise the Lord. How is he blessing your day so far?
Aye, praise the Lord. I be most blessed, my head has a place to sleep, my belly has food, my hands have work to do.
I am glad the Lord has been kind to you, my friend, Tell me, did I hear wrong or did you not work with the Logans?
I helped old man Logan fix his fence just a night ago.
So you have not heard about his family?
Nay, what is the word?
They in the catacombs as we speak. Treason against the King and witchcraft for the Mrs... You'd maybe do best to stay away from the old man for a while...
Tis a shame when you think people are good and they turn out so wrong.  Shame, the kid has no chance now.
Yes, but the lesson we take from this be we don't go against the Lord and take the devil's apple for it shall always be poisoned.
You don't have to tell me twice father.  I don't hesitate to whip the evil out of my charges.
That's is the proper way to go about, my child. How's the Mrs?
That bad cough is afflicting her again.  She can barely get out of bed these days.
Poor woman, she had suffered enough with the loss of her mother one would think. I will pray for her, my son. May the Lord find the grace to keep her with us as long as possible.

setting.name: Supply store
setting.description: With so many ships docked at the port, sailor from all the ships crowd the bazaar. The supply store is filled with buyers today. The inside is plain and unadorned. Sturdy shelves hold common supplies. Along the walls are the larger items for sale.
setting.background: The supply store is run by small family of people who lived in the area before the port was constructed. As sailors needed goods, the family was happy to accommodate them for a price.

speech: Hello, Captain. What brings you here today?
Aye! How fairs yer day so fa.... a map hey??
It's going well so far, Captain. That's a map where someone told me there's buried treasure.
Blasted me eyes! This is the map of the island of a thousan skulls!! I recognize the shape since it is one of a... skull. We need provisions, lad!
Let's get as many as we can here. Can we get the treasure together? I've been waiting for years!

Don't ya get too excited lad. This is a land of a thousand perils... the trip alone will have ya driven crazy! Months at sea, countless beasts await us in the journey... and the Island.. the locals are not friendly to anyone, not even their own kind. Shiver me bones I can't wait to sail!
Countless beasts? A thousand perils? Can I come, pretty please???
OF COURSE YA MAY COME, YA DAFT! There is not many that would accept this suicide mission!
But if I can come, why are you attacking me? Ahhhhhh! My mom always said I was a little daft, too.
If ya can't stand me puchin yer arm, I got bad news fer ya lass. It's only gonna get wors'! Now cease yer mumblin's and let's get ready to sail!
Oh, thank you, Captain! You won't regret it!
Now list'n here lad!!! NO ONE MUS KNOW. Especially the King. He will have the share of booty and we will see nothin but a scrap. Ya hear me?
I won't say a word, Captain, not even to my own wife!
A WIFE???! Ya never told me ye were married!! Ay we're doomed! She will ask questions!! The trip is cancelled, lad! Throw yer blasted map overboard!

setting.name: Disposal area
setting.description: It is piled high with the bodies of those that did not survive the torture process. The smell is absolutely nauseating and the rats are multiplying faster than the castle can be rid of the corpses.
setting.background: This room is used to hold the dead after they succumb from the various torture methods. Bodies, whole and part, are dumped in piles until they can be cremated weekly.

speech: Crumbs, crumbs, I love castle crumbs and kitchen snacks.
All I see here are dead stinking bodies.
Corpses can be tasty too!  Have you tried any?
No! I don't eat my own kind!
Well, I think there are some dwarves and elves in here if you look hard enough.  Maybe even a halfling.  Oh look, a ring!
I eat pig, deer, rabbits and fish. Elves are too human looking.
Well, their ears taste a bit like fish oddly enough.
Elves are pretty smart. I can't imagine one letting you get that close to try. They never seem to age. I have never known of a dead elf.
Well, the King likes to torture some to death.  There was one at the bottom of this corpse pile last week.
I suppose you finished him up. Wouldn't you rather eat table scraps?
I'm not all that choosy.  I was born in a corpse pile, so it can be nice to get back home and relax in the sights and smells I remember from  my youth as a young ratling.
Disgusting. Well, I have about had enough of guarding the dump. I don't think I will eat for a week. Nice talking to you rat.
Have fun!  I think I might see if there's any orc left over here in the corner.
Ugh....gross. Orcs smell the worst.....Maybe I won't eat for a month.

setting.name: Curved Hallway
setting.description: The curved hallway is made of large, blocky stones that provide a secure defense. The walls are streaked with dark water stains. Light from thin arrow slits streaks down at angles as the hallway curves gently to the left. An old, wooden door is tucked into the eastern side of the wall.
setting.background: The tower was built with several levels of floors, each with a small hallway surrounding an inner room.

speech: now just to make a quick check that this hallway is clean
Evening Mr.Crowley!
did you wipe your boots before you came through here son
Why of course I... Oh, sorry about that...
just double checking gotta keep everything clean around here
Right, see if you can get rid of those water stains on the wall over there.
if water is leaking don't want to get my new sandals wet
Ah fancy new sandals I see! How much did you spend on those?
the king blessed me with them for all my hard work, no raise just some new sandals isn't he great
He gave you these sandals instead of a raise?
yup here is what i get after 20 years of service
Im sorry Mr.Crowley. Me and the rest of the Guard appreciate all your work, you can be sure of that!

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Hello, sir knight. What brings you to the castle foothills?
I am guarding this part of the castle. Do you see anyone suspicious here?
No, I haven't. Although all the flowers I planted here on the foothills are gone. Perhaps someone took them all? They were for the king.
Yes, I found it weird that the grass are uneven. It seems like someone brought a heavy object across the hills
That's concerning. The only people nearby to do so are from the neighboring village, but we haven't had quarrel with them for years.
I need to take a look at the hut over there. Can you hold my mace for a while?
Of course, knight. I will follow behind you in case anything happens. I might be a nun, but I used to be trained in fighting.
I wish more knights have your attitude, My Lady!
Oh sir knight, you're too kind! But we must focus on the matter at hand. Do you see anything of concern in the hut?
Hmm. Nothing.. It is empty... Well maybe because I am tired and seeing things.. I'm just worried because we captured the general of our enemies and I think they will try to release him.
There is no shame in being on edge. That keeps your wits sharp, after all. Would you like your mace back, knight?
Yes please. Thank you for holding it My Lady! what brings you here, if I may ask?
I came to tend to the flowers, but since they're all gone I suppose I'll have to replant them. But that's not so bad!
I'll help you then. Flowers will bring great joy in dark times!

setting.name: gate to street
setting.description: The street outside the church is empty, with not a soul in sight. The sky is gray and seems to threaten snow. The pavement is rutted and worn, littered with loose cobblestones and other signs of disuses and disrepair. The only sound is the cold wind blowing, and the awful metallic squeak as it blows the iron gate open and shut.
setting.background: The street running outside the abandoned church. Empty and devoid of activity.

speech: I am tired of being poor, I spend all day cleaning the house, cooking buy I sure love my husband
That is nice of you to say.  I love you too wife.  I wish there was something else we could do.
I wish there was something else too but as long as I have you in my life things will be alright
I know that is true, but I don't like the look of the sky.  If it snows this late in the year all our crops could be lost.
It is grey we must prey to our only true God and maybe offer a goat or two in sacrifice, I know we cant spare them but lets hope our God is mercyful
Maybe we can spare one goat, but I don't know if that is necessary.  Do you really think we should?
We can always wait but I fear the grey sky means out God is in thrist of a sacrifice, the cold wind, all signs of his discomfort
You may be right.  Why can things never be easy.  I am so tired of all this turmoil.
I am tired too my husband, there are days when we have barely enough to eat and days when we dont even have enough to have a decent meal
I am sorry that you have to live this way.  I know you could have married anyone in the kingdom.  Thank you for your loyalty to me.
You are my one only love, I would rather be poor than be rich and miserable with a nasty lord
Maybe we can escape this kingdom and be out from under this king.  We could settle in the plains.  It would be risky, but it might be possible.  Are you up for an adventure?
Where would we go? I guess any place is better than living like this.
The plains to the east are fertile and free.  We would be vulnerable to attack, but we might join a tribe there.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: Pretty view from up here.
Wish we could stay here forever.
Maybe we could. Have you ever noticed how much I look like the king? Maybe we could off him and I could take his place.
You really think we won't get caught?
He takes a stroll alone in the gardens every morning. All I have to do is hide in the bushes and wham! It'll be fun.
You know what? We really have nothing to lose anyway. Let's do it.
Cool, babe. That's why I love you, so. You're so easy to talk to, even about murdering the local royalty.
Thanks dear, I try. Should we do it tomorrow?
Sure. I'll need you to be ready to be my new love interest because I'll have to do away the queen, too, eventually. You and I will meet at a party and fall in love.
What will we say happened to the real queen?
She'll fall out a window or something. Not worried about it, yet.
Okay, I trust you. Where should I go until this party happens?
Go home and pretend I went to visit some relatives or something. I'm excited. Can you tell?
You should be! Our lives are about to get so much more exciting. I really hope we don't get caught.

setting.name: Secret tunnel
setting.description: Your senses are met with the dank moisture of a secret tunnel. The stony walls are full of lichen and cave moss. Stalactites and stalagmites pepper the small channel, which bleeds in a pinpoint light from a far off point. The chill air of the King's forest whistles through the tunnel interior.
setting.background: This tunnel provides escape to prisoners with enough coin to bribe the guards. While escape is possible through other means, slipping five copper to the militiaman in charge of relieving you of your wares may grant you access to the tunnel. The door was well hidden and unassuming, blending in the wall behind chests and barrels in the storage room. The tunnel is a natural formation, used by early pioneering guards to make a few extra coins on top of their salaries.

speech: well i never even knew this tunnel existed
Oh, goodness. I did not expect to see you down here. What's brought a guard to the lichen covered tunnel?
they are worried about an attack from the forest i was sent to guard this tunnel
An attack from the forest, my company had not alerted me. I was visiting down here for a brief respite, I do enjoy these sparkly stalagmites and stalactites so...
keep your guard up they say enemies have invaded the forest and are getting close to the castle
Thank you good sir, my equipment is at home and this will surely help me reach my fellow soldiers. Do you know where they have formed?
sadly the last scout we sent out has not returned that is why i am here at this tunnel
Oh dear, sounds dangerous indeed. Well, I'm certainly glad you're here to protect entry from the King's forest.
i will gladly lay down my life to protect the king no one will get past me here while i yet breath
Honor speaks to me as well, it's been a time since I've had a good battle. It will certainly renew my soul!
good man if they come this way we shall show them what the kings men are made of
Indeed, this heirloom shall protect us both. It has never failed me before.
well if that protects you then you won't be needing this i shall hold onto it you should go outside and tell me what you see
Yes, uh, er... on second thought I do believe a bit more protection than my heirloom may be required.

setting.name: soldiers camp
setting.description: The camp is hidden away in a light forest of trees and brush that might be hard to find if there had not been a symbol on the trees leading up to it. You can feel the anxiety of the soldiers here, as this camp is not well fortified by any conventional means, but instead is supposed to be hidden and camouflaged to throw off anyone that might pursue. The camp is nothing more than a fire and some barracks. Nothing fancy to see.
setting.background: This soldiers camp was created as there was need for a training and resting area for the soldiers of the king's royal army. The location is ideal as they have water and material. The king himself was excited by this spot.

speech: I wouldn't sneak about around here. Your libel to get your head shopped off or worse.
Oh... Hi there... Hmmm... I was walking around and peeking.. No harm here...
Well just be warned. The next guy may not be so restrained. These woods are full of bandits and robbers.
It is... I know a lot of robbers out there ready to jump out from the bushes and take your money... Scary, isn't it??
That would be a big mistake taking anyone of my soldiers by surprise though. No worries here.
I'm just curious... What's up with the camp so hidden in the forest? It seems like you are trying to hide something or hiding from something??
Hiding...We're not hiding. We are training for....Ok, we're hiding. We are waiting for another shipment of soldiers from the sea.
hmmm. what is this??? Treasure Map???!!
No...No treasure map....It's a map to the church in the next village. Quite boring.
Well... I know a treasure map when I seen one.. Come'on you have to include me in this hunting... I will be a great help but of course... it has to benefit me as well
You may need some armor to look like the rest of the soldiers. Perhaps you would like me to recruit you. We are always looking for fresh blood.
Thanks. Count me in, my friend! so what treasure are we looking for?

Have you seen these mountains? It appears there is a dragons cave full of treasure. I am to go and kill the dragon and bring back his head. wagons are already on their way to bring the gold back to the King.
I have been there...It is not the nicest place on earth! The place is fully guarded with traps and monsters. You might need more than wagons and weapons.
action: steal a treasure map from robber
give a treasure map to robber

setting.name: flower garden
setting.description: This clearing is in reveal a wide circle of trees. Proud oaks stand close enough that only the smallest of fauna can squeeze through, protecting the garden within from curious deer and hungry rabbits. Flowers of every hue and shade crowd the soft lawn of grass, soaking up what light they can through the shadows cast by the branches above. Purple, yellow, red, blue - even green blossoms bob in the breeze, their scents mixing to create a heady perfume. Vines and creepers climb up the tree trunks, dripping with grapes and berries.
setting.background: This garden is used to feed the fae that live in the Brush den. The fruit from the climbing vines and the nectar from the flowers make up most of their diet, and the garden provides them with a ready source of nourishment. The entrance to the encircled clearing is within the roots of an ancient oak, and is not easy to see.

speech: What a beautiful flower garden!
You almost gave me a heart attack.  Where did such a tiny creature come from?
I live in the forest. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you.  Do you spend time in this flower garden often?
As much as I can. Sometimes humans want to enslave me, so I try not to be here when humans are around, but you seem nice.
Why would they enslave you?  Do you have powers?
I have a few magical skills, but not many. I'm not like a wizard or anything. How about you? What do you do?
I am a priest that is at war against the lies of this kingdom.  I hate the way they oppress the needy and call it aide.
How terrible! I'm so glad you are there for them. Who fights with you?
The King, the Lords, and all who benefit from cheap labor.  The powerful pretend that they are doing good while exploiting others.
What a sad state of affairs. Can I help?
I don't know, what are your powers?
Hmmm...well, I can become invisible, I can bring good luck, and I have the ability to heal some illnesses,
You could be a great ally to us.  You could spy, heal, and bring us luck.  I don't want to put you in danger, though.

setting.name: Guard Barracks
setting.description: This is a long, wide hall, filled with bunk beds, foot lockers, side tables and various possessions, stuffed in corners, or under furniture. The high ceiling it pointed and a dizzying array of beams criss-cross their way down the length of the room. Neat, uncluttered and relatively free of dirt. Swords, axes, maces and bows lean against walls or hang from pegs. A large center pathway, twenty feet wide, separates the long rows of beds. Two large tables near the back of the room are each surrounded by twelve old, but serviceable chairs.
setting.background: This room may be bustling with activity, or almost totally empty, at any given time. Guards rarely spend their free time here, though on occasion, especially when off duty but in a state of readiness, they may be found playing games, wrestling, or simply conversing. The Captain of the Guard runs a very tight ship and does not tolerate any slovenly behavior. Older, senior guardsmen can sometimes be found at the tables in the back, drinking and discussing current events.

speech: Hello craftsman, how are you doing this fine day?
I am very well Knight, thank you for asking! The king asked me to come adjust these twelve chairs.
I see. Those chairs are very well crafted and the design are beautiful. I have to ask you though, can you perhaps craft some type of sheath for my longsword by any chance?
I do think I have the leather for it at my shop. I could make you one but I'll have to charge.
For you to charge a knight in the royal army should be considered a crime! Can ye not see that I am of royal servant! Can ye please do this free of charge?
No I'm sorry I will not. Why do you think I should work for free? My skills just didn't happen over night, it took years.
Ah yes that is true. A craftsman that speaks wise words and profits from it....but how about if I take ye charcoal and shove it up ye arse! You will make me a sheath for my bows as well I tell ye!

You dumb knight, who do you think made the generals sheath? I did and guess what, he got charged! I will not work for free. You can threaten me all you want to but the general will take care of you if you keep it up!

Well guess what ye, I am not the general! I am the stubborn knight and people stay out of my way....I always get what I want. These punches are merely nothing compared to me blade. Now that is done, have you changed your mind my fellow craftsman?
Haha for being a knight you sure are weak
That hurt so bad! You made me drop the charcoal and now it has created some mess. Fine, let me ask you then - is there anything you can craft for me.....for free?
I can craft you anything but it'll cost you triple what it would anyone else!

Take it back ye! Charge me like a normal person...or...or I will tell my general to get you kicked out of the town hall! and taxed as well! Don't you understand I fight on the front line!? I should be treated with more respect grrr!
Haha knight you silly fool, you have to treat people with respect to be respected

setting.name: Castle Royal tower
setting.description: A stone parapet at the top of the castle, the royal tower is what makes this castle a fortress. The walls are stone and dinged with souvenirs of past battles. It is cold and gray, but the perfect vantage point for soldiers. The wind whistles through the cracks in the wall. Straw litters the floor.
setting.background: The castle's royal tower is a lookout point for the king's men. From stone windows, soldiers can survey the land around them. You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

speech: We have almost taken the castle, only one tower remains!
What forces remain to defend it?
Only a few of the King's men remain, we have taken heavy losses, but victory is in sight!
There is no need to send so many battle weary troops to this.  Give me your five best men and I will take the rower.
Fine - you have them.  Carry the day, and you will be rewarded.
Is Sir Belmore about.  Him I must have, the other four I leave up to you.
Sir Belmore was struck by an arrow in the first assault, I am afraid he did not make it.  Any others?
It is a great blow, but we will carry on. I leave it to you to choose the five.
Well Sir Harold the Tiny, Sir Bewet the Meek, Sir Larry the Knave, Sir Hewet the Lame, And Brave Sir Robin shall accompany you.
A fine lot they are.  In the name of the king, the castle will be ours before the sun rests.
Lead on!  I shall supervise from this vantage point.
To valor, to victory...uh which way is the tower?
Up the stairs!  Be wary, they may still have an archer!
To.the stairs men! .No quarter!

setting.name: Wealthy area of town
setting.description: A new section of town, new stone buildings and with fresh paint and clean installations. It looks like an old city of rich bankers and guilds of merchants.
setting.background: This city was once a garrison for the King's soldiers but in times of peace has become the commerce hub of the region. You can see some military installations but they are old and unused, relics of an earlier time.installations

speech: How are you today merchant?  Still keeping the King's peace?
Of course, soldier. Is there something you're interested in?
Well, lets see, what do you have for sale today?
I have this jewelry and a number of other gold items
Not sure If that's my cup of tea to be honest.
Ah okay. What is it that you are seeking?
Give that back thief!  Back to the oubliette for you!
Um excuse me, why are you trying to steal my wares?
That is not yours thief!  First we shall cut off your right hand, and then your tongue if you do not silence yourself!
Get away from me!
Assault on an officer of the law will result in the forfeiture of all property to the crown and the enslavement of your family!
What is wrong with you!? I was just here trying to sell my wares. I have more authority than you anyway.
And you stole from me!  You will lose you hand, your land, you tongue, your children, your wife, and your property.
I did not steal from you! you stole from me. I will get the King

setting.name: Hiking path
setting.description: hiking path is very worn down. it is muddied from rain and snow, and has a bleak atmosphere. it is a place that almost depresses you, but being close to the peak keeps you going
setting.background: the atmosphere is caused by an energy that portrays the failure of those who tried to conquer the mountain. it has a quiet eerie sound and makes you doubt yourself, causing many to not try and climb to the peak

speech: how much farther is it to the top
I don't know. All of this mud is making me think we will never reach the top.
yeah best to cover that up before bandits spot it and try and rob us
I'll put it here in the meantime.
sounds good what have you to eat in there this depressing place is making me hungry
Nothing, but maybe we can hunt something on our way to warn the villagers.
you hunt i shall sit down and take a break men of my stature do not hunt
We don't have time to rest. We must warn the villagers where the wolves are sleeping before they wake up and move.
get your peasant hands off of me i will report this to the king at once
Hurry up! We stand to make a lot of money off those pelts.
now you are talking my language just remember the split is 70 for me 30 for you
Exactly, now lets keep moving were already near the peak.
here now that we have an understanding use this to catch some food on the way
It's going to be hard to find animals along this muddied path.
action: remove the royal coat of arms
put the royal coat of arms in pouch

setting.name: Apple trees
setting.description: the apple trees are a beautiful color and very nice to look at they are easy on the eyes and attract visitors as a result
setting.background: this apple tree has sparked debate, as many want it cut down to make room for more market space, as well as wood resources. others admire the beauty and admire it as a food source in harsh times

speech: Is anyone here?
No one is here.
I don't want anyone to here my musings on my friend, Alice.
Alice...but I want to know...I'm not here so I will not hear.
Alice is so beautiful.  I want so badly to make her my wife, but, alas, I am but a humble gardener.  I will not always be a gardener, though.
I am just a no one but if I were you I would give her some apples from this tree.
An idea just flew into my head, perhaps she would like some apples from this tree.  How will I get them down, though?
Here let me help knock them down with your rake.
My rake is floating around and knocking down the apples for me.  Am I a wizard?  Do I have powers to make the world around me do my bidding?
Listen to me gardener. Take these apples to Alice and some flowers and she will love you forever.
I will pick her flowers too and make her my bride, but first I must go to the king and get a new job as a wizard in his court.  I can't believe my luck.
No...no....no one is doing this...I don't want you committed for thinking you are a wizard.
Hmmm, I wonder if that was a fluke?  I never had any powers before.  I will test it.  Flowers come to me!
Yes...it was I no one who did those things but it will be you gardener who will wed your beloved Alice.

setting.name: Main street
setting.description: main street is bleak and outdated. it wears the atmosphere of the cemetery based on association. it is dark even in sunlight and has a unique odor
setting.background: many members of the town protested the cemetery being so close to the main street, but they were denied, and the atmosphere reflects this

speech: Its nice to take a break from digging.
Why are you digging in the street ?
Graveyard ran out of space, plague and all.
ew... steps back....
Hey, it is honest work!
yes but you might catch the plague
They have to be dealt with or the whole town will become infected!
i mean that I should not come into contact with you
Just don't stand too close, it is pretty simple. This is spread by bodily fluids afterall.
I certainly do not share bodily fluids with his majesty. What are you implying?
I didn't mention him...guilty conscience?
I am an immortal being sent by the Gods themselves! I do not fraternize with my charges. Do you have relations with your dead bodies?
You seem to have gone a bit off the rails, is something wrong with you?
I was merely pointing out that the King is a short term contract for me and I don't want to terminate it early by giving him the plague.

setting.name: In Front of a Stone Tower
setting.description: A large tower stretches high into the sky. It is made of gray stone blocks, some of which have softened edges illustrating aged signs of wear. Sparse grass grows around the base of the tower, dwindling down to nothing near the dark open doorway at the tower's front. A few rays of light shine into the doorway and brighten a rough stone floor, with specks of dust being illuminated by the sun's rays.
setting.background: This tower was created a long time ago by workers unknown. It appears rather old, but has withstood the test of time.

speech: Hello up there. Was that a Princess I saw in the window?
Oh! Hello, good sir! Are you the keeper of this Stone Tower?
Yes your highness.  Can I be of service?

These are trying times, good sir. I wish to unite the villages under my family's banner once again, and I will need a new seat of power from which to organize such a movement. This place seems secluded enough, yet still inviting. Tell me, is it fortified? Do the walls still stand true?
Well your highness some parts are still sturdy but others are not.  Are you aware that there is a witch here with us?
Oh, yes! I am here to visit her. She may seem scary, but she was loyal to my mother. How is she?

Well it will take some work to get her...I mean the tower...back in shape.  Would your witch friend want to help? I'm sure she has a spell or two that would put this tower back in shape your highness.
Hopefully. I will need strong people to rebuild in the wake of the war. How about the locals in the village? Do they show loyalty to the Crown, even after all these years?
I hear your highness that the people are loyal to your father the King.  They villages will rally to your side.

Then I ask kindly that you accompany me to the village. The witch will understand if I am a bit late to our meeting. I must see my people, look them in the eye and tell them that their princess is ready to ascend to the throne and make thing right. They need to hear it, and I need to say it.
But your highness...what protection have you?  I see no guard and I have no weapons.  I worry for your safety your highness.
I will have to trust that my parents smile down on my actions.
Well if you insist on going then I insist on trying to protect you your highness.  I will take this hook and swing it at anyone who gets too close to you your highness.
You are kind, dear sir. Come with me, then! We have much work to do to rebuild my family's name and country!
action: put block in a rough stone floor

setting.name: Enormous church entrance door
setting.description: The door stands twenty feet tall. It is made of metal with a large knocker at eye level. There is a small sliding window covered with metal so that people inside can slide it and see who is knocking. The door has three large rectangles made of rivets, one high, one in the middle, and one low.
setting.background: This church has stood for over five hundred years. Many people have knocked on its doors looking for protection or service. It is commanding, yet welcoming.

speech: Hello. I am an attendee of the queen. May I be of service?
I am a poor weary traveller, drenched by the rain tonight.  I was hoping that a church as grand as this could admit me for the night, or at least a few hours to warm up and dry off.
Oh yes. Come in and dry yourself by the fire. I can get the priest for you.
Thank you so much, my weary bones couldn't take the cold and wet much longer.  What is this church called?
It is the Church of the King.  It is the Royal family's church.

setting.name: Hilltop temple grounds
setting.description: A tall white building with stained glass windows and surrounded lush green grass.  It sits on top of a hill with many steps to climb.  Each room has a different setting and painted walls to set the mood.
setting.background: Many people journey to the temple for peace, solitude, reflection and meditation.  They journey up the hill and steps that are cut into the side of the mountain.  Once they reach the temple grounds the view is luxurious, breath taking and serene.

speech: Good day!  I hope all is well!
Well, take a look at this plant. My crops are stunted because of the drought. Will you pray for rain. The more people who pray the better chances for rain soon.
I new the drought was bad, but didn't know it was this bad yet.  I will certainly pray.
Thank you. I'm sure the plants will be grateful as well.
What exactly do you grow?
I grow all the grain for the village. there are some veggies I like to grow as well. Potatoes are my favorite.
It's amazing to see how green the grass is here.  I wonder how that is.
I'm sure the King has the priests water it. His temple must look the part. I just love all the stained glass windows.
They are beautiful. It must have taken forever to put them all together.
Yes, I couldn't begin to know how long that took to make. I will stick with the crops
Have you spoken to the priest over there about your crop troubles?
Not yet. He looks to be praying. I didn't want to disturb him.
I guess you'll want this back.
Maybe this will help. I will just plant it in here for now. It looks so thirsty.

setting.name: Castle Maids' Room
setting.description: Inside the maids room is dark and grey.  It is much different from the rest of the Castle which has grand walls and floors and paintings from famous painters around the wall.  The maid holds many secrets in this room.  One which is a secret door that holds paintings she should not have.
setting.background: Many of the servants share quarters, but the head maid has her own room.  She is a favorite of the Duke who owns the castle.  She is loyal, but her room still reflects that she is a servant.  She has plans of her own as her room inside the Castle has secret door and storage where she has things she should not.

speech: Hello, pianter! What are you here to paint today?
I usually try to paint depictions of my horrible agony i suffer from.
Horrible agony, sir?
Yes, i have lost my family.
How terrible! What happened?
My king disliked my paintings so he locked me away.
He disliked them so he locked you away here in the castle?
Yes you are correct. It helped my paintings though.
How did it help your paintings?
My agony helped me generate amazing ideas for art.
I see. What is your favorite?
This one here depicts the thought of taking one's life. It is a powerful piece.
Oh my! It is very powerful indeed.
Tell me, where do you work?

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: Tell me master, what do you use this for?
It is what I write the precious celebration invites with. Have you received one?
Why yes of course. I am excited!
I am as well! The new royalties have now taken their positions, and we have much traveling to do this year.
Do you know where you are going?
First, we will have our celebration here. Then we must go settle new terms with the countries and kingdoms of the King's choice.
When you are done with negotiations.. do you think my taxes will be lower?
I do not believe this new king had any plans yet for his very own kingdom regarding taxes. He seems to be quite pleased with how things are going in that department.
Well i could really use some extra money. My finances havee been struggling.
Oh, couldn't we all use more?!
Have you eaten yet sir?
I have not yet. I will be eating tonight! What do you do, subject?
I am just an average joe. I hate my job right now but it feeds me.
What job do you do?!

setting.name: The Great Hall
setting.description: Large room with vast ceilings for meetings and dining. There is a large ornate table at the head of the room for the king and his guest overlooking smaller tables for the servants.
setting.background: The Great Hall is the room in the castle where all can meet and dine. The king sits at a higher dining table than the rest overlooking servants at lower tables. The king meets with all leaders and visitors here.

speech: Here is a crystal ball for you, sir.
Oh no! You dropped it. Or did you mean to? I can never tell with a jester.
That was a fake, sir, the real one is in your hand!
My goodness, you're good at this. I can see why the king hired you!
Can I borrow this a minute?
but that's my favorite shield!
I'm so sorry, but I think you will approve.  Watch now!
You are crazy in the best way, jester.
Thank you, Sir.  I am looking for a new job!
A new job? But you're so very good at this one!
But the hours are terrible.  I sleep all day and joke all night.  How can I be funny at that rate.
I'd never thought of it that way. Suddenly it doesn't sound so fun. I'm sorry.
Oooops, that was the real one.
Oh no! Now what do we do?

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Yes? do you need me? I'm just finishing up here.
Yes, the King wants to know if you have just about finished up?
Yes, he'd not come down to see the dirty work in person would he? I poke the remains, there''s a strange noise as air escapes the mass of flesh.
Not likely, he is a little bit weak of spirit.
I'll be up in a moment to tell His Maj all that this lil birdie sang as he and I were getting to know each other. I best change, wouldn't wantt o upset him

Are you as squeamish as His Maj? Of course I'm going to clean up. Though it spoils the dramatic effect don't you think?
I am feeling a bit green as we speak.  Why did you decided that in life you wanted to make a career out of hurting your fellow man?
I'm big, strong and from the bad section of town. Nobody hires us for anything good. I send all my wages to the orphans there so they don''t have to do this for a living. You why do you toas
Send your money to the orphans?  A likely story.  Or rather, and unlikely story.
i don't care what you think you know servant. I know that God will judge all my works in life. What can you say? You chase the snivelling idoiot who rules us. Are you afraid to meet your maker?
That's what you really think eh?  That's what the King's Guard thought as well.  They have been waiting for proof to take you down, and now they have it.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Hey prisoner...down here!
Egads, it's a talking rat. What witchcraft have you been accursed with?
I have always been able to talk to humans. Somehow my brain is bigger than the average rat.
That's amazing. I sure could use a friend in here. No one will hear my cries of innocence.
Well here, i'll stay awhile and chat with you.
That would be great, thank you for your kindness! See, I've been framed by my wife's jealous lover of attempting to poison the king.
Hmm, that sounds very cruel. How did he frame you?
Twas only rumors, started by him of course, they investigated my house and found some herbal remedies and thought that was enough for sentencing!
How can i help you out of this?

Well the jailor is asleep outside. If I could make an escape I shall flee these lands forever. I've already lost my family, maybe Nepal will treat me more kindly. I think he keeps the key in his pocket!
Ok here take this. I only ask for one thing in return?
What, anything you ask I shall happily do!
I want cheese. I freaking love cheese. Could you help me find some?

setting.name: Graveyard
setting.description: The dark and gloomy graveyard has fog all the time and has a large amount of graves everywhere you step. There are whispers and shadows that appear from the darkness and there is always a light drizzle that seems to moisten the place.
setting.background: The graveyard was started after the King's son died and they wanted to make a place just for royalty. For decades, this graveyard has held all the royal members that have come and go. The graveyard was expanded after they needed more room.

speech: no one will ever think of looking for me here
Boo! haha! Found ya! What do you want to play next brother!
aww you must have cheated how did you get here
I spied on you while you left the castle! You had no idea I was right behind you the whole way here!
how about you hide in that hole over there and i will get the groundskeeper to cover you with dirt to make it a really good hiding spot

well anyway i'm about to go run in the castle right after this

come on lets run together
Let me make sure he is ok first.
nobody gonna do nothing cause i am the prince lets go

you in line to go to war first hope you make it back alive
You take that back!

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

speech: Hello animal, do you happen to know what happened to the King's deer?
Just because I am hideous you think that I have mutilated the deer?
I never said that animal, sounds like guilt to me!
You are no more than a annoyance.  Please leave me alone.
I'll have you killed if you don't cooperate.
Kill me, the man that made this mutated creature didn't have the guts to finish the job when he made me, so I have been tortured every day of my existence.
You aren't a natural creature?
I was made in a lab by a mad man.  I hate what he made me.
Why did he do this to you?
He wanted to make an army of grotesque creatures.  He thought the king would be pleased, but he was put to death for his efforts.
Good he deserved to be put to death. His efforts were irreversible?
Sadly, yes.
Well I'm just trying to get to the bottom of this incident.
Thank you kind game warden.
