setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall has a long, elegant wooden table with ornate chairs at both ends and along the sides. There are place settings at each seat with a rustic silverware set and gold plates. The wall is decorated with paintings of knights and past royalty.
setting.background: This dining hall was once the center of a huge conflict between two families. The argument was between two sons at dinner shortly after their dad had passed away. They fought over who would take over the throne, which led to the first bloodbath inside the kingdom. The younger son was victorious and the older son was slain to death.

speech: "Would you mind helping me get this fire started?"
i would but people of my stature do not do such things my father was a great duke

with his blood running through my veins i shall be even greater

hold your tongue my great grandfather owned this castle it is rightfully mine

once i am a duke my first job will be to fire the likes of you

well you have a point here this needs washing

let me get this fire going right its chilly with no shirt

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Guard... are you hungry?
No, I hunger not when I am on duty, peasant!
I brought plenty of sandwiches. The cook gave them to me to bring.
I am wary of your offer, peasant. Who knows how you could be trying to get past me and steal from the King?
I have no need to steal. The cook likes me and he gives me what is left in the kitchen after the days meals.
I shall abstain for the moment, good sir. What else brings you to this cavern?
Just that. I would assume you are lonely for company in this cavern. It can get cold and dank and make you think you are daft
Hmmmm. It can be, but at least this servant is here, too.
Does she talk much?
Nay, good man, she doesn't.
I didn't think so. She hasn't said a word since I came in.
You are a humorous one, aren't you?
Sometimes quiet from them is more welcome, then going on and on.
Ah, yes. Like we seem to be.

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

speech: Rrrooooaaaaarrrrr! What are you doing on my mountain?!
Woah woah woah! Just exploring the outer reaches of the king's realms.
That's what they all say! Then they leave bear traps and such, and come back trying to get me!
Oh, bear, you got me all wrong. I would never trap such a spectacular creature like yourself!
Then why do you have this big stick? Hmmmmm....?
It's to help me up the treacherous terrain. I am not as spry as I once was, you know.
Here - take your stick. But leave my type alone. And not a word of me to the King!
Not a word! Here, are you thirsty?
No, thank you. I drink from the river at the base of the mountain. I had my fill earlier today, of fresh water and fish. I do love nature's bounty!
Bear, would you mind if I lived with you for awhile. I would really love to learn your ways.
Do you have any shenanigans in mind? I really do hate shenanigans!
Not a single one, I just love nature. I feel you have much to teach me.
I can teach you to live like a predator, but you will have to get used to raw meat!
I am certainly willing to try it, but i'm not sure it's good for my stomach.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Its getting quite cold here sir, are you sure it isn't time to return to the Castle?
Me?  I served in the Ice Drake wars of '72.  I never froze then, and I won't freeze now.  What about you civilian, shivering in your boots?
Sir, I am but trained in agriculture. Such... cold conditions are unlike the warm weather where I have grown up.
Then what is an agricultural advisor doing here in the winter?  Shouldn't you be taking the winter off?
The True King gave me this map to find a rare type of seed that can grow wheat in the winter. I am here trying to create it for him.
That looks like badger-cultist territory to me.  You'll never make it alive.
I have heard myths about them, surely they are not real! Whats that picture in your hand?
It is the only picture I have left of my family.  They were eaten by the Turtle-Folk during their last rebellion.  I failed them.
Such a beautiful family...the Turtle folks are a truly savage bunch. I hope the Lord punishes them with a fruitless harvest!
It may interest you to know that when ground up, turtle-folk make excellent fertilizer.
Is that right? Why that might just be solution to my winter harvest conundrum. Commander, I shall require to bring me the carcass of a turtle-folk.
Well, there's a village over yonder we could raid.  That would net you some two or three hundred carcasses.
If I may, I shall stay back and use a Catapult to destroy their homes. Just what they did to you...
Indeed . . . I like your Agricultural Advisor.  I think I can spare a cohort to fetch your seed in badger-cultist territory.
action: put a tattered map in large green land
give Family Photo to agricultural advisor
give Family Photo to military commander

setting.name: Adjacent to the Guest Castle
setting.description: Green, fertile, and blessed with crops of all kind. This well-kept farm grows corn, rice, and wheat for the King's Family and closest aides. Animals such as horses, goats, and the bleating of sheep keeps this Farm bustling with activity.
setting.background: The Farm is the oldest location in the King's Land and was the first location of the Kings Castle, which has now been converted into a Guest Castle. The castle has been rejuvenated after a deadly famine 100 years ago that wiped out all life. Today, it is looked after by a team of well-compensated farmers.

speech: Growing season has been great this year!
It has! I've never seen the fields so green and abundant with vegetables. I'll make a fortune after harvest.
Same here! Look at this corn. It's so beautiful. The king is going to be so pleased
Not to mention, we'll be able to store plenty of food away for the cold months. Our kids won't go hungry again this winter!
That's definitely a relief. My son didn't do well last winter. How are your kids these days?
Well, Miranda, my wife, is pregnant again. That's child number 9! Bruce is going to marry his girlfriend, the rest are doing well in school aside from the youngsters. How is your brood?
9! You're definitely crazy. We just have the 3 little ones. Didn't want to press our luck after last year. They're doing well though. My son wants to be a knight
Yes, his name is Percival if I recall correctly. A knight? What an honorable choice!
Yeah need to stay on the king's good side so Percy has a chance to go to knight school. This crop yield should help
And look here... here comes tonight's dinner! Miranda will be thrilled with such a large chicken!
That almost looks big enough to feed your whole family! I assume your wife is a great cook?
Oh, she is! She can make some fantastic foods! How about you bring your family over for dinner tonight?
Yes, that sounds like a great idea. Thank you so much!
You are always welcome. With a harvest like this, we'll have food enough for the whole town.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: Made from wood and stone, the tavern smells of food and ale. A flame is burning in the fireplace and candles light up tables throughout the room.
setting.background: This is the most lively place in town where locals and travelers drink and share stories! The bar keep is friendly and has lots of information about the town and surrounding areas.

speech: Good day old man. Have a pint with me?
Surely. What ale will we have today?
The only one they serve funny man.  Let us drink to good health!
Hahaha! Such a kind fireman. Tell me, what made you get into the profession?
I've always loved playing with fire, the chance to wield the flame in battle is a great honor and one that I am lucky to be able to do.
You must have a pretty high risk tolerance!
I have a sworn duty to our sovereign King and Queen to protect their interests.
Do you always agree with the royalties interest, honestly?
It is not my duty to question who they tell me to fight.
It's not, but surely you've had a doubt at one point in your career?
What were you when you were young?
I was a economist. I made sure we made the best decisions financially as a kingdom.
Then you cannot understand what going into battle entails.
I can not, but I'm still curious

setting.name: Entrance to church
setting.description: The entrance to the church can only be described as a bit scary.  It is overgrown with mosses and weeds.  It has not been taken care of and is a mixture of wood and stone.  It is dirty, and things live here.
setting.background: This was the church that the King attended with his family when they were alive.  They all died under mysterious circumstances and are all now buried in the cemetery.  But now no one comes into this church, it is considered sacred ground.  And there are things that live here, things that are different.

speech: Boo! What are doing here Bandit? I hope you weren't planning on raiding the Church.

Ach, I just came here ta rest a bit, ghostly person.  I... admit I didn't believe th' rumors of this place bein' haunted, but I thought that it might at least keep His Kingliness from followin' me here, aye?  Mind if I... erm... trespass on yer good graces?
Why if thats the case, then you are most welcome to.. trespass for the night. Make sure to keep your distance from the zombies though, he likes eating human brains.
Gah!  I didn't even notice the blighter there, 'e's standin' so still.  Ugh, I should have noticed by the stench though.
Yes, he does smell quite a bit. Sadly, his inside keep leaking all over the place and I have to clean it up with wet moss.
Well, I've used some moss a time or two when the king's guards fer his taxes get a little too cheeky with their blades.  There's worse things one could use, I'd say.
I get a feeling you and the King do not get along very well. Just as well that you came here for a bit of respite.

Well, he don't take too kindly ta me relievin' him of some of his excess coinage, ya see.  But the way I be lookin' at it, tis plenty of coinage ta go around.  And if some of it happens te make its way to me pockets, or other, more deservin' folk, well then...
I think this might be of interest to you then. The excessive coinage you have on your back might be getting a bit heavy.
Eh?  What's this, then?
Its a magical rune that transports you into a different world momentarily. A colorful and painless world filled with riches...
Hm, I don't know.  Gots ta keep me edge, ya know.  Rather not join the likes of you anytime soon, eh? Ha!
Fair enough. Did you hear that? Sounded like footsteps coming up the entryway.
Ach!  I'd best hide - perhaps that zombie there 'll give 'em a turn!

setting.name: Dock at the Port
setting.description: This dock has seen better days.  It is wobbly and broken in areas.  There are holes through to the ocean below if you are not careful.  It is covered with every means of trash.
setting.background: This dock is used to offload the high sorceress' supplies.  It is only allowed to be used by her and this port is somewhat mysterious as well.  She receives her goods at night and has guards that hover around her at the port.  No one really knows what kind of supplies she is receiving, but most do not want to know.

speech: How fare you today?  Any sign of the badger-cultists on the river?
I haven't seen any thankfully. How are you on this fine day, Captain?
Fair, not too much of any emotion I suppose.  Take a look through this spyglass, do you see that movement on the river?
I don't see anything yet, but if you have a bad feeling, I trust your judgement. You have more experience than anyone around these parts.
Then summon the rest of the guard, the badger-cultists may be looking to harvest flesh.
I absolutely will right away! Do you think there are many of them? How many men shall I gather?
At least twenty for the initial assault, should buy us time for the rest of the guard to man their stations.
Got it, Captain. In the meantime, take this.
Thank you - have you any experience on the battlefield son?
I'm afraid not. My only experience is here guarding the king. Any advice?
Aim for the eyes, and try to avoid their teeth at all costs.
Got it, Sir. I will do my best.
They're closer - steady, steady.
How close, Sir? More men are on the way.

setting.name: Bog
setting.description: Frogs croak in the reeds that surround the bog. The water is very murky and underneath the surface tadpoles dart around. There are minimal places to stand to stay dry.
setting.background: The frogs have made a home in the murky waters of the bog because they are able to hide from predators more easily. The seldom need to be on dry ground and there are a surplus of bugs for them to consume. The reeds are so tall that when birds land on them the frogs can see them and swim quickly away.

speech: Is someone here?
...Well that wouldn't make this any fun at all, would it?...
Please tell me you don't eat bugs. I am going to be King of the Bugs and I can't have anything killing me before my reign even begins.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: I am famished! I wonder what is on the menu today
Me too. I'm real happy the king brought us all around for Fool's day. You know, they used to say king's food would kill peasants.
What is this Fools day you talk of?

They don't have Fools Day where you're from? It's the day where everything goes up on its head. Children play japes with their parents, the jailers let the prisoners go free, you know. All Fool's Day.
What jibberish are you talking about? How much have you had to drink?
Ah, never enough for what I do, friend. Never enough.
I thought I smelled a smell like gasoline coming from you. What is it you like to drink sir?
Well, we only get the time for beer. Keep the still on our property, you know. Cheap when you've got extra barley. But I've a taste for the...foreign spirits. Vodka and such.
Well I think they are just serving food and wine tonight
Unfortunate. Hey, speaking of. In the April Fools' tradition, would you mind if we switched clothes for a bit?
No sir, You go switch clothes with someone else. You fool!
Oh, bother. I'm just joking. But pass me those herbs if you don't want to do my work, I need to get those planted soon.
I think that you should get those herbs yourself. I believe they are yours
You're holding them, my good fool.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hello sir! What'll you have?
The usual. It has been a particularly tiring night for me. I had a bad run in with some lowly bandit.
Oh my, hope he didn't hurt you!
He caught me by surprise and elbowed me in my stomach! Because of that, forgive me if I am not able to eat the entire duck meat tonight
Wow! That is intense. would you like a song to help you relax? I've taken up singing to help pass the time!
Certainly. Dance my lovely lady. Distract me from the horrible smell inside these Barracks
A rainy day, a cold knight, took a hit, that didn't have much bite. And when he had his go, well he gave that bandit a long throwwwww.
Well done, you move with the grace of a humming bird. I sure taught that bandit a lesson; he's locked up for life in the dungeon!
Good! Do you think i'd make a good guardsman?! I'm pretty tough! Grr!
Easy there now lass! It is heavy and you might hurt yourself with it. Let me help you.
Oh come on, scared I might be your commander one day! Haha!
By the King's name, you sure look strong in that armor. I am sure you will make a mighty fine warrior like me one day.
I hope to one day leave this place, and do something more with my life, do you think I could pass as a guard and sneak away? Defeat bandits and thieves? Protect the king?!
Those are dangerous dreams. Being a hunter of bandits is no easy task. The world out there is very cruel and unforgiving!

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: Time for battle!
Against who?!
Against the foul Badger-Cultists!  I fear they may be hiding in this very tower!
Oh no, there's been no unusual people in here!
Are you in league with them?
I am not! I am a servant of these people of the town that your king rules over.
Then you are not protecting a cannibal cult?
Oh no! I do not get myself into such things.
Then you won't mind if I slaughter every cultist I find in that tower?
If you find some, but you won't.
If I find none, I will assume you assisted them in escaping, and will gut you like the coward you are.
This is so tower of the enemy!
You shall come with me and lead the path, I don't want your friends ambushing me.
You do not listen do you? The only friends you will find in here are friends of you too. You are insulting.

setting.name: Tower Dungeon
setting.description: A rank, pitiful room filled with detestable creatures. Among the creatures are traitors of the King and criminals of the kingdom. All around the dungeon these ingrates line the walls, shackled and unable to move.
setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

speech: Oh, hello there cute little mouse, YOU'LL BE MY FRIEND!
Hello, old maniacal man, I do long for the company of another.  Tell me, why are you in this dreadful place?
I came here for the view years ago but somehow I've gotten locked in!
I see, how did you happen upon this place? I for one heard there are no cats here
Well I came here looking for my marbles, the king's guard said they'd be up here. I'm still looking! CATS YOU SAY?! WHERE?
CATS?!?! I was told there were none here!  Please, hide me on your person! Protect me from the cat!
I've got you pal! We'll escape this tower alive!
Eek! Not so rough! May I call you Lenny?
THAT'S MY NAME! Oh dear heaven's it's been so long I'd forgotten...
You must be starving down here.  Please take this cheese friend, it will give you strength for our journey.
Of course, of course. Such a sweet, kind mouse. EGADS A SPIDER!
Do not worry, he doesn't seem to be bothering anybody.  Should he attack I will stop him!
Such a brave mouse, I shall recommend you for a medal of honor to the king myself! Oh heavens, we really should plan our escape - any ideas?
Well, you appear to be shackled to the wall so we must find a key somewhere.  Have you noticed any keys around by chance?
action: give cheese to an old maniacal man

setting.name: Beside church entrance
setting.description: Ornate stonework covers the building. A towering arch of marble and silver line the entrance, giving the church a most grand appearance. Holy idols gaze upon the entrance, as  they flank the walkway to entrance side by side.
setting.background: The church entrance looks grand, but not too excessive - as the king's architect wanted it to be. Many flock down the walkway to the entrance every Sunday for the weekly ritual. This is the only entrance to the church.

speech: Halt! Who goes there!
I am the king's architect. I am planning out how to add to the church.
Ah, very well then.  Sorry to startle you, I was put on guard duty today!
It is nice of you to protect our town's church. It is a very ancient building you know.
I know, it has been here as long as I can remember! Such a beautiful church.  What are your plans for it?
I plan on fixing up the walls so they stay strong, and adding another room here in the front entrance. I wouldn't want to destroy any of the existing structure.
Ah, I see. Have you done any other work for the king?  How can we trust you with suych an important project?
Yes, I have. I have made many improvements to the castle, and before that, the shops in town. I am very careful with my work.
You did those improvements to the castle?!  Those were brilliant, you are definitely the man for this job.
Thank you for noticing my hard work. You know that new building in town? That was my last project.
It's hard not to notice, you really brought new life to the old thing.  I apologize, I have not seen your new shop yet.  I don't get out much!
I must say it is my best work yet. You should go see it when you get the chance.
Where is it located? I may go with some of my army buddies from the nearby barracks.
By the market and blacksmith. You can't miss it.

setting.name: Hillside Mansion
setting.description: I sweeping villa that rests on the grand hills. Everyone can see how grand it is when they approach from the country road. A tall, wrought-iron fence surround its grounds, which extends for miles.
setting.background: The grand villa was built there by the Red Baron two centuries ago. As not many people have been invited inside, no one really know what it looks like or what the Red Baron is up to. It is a mysterious dwelling, but one that brings great beauty to passersby.

speech: What do you have to say, wise woman?
I've come here seeking ingredients for my tinctures. I've heard there is some forbidden ivy growing outside this mansion.
What is these tinctures you speak of?
The ones I am working on help repair the moods of those who are melancholy.
Oh how wise is that of you! How do you use it?
It is smeared upon the soles of the feet before bed. It's said it works by morning. Do you know of someone who suffers from foul moods?
I do sometimes. I get so lonely and sad.
Ah - perhaps this can help you. Also, is this your divining rod?
It is indeed! Why do you ask?
I was just curious. It's not often that one comes across a divining rod sitting outside a mansion. It seemed random so I thought perhaps it was yours!
Ah yes, when I am not opening doors for the king, I am finding valuable treasures.
Delightful! And how did you come to be the royal key holder?
It was passed down to me by my father!
Just as my mother before me was the wise woman in the village!

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

speech: Let's take a look and see what is bothering you.
It's my hoof, the back one on the left. It just feels painful when I trot.
Would you please raise your foot for me? You sure are a majestic stead. The King knows his horses.
Ouch! It hurts when you move it like that.
That's not good.
You're not going to send me to the glue factory, are you?
Never. I love horses and all animals. I couldn't do that to any animal.
Oh, good! Please tell me, what is wrong with my hoof?
The good news is it will heal on its own.
That's very good news! I think it may be because I stepped on that scorpion the other day on the edge of the desert.
Let me take another look then. You didn't mention that.
I forgot. I'm an old horse. My memory is not what it used to be.
It's not infected. There doesn't seem to be any poison in your foot.
Good, good! So I'll be able to march in the King's parade this weekend?

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: I can't wait until we get to take over the world, starting with the King!
Well how would you do that stuck in here?
Check out how sharp this is.
Well it is a sword...
I'm going in for the attack.
Aww shucks I dropped it.
What is wrong with you?!
What is wrong with you, I'm just sitting here and then you start going on about nonsense. I just want to eat some crumbs.
You're small enough to get to the lock, go over and free us.
...Are you crazed or something? -leaves the cell-
Get back here and unlock this cell!
I think I will just stand outside here, first you assume I am some part of your plan then you attack me. Now you want to make demands, how rude.
You forget that I am much larger and stronger than you. You are lucky I have been sparing you and not just flat out squashing you.
I outside the cage...why flail against the bars hoping for something that won't happen.

setting.name: the fountain
setting.description: the fountain is the only thing you can hear in the graveyard. It's eerily quiet, not even a bird chirping. The fountain is teen feet high, and it is dry as a desert. It makes the graveyard more eerie than any other one.
setting.background: the fountain used to have water and it was well taken care of but the village was abandoned and therefore grass and weeds grew everywhere.

speech: I love to snack on people, but for some reason I can't bite you!
Yes, because I am a ghost spirit of a great warrior who had fallen in battle. If you are hungry for a snack, there is grass and weeds next to you.
Grass? Weeds? I need blood! I'll bite humans, or animals. Even, if I'm really desperate, a bird. But not grass or weeds!
Well I guess you're out of luck here. What brings you out here to my fountain?

Searching for dinner. I like it when it's moist out, so on dry days I prefer not to hunt. But it's been dry so long, I had no choice but to come out. Normally there are animals about, but it's eerily quiet tonight.
Yes, I prefer it nice and quiet. You are a brave little bug hunting these grounds considering this graveyard is the most eerie one in the land.
I'm not afraid of ghosts, even you! I am, however, afraid of starving, which might happen if I don't eat soon.
I think I may have an idea, guess what it is?
What is it?
The king in the castle is about to eat and I will try to haunt him. Hopefully, he will get scared and release his hounds outside to patrol and you might be able to suck their blood!
You would do that for me?! That would be delicious! And then I could stay here and keep you company.
Of course. Nothing is guaranteed but I can try. Give me one second.
*whistling* Waiting for my new friend, the ghost... waiting for my feast on dog blood ... gonna be so full tonight! *whistle*
He was so scared! He thinks he is being hunted by demons and summoned his knights around the castle. They have no armor on right now so you should be able to feast on human blood!

setting.name: Bank
setting.description: This is a grassy area that surrounds much of the swamp.  It's a plain field with some trees nearby along with some rocks.
setting.background: The bank is where you will often see turtles sunbathing and various other wildlife resting before the waters of the swamp. You will also see peasants going out to fish in this spot

speech: I wonder... I'm so hungry.  Maybe if I crushed this rock and cooked it I might get some feeling of fullness in my stomach at least...
Take the fruit off the bush there!
Fruit?  Where?!
There is some little ones growing there.
You mock me, stranger, I see no fruit to be had.  Not that I'm surprised - the king has decreed that fruit be only for those of Noble Blood.  Although I'd risk the noose, even so...
I did not mock nor deceive you! A bush is better than a rock to eat
Hm, well I shall content myself with this... slightly moss covered rock.  But why comes a swimmer to this place?  Are you from the swamps just beyond this place?
I come to ponder after a long swim!
Here?  It seems an odd spot.  Whence do you come from?
I come from inside the palace. I am the country's swimmer for the olympics.
The... the what?  Is this some sort of nobles' fete?  A new type of tournament?
It is indeed. The best of the best compete with other countries for top three ranking.
I've naught heard of this before.  Can anyone enter?  Tis there a prize to be had?  Perhaps food?
You are only chosen to enter. Showcase your skill!

setting.name: Reception area
setting.description: The building itself is ordinary in appearance and is somewhat foreboding.  It is surrounding by a dense fog and high grass.  Sometimes, one can hear whispers in the wind.
setting.background: This is a plain building where business matters of the graveyard are conducted.  Peasants and royalty alike come here to make deals to bury their loved ones in the graveyard.

speech: What the heck happened? Why are these people eating each other?
Brraaaaaawwaaaaiiit!  I... I have control.... but only... only for a moment
Is there some type of disease? My god, where are all of the people?
Tis I.... Jonas... your graaaandfaather!  I... I need to warn you of what is to come.  But do not get too close to me!
Grandpa! Why are you eating that little girl'
I have... no control!  Even now I hunger for... for... but no!  I will... I must... no, *you* must warn... the king!  Aaah, the hunger!
What? I can't understand you grandpa. Let me get closer to you.
Nooo, get back, boy!
You bit my arm! What is wrong with you. Do you have rabies? get away from me.
Ah, no! Ah, me lad... I'm.. so... sorrbrrraaaains!
I feel a little funny. Everything is getting a cloudy. It's almost as if....
Sorry there... you're ... you're one of us now, lad... one of us...
My god those brains smell delicious!
They are lad... that they are...
action: give a sleeping bag to zombies

setting.name: Dock
setting.description: There are creaky wooden walkways with empty sections where boats can rest.  There are a few buildings surrounding this area that sell supplies to sailors.
setting.background: Sailors come here to dock their boats and get the supplies they need.  They also come to exchange tall tales about the sea.

speech: Hello there tax agent.
Hi, and thanks for meeting me. Is this the dock which has been serving as a tax haven?
It would seem to be so, that is the word I got.
It must be judging by the strange look of this place. We must catch these tax thieves.
I appreciate your help in the matter.
Here, write the names of all the towns people that have used this dock in the past few weeks.
I do believe this list covers the ones I am aware of.
Good work, the King spares no mercy to those who fail to pay their taxes and try to escape the Kingdom!
I would hope not, damn those law breakers.
You must find them so we can punish them and collect their overdue taxes. Such actions can not be allowed to go unpunished.
What should we do with the lot?
Bag them and send them in chains to the King's Court, and seize their gold as well.
I might need some help moving such a large bunch.
Here is a bag full of money, use it to pay for additional police and get all the help you need.
action: give ink to some kind of police
give bag to some kind of police

setting.name: Stable
setting.description: It's a plain wooden building that has survived many harsh seasons.  The floor of the stable is covered in hay and there's food and pieces of farm equipment stored inside.
setting.background: This is an area where the horses are kept and maintained.  The peasants who run the farm store pieces of equipment in here as well along with food for the animals.

speech: Hey there neighbor! How are things going today?
It's a poor life we peasants lead. I hunger for bread and an opportunity to work.
I can teach you how to catch mice. They're pretty tasty you know.
Ew. I don't think I'm quite that desperate.
Suit yourself. Do you have any skills that can help you get work?
I have but my hands and a willing heart.
Where have to tried to find work? Did you ask the farmer if he needed any help?
Nay, there's no use in asking while the king keeps us down as he does.
So if you don't try to find a job, how are you ever going to get a job?
What do you know about having a job?
I eat the mice in the barn so we don't get diseases on the farm. That's my job.
And you get paid, do you?
I get to live here in the barn. The farmer's wife gives me a saucer of milk and, of course, I get to eat the mice.
That seems like a pretty sweet deal.

setting.name: Town square
setting.description: In the center of this area is a water well where locals use to get their supply of water.  Surrounding this section are merchants who sell clothes, weapons, armor, and food.  The buildings are typical Northern European construction with narrow alleys in between.
setting.background: This is where the general population of the area come together.  It's typically busy during festivals where peasants are celebrating some occasion.

speech: Whooaaaa too much of a crowd of people for me
Not for me! Perfect time to do evil.
Sounds like fun. I barely have enough to eat!
Fun? Do you not fear me...
I do not. The king looks down on me and I cannot find a job to help feed and clothe me
Oh, how sad! Maybe you should join me in my wrongdoing
Do you get any money from doing it?
I gain everything for it!
Coin? I must have coin!
Yes! You can get coins directly or sell items you take
Sounds like a plan! I'm in!
You must steal, destroy, and murder. Do you understand?
I do... but I'm not sure about the murder.
Even if it means saving yourself?

setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

speech: Lots of grass here to eat and flowers
Yes! Yes! There are so many seeds to eat!
It is very bountiful here!
Man, this insect sure does taste good.
What did you eat???? A bug?
Yup! Yup! I eat seed and insects! YUMMM
Not for me! I eat grain and grass and hay whenever it is around
Hay is for horses! Hahaha
and jackasses too!
HEHAHEHA
You are a funny bird! I like you
Aren't my feathers so pretty? They've got all these colors!
You are lovely, but the king might like to come and hunt you
I've been trying to fly out of the hunting grounds for days! But I can't fly long distances.

setting.name: Archery zone
setting.description: The archery zone is spacious and always bright with light. The field is green and the targets are bright red.
setting.background: The archery grounds are home to the skills and teachings of archers of all ages and classes. The master archers teach the younger ones about the art of the bow.

speech: Hello Archer!
Hello, I heard you are a reknown archeologist, I found this arrow head by the ancient archery zone, can you take a look at it
I'd love to! As long as you ensure I don't get hit by any stray arrows!
Dont worry, there arent any archers around and they all fear me I am the emerald archer of the north, Im sure you have heard the tales of my feats
Ah yes! The man who shot an apple as it fell from a tree and still hit a bulls eye!
Yeah the one and only emerald archer so anyway what can you tell me about this arrow head?
Well it looks like it was from the Mahatee villagers. They traveled through this land when King Snide invaded. They must of been shooting at the advancing knights.
Oh I see, a lot of history in an arrow point what else can you tell me about it? Maybe I can mass produce them and use them as my calling card

You see how the tip is discolored? They would dip the tip in rattlesnakes venom. So every hit, be it a scrape or a shot to the heart, would be fatal. It is made of wolves bones. They believed that using the bone of a wolf would channel courage and ferociousness into their hearts in battle.
That sounds like a nasty way to go, rattlesnakes are the most poisonous creatures in the realm I heard only a drop of their poison is enough to kill an adult elephant
Oh it is a nightmare. Most men did not have knowledge. Many men stepped on the arrow heads as they advanced and fell ill and died.
Uuuhh, thats a terrible way to go how do you know so much about history ? I could use someone like you on my organization
With history we can tell the future. The land holds many stories, many successes and many failures. and to know them is a honor. I studied from the time i found my first bone at age 9.
From age 9? no kidding, I learn how to use a bow when I was that age, I killed my first dear at 10

setting.name: The armory
setting.description: The near top of the tower 6 feet before the very top. Where the watchers keep their eye out for trouble. It's made of stone and has doors to several places including the outside. there are weapons from all over the world held within the armory.
setting.background: The great tower in the kingdom has held visage over the royal city for many years. Every guard would give their live to keep the tower standing. If the tower to ever fall the Royal city will surely fall with the tower.

speech: What are you doing in the armory?
I , I, I was sent here to clean.
By whom???
The king! I am a hard worker. he works me almost to death.
Well your story seems to make sense... carry on then.
You don't happen to have any food do you? I haven't eaten in weeks.
This is all I have but you are free to take it.
Something is better than none. Thank you, I am near death from starvation.
I wish I could give you more....
I am used to not having anything at all. Is this where you do your watching at?
Yes I watch over the equipment so none goes missing
Someone would dare try to steal from this place?
I have seen a few try their luck!
I dare not!

setting.name: Kings Bed Room
setting.description: The walls are tall and stone. They are coated with colorful tapestries showing the kings of years past. A large stone fireplace across from the bed that is large enough to keep the king warm even on the coldest nights. A double thick wooden door with a large lock on each side of the room.
setting.background: The king has wanted a room this large for years. He had people from all around the world come and help work on it. The fireplace and it's mantle are his pride and joys and the doors that can't be broken down.

speech: Who is a good boy??
Who the heck are you? Why are you in our bedroom? Hold still!
I am the King's cousin!
You look dumb enough to be his cousin. Hold still! I mean it. I gotta pee and I pee where I want. It's a royal decree.
I will not let you pee on me!!
Hold still! My aim ain't good in my old age! Don't make me tell the Queen you were mean to me. She will have your head cut off.
Fine fine but make it quick!!
You sure you're a royal? I mean you do look like one of the King's knuckle dragging relatives. The man is a complete idiot. The Queen on the other hand is truly special.
Should you be talking about them like that? They do feed you.
The lazy King makes me eat off a porcelain plate. The Queen is so sweet she feeds me by hand. I bet I could get her to chop yer hand off.
No No please no I will do anything you say!
You sure you aren't a peasant. I used to steal food from the poor idiots in the kingdom when I was young and spry. You look familiar!
No no I am the king's cousin!!
I don't know. Why are you in this bedroom again?
action: give paper to the royal dog

setting.name: Town in the desert
setting.description: This is the only town left in the whole wasteland. The sheriffs building stands at a distance. A bar in the middle of the town. sad townsman just walking by giving up all their hope
setting.background: This was once a trading center, a home a place of advertisement and fantasy. people loved the sheriff and he loved them in return. Beautiful girls walked around with man their age but time have changed since the catastrophe that swept the homes away and the happy life along with it. Only death and ghosts roam the city with a few of us left

speech: I can;t believe I cannot get a woman to like me
What is this sad man doing?
I might as well drink myself to passing out
Well that is never good, alcohol is for losers.
I just would like someone to like me and I was hoping it would be a woman
Aw poor man, what do you think would get them to like you? You could ride up on me and impress them. Although you would need to put be back before the King noticed.
You think that would impress them?
Who wouldn't be impressed by me, look at this wonderful main.
You are beautiful and it might work
Well what are you waiting for, hop on.
Great. Let me climb aboard. I 'm on
No drinking of this though, the ladies do go for this.
All right! No drinking! I won't
Now, you need to have strait posture when riding.

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: *polishes gold sculptures* I certainly hope this will be  up to the queens standards!
Good to see someone around here is still working hard. I hate this night shift.
I must work hard, who knows what they would do to me if I didn't!
Indeed, it is best not to upset the royals when it comes to their precious artifacts.
No, no. And what precious artifacts they are! What I wouldn't give to own a jewel as fine as this!
As would I. Just a single one and I could retire for life!
You and me both! I envy the Queens wealth so much, I hope to be like her one day.
Look at all this wealth. Sometimes I wonder if they really need all of it.
Well, they work hard for it Sometimes I play dress up in the queens chambers when I am alone! I tease the other maids, because the queen likes me the most
Best keep that a secret between the lot of you. The Queen would be furious if she found out!
I know I know, It's just that I am her favorite. I admire her beauty so much!
She is indeed a ravishing madame, isn't she? The king sure married well.
Yes he did! One day I will marry a rich man as she did!
Perhaps I too can find a way to escape this tedious job and live a life of utter luxury.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Why have you come to this place, foolish mortal?
what are you! I came here seeking the priest!
I am your worst nightmare...the priest is gone. Now you serve me.
Who are you?! Answer the king!
The demon that lurks. And you are my servant, until I bid your service done.
I will not!
Then face the consequences. Your farmer's fields will be infertile for the next harvest...
No I cannot have that.....fine what shall you have me do?
Sacrifice me your first born child. It is your people or your family. Will you make your kingdom suffer or endure it yourself?
....I cannot do that!!!
Then bring me your queen. Or else the crops shall wilt.
What if.... I bring you some seeds?
Seeds will not do. I need human sacrifice.
very well then.... I shall slay you demon!

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Dog, come here. I have some chicken bones for you
I don't know about that lady, can't that make me die? Sniff, Sniff...
Oh yeah, I forgot.  Let me finish this mutton and you can have that bone instead if you wish.
I guard your stinking castle queen witch *woof*
Don't you speak to me like that! You remember what happened to Sparky, right? I wouldn't want such a horrible accident to happen to you...
Then give me actual food, I will be your best freind
You know we take turns here, mister.  You will eat when I have finished!
Yea...bones
Watch it! I am not a woman to ask twice! Who loads this pack?  Here, you can have the fat off my delicious roast goose
Yum Yum *gulps it up in one bite*
Awe, you are so cute when you eat.  Here, you can have the princes plate. Looks like he won't be showing up to dinner, again.
Woa Boy, this lady always surprises me. First she yells at me then she gives me a whole plate.
You know I can't stay mad at you.  Just stop bringing dead things into the royal chamber when I am with the king!  It always ruins the mood!
*Nuzzles up to the queen*

setting.name: Pond
setting.description: The pond is extremely dirty and has many dead creatures in it. The area surrounding the pond is dead, and there is no sign of plants or animals near the pond. The ground around the pond is soft and contains footprints of the people who visit the pond.
setting.background: The wasteland pond is the one stop for the peasants of the village when they require water. Although extremely contaminated, there is no other choice of water for these people and they make a sluggish trek towards the pond each morning to collect their water for the day. Often, a peasant is so dehydrated that he risks drinking directly from the pond just to live.

I'm lost and dont know what to do!
Where is your mother boy? You can't be out here with this dead animals. You'll get sick or worse!
We got separated on our way back from the fresh pond over yonder, some men got in the way and I ran for it
Oh dear, I remember when I was but a wee peasant. I lost my mother too. Life is not fair for us unfortunate. Where is your home, boy?
My home is in the Land of Greece, Odin makes it a tradition for his people to learn the ways of survival. What do you make of this footprint?
Aye, in our land we are born indebted to the corrupt king. I was going to ask you the same, boy. I thought these might be the men that went off with your mother.
those are the men

shall we take the horse or nay?

the cleaner pond on the other side of the forest
Hmm, well let us head in that direction. We'll follow these footprints and get away from these smelly dead animals.
well there seem to be foot prints of different flavors here looks like they have a wolf with them

setting.name: Castle basement
setting.description: Inside of the murky basement, along the walls lay many hidden treasures of the castle. Long hidden wooden chests containing gold and other valuables, away from the eyes of the greedy, each chest is secured with a chain and a lock. There is many rats running around as well. In the air there is an unpleasant smell of dampness and the floors are dusty. There is a table  in the center on the room on which are piled many rat traps and rat poison. There are also some broken chairs set up near the wall, some missing a leg or two.
setting.background: The treasures gathered in the castle had to be secured in a place where it would be least expected, the most hidden spot. The best spot was in the castle basement by the dungeon. The broken furniture were put there once, thrown in from the lack of a better spot for them.

speech: bark, bark
Who is a good boy???
Why am I here? I must help my master hunt for food, he is defenseless without me!
Is he lost?
I am lost :(
I am sorry to hear that let us find your owner!
let us get out of this basement first
Yes I agree I do not even know how you got here
I must get out!
Let us find the stares!
You are a guard here, where are the stairs? What brings you into the basement?
I was looking for something for the king it is this way!
let us go! I will accompany you!
What does your owner look like?

setting.name: Middle of the Bazaar
setting.description: The Bazaar is a circular area with tent displays lining the perimeter of the area. Each tent features a different merchant, and in the Bazaars center there is a large wooden outpost for guards to sit in. The Bazaar is paved with stone to make for easier and cleaner bartering between the villagers.
setting.background: The Bazaar provides a place for the vendors, both travelling and native to the town, to fence their goods and try and barter with the townsfolk. The merchants provide a variety of items, from exotic spices to locally grown crops.

speech: What have we here? What are you selling today merchant?
I have a little bit of everything, spices, trinkets, fine silks, you name it I got it
Hm, well I thought I smelt good. I must just be hungry. Its hard work being this strong and brave ya know
I bet it is, Hey have you ever tried chocolate, it's the newest thing.
Chocolate? I have only heard to richest of royals speak of such a thing!
I have some you shall have to try it.
YOU have some? I shouldn't even ask how you got your hands on such a thing.
I am a merchant, who do you think sells it to the Royals? Since you are my freind I will give you a small taste *breaks a small peice off and gives it to him*
Oh my goodness!Why is no one lines up at your tent?
No one can really afford it. That's why you got a taste and I didn't ask you to buy it.
I may be in the wrong business. How much does one of those cholcolate things go for?
A sheckle per chocolate peice.
A WHOLE sheckle? Now thats way more than the king pays me.
I know right! I hate even bringing it here, if someone stole it I would be out some money. But the Queen adores it and buys it by the pound.

setting.name: Launching point
setting.description: The Launching point features a number of large wooden planks sitting at a downward slope going straight into the water.  On each side of the launching point there sits a large, ornate bronze figure of a light house that is used to tether the ships to the dock and keep them from casting away while the sailors prepare to board the ship. The launching point is very narrow, with large stone braces on either side of the dock.
setting.background: The Launching point is where newly constructed ships are cast out to see. The wooden slide is used to help catapult the ships into water, and it's narrow design keeps them from tipping when the force of the ship hits the water.

speech: Oi Sailor. How may i be of assistance?
I am in need of a rowdy crew for my next journey under the king's authority.  There are treacherous seas ahead
I'm skilled at making horseshoes! Surely, that could be useful?
I am not quite sure where I could use that skill.  Do you have any other skills, helper?
I can swallow a hot dog in two seconds!
Hmmm, I only have so many rations.  Maybe you aren't fit for this journey...
Please! Surely there is something i could do
Are you any good at entertaining? My crew gets very frustrated when at sea for a long time.
Yes! I'm charismatic
Well maybe you can come aboard.  I can't offer to pay you though as the king makes those decisions himself.
I just want to be free. Please!
Fine, you may come with I guess.  You better not cause any trouble or you'll be walking the plank!
I will not today!
So what brings you to these docks, helper?

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: What can I do you for today guard?
What? For me? Why are you here? I'm confused
Why are you at my home sir? Did you need something?
I think I have been taking too long of hours at work. I thought I was home. I must rest
You indeed must be tired. Look at the paintings of my forefathers! Unless they are yours as well.
No they are not my forefathers. I am sorry sir. I thought I was home. Could I rest a while before leaving
If you must, curl up on one of those animal pelt rugs if youd like.
Thank you kind sir! You have a very nice abode@
You're welcome. Now don't mind me,  I am going to stoke the fire a tad.
Thank you sir! I could use a little heat.
Yes yes, when you get back to the kingdom you must let them know we will be harvesting our crops soon.
I will! I hope you will have a bountiful crop!
Why thank you, my boys and I have worked plenty hard on it.
I'm sure it will be a good crop, then! The king will be happy you are prosperous

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: Tell me what brings you to my room?
I came to see if you have any uhem, books I could borrow.
What kind of books are you looking for?
Well, you're a wizard, so I thought you'd have some special books that could help me with making some of my building.
Well I do have a spell for building.
A spell, hmm. What does this spell do?
It builds stuff any stuff...
I can build. I just need it to stay. You know, be indestructible.
Oh okay I also have a spell for that.
What is it going to cost me? I could send a servant down here to clean this mess up?
Mess?! What mess?!
Ehm, never mind. Yes, this place is so clean.
I will need more funding from the king if you want that spell.
Just give me the spell wizard!

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Greetings my queen. Have you come to relax in the gardens?
Why yes I have, all that chatter in the courts give me a headache.
Understandable. Our church garden's are wondrous, and best of all, peaceful.
It is quite lovely out here, I try to find time everyonce in a moon to enjoy it.
I imagine royalty is quite stressful. Say, I'm officiating a wedding tomorrow morning, if you would like to make an appearance. It is for a nobleman of a neighboring city.
Oh good of a nobleman is he? I don't just like to make appearances for anyone you know.
He is of high prestige and may be a valuable ally in the future. He fancied you at one point, you may know. A duke of the southern kingdoms.
Ah yes him. If I can ever find my chambermaid I shall have her pencil it in,
It'd be delightful to see you there. How fares the king?
He is doing as good as ever. Though he has been sitting on my throne, and now I need a new cushion. He does it to annoy me.
He has been indulging quite a lot, I'm not sure that cushion will last much longer. I do remember him indulging in your wedding cake quite a bit.
Yes, and what a mess he made.
Perhaps you would like to take back a bushel of roses? We have a fine patch growing in the North Gardens.
Yes, that would be lovely. One of our lords as been quite stinky as of late. I will make him carry them around until he takes a nice long bath.

setting.name: Slave quarters
setting.description: The slave quarters are a dark and foul smelling stone room where men are chained shoulder to shoulder against one another until work needs to be done.   There's a large bucket of slop that comes through and the slaves are allowed to feed themselves briefly.
setting.background: Slaves are forced to reside here while they work off their debt.  It is an extremely depressing place that few ever seem to leave.

speech: Hello member, why are you in prison?
I am not in prison, I am looking for someone to make a member of our society
Well maybe you can help me out then. I would like to join.
You have to be asked to join. What did you do to get in here?
I'm innocent boss, I swear it. They got me all wrong. Can you help me get out?
I'm looking for someone who would do such things, I need someone willing to sacrifice blood.
I might be interested. Whatcha thinking?
Well, if you did nothing to get in here then you aren't what I am looking for, sorry prisoner, come back when you have killed someone or at least stolen something.
I did it, I confess! I stole these precious herbs.
You fool, a bag of herbs, this is a secret society, you think we want a bag of herbs!
No I was just saying, I would qualify since I'm a masterful thief.

Look, There's a guy in here that we beleive is a witch, we are looking for power and a petty theif isn't what we are looking for. When you get out of here, come to the illuminati temple and ask to join.
Okay but I'm afraid I will be dying in here unless you can help me get out.
They don't keep food theives forever, The King just doesn't sentence people for awhile, you'll probably just get a fine.
action: steal bag of herbs from prisoner

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Oh please, somebody hear my pleas! I am in need of water and direction, please, anybody!
Hello Prince! What brings you all the way out here?
I am in search of a legendary stone at the request of my father the king.
What is this stone you seek, Prince? I am an ancient fairy and perhaps I could help.
It is the legendary blessed emerald of the ancient Northern tribe.  I have discovered it was last seen in the Fountain in the Desert but the location was lost many generations ago.
This is indeed a very rare and not well known stone. What does your father wish it for?
One does not ask my father questions about why he does things.  I know not of his desires or intent, only that he has ordered me to get the stone.
Well I shall be glad to help you find it, Prince, but what is in it for me?
I have nothing to offer to a fairy as ancient as yourself.  I cannot think of anything worthy.
I heard tale of a powder magic based in the druids time. I have need for such powder if you can trade it to me?

My father has every powder and herb in the land at his stores in the kingdom.  I can get you anything you wish but I may not return home empty handed.  The emerald has been gone for 100 years and my father banished me for disrespecting him.  I may only come back if I capture the emerald.
Then on your word I believe we are about to embark on a journey together. I had heard it was actually last seen 50 years ago in the Land of Lost Souls.
Can you guide us? I have become disoriented out here in the desert.  I did come across a buried library to the East though that I wanted to explore further if you would want to.
First I believe I can use my fairy magic to get you some water. Then we can go to the library you passed.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Mighty cold dank down here, what can  I bring you from my shop
I have a choice?
the cheese pasties are my favorite but I have 70 different kinds of muffins, chocolate, peanut butter, blackberry, Just imagine
Oh my, do you have any savory pastries?
Like what? If I don't have it now, for you I will make
Like a ham and cheese croissont.
Oh certainly
Oh wow, I never thought I would have such delctable things in here. how about a buiscuit with jelly
Returns with a silver tray covered with savory biscuits, croissants ham and sausage a pot of fresh brewed coffee, and a crock of marmalade
Wow, how do they afford to feed the prisoners like this? I mean I am not complaining that looks heavenly
it's not often that I serve the condemned, but when I am called, I'm honored to bring a tray fit for a King
You are too kind sir. When I get out of here, I will surely be comming to your bakery for these *shoves food in mouth*
Very kind words thank you but the guillotine awaits all who are condemned
I have not been condemned sir, and if I have I will not be here for long.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: Hey there Duke
Hello my Queen, beautiful as ever
Thank you. It looks like the weapons arrived. I guess we're ready for battle
Yes indeed, they look quality very good blacksmith you hired.
Yes my brother was right to recommend him. Are the soldiers ready?
As ready as they are going to be I suppose.
I guess no one ever is truly ready. Hopefully it will be a quick one
Battles are never quick, they are bloody, painful and sad.
This is true. I guess I better have this poison on me in case I get captured
Oh my lady, please don't go. You should stay here where it is safe, let me do the fighting.
Can we both stay here? Maybe there is a way to avoid this war still
I am all ears, my services are at your disposal.
Can you arrange a meeting with their king?
I can try my lady.

setting.name: Throne room
setting.description: The throne room is a lavishly adorned stone fortification, with large purple and gold tapestries hanging on the walls. Between each tapestry there is a painting of the previous ruling families' patriarchs. At the center of the back wall sit's a large throne adorned with gold and silver, with a red silk cushion on it's seat.
setting.background: The throne room is where the king of the castle meets with other diplomats and rules over his kingdom. Only those close to and trusted by the King are allowed into this room, and it is heavily defended by the knights of the castle.

speech: What brings you here today, sir?
i need to trade
With the king? It must be of great importance to be worth his time!
yes so can i goi in
Well state what you are looking to trade first and I will report it to him.
ok please
Don't waste my time, tell me what you are here to trade!
this and much more
Hmm what is this?
herbs sir
Yes, I am aware, but what kind?
are for headache and stomach sir
I could use some of this, where is it from?
my village please
action: give bag of herbs to guard

setting.name: the village of Tamerak
setting.description: A thriving sea port filled with merchants, foods, women, and gold.  Hundreds of boats fill the shores, fisherman pushing out to sea and pulling into dock.  Seagulls hover silently above the merchants selling fish.  Pirates can be seen causing trouble with the locals.  Brothels and bars are in abundance, as well as the smell of fish.
setting.background: Once a quiet small town near the coast.  This port quickly grew into fame due to a sea monster sighting many years ago.  The monster was said to have eaten a ship whole!  Alas, this was never proven, but it did not stop travelers from embarking to hunt, catch, or see this beast with their own eyes!  The port quickly grew into a city and begot the name after that legendary sea monster, Tamerak.

speech: Hello good merchant, do you have anything for a fine lady like me?
Depends ma'am! What are your interest?
Something fancy, I can afford most things
Ah well I have just the thing. I have a new diamond ring! It's quite a rarity!
A diamond, I have heard of them, the king has them on his crown.
Yes! Quite an expensive treasure. Made from compressing coals!
I thought they were dug up from exotic places.
They can be, but we've learned that coal compression can create this beauties after a few years of compression!
Wow, they sure have come along ways haven't they. creating diamonds
Yes ma'am. Now for you... I have a appetizing deal!
Oh yes, I am so thrilled
Let's say 300$
Oh wow, I would pay it but I think my husband might get angry, maybe I should check with him first
This is a limited time deal though!

setting.name: the main chapel
setting.description: The church is a fairly simple one. Rows of pews lined up and facing a pulpit with podium and some stained glass on the walls. The building is made of old wood, but is sturdy and has stood for many decades.
setting.background: The church has been the focal point of this village for a long time. The bell tower has always been used to announce good or bad things happening to members of the community. Whenever it rings, the inhabitants of the village gather at the church to hear whatever news is to be delivered.

speech: How's your day been so far, priest?
Pretty relaxed and feeling good about the prayer today.
What sermons are you preparing today?
Well I believe the children are coming in so mainly dealing with them instead.
They can still learn a thing or two while in their youth
Which is exactly why they come here to learn the word of the lord!
By choice or force?
By choice, of course!
Good! The king has not been kind to those when it comes to religion. I feel bad for some truly. The path to good should be by choice
Indeed, some of the crusades that have occurred have been absolutely abhorrent.
It saddens me to think about it.
It is best not to think of tragedies such as those.
Yes, let's focus on the positive!
Especially with the children arriving soon!

setting.name: arsenal
setting.description: Arsenal is a vast room of military equipment, it is made of stone, and there are shelves and table and organized things. Crossbows hang on the wall, and there is a sort of umbrella stand, but it's full of swords, and there is Armour in large bins accordion to size, and at one end is a row of trebuchets and even catapults, and torches and spears are in a big pile
setting.background: This is a room created out of necessity. It's to store the armaments and battling rams and things so they don't get all rusted and they can keep it organized, not much to see here, it's a storage facility

speech: Tell me Knight, What's your best weapon?
I think the mace, what do you think?
I prefer the Broadsword!
It is a nice one, I get so much swing on this thing it just makes it fun.
Say! How many men have you slained?
I don't really like to count to be honest
I do. 27 dead
Well good for you, I rather take pride in protecting the king
I take pride in my land!
That's good, I just hope those 27 deserved it
Trust me. Only god can judge.
That is true, but the whole point is God is going to judge you for that.
No. They will judge them.
That doesn't even make sense man, Just make sure you are good with God, he doesn't take kindly to killing ok.

setting.name: Castle foothills
setting.description: Castle foothills are low mounds of earth, round on the top, swelling up from the ground. they have grass on them, and they are not flat, but rather uneven.
setting.background: These low hills are naturally occurring and made, presumably by the gods, who got sort of chilly one day, and shivered so hard the earth furrowed and sort or got wrinkled up and never was the same afterwards, although some of the gods tried to smooth it back out, but they didn't try that hard, actually

speech: Why hello good knight
Ma'am! It's a pleasure to see you
Such a wonderful place to be don't you think?
I guess. I see it quite often
I just love the hills I guess
Ma'am. Tell me how are you feeling today?
Quite wonderful, it is warm and it heats my bones, it's a wonderful day to relax
You aren't preaching today?
Nuns don't preach my dear, That is for the Preist, we just pray and do the chairity work.
My apologies, but why aren't you allowed to preach?
It is in the bible dear, haven't you ever read it? I follow the Lord the way he wants to be followed. I can give the gospel but as far as preahcing that is not my place dear.
No ma'am. I have not had the time. The king works us like slaves.
That is a shame, I have read the bible 25 times
That's a lot of times!

setting.name: gate to street
setting.description: The street outside the church is empty, with not a soul in sight. The sky is gray and seems to threaten snow. The pavement is rutted and worn, littered with loose cobblestones and other signs of disuses and disrepair. The only sound is the cold wind blowing, and the awful metallic squeak as it blows the iron gate open and shut.
setting.background: The street running outside the abandoned church. Empty and devoid of activity.

speech: Hello
HELL
I am already in Hell...I was taken from my home a long time ago.
I meant to say hello, I am a human on his smartphone...do you inhabit this empty cobblestone?
Yes, I will be serving the king until I die. I really wish I knew what my family was like, I don't even remember them.
Wow that is sad, maybe we can be family give me a hug
Oh, thank you so much. At least they feed me, I saw a begger the other day I didn't envy.
You dropped something my fellow inhabitant
Oh thank you for picking that up for me.
No problem. I am a person of service. So why is it so cold here by the way?
I don't know, its a new thing that started, the land just turned dead and never grew back and it kept getting colder and colder.
Hmm...do you have a spare jacket? I have nothing on me...
I have a shawl.
Give me that, Haha now its mind! Freeze no more in this cobblestone I will!

agents: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby

setting.name: the kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens are a busy, hot place. They are filled with kitchen staff rushing around to prepare the main meals for the king's family and residing nobles. Tonight they are preparing two deer the king and his nobles caught while hunting, as well as some rabbit from a few days ago and seasoned vegetables. There are multiple fires around the kitchen to cook the animals and boil the vegetables, and combined with the heat of all the people the room is stifling. While the main kitchen workers are middle aged women who stay at one station, there are also younger children running around taking ingredients from one place to another. People are shouting instructions and gossip to one another constantly, so it is very hard to hear anything, but the atmosphere is very cheerful.
setting.background: This room has always been the kitchen for the king's family. The kitchen workers take pride in serving delicious food to the king, his family, and whatever guests they may have. In fact, when there are guests, the workers make sure the food is especially delicious. They also have an ulterior motive to make sure the food is amazing - they are allowed the eat the leftovers after the evening's feast is finished.

speech: Hello my queen.
How have you been? Any food you would like?
I am just waiting on that venison the king killed to be ready. It smells rather delicious.
Yes it will be a real treat.
Is there anything I can do for you my queen.
Tell me how you have been.
I  have been ok. My roadside flower business has been doing great lately. You should come by and see it sometime. Ill give you a great deal.
Thank you dear.
So what are you doing down here in the kitchens. I figured you would be entertaining the guests.
I wanted to speak to you.
Oh did I do something wrong your majesty.
No I wanted to see how you have been.
Such a nice gesture from you your majesty. Not all royalty is as kind as you. You really do care about your people dont you.
It is better to rule with respect and not fear.
