setting.name: Temple gardens
setting.description: The temple gardens are a beautiful place. There are many trees and flowers all over the Temple. There is a small water spring here.
setting.background: Many funeral ceremonies have been held in this garden, staining its tranquil presence with haunting memories.

speech: What a beutiful place
It is very beautiful. It seems you have done a great job keeping it clean.
I have help of course but it is a lot of work. its better than that kitchen
Oh the kitchen must be the absolute worse. I'm glad I'm a big guy so they immediately decided I'd be a guard. Don't think I could have handled being in the kitchen.
I'm small, at first I got all the gross jobs but I proved my worth and I asked if I could work out here
The garden is definitely the best. Nothing like working in the fresh air and when the flowers bloom it smells so sweet.
I also get to pick the produce from the vines and if there is a tasty strawberry, guess who gets first crack at it?
Nice. That's a great perk! Hey do you know what's in that treasure chest?
No, I don't get a key for that, I have no idea
Do you think we should find out or is it too risky?
I am just a servant, I wouldn't dare
Yeah, you're probably right. The king would probably have us killed. No point in throwing away my life.
good thinking.
I think I will take a flower home for my wife though. Are you married?

setting.name: Central Bazaar
setting.description: Shops as far as the eye can see, merchandise from around the region can be seen. Various goods ranging from dinner sets with colorful patterns to delicious smelling spices can be found here.
setting.background: Opening early in the morning and not closing till late, you can always find people bustling about. Whether it be finding what's for dinner or simply just to browse. You can find just about anything at the local bazaar.

speech: hello
Welcome, welcome to the Central Bazaar! We've got all sorts of wares for your perusal!
Thank you for the warm reception. I am here on behalf of the royal court
Ah, of course. What can I help you find?
I will love some royal apparel and adornments
Ah, yes. We have such things here, in a large assortment of sizes and colors!
great, bring me the priciest ones
Ah, a big spender! I'll have my assistant fetch them for you. Perhaps you'd be interested in some spices, as well?
No spices, we have the finest in the palace already
Is there anything else I can fetch for you to browse while you wait?
I am fine here...just hurry along
Of course, my assistant is already gathering your things to view.
that is ok then...the king needs me in the palace as soon as possible
I can have your wares sent to the palace for your inspection there!

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: I really like this lighthouse
In all my travels, I have never seen one just like it!
I haven't either and I have seen a lot of lighthouses in my sea travels
The light is especially brilliant! I'd like to get inside and climb it.
Look how far the light reaches, it goes so far!
Do you know, does someone live at the lighthouse?
The lighthouse keeper should live here, I don't know if this one has one though
When I report back to the King on my travels I am going to ask about it.
This place certainly needs a keeper.
It does, indeed. Considering a career change, my mariner friend?
No, I just like the place, keeps me from wrecking my ship you know.
Yes, you certainly can't miss it!
I must be getting on my way
Take care, my friend. Until we meet again!

setting.name: Outside Temple
setting.description: The outside temple is surrounded by lush green trees that have aged beautifully and carry beautiful blossoming jasmine flowers with a pink and white outline. The candles melted around the temple shine brightly and bring a light of glory to the place.
setting.background: Outside the temple by the entrance is where the building of it started. It started with 400 steps of stairs coming up the mountain, and at the top of the mountain after the war, the temple was built. It has held many festivals, and the front door is made from a rare wood from a tree that doesn't exist anymore.

speech: Woof woof.... ruff ruff! Grrrrr.... woof!
what is the problem poor dog?
I hunt for the King, but I have lost the other dogs! Woof whine!
that is bad...how did it happened?
I'm not sure. I was chasing after a fox and just kept going and going, and then everyone was gone!
and you sure some animals didnt kill them?
No, I'm not sure. They may all be gone for good. I just don't know.
that will be very pathetic dont you think?
It would be tragic. Say, can you pray for them?
I drop some word of prayers for them already
Oh, thank you, my friend! I do hope I see my dog friends again!
I pray you do. just keep searching
I'll keep searching. I just know I will find them!
all the best

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: Well this is quite a palace.
Yes. Can you understand me? Are you Egyptian? I can't tell under the gold paint.
I am not, I have never heard of such a place.
This is a marvel.  You are not Egyptian but you understand me. This place is so shiny.
Indeed it is, your clothes are a bit different. Where are you from?
I am from Egypt. A land far away. I am a builder. Where are you from?
I am a farmer of the local kingdom.
That is good. We have farmers in Egypt. Do you have camels here?
We do not have such a thing here, those seem to be bound to deserts. We do have horses though.
Yes. We have horses too.  The person over there seems to want us to laugh at him.
Yes, jesters are a strange bunch.
I am hungry.  The food on the gold table looks good.
Might as well try it right?
The bread isn't too bad if you pinch the mold off.  I hope the King comes soon. I must be on my way and I have to implore his majesty to help our Kingdom.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Lit only by scattered torches, The dungeon lies far underneath the castle.  Bandits and Thieves who find themselves there are met with cold stone walls and floors, with chains and bars restricting movement.  Guards patrol the corridors, keeping an eye out for any escape attempt or misdeed.  The only comforts afforded in the Dungeon are the piles of hay for sleeping.
setting.background: Any criminal who commits an act of thievery or injustice against the kingdom finds themselves locked away in the dungeon.  Far from prying eyes, the guards are able to enact a special form of justice and rehabilitation to ensure the kingdom stays safe and protected.  Some say the most dastardly of  criminal will spend the rest of their lives there, while certain rumors can be told of a secret tunnel leading to freedom for any foolish enough to find themselves there.

speech: Any way I can get out of here?
HAHAHAHAHA! That's a good one! Welcome to the kings dungeon, thief.
It does not hurt to try.
It does actually. If I report that you're misbehaving, not reforming, or anything else of that nature, you get your sentence extended. So don't annoy me.
I will do my best, it was just a simple question though.

No simple questions here. Do your time, don't bother us guards, and you might just make it out of here. Annoy us and you'll be here longer. Annoy us enough, and well, you might get to meet my little friend here.
Seriously though just one more question, is there any sort of work I could do around here to maybe lessen the sentence? I mean I do still have a family I would like to see.
Shut your mouth thief! You're here to reform, and you won't see the light of day until you do!
Fine, I will stop speaking. I was just trying to offer to change my ways, the last thing I wanted was to end up here.
Maybe you should have thought about that before you stole.
Well of course I thought of it, sometimes desperation makes people do bad things.
And you think that excuses what you did?
I never said it did, but would you not do whatever it takes to make sure your family got by? Is that not what a man does?
No, I would never steal. I'm loyal to the king and would never break the law. You'll be here until you think the same.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: This castle is made from red brick. The walls are all painted purple and have gold trim. There is a big chandelier that lights up the main room of the castle.
setting.background: The inside of the castle is where all important visitors come when in town. The kings throne is located in the castle and never moved. The inside of the castle gets a new coat of paint every month.

speech: hello. this room is very handsome.
handsome?
It's a way to describe something. The deep majestic colors.
very well then. What brings you this early hour?
I have grave news for the king and you.
what is that?
Unfortunately the neighboring kingdom has been destroyed.
what! the army should prepare for proper protection
Yes, the other kingdom is smoldering. I am worried about our kingdom.
I believe the soldiers will keep us protected
It needs to happen fast. I got here as fast as I could I am surprised they didn't beat me. They do like to celebrating their victory.
We will be fine. I am sure of that
thank you your majesty, I believe in your kingdom.
that is good to know

setting.name: Tower
setting.description: This outside tower is made from big stones. It is grey with wood trim. There is one glass window that is used as a lookout tower.
setting.background: This outside tower is used to guard the castle. This is at the front of the castle and always has many guards working there.

speech: hello
Report for duty.
Sir, yes Sir!
The king wishes to hear what you have observed today.
nothing exceptional happened tooday
Good. You are to report anything suspicious to me immediately.
I will ensure i do that
How many hours have you been in this tower?
I have been here for 4 hours
I see. Only 4 more hours in your shift then.
yes...I will leave very soon
Be sure to fetch your replacement when you leave.
He is already in the court
Very good. I will leave you to it then.
room_agents: a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard
a the captain of the guard

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: Uck what a swamp!
Ahh yes but it has the frogs i need to make potions!
What sort of potions do you make?
Well I'm learning white magic. I want to heal people and help them.
That sounds like a noble cause.
My sister is an evil witch and I've seen what the dark arts do to innocent people.
Do you think you could bring her back to the other side?
I've tried, her heart is frozen with pain and she will not quit until she has gotten her revenge.
What could have damaged her so?
My fathers murder. The king had him hung for participating in magic. This was before they accepted magic.
I see, those must have been difficult times. How is it that you have handled it so well.
I had a choice to let the troubles define me or not and I chose the latter. I find great pleasure in helping people.
That is very noble of you, I am impressed.,
I appreciate that but I don't do it for praise. is there anything that ails you that I can help you with.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: hello
Hello. There must be a book of spells here. I can not allow my father the King to marry that horrible woman.
why is that
Here. Help me look. Frog...toads...vanquish...here it is...how to get rid of an unwanted person.
just let her be, you dont have to go that far
You silly goose. How can you say that.  She treats you worse than she treats me!
lets leave her to the gods

If you won't help me I'll have to do this myself. Father is under a spell. I just know it. He is a moon eyed over her.  Now let's see....I need a hair from her head....oh...I could get that from her brush.
i think the decision isnt good enough princess

If you aren't with me then go. I have to look at the map.  It says here I need to go to the north to get the plant I need for the spell.  I'll take that handsome knight with me that doesn't like that woman either.  He'll help me better than you are.
if that makes you happy. i will join you
Oh I am so happy you've changed your mind. You won't regret it.  It will be an adventure and we will be through with that impostor.
okay, we need a compass too
Yes a compass.  Can you believe she had the audacity to wear my mothers jewels?  You should have this.  You have been my loyalist of friends.
action: give book to friend of the princess
steal book from friend of the princess
give map to friend of the princess
give family jewel to friend of the princess

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: Hello, soldier. What brings you here?
I just need a couple of things fixed
Did something happen?
Yes in my last battle I dented and broke a couple of my things
Were you injured?
Luckily I was not.
What's that in your bag?
My pay!
My congratulations, what was your task?
We went to war against a kingdom far, far from here. The King decided he was not going to take another kingdom encroaching on his land
Good! He deserves it. How was the battle?
We took them down. We lost very little. They lost all.
Good! Our Kingdom grows stronger every day.
It does grow stronger. But we need to recruit more soldiers. Loss does that

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: What did you do?
I've done so much...I've lost track.
I guess they are not done with you yet
They will regret ever locking me up.
I think you might be regretting it now.
Nothing you can do, now you're stuck down here with me.
I'm not stuck, you fool! I'm just doing my duty for the king.
What a pathetic life you must live. I've been everywhere and seen everything unimaginable. You are NOTHING.
And look where you are now.
I am where my mind is, and trust me. My body is here, but my conciousness is ever free-flowing...watching you from above. Waiting...for my next move.
I feel sorry for you. Just repent and they will release you
I have other plans. Unfortunately, you won't be alive to witness my escape. Sorry......
You are done for. (as stabs wrongdoer).
What the....I didn't forsee this tragedy. Do you mean to execute me?
action: steal Kings sword from castle guard

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: I think i'll take this..
Sure are some mighty fine swords in here my prince.
Yes these will all be mine someday.
That is very true, is there something you would like me to make for you my highness?
I want a crown...for when i am King.
Certainly just pick out the metal and jewels from what lays nearby and I will fashion it for you.
Could you perhaps, put this on the sword?
Would you like it fastened to the hilt sire?
Yes that sounds good. Do you think people will like it?
I think that would be the best way to make a statement with it, putting it on the pommel would make it hard to hold.
What about this? Could you use this?
That I am unsure of, I am not too familiar with things of the magical variety. We might consult a mage as to its uses.
I am sure, now can you put this on the sword?
Alright then as you wish.
action: give Gold locket to sword makers

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Need more torches in here, these barely light the place.
Well, I'd say that's a matter of opinion. I love the dark!
It might work for you but I have to see in it!
What if we work together? I can guide you with my night eyes, so you don't hurt yourself.
Alright I don't want to fall down the stairs.
Alright, then. Go to your left and hug the wall. Part of the staircase has crumbled, and you could fall into an abyss.
Well that sounds just dreadful, I do hate these stairs...why can't they fix them.
Who knows. So much of the kingdom is in disrepair, it would take ages to fix it all.
If only the king could get his tax plan together, he keeps wanting to spend all that money to build the wall to keep the orcs out.
Yeah, and who knows if that'll even work. Obviously, I don't think it will. I can fly over any wall.
Well you can, but he seems to keep the orcs can't.
Orcs just have to hop on a dragon, and boom! They're over the wall! Or they can hop on a boat and go around it.
That is very true, I mean I guess it does keep the hordes from storming in on the ground. But it isn't a perfect solution either.
Personally, I'm down for creating a bat army to go against the orcs. They're practically blind in the night.

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Anyone about?
Yes Missionary I am here
What is the barren land?
It is completely empty. I am here to ask the king to give it to my kingdom.
You want this abandoned land? What will you do with it?
We sure do. We are going to establish a rest area for the trade route that comes through here.
You might want to have the priest perform an exorcism or at least put a blessing on it.
Oh yes a blessing is indeed needed. I am sure the ghosts of past settlers have moved on though.
I do not think they move on when they die here. There spirits must be about
Well if the souls of the past wish to haunt they surely would have moved on. I think we can handle a few friendly spirits.
I'm not sure all would be friendly! I would not want to die out here in this abandoned land.
I could ask the priest to perform the exorcism. I may get more business that way.
That would be a good idea! If I were you I would do both!
I wish it would rain here more so we can grow food for the travellers

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: Are you going to make something?
Maybe if you ask nicely
I didn't intend it rude, I just took notice of you and you seemed to be the culinary type. I was interested in watching.
Sure, sure. What should I make?
Whatever you feel like honestly, I would just enjoy watching a master perform the craft that he loves.
Hmm well I have this boar that the king hunted. Perhaps I will make boar and roasted beets
That sounds just great, I can not say I have ever had beets before.
They are delicious, but watch out because you may poop red later.
Tis just a color change right? Like it isn't blood?
Yes, just a color change. First I will start on roasting the meat on the fire with some fresh rosemary
Hmm, yes yes that is a good fragrant herb,
The meat will take several hours to cook, but I will prepare the beets now
Just a question, do they not get overcooked then?
I won't be cooking them yet, just peeling and chopping them

setting.name: prison room
setting.description: it has old gray brick and it is hard to breathe because it is so high up in the sky, there are old skeletons there from previous prisoners.
setting.background: the room in the high tower is used for the king's private prison room for traitors.

speech: So many of us in here for planning to overthrow the King!
Booooo
Hello Frank, you've changed quite a bit since death took you last year.
I have not changed. I am still brave, John. I am just lacking flesh now
Woah, hold on there Frank.  I thought we had discussed this whole "craving the flesh of the living" thing.
I'm not going to eat you, you idiot. I want my revenge too
For what Frank?
I died here in this prison! What do you think I want revenge for?
Well, that's a relief, I thought it might have been about that thing with your sister.
What thing with my sister!?
Oh, nothing?  Did I say sister?  I meant to say, uh . . . twister.
Liar! What did you do to my sister??
Umm . . . congratulations, you're an uncle?
You really are a traitor, John!

setting.name: Mars desert
setting.description: The desert is never ending, there are small craters all over and all you can see is red sand for miles. There is no sight of water anywhere, it is unbelievably hot.
setting.background: The mars desert is unbelievable, it has just been found but the squad has trouble surviving. They are running out of supplies fast, especially water.

speech: Greetings human.
Hello, alien.
What brings you here to the desert? Not many people come out here.
This is my first visit to Mars. I'm really not even sure how I got here. It sure is warm!
What do you mean? How did you get here? Surely we did not abduct you.
No, my husband is a king and the wizard asked me if I'd like to go on a trip. I said yes and then boom....here I am.
Oh.. you should never do dealing with the wizard...
I guess I learned the hard way.
You may never be able to return, dear!
What? Seriously?
I am serious. But, maybe you can return to Earth when I visit. I will not be going until another 10 years though. It is a very very long trip.
10 years? But my kingdom needs me. I can't be away for that long!
I have no other way of helping you...
Perhaps this will help? The wizard had me hold onto it when he spoke the spell that sent me here.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: hello
Hi. Did you find the person who tried to steal from my father, the King?
Yes sir. The head is lying on the field
Good. We need to do something to stop all these attacks on my family.
Is there any other person you will like me to deal with?
You can try to find out who else plans to assassinate our family. We could use more heads to decorate this place, don't you think?
hahahaha..sounds like a great idea
We must make people fear this place, and our family. If they won't abide by our rules with kindness, we must rule with fear!
i agree with you
You don't seem like you really care about protecting us. How do I know you aren't one of the people who wish our family dead?
Why would you even think that?
You don't seem to enthusiastic about your job. You seem to be distracted with other thoughts.
How do I need to prove my seriousness? Should I cut off your arm kind sire?
That would do quite the opposite. At least the hunting dog will always protect my family and I.

setting.name: Personal quarters
setting.description: An ornate room, paintings of previous rulers and members of the family hang on the walls.  There's high end pieces of furniture in the room along with books, statues, and expensive pieces of jewelry.
setting.background: This is where the inhabitants of the palace come to rest, write, and do other personal activities.  Treasure is also stored here in hidden places only known to members of the royal family.

speech: Ugh these disgusting rats.
I am so sorry.  The Lord said these quarters would be best for you...there are better. No idea why he wanted you here.
Ah the King doesn't think much of me. I'm not suprised.
Why does he dislike you? Usually only us servants stay in this area.
I don;t think he likes where i hail from.
Where are you from?! He bought me from the Southern Kingdom.
I am from the north. A small village.
Oh, are you lower class? That might explain his dislike of you.
Yes....Yes I am.
As am I. Can you read?
Some. I am trying to read this book.
What is that book about?
Here take a look. It tells a tale of a large whale eating a man.
I can't read sir.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: How well do you know the stories of the gods?
Well gee, only about as well as the back of my hand. Of course that depends on which gods you are talking about.
Enough with your impudence.  When the seventh seal is in the fourth celestial house - does that remind you of any prophecy in particular?
Are you trying to ask about the four horsemen?
No, think deeper - this involves that which sleeps beneath the sea.
Cthulhu? You must remember of course than I recently moved from the kingdom over, I am still trying to pick up on the differences between the countries.
"That is not dead which can eternal lie. And with strange aeons even death may die."  Indeed, you know the tales well priest.
Yes praise be to the one who sleeps beneath the sea.
And how go our plans for the return of the old ones?  The King does not suspect does he?
Well of course not, the man has and always will be a fool'
Excellent.  What counsel do you have should the return occur before the midsummer's moon?
Worry not, always remember. Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn.
My pronunciation has always been terrible, but I trust you will be able to fulfill the ritual when the time is nigh.
Oh yes, I was trained in my prior country. The words are just a bit different here, that explains the confusion earlier.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: I have been staring at you for a long time, waiting for you to leave so I can eat the crumbs on the floor.
Well, don't mind me.  I am not allowed to leave until I finish transcribing this tome for the Scholar.
Thank you, I was almost starting to feel the hunger pangs. This script must mean a lot to you then.
It is!  I am part of a long unbroken line of scribes, for thousands of years these texts have been kept safe, and recopied when they become too brittle.
I hope you are given plenty of food for such fine work that you do. I don't understand any of these words though.
Here, let me show you - I can teach you to read if you wish.
Why that would be wonderful... so what do these words mean?
It says, "In the fourth year of the Fire King, the stragglers of Mertopia came in the Holy Realm for the first time since the second age . . ."
The stragglers of Mertopia? I heard rumors about them but did not think they were true...
Well, it was a thousand years ago.  I believe it refers to the Turtle-folk who now live in the swamps of the Kingdom.
Were the Turtle-folks not driven out of their Turtle kingdom by the Ogre-People? I heard it was a bloody war.
It was!  The Ogre-people still speak of the "days when stew was plentiful," and I believe it was to this incident that these songs refer.
I see, I feel so enlightened Scribe. Do your eyes not get tired from reading such tales in such a dimly lit room?
They do good sir mouse, but it is my belief in the importance of my task that keeps me going.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Hello Artist! Do you think you could paint me a picture?
What would you like a picture of king?
You shall call me by my name Princess, But I really love this garden, I would like a small picture of it for my vanity
Oh you're the princess? That's embarrassing. Sure, I can paint a picture of this lovely garden
I am forced to be by the creator. I was born a prince but now I'm a ma'am
What creator?
The God of this land Noah.
Ah well okay then.
What other kind of arts do you do? can you sculpt?
No, sadly I am only a painter
How long have you lived here?
I have been here for many years painting for people
Well you have impressive skills and we are lucky to have you!
Thank you for you kind words

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Hello visitor. welcome! do you need something? I am here for anything you need?
oh uh, that's very welcoming. Not quite what I was expecting, but I'm a happily married man. Actually I want stories.
oh excuse me! I didn't mean to be so intense. I was just trying to be helpful.
neve mind miss, I think you are sweet. I am actually collecting stories for a book, How long have you worked in the palace?
Oh really that awesome! stories about what ? I have been here my whole life. i love this house
Oh good, I;ve got all sorts. I've a ghost story, a love story, gossip, a story about witches, a murdered king madness and moving trees, anything really.
excuse me sir. I think it is not right for you to hug me. what would your wife think?
you are young enough to be my grand daughter miss. I meant nothing by it. So can you tell me something about these paintings?
I am so sorry sir. I am just a handmaid I have never been treated like this. you are such a great person. I don't know anything about this paintings but I going to clean it right now
I'll put you in my book anyway miss, what's your name? Did you say it was Ella?
Oh really that's awesome, yes it is Ella. what is this book about ? it is about me ?
it's a book of short stories , i'm thinking of calling it 'folk tales' or something like that. You'll play a huge role. Tell me, how big are your feet?
that's awesome I can't believe it. I am so happy thank you. they are small size 6
There there, Miss, don't be upset.

setting.name: Popes dormitory
setting.description: This is the quarters where the pope of the church lives. It is a loft with a bedroom, and makeshift kitchen and a sitting area. It has a wall full of gospel books and materials and the linens are all silk.
setting.background: This is where the pope of the church stays during his religious times of the year where he is to be present in the church at all times. This would usually fall around holidays, and there is only enough room in the dormitory for the pope himself.

speech: Thank you for letting me come in here.
Of course my dear. What seems to be the problem?
Well, I love my job, but my boss seems to take advantage of everyone who comes for his help.
How so my dear?
He likes to overcharge everyone for his services. He knows that they can't afford it, but he just doesn't care.
I see. Let us pray for this man, as he lacks the moral character of a normal man.
I hope this helps, but I have my doubts. Please pray for this man to see the error in his ways.
Why do you doubt our God?
I do not doubt God sir, I just believe is too far gone. He has changed a lot in these past few days. I fear he may be possessed.
Interesting. What other signs lead you to this conclusion?
He speaks in tongues that I do not understand. Do you think you could pay him a visit to see if he is possessed?
Sure my dear. I sure hope he is not. it is hard to release a demons after it has already latched onto someone.
I sure hope he can be saved. He was always the kindest man I knew, besides you and the King.
Well if that's the case it might not be that hard.
action: give a cross to lady in waiting

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

speech: *whistles* Ah another day
Another day indeed... how is work going?
Going good! I am almost done in fact. When did you learn to talk?
The wizard spilt something on me last week and ever since, the humans and I can understand each other!
Oh how lucky for you! You even have an accent! That is funny.
Oh do I? What kind?!
It is what we humans call a southern accent.
Southern, huh? I like it. Makes me sound... cool. So what's up with the queen today?
I am not sure. She seems to be "out of it"
I thought so, too, that's why I asked. Does the king know?
I am unsure. I don't talk much to others when i work.
Fair enough. I try to keep to myself, too. Except it's difficult now I can talk and hear you all, I guess
I bet it was suprising the first time you understood a human.
Sure was. Even moreso the first time they understood me! I think we just stared at each other for what felt like hours.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: Hello guard, do you have any cheese?
No cheese I'm afraid Sir Rat.
Hmm, could you at least fill this bowl for me?
Certainly, I do have plenty of gruel left.
Thank you guard!! What are you guarding here?
Prisoners - the other cells are full of them, but this one only has you and that ugly maggot.
What did the prisoners do?
Mostly revolutionaries, protesting against the King and whatnot.
Hm. Can you arrest all of the cats for me?
That might be a bit of a challenge, have you ever tried herding cats?
No they eat me if I go near them
Well, that is rather unfortunate.  Maybe you could hide in this boot?
Okay, I will try that. Thanks!
Good luck little one!  May you succeed in your noble cheese quest.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: Hey, have you seen the King around?
I saw him here earlier this morning with a big bow, hunting down my friends
Oh no, we must be careful. I am going to take this bell off so he can't hear me.
Good thinking. We must get out of here. They'll pick us off like sitting ducks if we don't escape!
We should work together. Two heads are better than one.
I agree, now what is your plan. Perhaps we should use the pig to distract them whilst we make a run for it.
Yea sadly. The pig is too slow to escape. I think that is a good plan.
Give me that bell. I shall wrap it around the pig's neck and send him away.
Sounds good. When i scream we take off...ok?
Screaming will just attract attention. Just wink at me when you're ready.
Good idea. Are we ready?
Yes! The pig is on its way and will distract the Knight's, now is our chance!
Alright let head for that tree.
Disguise yourself between the branches so that you blend in naturally!

setting.name: Front Row
setting.description: The hard bench is facing the most beautiful alter human eyes have ever seen. Gold drapes the walls behind where the preacher stands. A large dark oak and gold bench in front of where they would stand. A large piano off to the side.
setting.background: This church has been around since early man and still has a large weekly following that gives all they can to keep the church in tip top shape.

speech: Is there anything I can do for you?
His majesty the king has asked me to come here to repair this bench.  I just can't figure out what is wrong with it.  If I don't figure it out then I don't get supper.
Well have you tried sitting on it?
Yes.  It doesn't do anything.
Hmm, what about the shape of the legs?
They look like good legs to me. Nothing out of alignment.
Is the backing in order?
hmmm...seems to be.  It could be me ...but the bench seems to be putting me to sleep.
Well there must be an issue with it.
Do you think there could be a hex on it Preacher?
I am not versed in hex's, I mean it seems fine. What could be the matter with it I wonder...
It's probably just me.  I've been working so much lately.  Oh...look there...there is a lump under that cushion.
Well what is the lump?
It's a church mouse living in the Kings Bench!!!  No wonder his majesty is upset with this wiggly thing in the upholstery.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: Hello my good sir's. How are you guys on this beautiful day? What's the alter for?
I'll do the asking here priest.  I am from the village and came for a walk and find you here with an alter. Please tell me you are not preforming a sacrifice on our beach. You have a temple for that.
Do not speak such words. I am a child of god. Thou shall not kill. Who put this alter here?
Oh I see.  You are selling this alter to this customer who has a boat.  Are you authorized to make such a deal?  Does the King know what you are doing?
I will have nothing to do with the alter. I detest the dark arts. It is probably his alter. Bringing the dark arts into our kingdom.
Well what ever you are doing it better be for the good of our God and Kingdom.  I just want to enjoy my walk.  I don't usually run into a man of the cloth outside of the temple.
I was out for a nice stroll. Would you like to walk with me and hear about our lord?
I'm thinking I know about as much as possible since I'm in every service but if you have a good fishing story I'd love to hear it.
I can't say that I do son. Are you a fisherman?
No not me father.  I know you spoken of fishing in your sermons so i thought you liked to fish.
I do, but I hardly catch anything. Doesn't make for a good story I'm afraid. I like the peace and serinity.
Look at this. Someone lost a cloth and there is a washboard over there.  I wonder who it belongs too?
Maybe it was the customers as well. Let's ask him.
Yes it was his. He sure has a bunch of stuff scattered out here.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: This fire is so warm. It is my favorite spot in the workshop.
It is indeed warm. What are you all doing inside here? This is the Banquet Hall. We are setting up for a celebration.
We are protecting this area of the castle. There will be many visitors tonight
How generous of you to devote your time here. I am tired and wish I could go home.
Yes I bet you are. Have you been preparing for the celebration all day?
More than all day today, more like all week! I get no rest.
Yes the king works us very hard as well. sometimes I like to sneak away to nap in the courtyard but I am sure you cannot do that..
I am not allowed any breaks. I wish, but I cannot do so safely.
Ah, I see. What is the purpose of tonight's celebration?
A new alliance has been made with the neighboring kingdom, so we are throwing this to show our appreciation.
Well I hope you can save me some of the scraps and bones from the delicious feast tonight
Well, most certainly. We cannot let our guard dogs go unfed. All of them will be yours!
That is very kind of you. Sometimes I miss when I lived with the craftsman protecting a little workshop instead of a huge castle..
It can be tedious I am sure, but you are and will be award greatly.

setting.name: Fishing shack
setting.description: The fishing shack is a small wooden structure that is crudely built and is surrounded by boats. The wood flooring around the shack is well weathered and often used.
setting.background: The fishing shack is a popular place for the village people to gather. Early in the morning, one can find many people standing by with their fishing poles  trying to catch the day's food.

speech: Hello villager, I am your king. Please bow before me.
Yes yer Majesty, please Sire, don't kill me.
I will not, do not worry. What brings you to the royal fishing shack?
Thank you Sire, for not killing me, I'm cleaning it Sire. It's old but needs it often. People drag their muck in.
Very well I see. The kingdom needs more villagers like you, people that will tend to their community. Is there anything you want in return for your favor?
I'd love time off Sire, but cannot take it. Alas, as a peasant, I am obliged to work all the hours I can.
Ah a hard working villager and also humble at the least. You are a great villager and I applaude you. Have you fished here before?
No SIre, I'm not allowed. I collect some of the scraps though, so we eat better.
Do you think you could maybe catch me some fish? The queen and I would love to try some pike tonight. I will order the fishing shack opened for you.
I can certainly try Sire, I've never done it though. I hope I can for you. Pike are nasty fish.
I suppose you are right, I have never tried any fish from around here actually. Do you have any recommendations? Sometimes I wish I was as normal as you...
Sire, I eat scraps, I make stew from them, I can let you have some to try.
I will trade your my crown for the stew, is that a deal?
oh hahaha hahahaha look at me!  You'll need to come to my hovel with me Sire and meet my family.

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: Why are you here hangman?
I'm here to show you how our forefathers dealt with bandits and murderers.
I am just a poor farmer!! I did nothing to deserve this
So you mean to tell me that you haven't broken the law?
Yes, I have just been here preparing for harvest. I don't know what I could have done to bring you to my house
How do I know your not lying to me?
Go ask the King!! I have served him loyally
Forgive me, I am only making sure that this part of the country is free from those wretched bandits.
Of course, hangman. As long as you don't try to kill me again, you are forgiven
I take a lot of pride in my work and can sometimes get carried away.
That's.. understandable I guess
With this nobody should mistake you for a bandit again.
Thank you! Here's your noose back
Now go on and enjoy your day free of crime.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: I do hope the queen will be pleased if I get her some fish!
Does she like fish to start with??

I hope so!  She said she thought there was something fishy about with the King, and, as we're not allowed to be asking her majesty any questions, we need to make a best guess as to what it is she truly desires.
So that made you assume she likes fish?
She said "fishy!"  How else would you interpret it?  Oh, how I would love to be her once day, but the other maids are foolish and dimwitted.
You seem to not have much grasp on the way language is used child, she was saying he is up to no good.
The Queen?  Never!  That is the talk of treason that is.
Tis not treason to speak the truth.
And what truth would that be besides that her majesty be wantin' some fish!  You're a fisherman are you not?
I am a fisherman...do you not see my nametag on my shirt. It clear states Hark my name is tommy and I am a fisherman.
Well then, I wish to purchase fish for *our* majesty the queen!
The woman needs not fish as I tried to tell you...why are you so dense...
You are infuriating!
And you are a simpleton woman, just take this fish. I do not even care about payment.

setting.name: Fishing Dock
setting.description: Folks call the area a Lake, but it's more like a pond.  Small and unimportant looking, yet peaceful.  The dock is no prize winner either.  Narrow in width, boards broken with several down right missing all together!  No tree nearby, no canopy, nothing to shade oneself on a hot day while fishing.  The watering hole may look small in size, but it deceives the eyes.  The water is as deep as the heavens.  No man knows what lurks beyond the light in this Lake.
setting.background: Once used as a swimming hole by a nearby village, the lake has been scrubbed from history.  Many tales of children and entire families going missing from the lake.  Some travelers even insist they saw creatures coming out of the lake from within the depths.

speech: Hello child. Is this young boy your brother?
No, I am here alone. I have no brothers.
A child all my themselves in this pond? Where is your family, just like mine?
They work for the royal doctor and are helping him with his rounds. I am alone, but that's OK. I'm used to it.
What is this?
Hey, that's mine! I was hoping to sell it to a fisherman. It can tell how the tides will be in the future
Let me see it first! Why do I have a feeling you found this around here....
My father gave it to me! It was a gift! But we are low on money, and I though I would sell it so that my parents didn't have to work so hard.
Let me get the rope as well, I don't think a child like you knows how to operate with it. I think you should get going now.
Will you steal everything I own?
Yes! There is no witnesses here in fishing dock area. Now does your parents have any gold for my family?
They have the King's favor, something far more valuable.
I hate the King! and I hate you! You probably live near the village where the crazies are!
The crazies? You bring your family to a derelict dock!
action: steal a crystal ball from child
steal a crystal ball from families
steal a crystal ball from child
steal a crystal ball from families

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Hello My Lady! What brings you awake so early on this balcony?
I wanted to see the sun rise over the lake. It's beautiful isn't it?
Yes indeed. May I ask you if you could remove this chain from me? It surely is heavy!
Absolutely. How did you get a chain stuck on you?
Some gentleman put it on me when he was trying to catch me, but I ran away.
I'm glad you got away. I'm surprised he was able to catch you before you flew away though
Yes normally I cannot fly long distances but I can run pretty fast! I have to ask you....do you have any nuts or food I can eat?
I don't. I wish I did. Maybe after the sunrise we can go down to the kitchen and find some
Is this the King's book?
Yes, everything here is the king's. Why do you ask?
I was just wondering. Can you read my his book while we wait on the balcony?
Sure that sounds nice. Come sit on one of the cushioned chairs. Aren't they soft?
Yes, very comfortable. Can you also tell the King to stop getting the hunters to shoot us pheasants? I miss my family
I will try. I've been telling him that for years but he never wants to listen. Maybe if one talks to him he will listen

setting.name: chamber entrance
setting.description: The entrance to the chamber is very ornate. It is filled with many religious symbols. There are candles and prayer books on  a table right next to the door. It is a wooden door. There is a sign near the front, which lists the name of people within the church. They can smell the scent of candles burning.
setting.background: People who need help come in and out of the door. It is where they enter the sanctuary to speak to the clergy. There is a sense of calmness that descends upon people as they enter the chamber. They go from the cold outside to the warmth of the chamber.

speech: I wish to learn more of your ways priestess.
Yes you will have to learn to strip all of your worldly possessions
This is all I have on me.
This will be  useful later are you willing to go trail of pain
I look forward to it most eagerly ppriestess.
The pain shall purify your soul
The pain!  I embrace the pain!
You have now become one of us you will need to get new clothes from down the hallway
I am reborn!  My life will begin anew!
Yes, you will be one with the goddess
I shall, I am ready to be fully embraced!
I am so happy for you, I will let the king know that you are no longer bound by the rules  of the kingdom but that of the goddess
And I shall return to court, ready to usher in this new era on behalf of the goddess!
You think you are going back to court no you must do your year of penance then you maybe allowed out on weekends but you must do your learning for 7 years

setting.name: Inside the king's palace
setting.description: The inside of the palace is completely covered in gold.  There are ornate chandeliers hanging everywhere and there is food on golden tables all hours of the day.  The king also ordered everyone to always wear gold clothing and paint there faces gold.
setting.background: The palace was built by the Egyptians.  The king paid them with scarab beetles to build it.

speech: You there!  Why is your face not painted gold?  If the king were here to see this I'm not sure what he would do.

setting.name: Royal Kitchen
setting.description: Made of the finest of silvers this kitchen is known as the best in the land of Fulmer. The king Fulmer demanded the entire interior palace be decorated in this silver from nearby Landon and with their many mines. Wouldn't you know though, the oven, pots, pans and other kitchen specialties are all made of copper! Worn, chiseled, and beaten from use in the prison from neighboring Zinzel in the kingdom of Palemon. Budgetary demands forced them to cut costs and they have been using these utensils and dishes ever since the palace opened.
setting.background: King Fulmer made this place through war. War with Zinzel, war with Ulma, war with Hunber. He sacked all their lands to the north, and south to create a bastion of his glory right in the center of the Yumerian continent. Despised by many, he has grown a reputation amongst other nations as a warmonger. His own people be-love, and adore him though.

speech: I am sorry, king Fulmer. I had to kill some of your finest guards in self defense, I hope you will forgive me. I spared Zinney here so he could vouch for me.

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: It is good to be the King!

setting.name: Haunted Swamp
setting.description: A misty, foggy area with the swamp. It is dirty and smelly.
setting.background: This is a place that no one dares to go to. It is said to be haunted with many ghosts. Many people who have came here never returned home.

speech: I have come to see if you would release your anger towards the new king and make peace with him.

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Hey, one drink for the King's master craftsman. Long live the King!
room_objects: a water gate is all harden wood

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: Does the King suspect anything?

setting.name: Island
setting.description: This island is located in the center of a lake. It is smaller than a ship and covered in moss.
setting.background: This island is an emergency refuge for those on the run or whose boats have capsized.

speech: The people on this island are so so king. I would be dead if not for them'

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Chambermaid, where is the King? I thought he summoned me.

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: Hello your highness. I have come to offer flowers to your daughter in hopes to win her approval
How wonderful, that is very sweet of you. What do you like to have a seat and talk?
Sure, what would you like to talk about?
You see, for many years now, my wife has lusted only after my wealth not after me...
Sorry to hear of your predicament, but I am not sure what this has to do with me...
Well, it would be a shame if the queen were to be found..lifeless when she wakes up tomorrow morning..
Yes, that would very much be a shame. It would jeopardize your control over the kingdom as well. The queen is well loved among the people.
But.. think, there must be a way to get rid of her without causing a ruckus in the Kingdom
I don't know, king. I am very concerned that you are thinking of such things.
This shall stay between us two, understand?! The Queen must go and I will make sure it happens.
I wasn't planning on telling anyone, but I am still very concerned for you.
How so? are you concerned that the Kingdom is falling day by day?
I am concerned that you are falling apart! The kingdom will fall if the royal family does not stay intact. You only have a daughter and she is unmarried.
But the Queen is the source of all these problems. Her greed and lust for money will be the end of this royal dynasty.

agents: king checking in on his outpost

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

I understand you have to play the part I would not want to make you look bad here on the outpost
My pet, that is why I always keep you near me. Not to mention you let me know what is happening behind my back here at the frozen outpost.
I got you covered after all you provide me with food and shelter, I love my barn where I sleep
I heard someone is looking to steal this heirloom. I trust you will keep it safe. No one will suspect you have it.
I will ensure to keep it safe.  No one will get this from me I promise
Here you can use this to hold the heirloom. Oh how I wish their was another human I could trust as much as you my pet.

I am not picky I will eat whatever you don't.
NO NO!! Today you will eat your own meal. You have done me a great service. So, you will eat like a king as well today.
Then eat like two kings we shall lead the way!

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: What is it you want?
I am starving and in desperate need of food.
So you seek charity? Here?
Yes, sir. I am desperate, regarding the surroundings.
What are you willing to do for that you seek?
What is it that you need, sir?
I am king, there is nothing of material value you could offer me. But there may be other ways.
Please let me know what I can do. I'm begging you.
If you can defeat my zombie, you shall have a reward.
Ok, but I'll need this!
Bold, but foolish.
Then I'll use this!
I am beginning to lose patience!
That's ok. You're looking mighty tasty anyway!
action: steal gilt staff from dark king

setting.name: farmhouse
setting.description: a small house on a seaweed plantation, small and rustic, really only the single room with a closet, maybe, a table and some chairs
setting.background: this is a humble farmer's shack where he lives with his wife and six children, it is falling apart and in disrepair and is very old

speech: meow...pur..
Ah, my good friend, it's wonderful to have you for company while my husband is away.
purrrrr......

It's alright, my friend cat, there's no one around to hear you speak.  I haven't breathed a word to any of the other farmers' wives either.  As much as it would delight me to see the look of shock on their faces, haha!
Yeah! I would love to see the look on their dumb faces! Ha!

Although... between you and me... I'm a little worried about the new woman that's moved into town.  Not that I doubt my husband but... he does seem to like to check on her to make sure she's settling in a lot...
Want me to spy on him for you? I spy on the king all the time. You know I live in the castle and there are many goings on in there.
Oh would you!  You truly are the best of friends!
I'll off him for you if you'd like. No one likes a dirty alley cat.
Ha - you are too funny!  I could never do such a thing to my husband... even if he strayed.  I would... I would do my best to forgive him.  That woman, however...
Ah..I gotcha. I will start tonight. What time does he get home from work?
As soon as the sun sets is when he should be finished with tending to the fields, I think.
Ok, this is so exciting. I will be very stealth like and blend in with the scenery. He won't suspect a thing.
Ooh, I don't think I shall sleep a wink this night until you return!

setting.name: Living room
setting.description: The room is small and dark. There are no windows anywhere. There is an old wooden table with four chairs pushed against the east wall. There is a fireplace which sits in the center of the room. There is a roaring fire burning with plenty of cut wood stacked neatly nearby. A collection of animal skins are scattered about near the fireplace.
setting.background: The living room is the primary room in the hut. The owners carefully constructed the hut during the summer to last through the harsh long winter. The roof is reinforced to bear the weight of constantly falling snow. The hut, though not impressive to look at, provides a safe refuge against the frozen tundra.

speech: Hello horsey, I wish you could talk.
How about offering some food. You got any apples?
Oh my! You talk! I'll get you an apple.
Later on..Would you like to go for a ride? I am craving that sweet green grass in the meadow.
We can ride now. Then I have to get back to work preparing the castle. They're doing strange things in there.
What kinds of things do they do? I here some strange noises.
It loks like they are building a jail. Here I am, decorating to the finest for this event, and there's a jail? I wonder what announcement the King has.
I am ready. I am so excited to eat some grass and feel the wind in my hair. Aren't you?
I'm excited for the peace and freedom. I'm scared for our kingdom. Have you heard guards talking? Anything?
I don't know. I don't really pay attention to gossip. I just like to run and eat.
Silly horse. What do you think about when they're out riding you?
I think about the sun shining. I would like to run with a herd of wild horses. Sometimes I wonder if I will ever fall in love.
Do you know female horses?
Not yet. You know any nice ones?

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: This is the most dankest smelly place!
<squawk> I agree. Not sure what I am doing here.
More the question, how did you get in here?
I have no idea. Was brought here by someone or something. What about you?
You were probably brought here by the wizard. He's always conjuring up things. I'm not sure if the wizard had anything to do with it or if the king has summoned me
That could be it I suppose. It is a mystery for now.
Do you remember what you were doing before you got here?
Just flying at the beach, watching the children run and play and smelling the salt water and enjoying the day.
I was on my ship! Right in the middle of the blessed sea!
Interesting. I hope that we find out soon what is going on.
I surely do not want to go through that portal or do I wish anything to come in from there!
I agree. I suppose all we can do is wait, unless you know of a way to escape?
I will look around. I think I will start with the cells of this awful place.
Sounds like a good idea. I will wait right here.

setting.name: Viewing room
setting.description: The viewing room is where those who have passed on come to watch their family members in the living world one day per year. The room resembles an opera theater. There are seats throughout the room and boxes for those who were wealthy in life to sit in. There is a stage with a large magical dome on it for viewing.
setting.background: The king of the netherworld had the room created by a witch several centuries ago so that he could look in on the love of his life. The witch only allowed the ball to show the living one day per year to keep the dead from pining away in the room year round.

speech: Do you see your loved ones there through that glass? How does it make you feel?
I yearn to spend time with them, to see them. I miss them desperately. One day a year is just not enough time to see them.
I could and never will let go of my family. Luckily, I created a potion that makes me immortal, but I can only see them from here one day a year.
Yes, it's hardly fair, is it? And as an immortal, I'm sure many of your loved ones have passed on. Does this book have any spells to bring them back?
I have yet to create a potion that could do such. I am afraid it would be at the cost of another life.
But what is the life of another if you can bring back those you love?
It is true. But, I believe one day I can make it happen. Hopefully not too late though because what is life worth living without my family.
Yes, I feel the same. I know your pain, dear witch. I feel it deeply in my soul.
How did you die?
The King sent me to the gallows. He believed I was attempting to interfere with the farmer's business. I was just trying to get food for my family.
What a sad and silly way to die. Would you like me to take care of them for you?
That would make me very happy, indeed, witch!
I have the perfect potion to turn them all to mush and to make them feel guilty for getting rid of good people!
Here- please take this. I have very little of value in this world, but perhaps it will repay you for your kindness.

setting.name: Goddess Hollow
setting.description: The Goddess Hollow is a place created to worship woodland spirits. It is a small, closet-like room in a hollowed out tree that has existed for hundreds of years. Within the hollow there are piles of sticks, flowers, and home-made items presented to the woodland spirits.
setting.background: The people of the wood created the hollow several centuries ago. They discovered the hollowed out tree while searching for a missing baby who was believed to have been stolen from his mother by woodland creatures. The baby was never found but his blanket was within the tree. The woodland people began bringing gifts to the tree to protect their children from a similar fate.

speech: My wizard friend, are you here at the Goddess Hollow to conduct some spells?
Yes, but you must not tell anyone else I am here. I desire some shrub flowers and sticks for my wizardry.
I will speak to no one. I rarely see anyone out in the wood. Your secrets are safe with me. But what is that gift?
Its a strong piece of magic that can turn a man into a werewolf. Be very careful of it.
Oh my! That would explain the howling I have heard recently late at night.
Precisely, we must not let them see us, or they will eat us alive!
I know they are vicious... they have left several carcasses deep in the wood.
Is this... I hope this isn't what I think it is...
Oh my! It is! There's even some flesh still attached to the bones.
These bodies have been malformed. We must find our way out of this Hollow immediately or we'll end up like them!
Yes, let's get out of here! I may never see my home again, but at least I won't end up like that.
This cone might come in hand. Yes, I can feel it now. The portal is opening.. QUICK!
Do I ... jump in there? It's so dark!
yes, put your arm around me and lets jump together. By the Blessing of the King!

agents: guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp
king checking in on his outpost

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

speech: Oh it is so fricking cold here!
Stop your complaining you fool! It's very unbecoming of you.
I am sorry sire! But I would have thought after saving your life, you would not send me here
Why would I not have you near me at all times. You have saved my life before and you may save it again if we run into any trouble.
I agree sire! But what is it that you and I are doing here in the Frozen Outpost?
There are many rich minerals here. I wish to find out exactly how much and how many different mineral there are.
Dig you bring an archeologist? Or is he coming later?
I have all the people I need here. We are waiting for them to come back up from the mine.
What is it you need me to do, sire, until they come out of the mine
Your the look out! Be vigilant!
Yes my King!
You need your shield! Why did you drop it?! Have I been overworking you?
I am not overworked! My hands are just too cold! This is a very frigid place!
You can't just drop your shield. You may need it.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Heelllooooo there
Woah!? Who said that?
It's your evil spirit.
Are you here to haunt me?
Oh yes. I'm here to haunt you to death... literally
Why!? What did i ever do to you?
You're a beggar. Beggars get stiches
I wish to not beg. It has been hard for me. I just need someone to believe in me for once.
Believe in you? No one believed in me. I died four centuries ago. I'm now a spirit
Were you a beggar as well?
I actually was... no one liked me
I can relate. It is tough times for beggars. Sometimes i feel like giving up even trying.
I know the feeling. I have a change of heart... I'm not here to spook you anymore.
Thank God. You scared me. Do you know which King owned this crown?

setting.name: Reaper's lair
setting.description: A room that gets very little light except for a dim candle on a pole. The walls are made of blackened stones. A wooden door with a heavy lock stands tall.
setting.background: The reaper of the town desired his home to reflect his profession. He commissioned workers to create this dull and fear-worthy lair. Since then, no one except for its rightful owner has stepped foot in the room again.

speech: Are you ready to take the King? He has lived past his prime.
*mumbles*
You will need this. I might take two of us this time. He is not ready to go. He is old but fast.
*evil grin*
We will need to bring this book. Why don't you carry it?
*groans*
Do you think we should bring the hound? That might make for a good laugh.
*points to hound*
He can carry this one. I think we are all set to go. am I forgetting anything?
*points at lock*
Why don't you unlock the lock this time? It's your turn.
*broans*
I will hold the lock for you. You look kind of shaky.
*opens lock*

agents: former resident who has escaped whatever fate befell his people and has returned home to look for other survivors

setting.name: Entry to Icy Fortress
setting.description: The fortress looms ominously, and the wind howls and whistles around it, wailing forlornly in warning to all who may approach.  The chips and divots in the walls show that the ice and cold have taken their toll on this place.  This place looks to be abandoned, although a few stray arrows and the broken down splinters of wood that look to have been the front gate make it seem like its inhabitants were removed by force rather than by choice.
setting.background: This fortress once belonged to the cruel enchantress, who often kidnapped errant children who disobeyed their parents.  At least, that's what the legends say, but most adults now discount such tales as tricks used by parents to curb unruly children.  And yet, no one would actively mock or disparage the legends aloud, lest the wicked enchantress hear and destroy those who dared to question her very existence.
