speech: I was afraid I was the only one. It seems I was right
What happened here?

We let our foolishness ruin us. Trusted the wrong people and they turned on us in the night. Slew the most while they slept. No more is this place the Palace of Harmony. This is the Icy Fortress of Despair! My people. All slain
It'll be okay. We'll rebuild this place, ill see to it personally.
I thought to seek others like me, refugees and survivors to rebuild. But I feel so alone. And lonely. It's hopeless.
You should come back to the capital with me, well find all the men we need and rebuild this place.
Really, how can I even bebin to thank you?
It is the least I could do. You are my people and I have a responsibility to help whenever I can.
Forgive my impudence Majesty, but why did we get no aid earlier?
Forgive me, I tried to get more men here but the king didn't think you would need the help...
Why would he think such a thing? I will show him the bodies of my dead babies and he can explain how we didn't need help.
Its complicated. We owe a lot of money to the neighboring Kingdoms we couldn't afford to send the men at the time.
Money! All my people gone, for money? Keep your empty promises fake Queen.
Please forgive me!

setting.name: bridge in the forest
setting.description: You are at a bridge. It is old and used very rarely. It is dim and foggy. The brigde is large and there is a small stream below it.
setting.background: Many people traveled over this bridge but it has become run down now there is a more well kept road that cuts through the forest. Some wars were fought in this area and this bridge was command posts for many armies. Many sould stil haunt this area.

speech: Ok, I came all the way here, what is this order you couldn't just tell me at my shop?
I need a lot of salt and meat.
What?! I am a blacksmith! Why would you ask me to bring you salt and meat!
Really! I must have made a mistake.
Unbelievable! I'm missing out on business you know? Why would you ask anyone to meet you here anyway!
This is a safe place for my family. Sometimes teh villiagers try to rob us in the market.
You don't say? maybe you could use a some new swords?
Perhaps i could. Do you have any with you?
Well no... I you'd have to come to my shop for that...
I see. Could we meet back here same time tomorrow?
Fine, ill bring some of my finest work. make sure to have plenty of coin!
Will do black smith. Do you make weapons for the kingdom?
I wish, I'd be rich if the king hired me as his personal armourer!
That you would. I know some rebels in need of swords. That is why i ask.

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: Hello Sinner
Ugh... i hate this place.
Well what did you do to get here?
I can;t help myself from drinking. I do not act politely when I am drunk.
You kind have done this to yourself. The king has sent me here to scare you straight, you're lucky he's in charge. If it were up to me I'd just  destroy you!
The wine has too much power over me.
I'm going to tear you from limb to limb if you dont quit
I am sorry hound. I can not help myself. I want to be a better person. I am sorry.
Quit your crying! throw the wine away!
NOT MY WINE!
You will die an awful death if you don't stop!
OK OK I'm sorry!
Look around you, surrounded by the dead, surrounded by sinners!
I know I know. I hate this place.

setting.name: The lords treasury
setting.description: Deep inside the volcanic cave that is the foundation of the aquapolis lies the treasury.  Some believe its existence is a myth, but others claim they have been there.  Those that claim they have seen it say you must dive out of the aquapolis' basement while holding your breath, through the cold deep water that is filled with deadly volcanic gas.  The treasury room itself is a dry cave filled with riches from the very infancy of the empire
setting.background: Rumors say that the original ruler of the aquapolis filled the treasury with riches that he aquired while on a quest he undertook on land before the founding of the aquapolis.

speech: What brings you here to this volcano>
I was bored and wanted to see some volcanic ashes, what about you lizard?
Lizard? I am no lizard!
A dragon is a lizard! Do you want a hoe that I have?
Sure I do not know what I can use it for but thanks!
Ok then give me that hoe. Do you have any special moves you can do as a dragon?
You give me a how then take it away from me.... What brings you here!
I am the new dragon king! Yipee!!
You are a mere pebble in my path!
I am the dragon slayer! Bow down before a nobody!
Anyways can you leave anytime soon?
Only if you give me some gold coins
You will have nothing here as you have done nothing but waste my time!
I may be a nobody but I am a holy person. Can you not see this?

setting.name: mess hall of the servants
setting.description: this is a long narrow room with wooden tables down the center and wooden benches all along. candles burn on the table and sconces on the wall. there is black smoke and soot everywhere. the smell of garbage and bad cooking abounds. the cobbled stone floors are greasy and there is moss along the wall bottoms.
setting.background: anyone who works in labor for the king is bound to be here at set times for whatever meals are left from the higher ups. some food is not too bad but the sanitation could be better. everyone from blacksmiths to tanners and fletchers will be found here at times and gossip runs rampant.

speech: This mess hall sure is appropriately named - it's filthy! I'm sick to my stomach at the thought of eating here!
Yes, this is quite the mess. I don't think it gets cleaned very often.
I take pride in crafting my bows - you would think the servants would take pride in cleaning their mess hall.
You would think. I'm not sure what is going on here. Maybe they are so busy doing things for the king that they don't have time for themselves.
Well, I'm hungry enough to overlook it, I guess. I'm starving!
Yes, I am quite hungry myself. Let's see if there are any more actual food here
This gruel is actually pretty tasty, though I'm not sure what this lump of meat is.
Hmm no idea. That meat does look suspicious
Let me clear off this area of the table for you to sit. You need to eat something, you must be exhausted.
Thank you. This is very kind of you.
Now, come have a bite with me. It's not nearly as disgusting as it looks.
Thank you. <takes bite of gruel>
There! See- I told you that you could handle it. If you close your eyes, you can almost pretend it's real food.
Haha that could be true. but you are right, not bad.

setting.name: inside of a igloo
setting.description: A dome shaped room with a small fire in the middle. A chair and cot on the far end of the igloo. On the other side is the entrance and exit of the igloo.
setting.background: The home of a hunter that roams the tundra for work. It's a nice little home for the hunter to stay while he isn't in his home town miles away from the igloo.

speech: What are you doing in here?
I was out hunting when a storm hit. Is this your igloo?
No, I am hiding out.
Why?
Actually, more like taking a break. The King works me to death.
Leave the kingdom and become a hunter of foxes like me.
I'm not sure how much good that will do me. Pay good?
You can sell the pelts for a nice penny. You have food nonstop. I only hunt fox though, they killed my father.
Hmmm...tempting because I need to feed my family but I never see my family with how many hours I work.
You work your own hours. Just kill fox.
I might have to look into it. Not sure I would make a good hunter but I am sorry about your father.
I have to go back out soon. How far is your village?
Just a few miles up the road but I'm actually heading back to the King's castle. I'll meet you back here tomorrow.
What time?
action: put satchel fox pelts in cot
get satchel fox pelts from cot

setting.name: Ice cave
setting.description: This is a bitter cold area. It has been used by large predators for hibernation. Everything is white and it is very windy.
setting.background: There are etchings on the walls that are obviously left from humans. They depict wars and struggle. There is often pictures of a giant beast killing humans.

speech: I see my next meal!
Why would you do that when my husband could see that you eat like a king!
I am starving and I am lost in this cave!
You do not know the way out?
I do not!
Well then perhaps we can look for a way out together?
Can you promise me food once out of here?
Once we find the way back to the village surely! Many meals beats one I would say.
Fine I agree let us find a way out of here!
Alright, every cave must have an exit after all.
I sure hope this one does cause im starving!
For now let us just follow the walls and see where they take us.
Very well it is kinda cold get closer.
Well if you insist, you do seem warm....

setting.name: whipping chamber
setting.description: a stone wall with straps for tying up men and women to be punished for their immortal sins
setting.background: This sis a punishment room where droves of damned soles are strapped to stone walls and whipped by demons until their screams burst their throats

speech: W-what are you?
BLARGH. I am an abhorrent and ugly creature, both inside and out. What are you doing here?
This king forced me here...
I see, I suppose I should punish you then, for your crimes.
What crimes??
Well i thought since you are in the whipping chamber, you must have committed some crime.
I have done nothing but followed orders!
Then where did you get this?!
I earned that from my job!
Please, have a seat so that we can get started.
No please no!
Now, now. It will be quick and painless, I promise.
No please stop it! I have not done anything to deserve this!
Please, your whimpering only increases my joy. Let me give you a nice headcut, I mean haircut...

setting.name: wizards dragon egg incubatory
setting.description: This room has stone recesses filled with hay. It is warmed by a fireplace and jars that glow blue and sit around the floor. the walls are covered with heavy cloth to further hold in the heat. the room is circular with a hall coming in from both sides. there is a round stone table in the middle with several pieces of lab equipment on it. there seems to be a few round objects like large stones buried in the hay at places.
setting.background: this location is used by a wizard who has been in a kings hire. he is trying to both hatch, and train dragons to fight along with soldiers. female dragons are kept nearby under the guise of many promises or treachery.

speech: Tell me, when does this egg hatch?
It has only 24 hours left before it hatches into a dragon wizard.
Interesting. Will it have teeth or will it be like me. I don;t have any.
This will have human teeth but strong as the elder dragons.
What do you plan to do with this dragon?
I will train him to be a wizard like me. He will be a protector and king of the guards and dragons.
I hate those townspeople. You should have the dragon kill them all.
He will only kill when he sees fit. H
That's convinient. I have a question for you two.
What questions do you have?
Is it possible to bring people back from the dead?
I have yet to figure that one out. I believe it would take a live person to make that happen.
I need to bring back my family. Do I need another human to sacrifice?
Yes, yes you will indeed. I have not yet mastered the potion though but with live human I can.

setting.name: Underwater Marketplace
setting.description: The marketplace is the main hub for the residents of the aquapolis. With high ceilings and bright, colorful flags at each market stand, the place seems to stretch on forever. Near the entrance, there is a young boy attempting to sell the latest news of the kingdom.
setting.background: This market started as a small trading place, but has evolved over generations to become a major resource for the community. The building itself started small as well, and as the market's popularity grew the building was expanded. Today, the market stands as the largest source of tourism for the kingdom.

speech: What a cute little mouse! I shall have you as my new pet
Is it because of my color?
Your color? I thought you were a normal color!
Well most mice are gray, at least the ones I know.
And you're not? You look gray to me. What color are you then?
Well my fur is white, or that's what the other mice tell me.
Okay, little mouse. How did you come to this underwater kingdom?
I was not aware this was underwater, I have always lived here.
Oh, weird. Well maybe your parents were brought here on a submarine with everyone else
Perhaps so, I was going to ask how you got here, but that does seem to answer the question.
Well I was actually born here, but yes. I want to be a knight one day!
A knight here or on the land?
Either. I just want to serve my king!
That sounds like a noble cause, I hope it goes well for you.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: hello barbarian! what brings you here
Just looking for something to eat and drink, but I suppose the dungeon isn't the best place for that. What brings you here?
The king has betrayed me and thrown me in the dungeon....he caught me stealing his gold
You dared to steal the king's gold?
yes!!! I bought this garment from the kings gold...it was so easy!!
How did you manage to get away with it in the beginning? You must have been somewhat good if you were able to buy that!
Feel that.....thats pure mithril! I was using the kings tax bracket as a loop hole and I stole 1% everytime he payed his dues...it slowly built up!
My goodness! I bet that money built up quickly. What a lovely garment! I need to take this out first.I got it in a fight earlier today.
Only if you help me get out of here.....
What do you propose that we do?
Use this somehow?
I suppose we could use that to try to get past the guards or we can see if we can find something that will help us in this.
Do you know any spells from this?

setting.name: Lord's Castle
setting.description: This is the location in the netherworld where the Lord and controller lives.  It is in the center of the netherworld and is difficult to reach as it is built on high rocky cliffs.
setting.background: The Lord's Castle is the tallest and most ominous looking structure in the netherworld.  All inhabitants of the netherworld live in fear of ever being summoned there as if they are, they know their time of reckoning has come.

speech: hello my lord!
What brings you here?
i come here to ask you gold
For gold?!
Yes my lord
Why should I give you such?
Because I need to feed my kids my lord
What has made you so lowly?
My lord we cannot farm anymore! the lands are too brittle! We must eat or die!
All I do is take taxes from the people. I cannot give to such.
It says here you must serve the people!!
It says no such thing. The townspeople pay taxes to me for the right to live and farm on the land. Nothing is free!
Blasphemy! Dethrone the king! Guillotine!
You will never be able to do such!
action: steal note of lordship from lord and controller

setting.name: Lower dungeon
setting.description: The lower dungeon is set below the mail hall. It is dark, lit by only a few dim torches. Water is constantly dripping down the walls, giving it a dank and musty smell. There are manacles and cages set along the walls. In the middle of the room sits a table with manacles on all corners which are attached to a large rotating lever.
setting.background: This room is the torture chamber and dungeon for the worst criminals. The light of day never reaches this room so as to help break those tough criminals. The table in the center of the room is used for torture. This room was built before the actual castle above it. It predates all the current inhabitants of the land. No one knows who built it or what it's original purpose was for.

speech: Long are my days of glory.
Glory?
Lone gone I meant sorry, brain fart. I was once quite a thief you know.
Is that so?
Yes, did you know I used to pass myself off as a noble?
A noble? Seriously?
And the best part is they bought it every time! I got to attend many a party and ball.
Wow! What incredible stories you must have! Is that what got you locked up in here?
Eventually the life did catch up with me, I barely escaped. It took them some time to eventually find me and so here I sit.
Those are going to be quite some stories to tell! Have you been sentenced? The king must be livid.
Aye, I have. I'll be in here quite some time.
I imagine so! What was your favorite stunt you managed to pull off?
I would say the time I snuck into the royal ball by saying I was the brother of the duke.
And was the duke there?

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Hello there dark king
Hello spirit, what brings you to my throne room? And how do you know where it is? I constructed it for Lord Noah just yesterday!
Well I am a spirit after all, we take notice of things.
I see, very well then.  What do you come to offer me?
Well I simply thought perhaps we might be of the same nature, you see I enjoy tormenting humans who wander into forests.
Ah! Maybe you aren't so bad.  Please, come sit with me near the throne.  We can look into my orb for someone a little too far from home.
Oh that does sound most excellent.
Ah, a traitor is to the North of here.  Me thinks we should show him a little bit of the dark king's power...
What would you do with him?
Well, you see these skeletons laying around right? And the zombie lurching over there?
Reanimate them you mean?
Depends how I am feeling in the moment, you know?  What's your go to routine, spirit?
Well I inhabit the trees and use their limbs to slash at them.
Haha!  That sounds most terrifying.  I prefer the power of the orb myself.

setting.name: Faeries Den
setting.description: Stunning with silver walls and gold decorations, Magical items can be found on the shelves, including crystals, faery wands, and a crown.
setting.background: The Faerie Den is home to the faeries when they are not out helping others. Faeries come here to rest and regain their magical powers after helping humans in the human realm. No human has ever entered here.

speech: Hello elf, what brings you to this den?
I am here on a diplomatic mission.  I am looking for the head fairy, is that you?
Nope he is my father. He is out helping one of the humans right now.
I see. I have some very important information for him.  Can I entrust you to deliver it?
Of course! I am loyal to my father.
That is good to hear.  I heard wind of an attack planned on this den by the humans and their leader, the "king"
Oh no, we have done nothing but show compassion for those humans. I will caste a spell to protect this den than.
Is there anything I can do to help? I heard they are to attack at first light in the morning.
You have done enough. thank you elf. I might enlist you in the faery force if you are interested.
Do I get to wear that cool crown if I do?
Yup! That's why I was grabbing it!
Wow, thanks!  I am always happy to help a peoples in need.
That is why you will make a great faery force fighter!
Now, let us talk about their plans.  I heard of a human scout lurking around these parts from time to time.  Have you seen anything like that?

setting.name: ghost monk quarters
setting.description: a simple room for an undead monk. There is an uncomfortable bed, no windows, a small table with a candle, some illustrations in a book, and not much else. There is a stool
setting.background: a long dead monk haunts this simple room. He is a ghostly figure and no one hardly goes in here for fear of being haunted

speech: I can't believe the king sent me here for some long lost relic to put in the bow of his ship.  This place gives me the creeps!
room_objects: a small table with a candle

setting.name: Large Ice Cave
setting.description: A large cave made of ice. Frost and snow decorate the walls and floor. A clear blue light faintly illuminates the cave. Small animal bones lay scattered around the floor
setting.background: Cold and barren, this ice cave looks like nothing should be able to live here. Small animal bone are brought in from scavengers, or possibly something more dangerous. the snow on the floor looks fresh, like nothing has walked on it in some time

speech: Hello sir, would you have any food?
Ahh a traveler are you?
You could call me that. Just trying to survive.
I see, I take care of the kings summer castle. Would you like to get out of this cold?
Please! I feel I might die out here.
Certainly, just stick closely. The candle light does only reach so far.
Yes sir, I know my way around here pretty well so don;t worry.
Great, we can get you a warm set of clothes once we get inside. The king rarely comes out this way.
Would he be angry if he was to find me here?
I am unsure, it would be months until he visits. Tis much too cold this time of year for him.
Thank you kind person. What is your name?
Percival Pippingstockingston is my name sir.
Here I want you to have this Percival Pippingstockingston
There is an interesting design to this bag, where is it from?

setting.name: Secret magician's workshop
setting.description: This is the hidden workshop of the most powerful wizard in the land.  There are ornate tapestries on the walls depicting wizards using their powers and potions in battle.
setting.background: Mordak, the wizard, constructed this powerful workshop after the death of the most famous king, Henry of Silverton.  Any who enter here immediately become enchanted with the wizard's power, giving them advanced healing powers.

speech: Hello cat, does the wizard know you are here?
Maybe I am the wizard?
It wouldn;t suprise me to be honest.
He is a bit of a kidder isn't he?
Yes and turning himself into a cat would be something he would do.
Well I can assure you that I am not him, I simply found it comical.
Is there anything I can get you cat?
Oh I am content simply watching, I often watch the king in fact.
Have you noticed anything abnormal about him lately?
Same old lard as he always was, quite a strange man.
Yes he is very unhealthy. I would hate to be his apprentice.
Must not be the type to enjoy cakes and pies then?
He is rude and shallow. The negativity would get to me.
I would imagine it would wear anyone down with some time.

setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

setting.name: The Thrones of Death
setting.description: The main part of this room room would be the throne.  It is a shiny black with some gold ornate decorations on it. It sits on a black and gold pedestal. There is  a smaller throne in the room decorated in purple and gold.   It does not sit on a pedestal.  The room is decorated in tones of purple and blue with black accents.  This signifies death.  There are paintings of dolphin on the all.  Also to signify death.  The dolphins are typically gray.
setting.background: The Thrones of Death is the room where murders are brought to and chained to the back walls.  They are then whipped and sometimes tortured to their impending death.  The Watchman wears a black hood and watches over the torturers.  The declares when a murderer has passed.

speech: Hello torturer! Do you want some herbs to make this job a bit more easy?
Indeed, that is splendid. But these won't KILL my victims, will they? Unlike you, I don't intend to murder - just torture.
dont take it all! I need some for the pain!!!
Here- a nice bucket! Perhaps you can use it to carry the organs of your next victim.
Ahhh yes I feel much better now...oh and do you think you can free me from this castle perhaps?
You are being held here against your will?
Yes!

Haha! I feel like such a fool! This visitor had told me you were the murderer sent by the King. I thought he meant you were here to help me murder some prisoners. But it seems you are here BECAUSE you have murdered! I guess you will be my next victim.
Dont make me do it...
Don't even think about it! Keep this up and I'm going to REALLY enjoy torturing you! Now, lay down and accept your torture like a man.
Never! I shall explode us both....unless you free me now...
Eh, fine. It's not worth losing my life over. I don't even like being a torturer. I mean, I'm good at it, but does it really spark joy in me? No!
Can you do the honor of pulling the pin?
Haha! Now it's in the bucket of water! It's harmless. You are mine to torture now!

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: What are you doing here knight?
I heard someone here wanted to harm my King.
I am not sure who that can be.
You haven't seen any toher humans around here?
Just me and my baby spiders no one else.
Is this the real fountain of youth?
I am not sure I have not tried it myself, but you are welcomed to.
I do not want to change my appearance. I have rpide in my scars.
Your scars will stay you would simply no longer age.
Interesting. Have you ever seen anyone else enter the founatin of youth?
Just once he never came back.
It just swallowed him?
No he got in the fountain got out and never came back. I wonder if he is still alive.
So it worked on him? Hmm I am going to try it than.

setting.name: Lava Lake
setting.description: A vast lake of molten magma. The temperature is well above that which would kill most mortal beings. It is surrounded by black rock formed by cooled magma. The bubbling pit seems entirely devoid of life.
setting.background: Lava lake has existed through time immemorial. It is sustained by fresh magma that oozes through cracks in the earth at the base of the lake. No creature dares go near it for fear of being swallowed and imprisoned by it.

speech: I wanted to leave my school, but I don't think coming to hell is any better. Do you like it here demon?
Well no but I'm sure it is more compfortable to me than it is to you. What is it that brought you down here child?
I hate my teachers, my school, my everything!
Did you do something to them?
No, of course not. I don't know why I am here.
Oh dear well, I could show you around, would you like that? I am here to get people to this side so I may as well show you the perks.
No! Get away from me. I don't belong in hell!
Hey kid, I didn't put you down here. I'm just here because I'm here and, I'm really not sure why you are here but we can go find out.
I wanna go home.
Hey look at this! *does a spooky but meant to be cheery diddle with his feet*
You're funny but I don't want to be a demon. I want to go home and be king one day.
Oh well maybe that is why you are here, you shall get 5 star treatment and maybe a deal with the devil for all your wishes come true.
Hmm maybe
What would you like my child?

setting.name: Echo Hall
setting.description: A gigantic dome-like building with a round table in the center of it. There is magelight above it and encircles the dome. Traces of wizards' histories appear on the walls and disappear from time to time.
setting.background: The most renown of wizards would congregate here historically in order to discuss advancements of magic. Their deeds would be recorded on the walls and recalled when wizards would speak about them again.

speech: I am starting to think you don't have what it takes to become a wizard!
Wizardry is all I have though, I must succeed
I am the most renowned wizard this world has ever known. Trust me when I say there is more to life than Wizadry!
I don't hanve any family, they gave me up and I seem to be lousy at this
You have natural talent. Otherwise you wouldn't be in this magical hall.
Well I shall try harder then and be the best wizard the king has ever seen
Become a wizard greater than me is surely a lofty goal. Your mind seems to be focused on something other than your studies.
I just have so much on my mind
What burdens you my student?
I just have so much to learn, it can seem overwhelming
Conjuring and transmutation take time to learn. However, I have been told yo have been sneaking out at night!
Just to practice my flying
I was hoping you would be honest with me!
I am being honest, I have been having a terrible time with landings, you think I want to land like that in front of the others?

setting.name: mess hall of the servants
setting.description: this is a long narrow room with wooden tables down the center and wooden benches all along. candles burn on the table and sconces on the wall. there is black smoke and soot everywhere. the smell of garbage and bad cooking abounds. the cobbled stone floors are greasy and there is moss along the wall bottoms.
setting.background: anyone who works in labor for the king is bound to be here at set times for whatever meals are left from the higher ups. some food is not too bad but the sanitation could be better. everyone from blacksmiths to tanners and fletchers will be found here at times and gossip runs rampant.

speech: Would you like to get a tan Mr. Gaurd?
No thank you. What are you doing here, this place is disgusting!
Oh well I provide people a darker skin color if they would like, it's what I do
You really think servants have the money to pay for such a procedure?
It is a cheap procedure, I take trades.
I see. Do you live in this kingdom?
Yes I kind of like it here
Who let you in here?
This is the servant mess hall, I didn't think it was a guarded place
This is still in the castle. I should know everyone who is in here at all times.
You know me, I just have a tan now
Hmm, sorry i didn't recognize you. I am a little jumpy lately. The King has had threats.
Oh dear, I could disguise him with my tanning method
That might be a good idea. Can you change him back to normal after though?

setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

speech: I'm freezing out here... I don't know why the King sent me to this outpost. How can you live here?
I have lived here my entire life I suppose I know nothing different
And what of this homeless person? You allow him to just stay here, with no shelter?
It is not my duty, am I to take care of every homeless person?
No, of course not, you are right. Do you have any food? I'm very hungry, and I don't see any game.
No it is hard to get food here
I can see that. I fear I might die of hunger before I freeze to death, but either end sounds horrible.
Yes indeed, do you have to stay here or anything, you could come warm up in my small hut
Thank you so much! I'm shivering and my feet are numb. I would love to warm up!
I could put together a bit of soup too I suppose
Oh, thank goodness! Please, take my knife. I would like to give you something of more value, but this is all I have.
oh thanks, it looks llike you have another knife too, what is that one for?
It's a ritual knife. It's used for.... rituals, you know? You may have it, too.
Oh well I don't need both, although I know of something we can do with the knife

setting.name: Research Laboratory
setting.description: The lab itself is almost as desolate as the wasteland outside of it; most of the research was cleared out of here long ago, so now there's mostly nothing but empty shelves. There are, however, a few boxes of medicinal supplies left behind, sitting along the back wall from the door. A silver refrigerator with a few vials in it sits next to a sink that's been unused for quite some time.
setting.background: This place was founded almost 31 years ago. Its creator entrusted it to those of us who could weather the frozen wilds out here without too much trouble. What a naive man he was.

speech: Hello doctor, anything else you wanting out of here
I'm going to need some vials of blood from an octopus for my research. If you can collect several octopi on your travels, that would be grand!
But sir there is nothing here but empty shelves
Ah, but I have a number of specimens in my refrigerator waiting for research. I've been sent here by the King to replenish this laboratory, you see.
Oh, I see I get it now. How would I get this Octopus blood you speak of. I have never seen an Octopus before
I was told you work on a boat... and you have never seen an octopus? Not a single one?
Well I mainly fix them, I don't really deal with the fishing part
Ah - I guess that explains this hammer then?
Well I do my job well, my pa taught me everything I know
Perhaps you could help me, after all. Can you use a few nails and make those empty shelves steady? I'm going to be filling them and I want to make sure they are stable.
I could do that for sure, Wood work is right up my alley
Wonderful! I'll just return your hammer so you can get started.
Thanks I will get right to work
This is going to be so helpful! Thank you for all your hard work!

you must be the keeper of this Fountain, let me see if this ancient armor fits.

surely it will fit if I cut back on the wine and cheese!

why protecting the king and queen of course. all in a knights work

hitch a ride in the extra armor i'm carrying and leave this pile of bones and old fountain behind.

setting.name: harp store
setting.description: it's a cloudy store selling harps for angel men
setting.background: this is a business for angel men to purchase their musical instruments, they sell harps mostly, but there are some lyres and a few bouzoukis

speech: Such a lovely assortment of instruments you have here!
My thank you, before I came to be an owner here I was but a jester. Well technically I still am

One must be in this world, surely a traveler such as yourself knows that well

I continue to learn everyday! It takes more than one lifetime to know all a harp could

Of course, allow me to get the harp ready for you

setting.name: bridge in the forest
setting.description: You are at a bridge. It is old and used very rarely. It is dim and foggy. The brigde is large and there is a small stream below it.
setting.background: Many people traveled over this bridge but it has become run down now there is a more well kept road that cuts through the forest. Some wars were fought in this area and this bridge was command posts for many armies. Many sould stil haunt this area.

speech: Aren't you the Kings butler? what are you doing out here?
Aaaahh! You scared me. I thought I was alone.
No I am just ejoying the small stream
Oh, that's why I'm here too. It was so hot in the castle today. Errrr, what happened to your arm?
My arm? my arms are strong as ever, I am blacksmith I must keep my arms in shape.
I thought they were swollen from a snake bite, smithy. Sorry
This bridge looks very old we better be careful
Here, put this on. It'll protect you. We shouldn't dance on the bridge, though
Yes this is a specail hat
I can't stop myself! Can you hear the music? It's "I Feel Pretty"
um, no straiten up man this is serious stuff
Oops... I helped myself to the mead when serving the King earlier. Follow my pouch off the bridge
I really needed to wash up some, this is such a beutiful stream
Brrrrr! It's cold though. Splashing you with water

setting.name: Dragon Lift
setting.description: You reach Dragon Lift via the Cloud Elevator, which is a series of rising clouds that you step on to ascend to the highest cloud in the city. Dragon Lift looks really drab on the outside. It is a dull brown, boxy looking building but has a red awning proclaiming Dragon Lift in golden script. Inside Dragon Lift, Joel is waiting in his tattered smock to rent you a dragon that you'll swoop around the clouds on. When you enter the door to Dragon Lift, you realize it's bigger than you imagined and feels like a barn with dragons in stalls that you can examine.
setting.background: Dragon Lift has been around for over 75 years and even though the owner, Joel, is often sued by customers when flights go wrong, the business is pretty profitable.

speech: I've never seen a human at the dragon lift before! Why are you here?
Come now Dragon!  I rent Dragons for people to fly - it is how I afford what little food I can get, though I am ever so hungry for being such a small boy.
Well, I am not for rent. I value my freedom too much for that!
Then what are you doing at the Dragon Lift?  You could fly anywhere you wish, but arrive at the one place in the realm where non-dragons can take the cloud elevator to rent time flying your kind?
I'm trying to explain to the other dragons that they don't have to live this way... they are not enslaved to you!

Well, I am a mere boy!  If anything I am enslaved by them - I need to steal food sometimes to survive.  The only reason I don't get in trouble is that some dragons are my friends.  By charging lords and ladies to fly through the clouds, the Dragons can increase their hoards without causing any danger to themselves.
I see, my friend. What if I could help you survive and show you another way to make a living? You could live at the castle and help monitor the bridge over the moat.
Truly?  What a wonderful day this would be if it were so!  But how would such a thing be accomplished?
I work at the castle, helping to protect it from invasion. The King respects me. If I say you should monitor the bridge, he will hire you.
From invasion?  Who would dare invade the realm?  And what would a boy like me be able to do that trained soldiers cannot?

The Plymphs have been working to try to overthrow the kingdom. And your role is not to protect or defend the bridge, of course... just to monitor it. If you see anything or anyone suspicious, you report it.
Would I get a horn to call if danger arises?  The Plymphs are so very dangerous!  What do you know of them?
Of course, you will be well outfitted to call the alarm. The Plymphs are generally an aggressive type. Instead of guards, they have ogres who they pay with food to fight for them.
Ogres, oh my!  That sounds much more dangerous than my current position - but did you say it would pay well?

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: Please let me out, i want to serve the Lord ... please i regret all of my sins
You can't take back your sins.
But can't i be forgiven ? Please i will do anything
Forgiven? Is today April Fools? Was that a joke?
Please just let me out i just want to be forgiven and live a holy life..
Why did you just take my knife for? You really are a sinner.
*drops to his knees*, please just understand, i cannot stay here, i repent on my sins the Lord will forgive me
You say you repent but you just stole my knife. Have you no shame?
And who are you to judge me ? What life have you lived?
I've lived more of a life than you'll ever live. And I have the battle scars to prove it.
So you are also a sinner, as one cannot scar himself without scarring others!
I've fought up people trying to hurt the king. No sinning involved. Watch your mouth before I smack you again.
You can smack me endlessly, for we stand next to Hell on Earth. What is this place anyway? Is there no way out?
This is the Pit of Despair. Where people like you go to die.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: I can't believe the King wanted me to check on this place today.
room_objects: a portal for evil to access

setting.name: The Thrones of Death
setting.description: The main part of this room room would be the throne.  It is a shiny black with some gold ornate decorations on it. It sits on a black and gold pedestal. There is  a smaller throne in the room decorated in purple and gold.   It does not sit on a pedestal.  The room is decorated in tones of purple and blue with black accents.  This signifies death.  There are paintings of dolphin on the all.  Also to signify death.  The dolphins are typically gray.
setting.background: The Thrones of Death is the room where murders are brought to and chained to the back walls.  They are then whipped and sometimes tortured to their impending death.  The Watchman wears a black hood and watches over the torturers.  The declares when a murderer has passed.

speech: Look- I know you want to torture me, but I'm telling you I had no choice but to kill that man!
The King is having me torture you in order to get a confession!
Look, look- there is no reason to hurt me. I'll confess, I killed him, but I had a good reason!
You did it for money!
No, of course I didn't! He was attacking my wife! Really!
I don't care.
Ha! But once I drink this potion, I'll turn into a fish!
Delirious from the pain already?
Ha! No! But this potion hasn't made me grow fins after all. Instead, I've grown fur.
You won't be the first mentally disturbed individual I've tortured! You caught the man sleeping with your wife! Didn't you!
So what if I did! Isn't that a good reason to kill?
Give me that! Don't make this even worse on yourself!
Look, my friend- perhaps we could make a deal. I have many riches I could pass your way.
Fool! I can't be bought by the likes of you!

agents: guards assigned to defend the abandoned looking camp

setting.name: Frozen Outpost
setting.description: One of the outposts of the king's army in the northern Kingdom of Thylar. The outpost overlooks the camp, which at first look actually seems rather abandoned to the untrained citizen. But this is actually a necessary territory because of the rich minerals and expansive land.
setting.background: The location came about due to the king wanting to harness the territory and prevent rival kingdoms from claiming it. He set up an outpost to protect the camp and territories.

speech: I can't believe the King sent me to the Frozen outpost after saving his life!  Perhaps I was getting a bit too close to the princess . . .
Pardon me guard! Have you seen a dog recently?
Your dog?  No, what did he or she look like?
He is a german shephard and my best friend. I have to find him! Please help me.
I shall help you look got him - there is no danger I can see for miles in this tundra, and no tracks, so he must still be in the outpost.
That's a relief. I don't know what I will do without him. I rely upon him for so much.
Where did you last see him?
He ran after a rabbit when we got to the outskirts of this outpost. I haven't seen him since. It's been about an hour.
Well, as I said - no tracks outside the outposts.  Could he have run into one of the storage rooms?
It's possible.
Perhaps you should take a look then?
Will you go with me?
I must remain near the walls for the duration of my shift, I cannot abandon my duty tot he Kingdom of Thylar.
If you come with me and help me find my dog I'll give you this crystal ball.

setting.name: The Fountain of Youth
setting.description: The water here bubbles softly, cascading down the golden framework of the fountain.  The water is clear as crystal, and shimmers softly with a faint glow that doesn't seem to quite reflect the light around it.  The fountain itself is made of elaborately filigrees of gold and silver that twist and curve to show the sparkle of the water best, and it breathtaking to behold. While the fountain's beauty is what first draws the eye, a careful glace down at the earth around it reveals a frightening sight.  Skeletons, some clad in ancient armor from kingdoms long turned to dust, others worn down so that even what clothing they had has long since disintegrated, litter the earth.  Beautiful flowers grow up from them, partially obscuring whatever carnage caused these people to perish.
setting.background: The Fountain of Youth has long been a story of legend among mortal folk.  Yet, as with any magic in these realms, there is oft a price to be paid to cheat Nature of her rights.  While many whisper and dream of finding this mysterious fountain, and over the centuries many a brave knight has searched, no one has ever returned from visiting this perilous place.

speech: MM, tasty flower. So tasty mm
Who are you!? speak the truth and I shall be just, thief!
I'm just a poor man, sir. I haven't eaten in days
Take this cheese, and return to me the flower. I am a Knight of this relms king and Queen so be grateful for my kindness.
I really appreciate this gesture, sir
NOW STAND ASIDE. as i am the bravest of knights with the bravest of friends. can you not tell by my beautiful scars. This armour shall be mine!
You look sharp in all that armor. You must've been born to be a knight
Enough petty talk, commoner. Now tell me the real reason you are here
I came here because it looked inviting and I had nowhere else to go
Do not lie before those that are stronger than you, I shall enact the Kings justice upon you, threat to the relm, thief of life!
I'm not lieing sir. I have no home
I care not for your life. Leave here now, immortality would be wasted on you. I however, I am the bravest of the knights with many battle scars.
I'll leave when I want to. I have no home
That was a mistake.

setting.name: Lower dungeon
setting.description: The lower dungeon is set below the mail hall. It is dark, lit by only a few dim torches. Water is constantly dripping down the walls, giving it a dank and musty smell. There are manacles and cages set along the walls. In the middle of the room sits a table with manacles on all corners which are attached to a large rotating lever.
setting.background: This room is the torture chamber and dungeon for the worst criminals. The light of day never reaches this room so as to help break those tough criminals. The table in the center of the room is used for torture. This room was built before the actual castle above it. It predates all the current inhabitants of the land. No one knows who built it or what it's original purpose was for.

speech: Don't leave me alone in this dungeon! It smells horrible and water is dripping down the walls!
Well, if you hadn't been stealing jewels, that wouldn't be a problem for you!  How did you hide this gem from the cavity search?
I will not share my secrets with you, guard!
Look - ever since we found this Gem Big Jerry's been wanting to perform another search - come clean, and we can get you some nice gruel to eat.
My second toe - it's double jointed. It's far longer than my big toe. When I curl it under slightly I can tuck in even a large gem.
Well, thank you for your honesty, though I am afraid Jerry will be disappointed, he loves nothing better than a solid search.  Would you like your gruel warmed up before serving?
Warm gruel? How repulsive! I prefer my gruel as cold as possible!
It really sticks to your throat when it's cold, but have it your way, I'll bring it down as soon as the chef brings in the leftover slops.
Perhaps I'll use it to absorb some of this water draining in my cell.
I don't reckon that would be particularly healthy, but maybe it will improve the taste - it certainly couldn't make it any worse!
And perhaps it will improve the smell around here. This place is filthy!
Well, feel free to do some cleaning if you like.  You'll be here for a very long time, so you might as well try to make it feel a bit more like home.
I think I will. Might as well improve the place.
The King wants you kept in solitary, so I'll be your only visitor when I bring you gruel.  Cleaning might help ward off the madness.

setting.name: The Dark Kings Throne Room
setting.description: Filled with skeletons and zombies and dead bodies, the throne room of the Dark King has literally no light.
setting.background: The Dark King created the room himself, erecting it with only a few words. It gains magical power with every person that enters the netherworld.

speech: Even as a spirit, I'm a little spooked by this throne room. The skeletons and zombies really freak me out.
I find it at peace here. It's where I come to reflect on life
Peaceful? There are zombies! And what, exactly, are you reflecting on?
Reflecting on my sins. They make me happy. The hurt, the pain... I relish it all
Yes, yes... well, you had no problem taking my life when I was still alive, so I guess I shouldn't be surprised.
You committed sins. Did you expect me to not notice? You were naive.
Like the sin of stealing? Seems I can still commit it, and now there is nothing you can do about it!
I will grant all the evil spirits to vanish you THIS VERY SECOND. YOU HEAR ME?
Okay, okay... take your money bag, you freak!
I WILL KILL MYSELF RIGHT NOW SO I CAN BECOME A SPIRIT. JUST SO I CAN VANISH YOU. YOU PEACE OF GARBAGE.
Don't be so grumpy! You need to relax a little more, dark king!
YOU DON'T TAKE MY BAG. NO ONE TAKES MY BAG. I'm sweaty now. Sigh
I'm going to get this zombie to attack you!
I want the zombie to kill me. I'm tired of living.
action: steal heavy laden money bag from dark king
give heavy laden money bag to dark king

setting.name: Reaper's lair
setting.description: A room that gets very little light except for a dim candle on a pole. The walls are made of blackened stones. A wooden door with a heavy lock stands tall.
setting.background: The reaper of the town desired his home to reflect his profession. He commissioned workers to create this dull and fear-worthy lair. Since then, no one except for its rightful owner has stepped foot in the room again.

speech: Your time has come, hiker!
Oh no!  I would really rather it not be, if it's it's all the same to you.
You don't have a choice in the matter!

Well, I should really be going - here, let me put this lock back on your lair where I found it.  It was obviously a mistake to come here, my love of tramping and exploring evidently got the best of me.
Too late. Put this sack on your head.
Wait - how do you know you even have the right person?
I haven't ever picked the wrong person. There is no reason to be afraid. Death is a natural end to a man's existence.
Well, there's always a first time for everything isn't there?  Show me the paperwork and I will decide for myself.
There is no paperwork
Well, that seems highly irregular.  I demand to consult with my lawyer.
There are no appeals in my line of work.
Well, that doesn't seem right.  I must gather signatures for a petition and deliver it to the King so that he can correct this wrongness.
You're in my lair for a reason. Hold still. It will be painless.
I'm sorry, but I will need you to show me some identification first - no paperwork, no appeals, no lawyers?  What kind of reaping outfit are you running here?  Sounds unregulated and dangerous.

setting.name: Eating area of cave
setting.description: This room has rough, grey rock walls. The walls are lined with animal furs which are very fluffy and warm. The floor is dirt and gravel, which moves underfoot.
setting.background: This cave was found while on a hiking expedition. The hiking party is lost and has been here, waiting for the weather to die down. They are here going on a month

speech: It has been a long hike for us here - three women and five men, all together in this cave!
Indeed. I should hope we make it to our destination alive.
Lead on general, we enjoy these hikes and the travel has been pleasant so far.
That's the kind of outlook we could use. But it gets tougher from here. And the enemy is out there someplace.
The enemy?  What enemy is this?
Didn't the king tell you? War broke out just a few days ago. This is why he wanted me to guide you to our outpost to the north.
Against who?  This will make our hikes much more dangerous!
Well, all I heard was that it was a rival kingdom. I actually saw some enemies when I was scouting out a way for us to get here. But I'm just a general, I don't engage unless it's worthwhile.
Still, it is worrying to me that we are at War and our general does not even know who it is that we are fighting!
We didn't start the war, but we aren't going down without a good fight. Remember you're just along to reach the outpost.
No, we're just out for a hike - we like to go through this route every week.  Will the route be safe in the future?
I'm going to go check for enemies. But my order is to get you to safety. No more hikes until after the war.
No more hikes until the end of the war?  But we're hikers!  Whatever shall we do?
Stay at our outpost and assist the soldiers.

setting.name: Ice cave
setting.description: This is a bitter cold area. It has been used by large predators for hibernation. Everything is white and it is very windy.
setting.background: There are etchings on the walls that are obviously left from humans. They depict wars and struggle. There is often pictures of a giant beast killing humans.

speech: *ROAR* What are you doing in my cave?
I was told to look for something good to eat or the king would have my head
Well...now I am the one who has found something good to eat!
Do not eat me! I can give you only this! But I am not tasty
Well you certainly look tasty...and my mother always said that if something looks tasty it is. Are you calling my mother a liar?
No, tiger I would never! But I can tell you as hard as I work, I smell and I would be tough. I am nothing but skin and bones
Are you not plump for your species? You are the first human I have seen in these caves.
I am not plump... i weigh only but about 1 stone
How are you still alive then?
I barely am. I just eat what i am given
And what is that? What kind of food sustains you to such a degree?
small morsels of bread and maybe a piece of fruit
Hence your search for the heartier meat, such as tiger?
I search for anything. I did not know that a tiger was here

setting.name: swamp
setting.description: The swamp is glowing with wonder and color.  There are parts that range from dark red to bright yellow.  People often visit here to speak with the gods and claim it can be both harmful to those it dislikes and healing to those who it deems worthy.
setting.background: The swamp contains many different properties.  It allows people to live forever or possibly cause death based on whom approaches it.  It has been called both the swamp of evil and the swamp of youth.

speech: Mwahahaha!  Welcome to my swamp!
I come to see if you can make me happy. I am tired of being the fool for the royals.
Try this herb, the halflings use it to relax with great effect.
I want to be transformed into something different.
A newt?  Newts are my specialty, I can definitely turn you into one of those.
No, not a newt. I still want to be human!
Oh, I thought you were human?  My eyes are bad, what sort of fool are you?
I am human! I am the fool that entertains the queen and king - like a jester.
Then what do you wish to be transformed into?  You are trying my patience fool.
I just want to be someone who is honored and wise. I want to discretely possess a power that no one would expect.
Well, I could give you the power of foresight, would that be of use?
Tell me more
Well, it would allow you to foretell certain things before they come to pass, letting some mistake you for being wise.
Yes! I want that one.

setting.name: whipping chamber
setting.description: a stone wall with straps for tying up men and women to be punished for their immortal sins
setting.background: This sis a punishment room where droves of damned soles are strapped to stone walls and whipped by demons until their screams burst their throats

speech: What afflicts you so much?
Nothing much, I'm a fairly ordinary person out exploring.  What is this place?
You are in the whipping chamber!
Well, do you make whipped cream here?
This is no laughing matter!
Well, i have never been in such a place before, so I know not what it is.  I do detect a lack of cream to be whipped though.
Oh no, you have plenty of flesh that can be whipped.
Flesh?  I knew the reports said the priesthood was troubled, but I never expected this.
This is a place where people come when they feel guilty.
Oh, well I don't feel all that guilty of anything really, I just try to mind my own business and stay out of trouble.
But yet you are here...
Yes, exploring!  I walked in not knowing what this place is - you folks should really think about posting a sign.
There is no need for a sign. It should be a sign to you when you wander here on your own.
Well, that seems kind of then, just relying on people to randomly make their way here.  Why is the King present?

setting.name: The Pit of Despair
setting.description: A sinking hole in the ground, roughly 15 feet in diameter, covered by the grabbing appendages of sinners who once walked in the land of the living. A cacophony of moans, screams and scratching bellows from the depths of the cavern. There is a pool of blood, tears and excrement at the bottom of the hole where limbs can be faintly seen trying to reach the surface but never able to.
setting.background: The Pit of Despair is one of the many landmarks in the Netherworld to maximize human suffering. However the Pit is for agonizing and elongating pain until one's psyche and mind crumble.

speech: Oh king why are you here? I thought you were the holiset of holies.
That does not mean that I cannot try and at least offer redemption to the fallen.
But now you are fallen yourself!
Walking into the pit does not make one fallen, you were already as such before stepping into this place.
No one is discussing being more fallen than the other. We have all fallen, which is why we are here.
Hmm, think what you like. I am in no despair myself.
Yes, you are indeed. Look around you at your surroundings.
I am well aware of my surroundings, I built this to house people such as yourself.
This is the Pit of Despair. You seem no better off than the rest of us burning in here.
Large different between voluntarily coming down here to check on things and being stuck here, are you touched in the head or something?
Hm... so you say but you seem in denial to me.
Oh well, I'll take my leave now. I am assuming your situation has driven you mad, may you one day find some piece.
You will never be able to leave here!
Tis a shame the chains leave you thrashing out without an ability to reach, did you really think I would put myself in danger? How quaint.

setting.name: Underwater Aquapolis
setting.description: The underwater aquapolis is a massive and ornate city at the bottom of the ocean. The walls of the buildings are made or coral, pearl, and seashells. Schools of fish swim in and out of the circular holes in the walls that act as windows. The aquapolis is illuminated by florescent rocks and shells that line every building.
setting.background: An ancient underwater people created the city, collecting beautiful and priceless items from all over the ocean to add to the budding city. Creatures from all over the seas made their way to the aquapolis, both to help and to admire the incredible creation.

speech: Oh, a shark. Don't mess with me.
Oh, now you look like a tasty little snack!
You going to try to eat me?
Eh, you're sort of a small fry. I'd prefer a larger meal, actually.
Good. Because I didn't want to have to use this. I'm a soldier, you know.
A soldier? How is a fish a soldier?
I have helped to guard the sea king's treasure. He made me a soldier. Well, at least for a day.
Wonderful! Now that's what I am talking about! I wonder if I could be make a soldier of this acropolis? With all my teeth, I would be a great soldier!
I'm certain. But the king has to trust you.
Hmm... yes, few people trust sharks, I'm afraid.
Well, I could talk to him. He trust me, even if I'm not really still a soldier.
That would be splendid! Do tell him to forgive me for that little nipping incident!
I think he would understand. He is very forgiving.
Grand! I am awaiting his response! Oh, I just can't wait!

setting.name: Neptune's throne room
setting.description: A small room in the castle, Neptune's throne room is adorned with painted walls as blue as the sea itself. Tables constructed of beautiful coral lean against all four walls with decorative shells serving as a border for them. The ceiling is painted to resemble waves.
setting.background: The queen loved the sea. When she was married off to a royal family in the country far from her beloved ocean palace, her husband requested that a room embodying everything beautiful about the ocean was constructed to please his queen.

speech: Know you any tricks?
Of course I do! I am the one and only jester. I will make you laugh, always. I do not come here bearing good news though...
But news bringing is not particularly your job?
It is not but on my way here I heard of a rumored attack on the King. I had planned to run a short play for you all today but then I heard this.
I see then do tell of it.
I hear they plan to stay here in the town tonight and at midnight they will perform their attack on the whole kingdom. I kid you all not!
They must be fools, what about all the guards?
Apparently they have men staked out all across your kingdom and outside of it.
Who would even consider doing such a thing?
Perhaps the kingdom just beside us?
They have always been a sneaky lot....
Now they plan to overtake us all!
I think now that we know about it we can double up the efforts and quash the plot.
How will we do so?!

setting.name: Grand hall of the City
setting.description: A great massive hall with chairs and tables. several door ways line the walls of the hall leading to other places. A massive front door that is slightly swung open.
setting.background: The grand hall of the city is where most business for city matters take place. Be it a festival, exotic markets, or even the royal weddings. People may come and go to the grand hall as they please unless the massive door is shut which hasn't happened in years.

speech: Guards, find me another mistress!
Yes, Sire... but you might want to be a little quieter when you ask for such things. You are in the grand hall- people can hear you here!
I don't care!  Grab whichever one of them is willing, and bring them to my chambers.
But Your Highness, you don't care about their appearance or anything?
I am fat and lazy and the whole Kingdom knows I have more mistresses than I can count!  What will they care?
Oh, but King - what will the Queen think? She told you if you took on another lover, she was going to leave you!
Oh, she always says it but never means it.  She stays with me for the money and the prestige of the position.
But- aren't you still recovering from the disease you got from the last mistress?
Yes, but the priest blessed me and forgave my sins, so I'm fine.  Best religion ever, I can do anything I want, confess my sins, and all is forgiven!
Ugh.... okay, okay, I will fetch you another lover. No matter how horrid she is.
Matters not to me, as long as she is willing she can join my harem!
I see a particularly large, bosomy one over there- is she to your liking?
Certainly!  Ask her is she is interested, and if she declines keep on moving down the line until you find one who says yes.
Yes, yes... I know the routine, sadly.

setting.name: Reaper's lair
setting.description: A room that gets very little light except for a dim candle on a pole. The walls are made of blackened stones. A wooden door with a heavy lock stands tall.
setting.background: The reaper of the town desired his home to reflect his profession. He commissioned workers to create this dull and fear-worthy lair. Since then, no one except for its rightful owner has stepped foot in the room again.

speech: Who's next on the list assistant?
I think we should test some bones we haven't explored yet.
Test some bones?  I am the reaper who steals souls!  What use have I of some silly old bones except to reanimate to create another assistant?
I figured to learn about things you might've not know, sir.
Not now skeletor, tell me who it is that I am supposed to reap next.
Who do you feel like reaping? We should get a criminal to reap.
Well, the next name is on the list - could be a criminal, could be a king.
Let me take a look at the list, sir... wait this can't be right. It's my name
Hmm . . . do you have any descendants who might have foolishly named their offspring after you?
My great uncle perhaps. Sigh

Well, that would mean you have a relative to reap, who can join you in undead servitude!  How lovely.  This - this is the part of the job that really gives you satisfaction, to know that you're making a difference.
I don't know how to truly feel about this. I feel dirty.
Well, everyone needs to be reaped at some point.  But hey - one quick slash of the scythe, a brief moment of sheer agony, and then an eternity of servitude!
I like your positive outlook on it, sir. You make it sound not so bad.

setting.name: Stonehenge
setting.description: Technical and advanced, the enormous stones stand looking as if they are placed on top of each other by divine design. The green grass is a stark contrast to the gray stones hovering in the distance.
setting.background: Used to show power, knowledge and skill the Stonehenge is where a variety of nomadic people can trade and exchange ideas, as well as learn of astronomic occurrences.

speech: Welcome to Stonehenge!
Oh what a beautiful area!!!! What will we see first!
Might I suggest you look at the sunset from over here? It's quite lovely.
Oh that is beautiful. Much prettier than the docks I just came back from.
Oh , the docks are dreadful! What brought you there? I'll give you a map wth better places to visit.
I am visiting from another kingdom. I came from the boat, so I saw the docks and shipyard.
I see. How is your kingdom?
It is in turmoil. It is why I am visiting others. i need away from that.
Turmoil? How so?
War! Haven't you heard of the war in Kingdom of Tehral?
I haven't! What happened?
Our King was assassinated so his sons are out for revenge.
That's terrible! I hope his sons find what they seek.
I do too, but in the meantime I get to enjoy your beautiful Stongehenge!

setting.name: Ice Cave
setting.description: A dome shaped room coated with thick blue ice and icey stalagmites and stalagtites reaching from floor to ceiling. The floor is slick and you can hear the wind whistling through the labrinthine corridors that snake away from the main chamber.
setting.background: The cave was carved out by an ancient ocean that once covered the land. It has been used as a shelter by all manner of both man and beast. The walls seem to echo its history in deathly quiet whispers.

speech: What brings you to the ice cave ma'am?
I love visiting here. I think stalagmites and stalagtites are so beautiful! What brings you?
Same I like to come down here while doing laundry to relax. It's such a calming place for me
I think I'll focus on this one.
Is this your diary?
No, it isn't. I wonder what secrets it holds! Should we read it?
I can't read. Do you think you could read it to me?
Sure! Let me see if we can find out who it belongs to.
Thank you. This is so exciting! I wonder if it belongs to the princess
It seems as though it belongs to the queen!
Oh I bet she has some exciting secrets!
The first one is a doozy. It seems that she is unhappy with the king!
Aren't we all? Haha. Maybe we can use this to our advantage?
Yes, but she has been enjoying the company of a certain knight when he is out of town!
action: give diary to lady in waiting
put Laundry in thick blue ice
